SM Meherob Hasan remained unbeaten with eight runs.Khaled Ahmed, Ebadot Hossain and Rejaur Rahman Raja picked up one wicket each instead of 32, 36 and 43 runs respectively.

title: Rajshahi ready to host International Tennis
body: BSS, Rajshahi : Rajshahi Tennis Complex is all set to host the J-30 International (U-18) Tennis Championship-2025, scheduled to begin tomorrow. A total of 58 players, including 38 from 19 countries, are expected to participate in the forthcoming week-long international tournament. Convener of the tennis complex Muhammad Habibur Rahman said all necessary preparations are now in the final stage. Tennis courts have been painted and floodlights installed. Initially, a total of 149 players from home and abroad had registered to take part in the tournament. However, a number of Indian and Nepalese players withdrew their names due to the Durga Puja festival. Habibur Rahman said the players are scheduled to arrive from today. “We have arranged accommodation for them in Parjatan Motel and two other hotels in the city,” he added. Rajshahi Divisional Commissioner Khondoker Azim Ahmed is expected to attend the inaugural ceremony on Saturday afternoon as the chief guest.

title: PSG battle back to earn gritty 2-1 win at Barca
body: Agency : Paris St Germain (PSG) battled back from a goal down to grab a late 2-1 win over Barcelona in a gripping Champions League encounter on Wednesday, with the defending champions overcoming a raft of injuries to secure a valuable away victory. Substitute Goncalo Ramos bagged the winner in the 90th minute for the holders, who had fallen behind early on before taking control of the match. It was PSG’s third consecutive triumph over Barcelona in the Catalan capital and maintained their perfect start to the Champions League campaign, after they opened with a 4-0 win over Atalanta. Barcelona, lifted by the return of 18-year-old Lamine Yamal, started well. The Ballon d’Or runner-up, who had missed their opening win at Newcastle United, sparkled from the get-go, showcasing his ability in the second minute with a mazy dribble and cross that Ferran Torres failed to convert. Yet their pressure paid off in the 19th minute when Marcus Rashford delivered a precise pass across the box to Torres, who slid in to beat the offside trap and slot past PSG goalkeeper Lucas Chevalier. PSG, however, responded tenaciously despite missing captain Marquinhos and their starting attacking trio of Ousmane Dembele, Khvicha Kvaratskhelia and Desire Doue in addition to midfielder Joao Neves, who was injured during the warmup. They took control of proceedings and Barca keeper Wojciech Szczesny made a fine save to palm round the post a venomous free kick by Achraf Hakimi from the edge of the box that was destined for the top-right corner. PSG equalized in the 38th minute when Nuno Mendes embarked on a dazzling run down the left, beating three defenders before setting up 19-year-old Senny Mayulu, who finished clinically into the bottom corner. Bradley Barcola wasted a great chance to give his side the lead in the 42nd minute, running past Eric Garcia inside the box but blasting his effort well over the crossbar. PSG were a constant threat in the second half as Barcelona’s defense struggled to contain the French side’s speed in the channels. Ibrahim Mbaye almost scored with a strike from inside the box in the 50th minute and Szczesny made a stunning save to block a Barcola effort from close-range two minutes later. Barca, however, had a great chance in the 62nd minute when Hakimi made a crucial goalline clearance to deny a Dani Olmo effort that had already beaten the goalkeeper. But PSG got the breakthrough late on. After substitute Lee Kang-in hit the post with a shot from the edge of the box in the 83rd minute, they finally scored a deserved winner from a quick counter in the 90th, with Hakimi crossing for Ramos to fire home from close range. “It was a close match, but we still believed in ourselves despite facing a lot of injuries. Those who played were top notch,” PSG defender Mendes told Canal Plus. “That’s what we need, players who come in and help us when needed, playing our style of football. We showed our work at the top level. “We know that this year it’s going to be more difficult because everyone wants to beat us. We know that and we’re focused. We always come to win.” Barcelona will host Olympiacos in their next group-stage match on October 21, when PSG travel to Bayer Leverkusen.

title: Monaco draw 2-2 with Man City
body: Agency : Monaco salvaged a 2-2 draw at home to Manchester City with a last-gasp penalty by Eric Dier on Wednesday after the visitors failed to make the most of their domination in the second round of Champions League matches. Dier buried a penalty in the 90th minute to cancel out Erling Haaland’s first-half double, after Jordan Teze’s early equalizer for the French side. That denied City what would have been their first away win in the competition in 12 months. Pep Guardiola’s team, who had opened their campaign with a 2-0 win against Napoli, now have four points while Monaco are in the elimination zone on one point after their 4-1 defeat at Club Brugge in the first round. City next travel to Villarreal on Oct 21 and Monaco will entertain Tottenham Hotspur the following day. “I don’t think we played good enough. We don’t deserve to win. We need more energy. We needed to do more of what we did in the first half,” Haaland said. “We dominated much more and then in the second half they took the lead much more. It’s not good enough.” In a quiet Louis II stadium, City were quickly in action. Haaland darted behind the defense and dinked a lob over goalkeeper Phillip Koehn for his 51st goal in 50 Champions League appearances in the 15th minute. Monaco’s Folarin Balogun was inches away from connecting with a Maghnes Akliouche cross before Jordan Teze pounced after a high press, drilling a finish into the top corner that left City goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma with no chance three minutes later. Monaco, however, were on the back foot, pegged into their own half with Phil Foden rattling the crossbar as the visitors dominated. Haaland was at it again on the stroke of halftime as he rose to meet Nico O’Reilly’s cross and powered a header into the bottom corner to restore City’s lead with his second of the night. Monaco upped the tempo after the break and Maghnes Akliouche cut inside his marker before firing a low right-footed shot that Donnarumma turned behind for a corner. But City regained possession and Haaland came close to wrapping it up with a powerful low shot 16 minutes from time. The visitors, however, lacked a cutting edge and seemed content with their single-goal advantage. They were made to regret that when, following a VAR review, Monaco were awarded a penalty after Nico Gonzalez’s high foot hit Dier’s head. The England international sent Donnarrumma the wrong way to earn his team a point they did not seem to deserve.

title: Tigresses face off Pakistan today
body: Sports Reporter : Bangladesh Women’s Cricket team will face off Pakistan Women’s Cricket team in their first match of the International Cricket Council (ICC) Women’s World Cup at Ranasinghe Premadasa Stadium in Colombo, the capital city of Sri Lanka today. Captain of Tigresses Nigar Sultana Joty will lead her squad, while Captain of Pakistan Women’s Cricket squad Fatima Sana will lead her squad. This World Cup is rolling on ODI format. The gala match will start at 3:30pm (Bangladesh Standard Time). Private satellite sports channel T Sports and private satellite channel Nagorik TV will telecast the match live. A total of eight teams are taking part in the World Cup, the most prestigious cricket meet for women of the whole world. Australia, New Zealand, Bangladesh, India, Pakistan, England, South Africa, Sri Lanka are competing in this World Cup. The first phase of the tournament will be held on single league basis. Top four teams will get the tickets of the semi-finals. The winning teams of the semi-finals will face each other in the final. The final will be held on November 2. Before today’s match, Bangladesh women and Pakistan women faced each other in 13 ODI matches. Of them, Bangladesh registered five victories, while Pakistan won in the eight occasions. Captain of Bangladesh Women’s Cricket squad Nigar Sultana Joty said, “I was walking around the balcony at the hotel because I knew there were a lot of things I could have done for the team that I didn’t do. I was in good touch (at the Qualifier) but I didn’t make runs in the Pakistan game. I got the first call from Fatima Sana and a few players that were there (in the Pakistan room). Whenever I play against her I don’t feel like she’s my friend, she’s my opponent, but we have fun after we finish the game.” Captain of Pakistan Women’s Cricket squad Fatima Sana said, “We have a lot of rivalry matches, but she’s my good friend, we have a good connection off the field. Because I was one of the younger ones , she would always sit with me and eat food, go outside together. We had a really good time. She’s my good friend. A lot of the time she asks about batting because she’s a batter and I want to become a good all-rounder, so she gives me a lot of tips. She gives me confidence in my batting.”

title: Suarez double in vain as Chicago sink Miami
body: AFP, Miami : Chicago Fire booked their place in the Major League Soccer (MLS) playoffs on Tuesday with a roller coaster 5-3 victory over Lionel Messi’s Inter Miami. Miami striker Luis Suarez scored twice to level it at 3-3 after Inter had trailed 3-1 against Gregg Berhalter’s well-organized Chicago side. But Suarez’s second-half brace was in vain as a weary Miami-playing their sixth game in 17 days-ran out of steam before conceding two late goals at home in Fort Lauderdale. Chicago’s win sees them return to the MLS postseason for the first time since 2017, and marks a successful return to club management for Berhalter, the former United States coach who was sacked from the national team last year. “It was an objective of ours to reach the playoffs, and we’ve achieved it with two games left,” Berhalter said afterwards. “But for us it’s about continuing to build a strong team that can win.” Despite Miami dominating possession, Chicago’s energy on the counterattack repeatedly troubled Miami in the first half. Ivorian midfielder Dje D’Avilla headed Chicago in front from a corner in the 11th minute before a superb goal on the break from Jonathan Dean made it 2-0 just after the half-hour mark. Although Miami pulled one back from Tomas Aviles in the 39th minute, another breakaway goal from Rominingue Kouame just before half-time restored Chicago’s two-goal lead. Uruguayan veteran Suarez led a Miami fightback after the break tucking away a low finish in the 57th minute before curling in an equalizer to make it 3-3 in the 74th minute. But Miami’s suspect defense conceded a soft goal tapped in from close range by Justin Pledger Reynolds in the 80th minute to put Chicago 4-3 up. There was little Miami could do about Chicago’s fifth though, with US international Brian Gutierrez unleashing a rocket which flew into top corner from 25 yards in the 83rd minute.

title: Mbappe hat-trick powers Madrid to thrash Kairat in CL
body: Agency : Kylian Mbappe scored a hat-trick as Real Madrid eased to a 5-0 victory over Champions League (CL) debutants Kairat Almaty on Tuesday, bouncing back emphatically from their weekend LaLiga defeat. Real, coming off a humbling 5-2 loss to city rivals Atletico Madrid on Saturday, responded in style, with Mbappe taking his Champions League tally to five goals this season. “We must never forget (what happened on Saturday). Yes, it’s another competition, but we have to keep thinking about what happened last weekend so we can learn from our mistakes and work to ensure it doesn’t happen again,” Mbappe told Movistar Plus. “My job is to help the team and I only think about doing what I can to help the team win matches and trophies. “A player like me, when he has five chances, wants and has to score all five. That’s why Real Madrid bought me and I always want more. Three were very good, but I could have scored more.” Kairat, undeterred by their underdog status, began brightly and created a couple of half-chances down the left. However, Real Madrid gradually asserted control, and the breakthrough arrived in the 25th minute. A defensive error from the hosts gifted Real midfielder Franco Mastantuono possession inside the box, where he was fouled by 18-year-old goalkeeper Sherhan Kalmurza. Mbappe rifled the resulting penalty into the back of the net. Despite several chances, Real ended the first half with a slender 1-0 lead, but Mbappe doubled their advantage in the 52nd minute with a moment of brilliance. A long kick from goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois found the French forward, who outpaced Kairat’s defense, and chipped the advancing Kalmurza. The home side thought they had a lifeline in the 69th minute when Dani Ceballos was penalized for a foul on Valeriy Gromyko in the box, but the referee overturned his decision after a Video Assistant Review (VAR) review. Mbappe eventually sealed his hat-trick in the 73rd minute, unleashing a thunderous strike from the edge of the box into the top corner, following a dazzling run by substitute Rodrygo. The Brazilian continued to shine, setting up Eduardo Camavinga for a headed goal in the 83rd minute, before Brahim Diaz completed the rout in stoppage time with a close-range finish. Real’s dominant display leaves them in a strong position in the standings, while Kairat, still seeking their first Champions League point, were left to rue defensive lapses on a challenging night.

title: Sinner, Tien advance to China Open final
body: Agency : Italy’s Jannik Sinner advanced to his third consecutive China Open final on Tuesday with a 6-3, 4-6, 6-2 victory over Australia’s Alex de Minaur. Later, American teenager Learner Tien reached his first career tour-level final in Beijing after Daniil Medvedev retired injured from their semifinal. The top-seeded Sinner, 24, extended his dominance over De Minaur, improving his head-to-head record to 11-0. The world No 2 dropped a set to the 26-year-old Australian for the first time since 2020. “It’s obviously great to be again in a final. It’s a special place to be,” Sinner said in his post-match news conference. “Every year is different. I’m very happy, and let’s see what’s coming tomorrow.” Sinner seized control early, breaking in the sixth game to move ahead 4-2. He then held off two break points in the following game before serving out the opening set. De Minaur, the world No 8, responded with characteristic grit. In a grueling second set, he saved multiple break points before finally converting his chance late in the 10th game to take it 6-4, ending a nine-match streak without winning a set against the Italian. The deciding set, however, belonged firmly to Sinner. He broke immediately for a 2-0 lead, then held a marathon service game after saving three break points to consolidate his lead. Another break followed as he surged to a 4-0 lead, mixing baseline power with deft touches at the net. De Minaur managed to hold serve once to avoid a shutout, but Sinner closed the match with a strong final service game, firing an ace and forcing two errors to secure the victory after 2 hours and 20 minutes. “It was a key moment in the third set. When you break and hold serve, it’s good,” said Sinner, a four-time Grand Slam winner. “Then I tried to stay a bit more aggressive, which worked very well. He was playing great tennis, very physical. All things considered, I’m very happy about today’s level and match.” With the win, Sinner reached the Beijing final for the third straight year. He lifted the trophy in 2023 and was the runner-up in 2024. In the day’s second men’s semifinal, 19-year-old Tien continued his breakthrough run, advancing when Medvedev retired early in the third set while trailing 5-7, 7-5, 4-0. Medvedev, 29, had appeared in control early, recovering from a 3-0 deficit to edge the opening set. But Tien, ranked 52nd, showed remarkable resilience. After falling behind 3-0 in the second set, the teenager broke back and then struck again at 5-5 before holding serve to level the match. Medvedev requested a medical timeout after the set and returned with visible discomfort. Limping between points, he was broken twice as Tien surged ahead 4-0. With his movement severely hampered, the 2021 US Open champion retired, leaving the court to warm applause from the Beijing crowd. “It’s not the way you want to end a match,” Tien said in his on-court interview. “I definitely wish Daniil a speedy recovery. At the same time, I’m really happy to be in my first final, and to do it here in Beijing makes it even more special.” As he left Diamond Court, Tien wrote “Get better soon, Daniil” on the camera lens, a gesture underscoring his respect for his opponent. The American has advanced to the final following back-to-back retirements; Lorenzo Musetti pulled out in the third set of their quarterfinal clash Monday. Earlier this year, Tien announced himself on the world stage by coming through qualifying to reach the round of 16 at the Australian Open, defeating Medvedev in a five-set thriller in the second round.

title: Aussies post 6-wkt win against NZ
body: Agency : An unbeaten maiden century by New Zealand(NZ)’s Tim Robinson wasn’t enough to deny Australia a comfortable six-wicket win in the opening Twenty20 International (T20I) at Bay Oval on Wednesday. Captain Mitchell Marsh led Australia’s chase with 85 off 43 balls as they raced to 185-4 off 16.3 overs in response to the home side’s 181-6. He was adjudged the Man of the Match. The powerful Marsh struck nine fours and five sixes in cold, windy conditions at Mount Maunganui. He was caught in the deep in the 15th over to fall short of what would have been his first century in 74 T20 Internationals. Fellow-opener Travis Head scored 31 in an electric opening stand of 67 off just 5.3 overs that set up victory and a 1-0 lead in the three-match series. Marsh said he and Head complemented each other as opening batsmen. “We’ve got a great relationship off the field and I’m hoping that translates into good partnerships,” he said. “Tonight was a lot of fun.” Robinson plundered 106 not out off 66 balls after a dreadful New Zealand start when they were asked to bat first. The hosts collapsed to 6-3, with seamer Ben Dwarshuis removing Devon Conway and Mark Chapman off successive balls in the second over. The fightback was launched by Robinson and Daryl Mitchell (34), whose fourth-wicket stand of 92 came from just 55 deliveries. Robinson, 23, became the second-youngest New Zealander to score a T20I century when he blasted a four and then a six from the last two balls of the innings from Dwarshuis. T20 merchandise “I got streaky through the middle there and got away with a few chances but that’s cricket,” Robinson said. “Those Aussies bowled really well at the top and Daryl and I spoke about getting through that really tough period when the ball was nipping around.” Both teams had a key player ruled out of the series in training incidents on Tuesday. New Zealand batsman Rachin Ravindra suffered facial cuts when he collided with a boundary fence during fielding practice. Australian all-rounder Glenn Maxwell broke his arm when struck by a shot from team-mate Mitchell Owen while bowling in the nets. The remaining two games are also day-night fixtures in Mount Maunganui on Friday and Saturday.

title: Chelsea earn 1-0 win against Benfica
body: Agency : Jose Mourinho enjoyed a warm welcome but a disappointing return to Stamford Bridge on Tuesday, a first-half own goal gifting Chelsea a 1-0 win over his new Benfica side in the Champions League. A scrappy game was decided in the 18th minute when Chelsea’s Pedro Neto looped the ball to Alejandro Garnacho at the far post and the Argentine stretched to turn it across the face of goal where the unfortunate Richard Rios could only poke it in his own net. Mourinho, who won three league titles in two spells with Chelsea, waved and blew a kiss when the home supporters sang his name. The fans’ mood contrasted strongly with previous visits when he was in charge of Manchester United and London rivals Tottenham Hotspur. Chelsea will be relieved to have points on the Champions League board, despite finishing the game with 10 men after substitute Joao Pedro was sent off deep into added time for two yellow cards. Enzo Maresca’s team lost their first Champions League outing in more than two years to Bayern Munich earlier this month. They started brightly, hogging possession and creating chances for Neto and Enzo Fernandez. Garnacho, signed this season from Manchester United, busily probed down the left wing. Benfica, who have lost all five of their meetings against the London side, looked dangerous in spells with Fredrik Aursnes and Georgiy Sudakov having shots blocked and Dodi Lukebakio forcing a save onto the post. But the game was a stop, start affair in the second half, with seven yellow cards brandished before Chelsea’s red just before the final whistle. Benfica fans taunted their former player Fernandez as he took a corner in front of them late in the first half and the smiling Argentine clapped them which provoked a flurry of plastic cups from the stands. Mourinho strode down the touchline gesturing for the visiting fans to calm down. The Portuguese coach took charge of Benfica less than two weeks ago after the side lost their first Champions League game to Azerbaijan’s Qarabag and the Lisbon side sacked Bruno Lage.

title: Tamim pulls out of BCB polls amid turbulence
body: NN ONLINE: Former Bangladesh captain Tamim Iqbal has withdrawn his nomination from Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) election, in a move that deepens the turmoil already surrounding the polls slated for October 6. Tamim appeared at the Sher-e-Bangla National Stadium in Mirpur around 10:15am on Wednesday and withdrew as today is the last day for candidates to pull out. Sources close to the process suggested that up to a dozen club-backed candidates are also considering withdrawal. Tamim’s move — given his profile as one of the country’s most influential cricketers — has cast further doubt over how credible and competitive the election will be. Tamim’s withdrawal indicates how sharply cricket politics entwined with national politics now. All these together put the BCB election on edge.

title: I’m Ashamed of Three Films’: Anjan Dutt Speaks Frankly at 72
body: I have been very selective about the work I chose. I tried hard not to do cheap songs or anything of low taste. Even today, I feel embarrassed and ashamed about three films; it is difficult for me to acknowledge them as my own. I have avoided politics, controversy, quarrels, foolishness, and mediocrity-no matter how purple the times may have been. I am 72 years old. My sense of humor is the only support that has kept me alive. Anjan Dutt

title: Apu returns after 2 years
body: Entertainment Report : After a two-year break, Dhallywood’s popular actress Apu Biswasis making her return to the big screen. Audiences will see her in an entirely new look and different getup in the thriller film Durbar, directed by Kamrul Hasan Fuad. Apu Biswas herself said that she will be seen in the film “with unstoppable momentum.” The shooting of the film is already progressing rapidly. Apu Biswas shared that around 40 percent of her portions have been completed so far, and the remaining work will be finished soon. She said, “There are many surprises in this film. Audiences will be able to enjoy a movie with a strong story.” Talking about returning to the camera after a long break, Apu Biswas said, “Cinema is the core of my identity. I am Apu Biswas today because of films. The love I have received from the audience has come through this medium. So, even if it’s a bit late, it feels wonderful to return with a good film.” In Durbar, Apu Biswas will be seen opposite popular small-screen actor Shajal for the first time. She is very excited about this new pairing as well. She said, “Shajal bhai is extremely humble and a very talented actor. I am a fan of his acting. From the very first day, our working experience has been very good. The audience will see us in a new way.” She even referred to Shajal as her “dream hero.” Speaking about director Kamrul Hasan Fuad, Apu Biswas said that he is a talented filmmaker who is very careful about both storytelling and execution. “Just as the story is different, his finesse is clearly visible in the direction as well,” she added. However, she did not want to reveal details about her character at this moment.

title: Mila to rock thirty-first night
body: Entertainment Desk : Popular pop singer Mila is currently enjoying a remarkable phase in her career. Over the past few months, she has been extremely busy with shows both at home and abroad. Now, she is coming up with a new surprise to welcome the New Year. To celebrate the New Year, Mila will set the stage on fire on Thirty-First Night, the singer has confirmed. This December, she has already performed at several major shows in Narsingdi, Manikganj, and different locations in Dhaka. On December 31, Thirty-First Night, Mila will perform at a grand event at Dhaka Regency Hotel & Resort. Promotional activities for the event have already begun from the hotel authorities. Speaking about performing this Thirty-First Night, Mila said, “I have many shows lined up this time. This year, I have been on several tours abroad. At the same time, I am performing at various concerts across the country. I want to end this year and begin the New Year with music.

title: Tushi in New Look for New Year
body: Entertainment Report : Actress Nazifa Tushi came into the spotlight with the big-screen release of Hawa in 2022. Before that, she had acted in the film Ice Cream. However, after Hawa, she was not seen on the big screen for a long time. After staying away quietly, the actress has finally broken her silence and returned to the spotlight. She is now appearing in Roid, directed by Mejbaur Rahman Sumon. The film has already been selected for the main competition section, Tiger Competition, at the 55th edition of the International Film Festival Rotterdam (IFFR), one of the world’s most prestigious film festivals. With this achievement, a new milestone has been created for Bangladeshi cinema. In the film, Tushi plays the role of “Sadhu’s wife.” Roid is set to be released in the new year. Tushi said, “For now, I want to stay focused on Roid and reflect on it. I have worked very hard for this film. I hope the results will be evident once it is released.”

title: For now, no films: Mahi
body: Entertainment Report : Samira Khan Mahi is one of the promising actresses of the time. By portraying a wide range of characters in television dramas, she has proven herself as a capable performer. Beyond TV dramas, she has also showcased her talent through OTT projects. Even as the year draws to a close, she remains quite busy with new drama projects. Recently, she completed work on a serial titled Dear Ladies, directed by Imrul Rafat. The series revolves around the lives of several women. Mahi said it is a beautifully written and well-crafted project, and she believes audiences will enjoy it. Over the past few months, she has also finished nearly half a dozen single-episode dramas. In these projects, she worked opposite Mushfiq R. Farhan and Arsh Khan, under the direction of Imrul Rafat, Mabrur Rashid Bannah, among others. During the conversation, Mahi also shared another piece of news. She has completed work on a web series. However, she said it is not possible to reveal details at the moment, and an official announcement may come soon. There has been discussion multiple times about her debut on the big screen. However, Mahi has now made it clear that films are not her priority at this time. Explaining why, she said she is content working in television dramas and OTT content, as she consistently receives love from audiences there. She added that it is not mandatory to work in films. Mahi further said that in the past, many topics beyond her work have been discussed about her, but now she is focused solely on her career. She feels she is going through a stable phase and hopes this period continues for a long time.

title: To err is human Parno Mittra
body: Entertainment Desk For the past few days, there had been speculation that Tollywood actress Parno Mittra was set to switch parties and join a new political platform. Putting an end to the speculation, she has now begun a new political journey. On Friday, Parno Mittra officially left the BJP and joined West Bengal’s ruling party, the Trinamool Congress (TMC). Parno Mittra joined the party at the TMC office in the presence of Minister Chandrima Bhattacharya and Trinamool leader Joyprakash Majumdar. Speaking on the occasion, Parno Mittra said, “I had joined the BJP at one point. However, things did not progress the way I had expected. To err is human. Under the leadership of Mamata Banerjee, I want to work afresh as a member of the Trinamool Congress.” TMC leader Joyprakash Majumdar stated that Parno has been actively involved in politics since 2019. She also contested the 2021 West Bengal Assembly elections. However, she had not been seen actively participating in BJP party programs for a long time. Notably, Parno Mittra began her acting career in 2007. She started on television with Ravi Ojha’s serial Khela. She was introduced to the big screen by Anjan Dutt and played the lead role in Ranjana Ami Ar Ashbona. Her filmography includes Bedroom, Maach Mishti & More, Rajkahini, Alinagarer Golokdhadha, Apu’r Panchali, Anko Ki Kothin, among others.

title: Bhabna on new web film
body: A new web film starring Ashna Habib Bhabna has gone into production. The film is being directed by Suman Dhar. This dark web film is being made for the OTT platform i Screen. Shooting has been underway for quite some time in Dhamrai. The film is scheduled to be released this upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr. Bhabna said that it is a web film with a very different story. She believes the audience will enjoy it very much.

title: Salman Khan celebrates 60th birthday with star-studded bash
body: NN ONLINE: Bollywood superstar Salman Khan marked his 60th birthday on Friday with a grand midnight celebration at his Panvel farmhouse, attended by celebrities from the film, sports and public life. Videos and photos from the celebration quickly went viral on social media, showing the actor cutting his birthday cake in the garden surrounded by close friends and guests. Actor Sanjay Dutt shared a picture with Salman Khan from the event and wished him health and success. Politician Beena Kak also posted several photos from the party, offering a glimpse of the guest list that included actors Sanjay Dutt, Aditya Roy Kapur and Maniesh Paul, along with singer Mika Singh. In her post, she described the gathering as a warm and joyful celebration among loved ones. Salman Khan’s longtime bodyguard Shera shared a heartfelt photo with the actor from the venue, while actress Jannat Zubair posted a smiling picture with the birthday star, extending her wishes on Instagram. Another widely shared photograph featured Salman Khan with former Indian cricket captain MS Dhoni, who attended the celebration in a casual yet stylish look. Several other celebrities were also present at the bash, including Karisma Kapoor, Genelia Deshmukh, Rakul Preet Singh, Huma Qureshi, Sangeeta Bijlani, Pragya Jaiswal, Zeeshan Siddiqui and Rahul Kanwal.

title: Sydney Sweeney wants to make film that saves lives
body: Popular Hollywood actress Sydney Sweeney has been in the news recently for her roles in films like ‘The Housemaid’ and ‘Christie’. The 28-year-old actress’s new work has tackled some of the most pressing social issues of our time. In a recent interview with the BBC, Sweeney said she is interested in making films that will have a profound impact on the audience and help save lives. In Sweeney’s words, “Through this type of film, such serious issues can be raised and discussed; which is very important. I myself would like to work more on films with this type of story; which will play a positive role for people, help save lives.”

title: Legendary Palestinian actor-producer Bakri dies
body: Legendary Palestinian actor and filmmaker Mohammed Bakri has passed away recently at the age of 72. International media outlets, citing family sources, reported that he had been suffering from heart problems for a long time. He was buried in his home village in Palestine. Born in 1953, this talented artist began his acting career in the theater in the 1980s. Despite being a Palestinian citizen, he was fluent in both Arabic and Hebrew. He made his big screen debut in Oscar-winning Greek-French director Costa-Gavras’s film ‘Hana K.’ He received worldwide acclaim for his portrayal of a Palestinian prisoner in the 1984 film ‘Beyond the Walls’, which was nominated for an Academy Award (Oscar).

title: Kailash Kher’s concert disrupted by frenzied crowd
body: A huge commotion has erupted during a concert by renowned singer Kailash Kher in Gwalior, India. The popular singer, angered by the unruly behaviour of the audience, stopped the concert midway and left the stage. The incident took place recently at an event organised to mark the birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. In a viral video, a group of audience members suddenly broke through the security barricades and moved very close to stage as Kailash Kher was about to start singing; they ignored the security guards and surrounded the stage. The show was halted due to the rush of the audience.

title: Emon’s movie to release at beginning of New Year
body: Actor Mamnun Hasan Emon’s new movie ‘Moynar Char’ is scheduled to be released at the beginning of the New Year. The actor signed a contract for this movie, produced with government subsidy, at the end of last year. The movie is being shot in Char Alexander, Ramgati Upazila, Lakshmipur. The movie is now fully ready for release after completing the remaining work. The film has already received clearance from the Film Certification Board without any cuts, said the film’s director, Mostafizur Rahman.

title: Jaya in Christmas spirit, gives special message
body: Entertainment Report : Christmas, the biggest religious festival of the Christians, is celebrated around the world on December 25. The festival was celebrated with due dignity and joy in Bangladesh as well. The spirit of this Christmas festival has touched the cultural arena of the country; along with the common people, showbiz stars are also celebrating the festival. This time, the famous actress of both Bangladesh and West Bengal, Jaya Ahsan, shared the joy of Christmas among her fans. Yesterday afternoon, Jaya shared several pictures on social media on the occasion of the Christmas. It can be seen that she has posed in a home environment in the Christmas spirit. She is wearing a light pink top and white pants. She has a teddy bear nearby. It can also be seen that there are special Christmas decorations in the corner of the house; such as Santa Claus and a tree. Jaya did not reveal where the pictures were released from. However, netizens speculate that the actress is staying in Kolkata, from where she has dressed up in Christmas attire. The actress also gave a special message. She wrote, “May peace come to the country on Christmas; all over the world.” Jaya’s post has received a lot of reactions from fans after it was published. Along with the Christmas wishes, fans are praising Jaya’s soft look. Also, amidst the current unrest in the country and the world, the actress’s prayer for peace has particularly attracted the attention of her fans. On the occasion of the Christmas, churches across the country, including the capital, have been decorated with lights and special prayers have been organised. They are busy welcoming the birth of Jesus Christ.

title: Chamak’s ‘Churi Chham Chham’ look spreads fascination
body: Entertainment Report : A month ago, the music video ‘Churi Chham Chham’ was released on YouTube. Since the song was released, it has received a lot of response from the audience; the main focus of attention was the popular actress and model Rukaiya Jahan Chamak. The star is back in the news after those looks were released on social media. In addition to modelling and acting, Chamak has taken herself to a unique height as an item dancer. In particular, the song is popular, and her makeup and look in this song have caught the attention. She looked flawless and charming in a red saree, silk bangles and heavy jewellery. Recently, Chamak released a bunch of stills from the shooting of this music video where she is sometimes seen in a dance pose, sometimes posing, and sometimes in a candid pose. The response to Chamak’s look is clear from the comments of netizens. One commented, “Singing, dancing and dressing; perfect in every way. It still looks new even after watching it a thousand times.” Another commented, “Chamak is a symbol of unimaginable beauty.” Many fans have also called her an “all-rounder.”

title: Who is Bill Gates’ daughter in love with?
body: Agencies : Phoebe Adele Gates, the youngest daughter of the world’s richest man and Microsoft co-founder Bill Gates, is a 23-year-old who is often in the news for her personal life and professional activities. Now, she is back in the headlines with love news. Phoebe recently hinted at a new relationship on social media. However, this love is not entirely new; their relationship has been developing since childhood. Phoebe posted a picture on Instagram. In picture, Bill Gates’ daughter is seen in an intimate moment with her childhood friend Chazz Flynn. The caption is just a love emoji! And that’s what started the discussion on the internet. After the post was published, the comment box was filled with comments from fans. Some congratulated, while others jokingly wrote, “May the old love last forever.” Phoebe is currently working on an artificial intelligence-based fashion shopping tool ‘Fia’ and has also established herself as a social media influencer.

title: Nusraat Faria looks glamorous in Canada, writes – “Ending the year beautifully”
body: Entertainment Desk : Actress Nusraat Faria is spending more time abroad than at home. She returned to Dhaka a few months ago, but is currently staying in Canada. The actress is busy spending Christmas and the end of the year in a holiday mood. Meanwhile, a stylish look of the heroine has caught the attention of her fans. Faria shared a bunch of pictures on social media on Friday. In the picture, which was shared from Otaya, the heroine is seen in a slightly warmer avatar. Nusraat’s glamorous look with an off-shoulder black gown and open hair; which is captivating the fans. She wrote in the caption of those pictures, “Ending the year in the most beautiful way.” Fans and netizens have made various comments on these pictures of Nusraat Faria. One praised her by comparing her to “Cleopatra”. Another wrote, “Gorgeous beauty and cuteness.” However, some also made funny comments after seeing Nusraat’s thin clothes in the severe winter.

title: Sunerah under direction of Angshu after 6 years
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : Sunerah Binte Kamal made her big screen debut in 2019 with the movie ‘No Darai’ directed by Tanim Rahman Angshu. The actress made a splash in her first movie. She won the National Film Award for Best Actress. After that, she worked regularly in OTT, movies and TV dramas, but Sunerah was not seen under the direction of Tanim Rahman Angshu again. After six years, she is working under the direction of this director again. Sunerah went to Nepal on December 18 to shoot for her new work. The shooting ended on December 23. Sharing a photo of the shooting with Tanim Rahman Angshu on that day on social media, the actress wrote, “Something is happening. We are working together after six years. Looking forward to showing everyone.” Sunerah was contacted to know about this new work. In a text message from Nepal, Sunerah said, “I am doing a very interesting job. Here I will be seen in a role that has never been seen before.” Sunerah is not willing to say anything right now about whether it is OTT content or a movie. She said, “I don’t want to say anything right now about where the work will be shown. I hope the audience will be able to see the work soon.” Sharing her shooting experience, Sunerah said, “We have to shoot in very cold weather. It’s minus degrees where we are shooting. It’s the first time I’ve shot in such weather. All in all, it was a terrible experience. But the work went very well.” Sunerah is spending a busy time in all mediums – dramas, OTT and movies. Her dramas are being released regularly on TV and YouTube. Sunerah’s first serial ‘Eta Amaderi Golpo’ started airing last month. She recently completed shooting for a series directed by Arafat Mohsin Nidhi. In addition, Rubaiyat Hossain’s film ‘The Difficult Bride’ awaiting to release. Sunerah’s co-stars in it are Azmeri Haque Badhon and Rikita Nandini Shimu.

title: ‘Even though I am Mehreen on screen, in reality I am Keya Payel’
body: Entertainment Report : Keya Payel is a popular actress on the small screen today. She has won the hearts of audience by playing diverse roles one after another. However, her character ‘Mehreen’ in a recent drama seems to have taken a special place in the hearts of the audience. Her fluent performance as ‘Mehreen’ has impressed so much that the audience is now reluctant to see her in any other role. In a recent interview, Keya Payel spoke about her work experience and the unprecedented response from the audience. She said that the director of the play messaged her about the special interest of the audience. Payel said, “The director told me that audience has received me so positively as ‘Mehreen’ that they don’t want to see me in any other role right now. What greater achievement can there be for an actress than this?” Keya Payel has been working regularly in the drama arena for a long time. However, according to her, this work has surpassed many of her previous successes. She credits the strong family atmosphere of the drama as the reason behind this. She believes that there is always a demand for stories that can be watched with the whole family in the drawing room. Actor Mukit Zakaria has joined the team of this drama, and Keya Payel is very excited about him. She said, “The name ‘Mehreen’ is really beautiful. I like it when someone calls me by this name. But at the end of the day, even though I am ‘Mehreen’ on screen, in reality I am Keya Payel. I feel more comfortable thinking of myself this way. In my eyes, every person in the world is beautiful. However, it is more important to know someone by their behaviour and conduct than judging them by their appearance. The true identity of a person is revealed in their behaviour.”

title: ‘Many people say they want to fix their nose and lips’
body: Agencies : She is approaching 60 years of age, yet her presence on screen still stirs the hearts of millions of men. She is the ‘Dhak Dhak Girl’ of the Bollywood empire, Madhuri Dixit. She is still flawless with her smooth skin and captivating smile. She has never resorted to any artificial method to maintain her eternal youthful appearance. However, at the beginning of her career, she had to hear many harsh words about this ‘natural beauty’. In a recent interview, Madhuri shared a painful experience from the beginning of her career. She said that when she was struggling to establish herself in the early nineties, many people questioned her physical build. Madhuri said, “When I was new in the industry, many people used to say that my nose and lips were not shaped right. Many people advised me to get surgery to fix my nose and lips. Hearing this, I would be very upset and disappointed.” Madhuri says, “My mother told me that once a film becomes a hit, no one will question your flaws. That statement came true to the letter.” To the new generation of actresses, this legendary star said, “Don’t be concerned with your appearance, focus on your work. Work with your best, success will be the answer to all criticism.”

title: Shahtaj looks charming on Pattaya Beach
body: Entertainment Desk : Shahtaj Monira Hashem, a once popular model and actress, was present everywhere from advertisements to dramas. However, Shahtaj has been away from the screen for a while since her marriage to musician Pritom Hasan. Although she is currently busy with her family, she is sharing various moments of her life with her fans on social media. Shahtaj shared a bunch of photos on Facebook on Wednesday afternoon, which instantly caught the attention of netizens. She is currently staying at Pattaya Beach in Thailand. In the photos shared today, Shahtaj is seen enjoying the sunset on the beach. Shahtaj was wearing a white off-shoulder gown, which made her look quite charming. Also, the large white flower in her hair added a different dimension to her beauty. She also posed in the light-filled atmosphere of a restaurant on the beach, captioning the post, “There’s no better way to end the day.” After the pictures were released, Shahtaj’s fans and admirers poured in their praise in the comments section. One fan wrote, “White Angel”, another wrote, “Gorgeous”. Some even called her ‘So Pretty Girl’ after seeing her new look. Shahtaj has never made it clear why she suddenly cut back on her work at the peak of her career. Her great journey that started in dramas, telefilms, and music videos is now limited to a loud presence on social media.

title: Nancy’s song ‘Neta Nayak’ about
body: Tarique Rahman : BNP acting Chairman Tarique Rahman has returned to the country after a 17-year exile. A special song ‘Neta Nayak’ has been released to celebrate his historic and much-awaited return. Popular singers Nazmun Munira Nancy and Salman Raj have given their voices to this song. The lyrics of the song was written by Mizanur Rahman, the tunes are by Palak Hasan Sumon and the music is arranged by AN Farhad. The entire project was planned and supervised by film actor Helal Khan. The song has received a huge response since it was released on BNP’s official Facebook page and YouTube channel.

title: Body of ‘Lion King’ actress found dead
body: Imani Dia Smith, who rose to fame as a child artiste in the Broadway play ‘The Lion King’ based on the world-famous Disney animated film, has been left in mourning by her fans and admirers. She has died mysteriously. The body of the 25-year-old actress was recovered by police from a home in New Jersey, USA. Based on the initial investigation, the police believe that Imani was murdered by her own boyfriend. Police said that Imani’s boyfriend, Jordan D Jackson-Small, has already been arrested in connection with the murder. He has been charged with direct murder.

title: I beat him with a stamp for proposing to me: Oishee
body: Miss World Bangladesh’s popular actress Jannatul Ferdous Oishee. Although she is seen as calm and graceful on screen, her fans have been shocked by an incident in real life. The actress recently participated in a talk show on Desh TV and shared memories of her school life. In the interview, Oishee said that when she was in the tenth grade, a young man proposed to her. But what happened in response to that proposal was unimaginable. Oishee said, “More important than the pattern of proposing, I beat up the person who proposed with a cricket bat.”

title: What really happens to Riaz, reveals by his family
body: On Wednesday, many people posted on social media asking if the hero Riaz was alive or not. Some spread rumours of his death. The hero’s fans fell into anxiety and panic as the matter spread widely. However, Riaz’s family said that he is healthy and doing well. However, Riaz’s family has confirmed that the news of his death is completely baseless and a rumour. Riaz’s wife said, “Such news is absolutely not true. Riaz is healthy. Wherever he is, he is fine.”

title: Will society accept me? Iman Chakraborty
body: Entertainment Desk : West Bengal singer Iman Chakraborty has always been outspoken. She does not hesitate to share the joys, sorrows, or special moments of her life with her fans through social media. However, recently, one of her comments has caused quite an uproar on the internet. In a video message, the singer can be heard asking, “I don’t know whether this society will accept me or not.”

title: I want to work with Arosh: Tasnuva Tisha
body: The news of personal and professional conflict between popular small screen actress Tasnuva Tisha and actor Arosh Khan is not unknown to anyone in the showbiz arena. However, Tisha has hinted that they will forget all the bitterness and return to the screen together again. In a recent interview, she said that the rift she had with Arosh has ended. In an interview, Tasnuva Tisha said, “Wherever I go in the country, everyone asks about Arosh. Currently, I’m shooting in Kamarpara, but I don’t know where Arosh is shooting. I want to make it clear that the conflict or conflict I had with Arosh has ended. Now I want to work with him again.”

title: It’s wise to remain silent in all situations
body: Entertainment Report : Rukaiya Jahan Chamak is a familiar face of the small screen. She has won the hearts of the audience in a short time with her acting and beauty. Since the beginning of her career, she has been known for her blunt nature and outspokenness. However, this time, the actress has changed her tune a bit. In a status on social media, Chamak said that staying silent is probably the most intelligent thing to do in this current situation. In a post on her Facebook handle, Chamak wrote, “In this country, staying silent is the smartest thing to do. Those who protest injustice are fools. From today onwards, I will wear a saree and post romantic pictures.” The actress is basically pointing to the ongoing unrest in society and the attitude towards protestors. According to Chamak, where speaking the truth or protesting injustice is seen as foolishness, it is better to withdraw. So, she has decided that from now on, instead of talking about social or contemporary issues, she will spend her time posting only glamorous and romantic pictures of herself. Fans have also given their reactions under the post of the actress. Many agreed with her arrogant decision. One wrote, “That would be the smart thing to do in the current situation.” Others said they were looking forward to her next work.

title: Politeness has no value: Misty Jannat
body: Entertainment Report : Misty Jannat is a much talked about and criticised name in Dhallywood. This film actress is in the news more for her personal life and straightforward comments than for her acting on the screen. Now she has come to the centre of discussion again with an explosive post on social media. Misty Jannat believes that polite behaviour is not valued in today’s society. Expressing her anger, she wrote on her page, “Polite behaviour has no value in this society, so I’m back to my previous form.” While followers were curious about Misty’s sudden change of mood, a large section of netizens expressed their solidarity with her comment. Many expressed their support in the comment box of her post, writing, “Absolutely right” or “Right decision.” Earlier, in another message, Misty Jannat clarified her position on her career and professionalism. There, she mentioned that it is true courage to turn down an offer with dignity rather than being dishonoured by working in a small role in a movie. The actress is not willing to sacrifice her self-respect even if she works less. Incidentally, this heroine, who made her debut on the silver screen in 2014 with the movie ‘Love Station’, is currently known as a dentist in addition to acting. However, her various comments often create controversy in the entertainment community. Now, speculation is going on about what exactly she was hinting at by saying “Politeness has no value.”

title: Mehazabien-Adnan spreading charm in the Maldives
body: Entertainment Desk : Ending 13 years of secrecy and rumours of love, popular small screen actress Mehazabien Chowdhury tied the knot with producer Adnan Al Rajeev in February this year. Ever since their marriage, fans have been intrigued by this star couple. The new proof of the happiness they are currently floating in has been found in the distant Maldives. Taking a break from their busy schedules, the couple is now staying in the Maldives, a paradise of immense natural beauty. Mehazabien shared some lovely pictures of their private moments on social media. The pictures show them standing next to the blue waters of the ocean, enjoying each other’s company. In some pictures, they are looking at the blue horizon, while in others; their sweet smiles are making fans’ hearts flutter. But not only enjoying the sea, Mehazabien and Adnan are also enjoying cycling. They also captured the moments of cycling around the resort, wearing sunglasses and casual clothes. The album shared by Mehazabien went viral soon after it was posted on social media.

title: Kareena has kept family together: Saif
body: Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor, one of the most talked about couples in Bollywood, tied the knot in 2012. It has been 13 years, and Saif-Kareena is now parents to two children. Saif also has two children from his previous marriage, Sara and Ibrahim. He and Kareena have a great relationship. It can be said that Saif Ali Khan is having one of the best times of his life. In Saif’s words, “Kareena has kept our family together. As well as being a creative actress, she is also an amazing mother and wife. I have rarely seen a kind-hearted person like her.”

title: Wheel of fortune will turn with magic of words: Akshay
body: After a long wait, Bollywood superstar Akshay Kumar, known as ‘Khiladi’, is returning to the television screen. But this time, he is not appearing in any ordinary show, but in the Indian version of the world famous game show ‘Wheel of Fortune’. This number one reality show in the United States is now ready to captivate the Indian audience. A stunning promo of the show has already been released. In Akshay’s words, “A single letter can change your entire life. This time, the wheel of fortune will turn with this magic of words.”

title: Pantha Kanai coming up with new song
body: Pantha Kanai has been singing for more than two decades. He still spends all his time with music. Recently, he has been releasing new songs regularly. After the huge popularity of ‘Sei Ek Somoy Chhilo’ released in October, Pantha Kanai is back with a new song. The title of his song this time is ‘Abar Tora Manush Ho’. The song, written by Faruk Anwar, was composed by Kamal Ahmed, and the music was arranged by Zahid Bashar Pankaj. The video of the song was made by Samrat Ahmed. The song will be released soon on the YouTube channel of FA Music.

title: I was rejected for being fat: Radhika
body: Agencies : In the entertainment world, the only criterion for the beauty of heroines is their slim body. Any slight deviation from this leads to harsh criticism and body shaming. Miss World Aishwarya Rai Bachchan also had to endure severe criticism for gaining weight after becoming a mother. Now, Bollywood actress Radhika Apte has spoken out about a similar experience. According to an Indian media report, Radhika got the opportunity to work in a big production film early in her acting career. But an unexpected incident happened before the shooting started. Radhika said that she had planned to go on a vacation before the shooting started. The actress had informed the concerned people about this in advance. She even made it clear that he would not go on a diet while travelling and that she might gain some weight. In Radhika’s words, “I was young then, my metabolism was also great. I knew I could lose weight quickly when I came back. But before the shoot, I had to participate in a photoshoot. There, I looked a little fat. I was dropped because I was fat.” After losing her big job, Radhika became mentally devastated. She developed a fear of weight. Even if she gained a little weight, she would panic that she might lose her job again. After going through this trauma for a long time, she was finally forced to seek help from a professional psychologist. Radhika recently became a mother. After giving birth, she naturally gained weight. However, after overcoming the trauma of the past, she is now learning to look at life in a new way. Radhika’s confession once again shows how much inhumane mental pressure even screen stars have to go through to maintain their careers.

title: Apu’s surprise look in western outfit
body: Entertainment Report : Apu Biswas is one of the most successful and popular heroines of Dhallywood. In her long career, she has made a place in the hearts of the audience by giving numerous commercially successful films. However, this actress is not only active on the silver screen, but also on social media. She regularly appears in new looks and impresses her fans. Recently, she was caught on camera in a western-fusion formal outfit. In a series of photos she shared, she is seen wearing a stylish white coat. Her earrings and necklace give off a modern and elegant look. In the caption, Apu wrote, “Develop yourself the way you want to get.” Meanwhile, netizens were impressed by Apu’s glamorous look. The comment box of the picture was immediately filled with praise. Apu’s beauty and enchanting eyes caught the eye. Incidentally, Apu Biswas got known in 2006 with ‘Koti Takar Kabin’. Before that, his career started with a supporting role in movie ‘Kal Shokale’. The movie was directed by Amjad Hossain. After that, Apu Biswas became a regular by pairing up with Shakib Khan.

title: Discrimination in payment in industry: Madhuri
body: Bollywood in the 90s is all about Madhuri Dixit’s world-conquering smile and magic eyes on the big screen. From ‘Tezaab’, ‘Hum Aapke Hai Kaun’ to ‘Prahar’ or ‘Pukar’, she established herself as a legend with her parallel path of glamour and acting. Despite being the highest-paid actress in industry at that time, she was not free from discrimination. Madhuri said, “Change is necessary for progress. There was a time when there was no vanity van on the set for any artiste, male or female. We used to sit in the sun with umbrellas. We even had to change our clothes by folding our veils to create a shelter. Back then, we didn’t even think that it should change. Today, at least, there has been change in those places.”

title: New episode of ‘Ityadi’ now in Chuadanga
body: Since the 1990s, magazine programmes have been shooting in various parts of the country in search of roots, going beyond the four walls of the studio. In continuation of this, the new episode of etc. has been shot in Chuadanga, an ancient town rich in history and tradition. The stage for this episode was set up on the premises of Natuda Secondary School, a centuries-old traditional school known as Hazarduari, built during the British era. This episode has two songs. One song is sung by folk singers Beauty and Pantha Kanai. The lyrics of the song are written by Mohammad Rafiquzzaman, and the music is arranged by Mehedi.

title: BINDU discloses her separation after 3 years
body: Entertainment Report : Lux beauty and actress Afsan Ara Bindu married businessman Asif Salahuddin Malik in 2014. After marriage, she completely withdrew from showbiz. She left acting and became a family woman. After four years of marriage, there were rumours that Bindu’s family had broken up. However, neither Bindu nor her husband said anything about the separation at that time. Finally, the actress confirmed her separation. Bindu recently said at an event that she had separated in 2022. Although they separated in 2022, Bindu had been separated from her husband since 2017. After five years, they finally decided to separate. Bindu said, “Many people think that I am still married. But no, I’m divorced. My family journey was very short.” Explaining the reason for the separation, Bindu said, “Sometimes there are big reasons for separation, big events happen. Sometimes there is no need for such a reason. There is another person involved in this journey of mine. He also has a personal life. I don’t want to put him in an embarrassing situation by giving any explanation about the separation.” Bindu started her showbiz journey with the Lux Channel i Superstar competition in 2006. She became a regular face in the media in a short time. Before taking a break from acting, she acted in 52 dramas aired on Eid-ul-Azha in 2014 alone. Apart from the small screen, Bindu has also acted in movies. At the beginning of her career, Bindu paired up with Arifin Shuvoo and acted in many dramas. Their pair was very popular on screen. The on-screen chemistry had an impact on the real life of both of them. Once, Bindu was in a love relationship with Shuvoo. The actress has also admitted to that love. Why did their relationship break up? Bindu’s short answer was, “I don’t have the answer. There is no such thing as the journey of two people ending together at the same destination.” After a break of almost a decade, Bindu returned to acting in 2023 with the web film ‘Unish20’. In it, directed by Mizanur Rahman Aryan, Bindu was opposite Arifin Shuvoo. However, Bindu was not seen in any other work after that. However, she wants to act regularly. In this regard, Bindu said, “I am ready to work as an actress. Now I have to think about working with me, about investing in me. I want to do the kind of work that I have not done yet. I want the producers to think about me in a way that was not thought of before.” Bindu left acting and got involved in business about five years ago. She has a boutique house in Gulshan. Bindu designs the clothes of this brand called ‘Afsan Bindu Designer Studio’ herself. When Bindu started the company in 2020, she had only one employee. However, the actress said that now 15 people work with her, she said.

title: Kiara Advani stuns in new look
body: Agencies : After the huge success of the two parts of the movie ‘KGF’, Kannada superstar Yash has joined the film of Malayalam director Geethu Mohandas. Kiara Advani has become the heroine of Yash for the first time in this Kannada language movie titled ‘Toxic: A Fairytale for Grownups’. Kiara’s character’s name in Toxic is Nadia. The look of Kiara’s character in this movie was revealed yesterday. Kiara is about to enter an era in showbiz. Since her debut with ‘Fugly’ in 2014, she has acted in around 20 films. She has appeared in diverse roles in each one. However, the newly released first look poster has given a glimpse of how Kiara’s character in Toxic is going to be completely different. In it, she will be seen as a circus artist. In the first look poster, Kiara’s character Nadia is standing in an off-shoulder velvet gown on a brightly lit circus set. There is a look of depression and fatigue in her eyes and face. The artist who is seen dancing in the grandeur of the circus stage in front of the audience, often has a wave of sadness in her mind.

title: Mysterious death of actor James Ransone
body: Popular American actor James Ransone has died mysteriously. Police found the 46-year-old actor hanging from his Los Angeles home on December 19. According to the police and autopsy report, James died of hanging. Police said they quickly reached the spot based on a call from the actor’s house and recovered his frozen body. The investigation has not found any murder conspiracy or unusual signs so far, and it is believed to be a suicide.

title: What Pakistani actress says about Salman
body: Pakistani artistes expressing their love or admiration for Bollywood stars is not new. Earlier, Hania Aamir was seen expressing her love for Shah Rukh Khan, while some others expressed their admiration for Rekha’s eternal beauty. Now, popular Pakistani actress Sajal Ali has joined the list. Recently, Sajal shared a fan-made video of Salman Khan on her Instagram story. In the caption of the video, Sajal Ali did not write a long sentence, she simply wrote, “My heart.” Fans are seeing Sajal’s love for Salman in a very positive way. Incidentally, Sajal Ali has proven her mettle not only on the Pakistani screen but also in Bollywood.

title: Bubly catches eye with her purple glow
body: Entertainment Desk : Shobnom Bubly is a glamorous actress of Dhallywood. Although she started her career as a news presenter, Bubly is currently one of the busiest actresses on the silver screen. She has long since won the hearts of the audience with her acting style and beauty. Her strong presence on social media is also noticeable. Bubly often shares her personal life and various moments with her fans. Recently, the heroine shared a bunch of pictures with her fans. In the picture, she is seen in an eye-catching purple dress. Her soft smile and charming appearance with open hair are spreading warmth in the net world. In the caption, Bubly wrote, “There’s always a reason to smile, you just have to find it.” Netizens are praising Bubly’s looks and leaving various comments in the comment box. One fan wrote, “Looks like a blue fairy, so beautiful.” Another commented, “Bubly Apu looks really gorgeous in the purple dress.” Most fans praised her sweet smile. Incidentally, Bubly made her big screen debut in 2016 with the film ‘Bossgiri’ opposite actor Shakib Khan. She made a name for herself in her first film with her smooth acting. After that, she never looked back. Currently, she is one of the top heroines of domestic cinema.

title: Properties worth crores of rupees of several Indian stars seized
body: Agencies : The Enforcement Directorate (ED) has seized assets worth crores of rupees belonging to several celebrities from West Bengal and Bollywood, including actress Mimi Chakraborty, actor Ankush Hazra and former Indian cricketers Yuvraj Singh and Robin Uthappa, for allegedly promoting and trading illegal betting apps. According to Indian media reports, assets worth a total of Rs 7.93 crore (about Tk11 crore in Bangladeshi currency) were seized on Friday in a case of financial fraud through an illegal betting app called ‘1xBet’. Of this, actress Mimi Chakraborty has assets worth Rs 5.9 million and actor Ankush Hazra has assets worth Rs 4.72 million. Among the cricketers, Yuvraj Singh’s assets worth Rs 2.5 crore and Robin Uthappa’s assets worth Rs 8.26 lakh have been seized. Apart from this, the ED has attached assets worth Rs 2.2 crore of Bollywood celebrities Urvashi Rautela, Rs 1 crore of Sonu Sood and Rs 1.26 crore of Neha Sharma. Urvashi’s assets were reportedly in her mother’s name. The ED has already questioned several celebrities in the long-running betting app scam. Mimi and Ankush were summoned to the central office in Delhi and questioned for several hours.

title: Nora Fatehi injured in road accident
body: Bollywood actress Nora Fatehi was involved in a road accident while on her way to attend American DJ David Getter’s concert in Mumbai. She suffered a concussion (brain injury) as a result of the accident. Nora was on her way to the Sunburn Festival to perform at a David Getter concert on Saturday night when another car hit her car. The driver was reportedly drunk. Nora was rushed to a nearby hospital immediately after the accident. Doctors performed a CT scan and found no bleeding or internal injuries. However, Nora suffered a concussion as a result of the accident.

title: ‘My clothes were getting wet, I was shaking with fear’
body: India’s popular comedian Bharti Singh has become a mother again. However, the moment of the arrival of her second child was not easy for Bharti at all. After becoming a mother, she shared that terrible and emotional memory on her YouTube channel, which brought tears to the eyes of her fans. Bharati said, “It was 6:00am. Suddenly, I realised that all my clothes were getting wet. Within moments, the bed sheets were also wet. I was very scared and was shaking. I immediately called the doctor. He said that my water had broken and I needed to be admitted to the hospital immediately.”

title: I don’t stop, I keep trying: Shakib
body: Dhallywood megastar Shakib Khan is always a surprise on screen. For the past few years, he has been appearing in front of the audience with a different look and innovative style in every movie. He himself has put an end to that curiosity. Shakib wrote, “Anyone can change themselves if they have time, experience, and the desire to learn. Those who stop moving forward, fall behind.” Referring to his constant journey, the superstar also wrote, “I don’t stop, I constantly try, change, and believe that every day is a golden opportunity to better myself.”

title: Income Tax department raids Shilpa’s house, restaurant, lawyer denies
body: Bollywood actress Shilpa Shetty’s Mumbai residence has been raided by Income Tax officials. The searches were conducted on the basis of allegations of fraud of Rs 60 crore. The Income Tax department also conducted searches at Shilpa’s restaurant ‘Bastian’ in Dadar. However, her lawyer has claimed that this news is baseless. He has clarified that no income tax ‘raid’ was conducted against Shilpa; rather, it was part of a regular verification process. In a statement issued on behalf of the actress, lawyer Prashant Patil said, “There was no Income Tax raid against Shilpa Shetty Kundra. The Income Tax officials merely verified the information as part of their regular follow-up verification.”

title: Shooting of new Spider-Man ends, to be released 31 July, 2026
body: Agencies : The shooting of the next installment of Hollywood’s popular superhero franchise Spider-Man, ‘Spider-Man: Brand New Day,’ has been successfully completed. The film’s director, Destin Daniel Cretton, announced this on social media last Friday. The big-budget film is set to be released next year. In a post on Instagram, director Cretton expressed his gratitude to the cast and crew of the film. Highly praising lead actor Tom Holland’s dedication and leadership, the director wrote, “Thank you for your generous leadership and dedication to your work on and off screen. I can’t wait for the audience to see this great work on the big screen.” Cretton also said that this movie is going to be the biggest and most fruitful work of his career. The new installment will feature a big surprise for the audience: Mark Ruffalo, known for his role as the popular character ‘Hulk’ in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. The film is written by Chris McKenna and Eric Somers. If all goes well, the Sony and Marvel film will be released in theaters worldwide on July 31 next year.

title: ‘Be happy as you are,’ Mim says in magic of rosewood
body: Entertainment Desk : Dhallywood actress Bidya Sinha Mim occasionally travels abroad. In that vein, she recently returned home from a trip to the Maldives. Mim shared some moments spent amidst the blue waters and peaceful surroundings with her fans. However, a white-yellow ‘wood rose’ has emerged as the centre of discussion. The actress posted some pictures from her trip to the Maldives on social media. Recently, Mim posted a few pictures on Instagram and wrote, “Be happy as you are.” In the shared photo, this Lux beauty is seen standing in front of a cottage surrounded by the sea. She has a rose in her ear and is wearing a striking sleeveless long dress in black and off-white. The photos seem to come alive with the combination of her enchanting look and sweet smile. Sometimes she is smiling softly at the camera, and sometimes she is framed by focusing on the softness of the rose. Netizens are fascinated by the soft appearance of her favourite star. Thousands of compliments are pouring into the comment box of the meme. One fan commented, “It’s like two flowers blooming at once.” Another wrote, “You look more beautiful than the rose.” It is learned that Mim returned to Dhaka and signed a contract for an untitled original film on December 13. She will be seen in the lead role in the movie directed by director Kazi Asad. Incidentally, Mim entered the entertainment world by winning the Lux-Channel i Superstar competition in 2007. She came to the attention of the audience by acting in the film ‘Aamar Achhe Jol’ directed by late Humayun Ahmed. Since then, she has gained popularity by working in television dramas and films. This heroine has made a place in the hearts of the audience with her acting skills.

title: “In the Face of Fading Intellect, Wealth Offers No Comfort”
body: Human intellect or even great achievements can disappear at any time. For example, an experienced brain surgeon with 40 years of success may himself fall ill, lose his memory, and become like a three-year-old child. If intelligence itself is so uncertain, then I feel there is really nothing to feel overly comfortable or excited about when it comes to wealth. – Rumana Rashid Ishita

title: Nabila appears  as ‘Bonolata Sen’
body: Entertainment Report : The film ‘Bonolata Sen’ is expected to be released this coming Eid-ul-Fitr. Centered on the imaginary female character created by poet Jibanananda Das, the film has been directed by Masud Hasan Ujjal. Although the movie was initially scheduled for release last year, the decision was postponed due to the circumstances at the time. Finally, the government-grant-funded film is set to hit theaters this Eid-ul-Fitr. Masuma Rahman Nabila plays the titular role in the film. However, becoming Bonolata Sen was not easy for her. It is known that she was initially offered a different character, but Nabila declined the proposal. She clearly informed the director that she wanted to play the character of Bonolata Sen. Subsequently, she proved her suitability for the role through three rounds of challenging auditions and ultimately secured the character. In Bonolata Sen, Khairul Basar portrays the role of Jibanananda Das. Other cast members include SohelMondol, Najiba Bashar, Priyonti Urbi, Ruponti Akid, Sharif Siraj, Sumaiya Khushi, among others. The film received a government grant of BDT 7 million in the 2021-22 fiscal year. The director stated that no effort was spared in making the film. Although it took more time, the work was completed with great care. Masud Hasan Ujjal said, “Working on Jibanananda Das carries a great sense of responsibility. Research, preparation, and finding suitable actors-the entire process was very challenging. Preparing everyone for the film was also a major task. We rehearsed for a long time. A large part of this film involved production design. It took a lot of time to create the cinematic look I wanted to see on screen.”

title: Item Girl Mimi
body: Entertainment Desk : Jeet is playing the central role in ‘Keu Bole Biplobi Keu Bole Dakat’, a film based on the life story of revolutionary Ananta Singh. To make the character believable, Jeet has completely transformed himself-losing weight, learning stick fighting, undergoing martial arts training, and even making major changes to his pronunciation and walking style. Meanwhile, according to reports in the Kolkata media, another major attraction of the film directed by Pathikrit Basu could be Mimi Chakraborty. She is expected to appear in a special song sequence in the movie-meaning Mimi may surprise audiences as an item girl. On the other hand, apart from Jeet’s film, Mimi Chakraborty will also be seen as the female lead in director Srijit Mukherji’s upcoming film Emperor vs Sarat Chandra. As a result, discussions in Tollywood are at their peak, with Mimi drawing attention through two contrasting appearances-an item song on one side and a lead role on the other. Additionally, newcomer actress Debottama Saha may be seen opposite Jeet in the film. This project will mark her debut in Bengali cinema.

title: Bappa’s new song ‘Ei Betha’
body: Entertainment Report : Bappa Mazumder, the singer of countless popular songs, has released a new track. The song is titled ‘Ei Betha’, with lyrics written by Mahi Flora and composed by Ehsan Rahi. The music arrangement is done by Amjad Hossain, and the video has been directed by Shubhrata Sarkar. The song has been released by Dhruba Music Station. Recently, a grand launch event for the song was held at Dhruba Music Station. Alongside Bappa Mazumder, several well-known figures from the music industry were present, including Tarun Munshi, Jewel Morshed, Lutfur Hasan, and Kishore Das. Speaking about the new song, Bappa Mazumder said, “After a long time, a song has been produced with proper planning, and I am delighted. Everyone involved in this project is extremely talented, and they have all given their best to the song. What makes it even more special is that the song was released on my elder daughter’s birthday, which has taken me to a completely different world of joy. As for the video, I believe it will bring a new dimension to the country’s music video scene.” Dhruba Guha, the founder of Dhruba Music Station and a musician himself, said,”We are happy to be able to release a song by a talented artist like Bappa Mazumder. We hope the song will find a place in the hearts of listeners.” Although Bappa Mazumder usually releases songs regularly on his own YouTube channel, this time he has sung a song written and composed by others. Currently, ‘Ei Betha’ is available on Dhruba Music Station’s YouTube channel as well as on all local and international music streaming platforms.

title: My door remains open to everyone in times of crisis: Pori Moni
body: Entertainment Report : Alongside her acting career and personal engagements, Dhallywood’s much-talked-about actress Pori Moni remains quite active on social media. She regularly shares moments from her life and her personal thoughts. This time, in an emotional post, the actress spoke about her experiences with “ungrateful” people. Pori shared that the very people she stands by during their difficult times often end up putting her in trouble and then walking away. Although she did not mention anyone by name, she wrote in a recent post on her personal Facebook account, “In everyone’s time of crisis, only my door remains open. And it is those very people who put me in trouble and then run away.” However, the actress said she is not disheartened by such incidents. Instead, she expressed pride in her humanity and conscience. In her words, “I still couldn’t change-neither my humanity nor my conscience. That is why Allah has given me the ability to help people like you. Alhamdulillah.” Meanwhile, Pori Moni is also going through a busy phase professionally. Her film “Dodor Golpo” is awaiting release, and another film titled “Golap” is also set to begin shooting soon.

title: I don’t look for work; let work find me: Mousumi Hamid
body: Entertainment Desk : Mousumi Hamid has returned to cinema after a long break with the film Tribunal. The movie is being directed by Raihan Khan and is based on a true story. About 75 percent of the shooting has already been completed. According to the director, the film focuses on women’s oppression and the fight for justice. Speaking about the project, Mousumi Hamid said that joining Tribunal was quite interesting. She had not worked with Raihan Khan for a long time, so it felt different for her as well. She added that she does not actively look for too much work; rather, she prefers limited work. She wants work to find her. Good stories and strong characters are what attract her, and Tribunal is exactly that kind of project.
