After reading the script, she told him that from what she found in the character of “Monowara,” she felt she could do justice to what was required and what she personally wanted to achieve within that scope. So she said yes.

title: Reunion of Moushumi and Shabnoor in US
body: Moushumi and Shabnoor are two legendary and once-rival stars of the golden era of Dhallywood cinema. Recently, the two popular actresses shared an emotional reunion in the United States. On December 17, Shabnoor traveled from Australia to the U.S. with her son Aizan to celebrate her birthday. She stayed at the residence of actor Amit Hasan during her visit. Upon hearing the news, Moushumi arrived with a bouquet of flowers to meet her. After a long time, seeing each other face to face, both stars became emotional and warmly embraced one another. Shabnoor shared this special moment on social media, writing, “After a long time, I met Moushumi apa. My heart felt full seeing her-words cannot describe how happy I felt!”

title: Tom Cruise looking for a girlfriend
body: Hollywood star Tom Cruise is reportedly ready to look for love again. Following his recent breakup with actress Ana de Armas, sources close to the actor say he is open to the possibility of a new relationship. After being together for nearly nine months, Tom Cruise and Ana de Armas have ended their relationship. According to multiple sources familiar with the matter, Ana decided to step away from the relationship due to Tom’s alleged controlling behavior and the significant age gap between them. However, people close to Tom say that despite the breakup, he is not the type to hold on to heartbreak for long. They believe he will soon become involved in a new relationship.

title: Atif praises Minar’s Song
body: At a time when discussions were intensifying over reports of Pakistani singer Atif Aslam holding a “secret concert” in Dhaka, popular Bangladeshi musician Minar Rahman shared photos and performance moments with Atif. The unannounced concert took place on Thursday at the campus of American International University- Bangladesh (AIUB), where Atif Aslam appeared as the main attraction. Minar Rahman also performed on the same stage during the event. After the concert, Minar shared a photo on social media and wrote that Atif Aslam had listened to his performance and praised him directly.

title: James Bond to be available on Netflix
body: Audiences will soon have another opportunity to watch the globally popular spy character James Bond. Starting in January, several films from the James Bond series will be added to the streaming platform Netflix. This development is quite surprising, as the rights to the Bond franchise are currently owned by Amazon MGM, a direct competitor of Netflix. From January 15, Netflix subscribers in the United States, German-speaking countries, France, Latin America, and several other regions will be able to stream the latest Bond film No Time to Die for three months, along with Die Another Day, Quantum of Solace, and Skyfall.

title: Story of ‘Rakkhosh’ brings Susmita to Dhallywood
body: Entertainment Report : West Bengal’s actress Susmita Chatterjee is making her debut in Dhallywood with Mehedi Hasan Hridoy’s ‘Rakkhosh’. This news was heard earlier this month. It was known that she would join the shooting of the second lot of the movie ‘Rakkhosh’ outside the country. However, surprising everyone, the heroine appeared at the official announcement of ‘Rakkhosh’ at BFDC on Wednesday. She said that the story of ‘Rakkhosh’ brought her to Bangladesh. Explaining the reason for joining the film ‘Rakkhosh’ at the press conference, Susmita Chatterjee said, “I was fascinated after hearing the story from the director Hridoy. I joined this film because of the story because the heroine has a lot to do in this story. I will try my best to portray the character on screen.” Regarding acting in a Dhaka film for the first time, the actress said, “I am very excited, this is the first time I have come to Bangladesh and am acting in a film. This day is very special for me. I have thanked the creator many times. This is the first time I am going to act in a Bangladeshi film with a good team, this is a great achievement for me.” Although she finds working in Dhallywood challenging, Susmita wants to overcome that challenge with everyone’s help. She wants to get the love of the Bangladeshi audience. She said, “When I first started working in cinema, I didn’t know anyone from the Kolkata film industry. I came to the film industry after a lot of hard work through auditions. Just as that was difficult for me, my first job in this country’s film industry will be challenging too. But after coming here and seeing everyone in the team, I feel like I can overcome the challenge. They don’t let me feel like I’m from another country for once. I came to get the love of the audience of this country; I hope to get a lot of love.” Susmita wanted to be an actress since childhood. She was also very good at studies. So, the family wanted her to finish her studies first, then do other work. As per her parents’ wishes, Susmita completed her degree in electronic engineering. After her studies, she got a job in a big company. But the job was not offered. She walked towards her childhood dream of becoming an actress. Susmita made her Tollywood debut with the movie ‘Prem Tem’ in 2021. After that, she worked in several movies including ‘Chengiz’ and ‘Manush’. Now, she has made her name in Dhallywood. Sharing her experience on the silver screen, Susmita said, “There is a lot of difference between the Susmita of the movie ‘Prem Tem’ and the Susmita of ‘Rakkhosh’. It has been four years since the movie ‘Prem Tem’. During this time, a lot of maturity has come to my work and personality. I hope everyone can understand that on screen.” Siam Ahmed is opposite Susmita in movie ‘Rakkhosh’. Bapparaj, Aliraj and others are also acting in it.

title: Want to give credit for my singing voice to Shabnur, says Kanak Chapa
body: Entertainment Report : One in front of the screen, the other in the atmosphere of the voice; whenever the golden days of Dhaka cinema are mentioned, the names of two female stars come to mind – Shabnur and Kanak Chapa. The combination of these two has won the hearts of the audience time and again. On Shabnur’s birthday, Kanak Chapa seemed to recall many unknown things about that era through an emotional recollection of her. Kanak Chapa wrote, “Her (Shabnur) acting style, her accent, her physical beauty, her moon-like face, her rose-like smile and her eyes have captivated the entire youth community for several decades. Her hair has not cut yet, and will never cut. Only one in a hundred people possess such talent. There are many of her contemporaries but no one is close to her.” Kanak Chapa has sung almost all the songs in Shabnur’s acting career. The artiste said about this long journey, “I have sung 99 out of her 100 songs. Our two bodies can be said to be one soul. I sang like me, she acted like her. But when I saw it on screen, I couldn’t believe that I had sung the song! It felt like it was her voice. I want to give full credit to Shabnur for this fusion of voice and acting.”

title: Celebs mourn death of Hadi
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : Sharif Osman Bin Hadi, a leading figure in the July uprising and spokesman for the Inqilab Mancha, breathed his last at around 9:45pm on Thursday while undergoing treatment at a hospital in Singapore. Hadi was seriously wounded in a gunshot to the head by terrorists during an election campaign in Purana Paltan in Dhaka on December 12. This brave young leader succumbed to his injuries after battling death for six days. The sudden death of Hadi has left the entire country stunned. The shadow of grief has also fallen on the country’s showbiz scene. Since the news of Hadi’s death spread, popular celebrities of the country have expressed their condolences and protest through emotional posts on social media. Actress Nusrat Imroz Tisha paid tribute to Hadi by posting a picture. She wrote, “Martyr Osman Bin Hadi will remain a symbol of our independence and sovereignty.” TV actress Rukaiya Jahan Chamak is shocked by the death of Hadi. She wrote, “Inna lillahi wa inna ilaihi raji’un. Remember the name, Shaheed – Bir Sharif Osman Hadi.” Later, in a long post, the actress raised questions and spoke about various sensitive issues. Chamak wrote, “He (Hadi) was not an MP-minister, he did not usurp anyone’s rights, he did not do injustice to the common people. Yet – because of a small word, a life can end like this? For which freedom of speech, so many movements, so many slogans – where does that freedom stand today? Does dissent mean punishment? Is asking questions a crime? Today Hadi, who tomorrow? This question is now, the time to look back at ourselves. I have never seen Hadi face to face. I have no blood relation with him. I’m not affiliated with any political party. Yet today my mind is wandering, a deep discomfort.” Finally, she mentioned, Sharif Osman Hadi (1993 – Infinity). Model and actress Peya Jannatul expressed her condolences to the family of Hadi and wrote, “This is truly heartbreaking and completely unacceptable. May Allah grant him the highest rank in Jannat, and grant his grieving family, especially his little child, patience, strength and comfort. Whoever he is, we want a future where politics is good, humane and responsible, where the value of human life comes first. Such loss of life should never become normal.” Actor Nasir Uddin Khan wrote, “I pray for the forgiveness of Osman Hadi’s soul. May his family, his little baby overcome this grief. May political ill will, political revenge, and political instability be eradicated. May peace return to the country, O merciful one.” Director Ashfaque Nipun wrote, expressing his respect for Osman Hadi. He wrote, “Osman Hadi, rest in peace. May Allah grant you Jannat and give strength to your family and newborn. They may have killed you but they cannot stop the fight you started. The killers must be brought to justice!” Meanwhile, protests, processions and arson attacks are taking place in various parts of the country over the death of Osman Hadi. Celebrities have expressed concern, especially over the attacks on media offices. In this regard, Ashfaque Nipun wrote, “The language of protest against the untimely death of martyr Hadi can’t be vandalism and anarchy. At this moment, everyone needs to be united. Those who want to create chaos in the country have different intentions. Don’t fall into their trap and risk the country’s resources and future!” Expressing her grief over the fire at the media office, Peya Jannatul wrote, “This is breaking my heart. Fire can destroy buildings, but courage cannot. Prothom Alo and The Daily Star will live on in the hearts of people.” She also wrote with surprise and regret, “Tomorrow, the arson will be discussed in the world media, but what was supposed to come was Hadi, his heroism, and the trial of the murder. When people die in this country, even grief is not safe. Everything is covered up – in fire, vandalism, politics. Here, the color of blood is political. Revolutions are always being disrupted here, we are always helpless here.”

title: We, musicians, will be in danger: Arnab’s concern
body: Taking advantage of the tense situation created by the death of Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi, incidents like clashes, vandalism and arson have taken place across the country. Cultural centres have not been spared from this fury. In particular, the incident of vandalism at the ‘Chhayanaut’ building has created deep concern and alarm in the cultural arena. On Friday morning, popular musician Shayan Chowdhury Arnab shared pictures of the destruction and expressed his concern. He wrote, “We have to actively participate and vote… otherwise we musicians will be in danger. Look what they did to Chhayanaut! The only way we can fight back is to vote and encourage others to vote too.”

title: ‘Avatar’ released in theatres in Dhaka
body: The record-breaking fantasy of the blue world is returning to the big screen. The third film in James Cameron’s epic science fiction series, ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash,’ was released worldwide on Friday. The much-awaited film will also be shown at the Star Cineplex in the capital for Bangladeshi audiences on the same day. Star Cineplex has already launched a ‘Now Showing’ campaign. The show will initially run from December 19 to December 24.

title: To survive in B’wood, you have to maintain personality: Madhuri
body: Madhuri Dixit, the Bollywood queen who rocked the screens of the nineties, has given the gift of numerous superhit films in her long career. However, even in this bright and successful career, there is a dark spot in that one scene from the movie ‘Dayabaan’ directed by Feroz Khan. After many years, she opened up about that bold and intimate scene with actor Vinod Khanna. Recalling that old mistake, Madhuri said, “Even today, when I watch that scene, I feel very helpless. But that one incident taught me how to maintain my personality and boundaries if I want to survive in Bollywood.”

title: Wiz Khalifa sentenced to prison for drug use
body: A Romanian court has sentenced US rapper Wiz Khalifa to nine months in prison for publicly smoking marijuana on stage. The verdict was announced on Friday. Wiz Khalifa, known for his hit ‘See You Again,’ has been sentenced to prison for smoking marijuana in public while performing at a ‘Bitch, Please’ concert in Costinesti, Romania last year. According to BBC, a Romanian court had previously fined him 3,600 Romanian lei (approximately Tk 96,000) in an initial ruling. However, after an appeal, the court overturned that decision and ordered him to serve a direct prison sentence.

title: My skin was burnt to ashes: Nazifa Tushi
body: Entertainment Report : She is returning with a new movie titled ‘Roid’ after three years in the movie ‘Hawa’ directed by Mejbaur Rahman Suman. Actress Nazifa Tushi plays one of the characters in it. However, portraying this character was not easy for Tushi. In a recent interview, Tushi said how hard she had to work to make herself believable on screen. The actress said that she did not resort to any artificial makeup to make her skin tanned for the character. Instead, she developed herself naturally. In this regard, Tushi said, “I used to apply mustard oil on my body and go out in the sun. If I apply mustard oil and go out in the sun, my skin burns very quickly. As a result, my skin became completely charred.” Explaining why she didn’t wear makeup, the actress said, “If you wear makeup, you’re afraid it might come off if you run, rain, or sweat. There was a possibility that my real skin would show through. So, I didn’t want to take the risk.” In her words, “This is the first time I have worked on a character that had no name. It was not easy to adapt myself to the psychology of the character. Although it looks easy, it was actually very challenging.” According to Nazifa Tushi, “We lived like locals there. Even for the shooting clothes, we bought used clothes from common people from the roadside ‘Tuker Bazar’ because my main goal was to bring credibility to the character.”

title: Chamak opens up about death threats
body: Entertainment Report : Many of the country’s top stars reacted to the attack on Sharif Osman bin Hadi, the spokesperson of the Inqilab Mancha, on social media. One of them, actress Rukaiya Jahan Chamak, said that she had received death threats for a post she had made wishing Hadi a speedy recovery and condemning the incident. Chamak said that she is being directly threatened from a Facebook account. She also alleged that her personal phone number has been leaked. She expressed deep concern about this. The actress released a video message about this. She said that she has received hundreds of calls so far; she is being threatened with death. In the video, she is heard saying, “I think I have at least done something for the country. And if they really kill me, then it will be a beautiful gift from Allah. It will be a martyr’s death.” Addressing her fans and well-wishers, the actress said, “Many are telling me to stay safe. Don’t worry about me. I’m not worried about it. If I really die, it will be with pride. And I won’t even sit at home in fear of being shot.”

title: Always be my side, keep me your prayers: Shabnur
body: Entertainment Report : Shabnur, a once popular actress of Dhallywood, occasionally shares news about her personal life and special moments with her fans on social media. This time, on the occasion of her birthday on December 17, she has shared a video with her fans. Meanwhile, in the caption of the video, she wrote, “Today is my birthday. The day is really special to me! It is really difficult to express in words the immense love and countless wishes that I am receiving on social media, on the phone, and in messages on the occasion of my birthday.” In her words, “As an actress, the love of my countless fans, listeners, colleagues and well-wishers is the biggest achievement and inspiration of my life. Everyone’s prayers and love make me more responsible and give me the strength to do better work.” Mentioning that everyone will always be by her side and keep her in alls prayers. The actress further wrote, “It is a blessing for me to have you by my side. Many thanks and love to all from the bottom of my heart. You will always be by my side and keep me in your prayers.” Incidentally, in 2005, Shabnur won the National Film Award for her performance in the film ‘Dui Noyoner Alo’ directed by Mostafizur Rahman Manik. Shabnur made her film debut with ‘Chandni Raate’ in 1993. Although the film was a commercial failure, she later achieved success by pairing up with late hero Salman Shah.

title: Apu-Momrenaz’s separation revealed
body: Entertainment Report : The family broke up six years ago. The news was kept secret for so long. Finally, it revealed recently. Actor Rashed Mamun Apu and private television channel’s news presenter Momrenaz Mom were married out of love. The two fell in love while studying at Rajshahi University, and that love led to marriage and family. Both of them said that they are no longer together. When contacted by Apu, he said, “We took the decision after discussing it because it is important for everyone to be well in life.” Momrenaz said that they ended their married life a long time ago. They brought the matter of their long-held secret separation to the public for their own relief. She wrote on Facebook, “Finally, Allah has forgiven us. We both decided to keep the separation secret for 6 years due to social barriers, fear, and shame. The matter of secrecy had become very painful for both of us. Therefore, we want to be clear about the matter by our mutual decision. Now, we are bringing the matter to the public very sincerely by our mutual decision. Separation does not mean destruction; it does not mean the end…” Apu-Momrenaz has a son in their family.

title: Sohini expresses love, admiration for acting of BD actors
body: Entertainment Report : Sohini Sarkar is a popular actress of West Bengal. She has made a place in the hearts of the audience of both Bengals with her fluent acting. In addition to acting, she regularly keeps track of Bangladeshi dramas and movies. In a recent interview, Sohini expressed her love and admiration for the acting of Bangladeshi actors. In the interview, Sohini specifically mentioned the duo of Afran Nisho and Mehazabien Chowdhury. She said, “I find the duo of Mehazabien and Nisho wonderful. I especially like Nisho’s works.” Paying tribute to the legends of the Bangladeshi acting world, Sohini said, “Whenever we talk about Bangladeshi actors, the names of Humayun Faridi, Suborna Mustafa, Mosharraf Karim or Chanchal Chowdhury come to mind. Apart from that, Jaya Ahsan or Aupee Karim are also my favourites.” In her words, “For those of us who see the work of Bengalis from both sides, the work of many Bangladeshi actors is great. To be honest, we are what we call a complete glutton for the work of many people.” Sohini praised the work of Tasnia Farin among the current generation of actresses. She also expressed her liking for the acting of Nusrat Imroz Tisha. The actress was even impressed by Shobnom Bubly’s performance opposite Siam in a project on the OTT platform ‘Chorki’. Sohini’s comment about Dhallywood superstar Shakib Khan, “There is nothing special to say about Shakib Khan, he is a huge star.” Apart from that, Sohini also recalled her working experience with film actor Arifin Shuvoo.

title: Nidhi subjected to extreme harassment while promoting film
body: Recently, popular South Indian actress Nidhi Agarwal was subjected to extreme harassment while attending an Indian film promotion event. She was left feeling extremely uncomfortable with her clothes amid the crowd and scuffles. The incident took place at the song release event of the film ‘Raja Saab’. The video also shows Nidhi, in a state of extreme panic and disorientation, somehow getting into the car and adjusting her clothes.

title: Our conversation started through birds: Priyanka
body: From Bollywood to Hollywood, Priyanka Chopra and American pop star Nick Jonas are at the centre of discussion and speculation everywhere. From their love to their family, the interest of fans is endless. Many were especially curious, how did our Bollywood’s Priyanka fall in love with this musician from the distant American country? The actress herself has unraveled the long-awaited mystery. In response, Priyanka smiled and said, “Not pigeons, but our conversation started through Twitter birds (current ex).”

title: Fashion influencer dies after falling from 10th floor
body: The 25-year Brazilian fashion and lifestyle influencer Maria Katiane Gomes da Silva has died under mysterious circumstances. She reportedly fell to her death from the 10th floor balcony of a high-rise building in Sao Paulo. The incident took place on November 29, but police in the country recently arrested her husband on suspicion of murder. According to the New York Post, Maria’s husband, Alex Leandro Bispo dos Santos, claimed it was a suicide after the incident. He said that she committed suicide by jumping off a balcony due to a family dispute.

title: Kumar Sanu files case against ex-wife
body: The long-standing feud between popular Indian singer Kumar Sanu and his ex-wife Rita Bhattacharya has reached the court’s doorstep. The legendary singer has filed a case in the Bombay High Court over Rita’s defamatory remarks. He has also demanded Rs 30 lakh as compensation. Kumar Sanu has taken legal action after being angered by his ex-wife’s comments. The singer claims that these allegations are completely baseless and motivated. Through this, his clean image built over a long 40-year career has been ruined.

title: Nick Reiner charged with parents’ murder in Los Angeles
body: Prosecutors in Los Angeles have charged Nick Reiner with the murder of his parents, filmmaker Rob Reiner and his wife Michele Reiner, two days after the couple were found dead in their home. District Attorney Nathan Hochman said the 32 year old faces two counts of first degree murder with a special circumstance alleging multiple murders. The charges also include an allegation that a knife was used in the killings. If convicted, Reiner could face life imprisonment without the possibility of parole or the death penalty. Prosecutors said no final decision has yet been made on whether they will seek capital punishment. Authorities said Rob and Michele Reiner were discovered with multiple stab wounds at their Brentwood residence. Autopsies are pending to determine the exact cause, manner and time of death. Reiner is expected to be brought before a court to formally hear the charges and enter a plea after he is medically cleared by prison officials. His arraignment has been postponed to a later date. Los Angeles Police Chief Jim McDonnell described the case as deeply personal and heartbreaking for the family and the city, and offered condolences to those affected. Rob Reiner was known for directing widely acclaimed films including This Is Spinal Tap, Stand By Me, The Princess Bride, When Harry Met Sally and A Few Good Men. Michele Reiner was an actress, photographer and producer, and the founder of a photography and production company. Tributes have poured in from friends and colleagues in the film industry, who remembered the couple as dedicated partners in both their creative work and public life.

title: Arjun Rampal confirms engagement to Gabriella Demetriades
body: Actor Arjun Rampal has confirmed his engagement to longtime partner Gabriella Demetriades, six years after they began dating. The announcement came during a conversation on Rhea Chakraborty’s podcast, when the topic of marriage arose unexpectedly. Gabriella spoke candidly about love and parenting, noting, “Love comes with conditions. With a child, it’s different.” Rampal added with humour, “I after her because she was hot. Then I realised there’s more to it than just that.” The engagement was confirmed when Gabriella remarked, “We are not married now, but who knows?” and Rampal immediately clarified, “We are engaged,” surprising the host. The couple, together since 2018, have two sons—Arik, born in 2019, and Arav, born in 2023. They have mostly kept their personal lives private, occasionally appearing publicly with their children. Gabriella, a South African model and designer, has previously discussed balancing her creative career with motherhood. Rampal was previously married to former supermodel Mehr Jesia. The couple, who married in 1998 and share two daughters, Mahikaa and Myra, announced their separation in 2018, finalising their divorce in 2019. Rampal has stated that they continue to co-parent amicably.

title: Pakistan to produce film on Lyari, cites Indian propaganda over Dhurandhar portrayal
body: Pakistani authorities have announced plans to produce a film titled Mera Lyari, citing what they described as Indian propaganda in the portrayal of Karachi’s Lyari area in the Bollywood film Dhurandhar. The Sindh Information Department said the upcoming film aims to present what it termed an accurate depiction of Lyari, contrasting with how the area was shown in Dhurandhar, which is set partly in Lyari between 1999 and 2009. The Indian film, released on December 5, depicts the area as being affected by gang violence, police operations, drug trafficking and militancy. Although Dhurandhar was not released in Pakistan, it has drawn attention there following its commercial success in India. The film was directed by Aditya Dhar and stars Ranveer Singh. In a post on X, the Sindh Information Department said Lyari represents “culture, peace and resilience” and rejected what it called attempts to portray the area through propaganda. It said Mera Lyari is scheduled for release in January 2026. Lyari, a densely populated neighborhood in Karachi, has historically been associated with gang-related violence, particularly during the early 2000s, a period depicted in Dhurandhar. The film includes characters based on real-life figures linked to criminal activity and law enforcement operations in the area. Officials said the new Pakistani film will focus on Lyari’s social and cultural identity. Further details about the cast and production have not been disclosed.

title: Where did Mehazabien go on vacation?
body: After a long 13-year relationship, popular actress Mehazabien Chowdhury tied the knot with director Adnan Al Rajeev in February this year. The star couple is now enjoying a happy married life. This time, they flew to the Maldives for a private vacation. The actress shared a bunch of pictures of special moments spent there with her fans on her social media. In shared pictures, the star couple is seen in a happy mood on the beach. The sweet smiles of the two make pictures more attractive.

title: Mysterious death of Hollywood director Reiner & his wife
body: Famous Hollywood director and actor Rob Reiner and his wife Michelle Reiner have died mysteriously. According to a BBC report, police recovered the bodies of the star couple from their home in Los Angeles, USA, on Sunday afternoon. Officers from the Los Angeles Police Department’s Robbery and Homicide Investigation Unit responded to the scene. Police are investigating the incident as a ‘possible homicide.’ The deceased, Rob Reiner, was 78 years old and his wife, Michelle Reiner, was 68 years old. Reiner has given Hollywood some of the most famous films include popular and classic like ‘The Princess Bride’, ‘When Harry Met Sally’ and ‘This Is Spinal Tap’.

title: Pori Moni stirs hullabaloo at parlour inauguration
body: Discussions and criticism are the constant companions of Dhallywood actress Pori Moni. She is often in the news for her various activities. Her personal life in particular often sparks controversy. The actress recently came into the limelight again when she inaugurated a beauty parlour in Narsingdi. This time, the reason for the discussion was her revealing outfit. Pori Moni was wearing a green sleeveless open gown at inauguration ceremony. Netizens didn’t take the heroine’s revealing outfit well. Many people shared Pori Moni’s pictures and videos and made negative comments about her clothing taste.

title: Akshay not happy even after becoming a millionaire
body: Akshay Kumar is one of the richest actors in Bollywood. His wealth and luxurious lifestyle are known to almost everyone. But despite being a millionaire, this superstar is not completely happy! He lamented in a recent interview; the actor said that due to his stardom, he can’t do a common habit of middle-class life even if he wants to. The actor said, “I used to go to the beach every day. I used to go there and exercise. But now I can’t go to the seashore and do these things. Yes, it’s something I miss a lot.”

title: Mim in new web film
body: Entertainment Report : Last month, popular actress Bidya Sinha Mim had said that the New Year will be her comeback year. That is how she is progressing. She has already completed the shooting of a movie with Saif Chandan whose name is yet to be finalised. Now the actress has joined a new web film. It will be directed by Kazi Asad. Initially, the movie has been named ‘Life Line’. It will be released on the OTT platform Chorki in 2026. Mim officially signed a contract with this web film two days ago. Mim said that she liked the story. She also said that she had not worked for so long because she did not like the story. “Many people want to know why I’m working less? Because the story itself was not suitable. Many story or work proposals came, but the story or the ancillary issues were not good. When Kazi Asad narrated this story and I saw his previous work in Chorki, I felt that the work needed to be done,” Mim said. Mim will be presented in a completely new way in this web film. Director Kazi Asad said, “Bidya Sinha Mim is a proven, talented and glamorous actress in our industry. We usually see her in a glamorous look. But the fun lies in how she can be broken down and presented to the audience in a new type of character. We have taken up that challenge. I hope the audience will agree with me.” The director does not want to talk about the story right now. He only said that it will be made in the emotional drama genre. The story was written by Mahmudul Hasan Tipu and Kazi Asad. Asaduzzaman Abir wrote the screenplay with the director. Shooting will begin at the end of this month. Chorki said that the names of Mim’s co-stars in this movie will be announced soon.

title: Badhon surprises everyone by losing 18kg in 6 months
body: Entertainment Report : Actress Azmeri Haque Badhon started her career in showbiz from the stage of the Lux Beauty Contest. Over time, she has added numerous dramas and web films to her portfolio. She has also left her mark on the big screen; she has won the National Film Award in recognition of her acting. However, this actress stands out not only for her acting but also for her looks. Even after 40 years, she continues to spread unwavering fascination among her fans. There is no hesitation in her bold presence; she has maintained her brilliance in her looks along with keeping herself fit through hard work. Recently, the actress shared the story of her fitness journey with her fans; sharing her experience of going from 78kg to 60kg. The actress surprised everyone by sharing separate pictures on social media, showing the difference in her transformation. Saying that this path to weight loss was not easy, Badhon wrote, “78kg to 60kg – I did it! This journey was not easy. My weight had increased as a result of mental health struggles, unhealthy habits and neglecting weight gain due to genetics. But with the right doctor’s guidance, discipline and confidence, I was able to lose 18kg in just 6 months.” The actress said her biggest strength was her daughter. She inspired her to exercise, stay away from junk food, and believe in herself every day. She added, “It’s not just about losing weight – it’s also a symbol of healing, strength, and self-esteem; I’m still moving forward.” However, Badhon’s efforts and weight loss have left his die-hard fans quite shocked! Currently, director Tanim Noor is busy with his new film ‘Banolata Express’. It is based on Humayun Ahmed’s novel ‘Kichhukkhon’. Badhon said that her daughter encouraged her to act in this film. The actress said, “I really like the producers and co-stars of this film. When Tanim Noor mentioned this character, my daughter said, ‘You do it.’ Because I’m always seen in serious and depressed characters and everyone knows how much I like Humayun Ahmed. After many years, I am getting the opportunity to work on his story. This is something special for me.”

title: Shadhika secures 2nd place in dance at ‘Notun Kuri’
body: Entertainment Desk : Nazifa Hossain Shadhika has secured second place in the General Dance category at ‘Notun Kuri 2025’, Bangladesh Television’s national talent search competition for children and teenagers. Shadhika is a regular student of Bangladesh Shishu Academy and studies at Udayan Higher Secondary School, says a press release. Competing against nearly 18,000 participants from across the country, Shadhika demonstrated exceptional skill and consistency. She emerged as the best performer in the Dhaka divisional round, ranked second in the top 10 selection, and later secured first place in the final top 10 round, earning her position among the top 5 nationally. Jointly organised by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and BTV, ‘Notun Kuri 2025’ features 12 categories,including dance, music, recitation and acting. Re-launched after 20 years, the competition has again become a major platform for discovering the young talents.

title: Case filed on Atif Aslam’s concert accused of fraud
body: Entertainment Desk : A case of fraud has been filed in court against five people, including the co-founder of the organising organisation, for not refunding ticket prices even after Pakistani artiste Atif Aslam’s concert was postponed. Lawyer Ahsan Habib Bhuiyan filed the case in the court of Dhaka Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate Zakir Hossain on Monday. The court recorded the statement of plaintiff Ahsan Habib Bhuiyan. Chalghuri Limited has been named as a company in the case. And four individuals have been named as accused. The accused in the case are : Kazi Rafsan, co-founder of the organising company ‘Main Stage Inc’, Briti Sabrina Khan, Chalghuri Limited’s Managing Director Asif Iqbal and Chairman Promee Islam. Plaintiff in the case, Ahsan Habib Bhuiyan, said that the court has taken cognizance of the application and asked the detective police to investigate the allegations and submit a report within the next 15 working days. According to the complaint, an advertisement was placed on a Facebook ID called ‘Main Stage Inc’ announcing that Atif Aslam’s concert would be held on December 13. The advertisement offered tickets of various categories. The plaintiff bought five tickets for the concert on November 19. He paid Tk 28,844 for the tickets. On December 12, the defendants announced on their Facebook page that the concert had been postponed due to lack of government permission. The names of six witnesses were mentioned in the case. They also bought six tickets of different prices. Charges of criminal breach of trust and fraud have been filed in the case. It is learned that the concert was scheduled to be held on December 13 at the China-Bangladesh Friendship Exhibition Centre in Purbachal. Earlier, in a Facebook post on December 11, musician Atif said that they were not performing at the concert scheduled for December 13 in Dhaka. The reason for this was that the concert organisers and management authorities were unable to secure the necessary local permits, security clearances and logistics.

title: As I get older, excitement is gone: Tasnuva Tisha
body: Entertainment Report : Tasnuva Tisha is a popular actress on the small screen. She has already won the hearts of the audience by playing various roles. In a recent interview, the star actress openly discussed her personal life and new projects outside of her work. Tasnuva Tisha said she doesn’t get as excited about her birthday as she used to. “I don’t really get that excited about my birthday anymore,” she said. “I’m not as excited as I used to be. Back in 2022, I was really excited about my birthday.” Regarding the disinterest, the actress said that it might be because of her age. In her words, “Maybe it comes with age, now I’m getting older; so the excitement is gone. I don’t like it anymore.” Tasnuva Tisha is coming to the audience with a new drama soon. The drama is titled ‘Life is Beautiful’. Written by Shafiqur Rahman Shantanu and directed by Chayanika Chowdhury, the drama can be seen on the Rangan YouTube channel. However, the actress believes that even though the name of the drama is ‘Life is Beautiful’, the reality of life is different. In this regard, Tisha said, “Although life is not always beautiful, life is really difficult.”

title: Habib’s song with lyrics by Alik
body: Entertainment Report : Film director SA Haque Alik and popular musician Habib Wahid met during making of movie ‘Hridoyer Kotha’. Habib’s song ‘Bhalobasbo Basbo Re Bondhu Tomay Jotone’ sung by Habib in this movie became popular. After that, Habib sang in almost all of Alik’s movies. Not only that, he also lent his voice to many songs written by Alik. Among the popular songs of this duo are ‘Prithibir Joto Sukh Joto Bhalobasa’, ‘Bolo Keno Emon Hoy’, ‘Jotsna Kotha Bolo Na’ etc. Habib last sang a song written by SA Haque Alik in movie ‘Golui’ in 2022. Zareen sang with Habib in the song titled ‘Jombe Mela’. Habib also composed the tunes and arranged the music. The director of this government-funded movie is Alik. Habib sang a solo song written by Alik for an album outside the movie 17 years ago in the album ‘Obosheshe’ released in 2008. Almost a decade and a half after that song, Alik wrote a song for Habib again outside the movie. The song titled ‘Piriti Shikhaili’ will be released on Habib’s YouTube channel. Apart from giving voice, Habib has also arranged tune and music of the song ‘Piriti Shikhaili’. About the new song, Alik said, “After many years, a song was written for Habib outside of cinema. The last one was written in one of Habib’s albums in 2008. After all these years, an audio song written by me in Habib’s voice is being released again. I like the tune and music arrangement of the song.” Last September, Alik announced on social media that he is writing four new songs for Habib. One of which is a duet and the remaining three are Habib’s solos. The releasing process of songs is starting with ‘Piriti Shikhaili’. Habib regularly releases songs on his YouTube channel. In that vein, he has released the new song from his own channel.

title: Victory Day song of 3 judges about 6 young stars
body: Entertainment Report : Lyricist Kabir Bakul, composer Emon Saha and singer Sania Sultana Liza were the judges of the ‘RTV Young Star’ competition in 2023. Sitting in the judges’ seat, they said that they would work to provide opportunities to the top artistes of the competition and make songs with them. As promised, they made songs with six of the top 10 contestants of that competition. The song, created on the occasion of Victory Day, was released on Liza’s YouTube channel yesterday. The song titled ‘Amra Sobai Bangladesh’ has been sung by Liza and Young Star 2023’s Zahid Antu, Anik, Arindal, Adiba, Ankita and Dipanwita. The tune and music have been arranged by Emon Saha. ‘Aamar Mukhe Bangladesh, Aamar Buke Bangladesh, Sukhe Dukkhe Aamar Bangladesh’ — the song was written by Kabir Bakul. The song ‘Amara Sobai Bangladesh’ was arranged and produced by Liza. The video of the song was directed by Raj Biswas Shankar. The shooting took place in various locations including Suhrawardy Udyan and Shikha Chirantan in the capital. About the song, lyricist Kabir Bakul said, “The original initiator of the song was singer Liza. Together, we have tried to present a beautiful song of the country. We have tried to convey the spiritual connection, emotional connection, and love that every person has for this beautiful country through the lyrics of the song.” Composer Emon Saha said, “Since the competition, we have wanted to sing with newcomers. This song is a reflection of that wish. Together, we have tried to present a beautiful patriotic song. I believe everyone will like the song.” Regarding talking about the song, singer Liza said, “I myself came from a reality show. But after the show, the rest of our journey is solo; there is no one to give us direction. I have realised from my own life that it is not enough to just find new artistes; we have to guide them properly. We have to be by their side. So while I was on the judge’s seat, I said that I will work for new ones, not just cover songs, and every new artiste needs to have original songs. So, this song of our country with young stars and I have tried to give a beautiful song. We want the song to reach all the listeners, so even though it is released from my channel; I’m not putting any kind of copyright restrictions. Anyone can release the song on any channel if they want.”

title: Tanha Tasnia in bold look with sweet smile
body: Entertainment Report : Actress Tanha Tasnia made her debut in Dhallywood in 2014 with the movie ‘Bhola To Jay Na Taare’. After that, she gave the audience popular movies like ‘Bhalo Theko’ and ‘Dhumketu’. She has made a place in hearts of audience with her acting skills. Besides, this heroine is also quite active on social media. She keeps in touch with her fans by sharing regular personal updates and pictures. This time, Tanha has caught the attention by sharing a bunch of pictures on social media. She has captured a bold look in those pictures. She has been captured wearing a large pendant matching a gorgeous black dress. Her sweet smile has caught the attention of netizens. Sharing the pictures, the actress wrote in caption, “Incredibly beautiful, radiant and full of that beauty.” She added a love emoji. Tanha Tasnia’s fans are impressed with her look. In comment box, one netizen praised her and wrote, “You look very beautiful.”

title: Madhumita in psychological thriller
body: A well-known name in the advertising world, Soumav Banerjee, is bringing a mysterious story to big screen. His first commercial feature film, ‘Otobi’, is a psychological thriller that has elements of horror, mystery and crime. One of the main characters in this multi-layered story will be seen in West Bengal’s actress Madhumita Sarkar. About her new work, she said, “It was a different experience doing the work. I have not worked on such a concept before. Soumavda is a very cool-headed person. The experience of working with him and with Sahebda, Rahulda, Inaya, and Aryan was also great. We shot the first part of the film in the jungles of Jhargram.”

title: I never eat at events: Karan Johar
body: The wedding season is in full swing. Along with the decorations, jewellery and excitement, one of the main attractions of this time is the delicious food of various flavours. For foodies, an invitation to a wedding is a great opportunity to forget about diet and indulge in delicious food. But for Bollywood director-producer Karan Johar, this picture is completely different. He has never eaten at a wedding function till date! He said, “I never eat food at weddings or any other event. I find it very uncomfortable to have to stand in long lines for food. I don’t like eating food while standing with a plate in my hand. That’s why I never eat at weddings.”

title: Disney’s billion-dollar deal to bring Mickey Mouse to life
body: Childhood favourites Mickey Mouse, Cinderella and Luke Skywalker from Star Wars are being brought to life through artificial intelligence (AI). Entertainment giant Walt Disney has signed a $1 billion investment and licensing deal with AI company OpenAI. OpenAI said the deal will allow users to create and share videos featuring more than 200 popular characters from Disney, Marvel, Pixar and Star Wars using its video generation tool, Sora. This is OpenAI’s first large-scale licensing deal, where Disney characters can be easily transformed into animated and realistic videos using text prompts. The deal is initially for three years.

title: ‘The Mask’ actor Peter Green no more
body: Actor Peter Green, best known for his role in the popular Hollywood film ‘The Mask,’ has died. His body was found in his New York City apartment on Friday. He was 60 years old at the time of his death. He is also remembered by cult classic fans for his role as Jade in ‘Pulp Fiction’.

title: Nodi’s New Song ‘Tumiheena’
body: Entertainment Report : Popular singer Moumita Tashrin Nodi has released her new solo song titled ‘Tumiheena’. The song was released on December 10 on Nodi’s official YouTube channel. The lyrics were written by Nodi herself, with lyrical support from Hridoy Hasin and Hema. The composition was done by Nodi and Hridoy Hasin, while the music arrangement was handled by Hridoy Hasin. Sayem Rahman worked on rhythm programming. The music video for ‘Tumiheena’ was directed by Sohel Raj, and Nodi herself appeared as the model in the video. Speaking about her new song, Nodi said, “The song is special to me for many reasons. Artists cannot always work exactly the way they want. That’s why, this time, I created the song by prioritizing what I truly like. From the lyrics, tune, and music arrangement to the video production-my personal preferences guided every aspect. Personally, I am very happy to be able to release a song that truly reflects what I love.” Nodi also shared that ‘Tumiheena’ has been produced under her own banner, ‘Nodimatrik Production’ Besides YouTube, the song is available on Spotify, Apple Music, and several other local and international music platforms. Notably, many of Nodi’s songs-such as ‘Jol chhaya’, ‘Nishshash’, ‘Rongila Akash’, ‘Ochinpur’, ‘Mugdhotaa’, ‘Amarto Keu Nei Tumi Chhara’, ‘Deshi Girl’, ‘Harano Jabe Na’, ‘Kotha Dilam’,’Tomake Debo Na Harate’ and ‘Suto Kata Ghuri’ from the film Poramon 2-have gained wide popularity among listeners.

title: Farzana Chumki Explains Mixed Reactions to Jaya Ahsan’s Photoshoot
body: Some of Jaya Apa’s hot photos seem incredibly good. But when I see some other photos, they don’t feel appealing. The reason is that when I first saw Jaya Apa, she was so conscious-even making sure a safety pin was in place so that her stomach wouldn’t be visible. I became accustomed to seeing her that way. That’s why, all of a sudden, it feels like a shock to us. Nothing more than that.(Regarding Jaya Ahsan’sphotoshoot) Farzana Chumki

title: Sabila ready for ‘Bonolata Express’
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actress Sabila Nur has begun work on a new film this December. She recently came into the spotlight after acting opposite Shakib Khan in the film ‘Tandob’. Following that, she was initially set to star in Mehdi Hasan Hridoy’s upcoming film ‘Rakshash’. However, she withdrew from the project a few days ago, as ‘Rakshash’ was scheduled to begin shooting this December. At the same time, filming for Bonolata Express is also set to begin this month, in which Sabila will be starring. Directed by Tanim Noor, the film also features Mosharraf Karim, Chanchal Chowdhury, and Shariful Raj. Due to scheduling conflicts with ‘Bonolata Express’, Sabila decided to step away from ‘Rakshash’. ‘Bonolata Express’ was officially announced on December 13. Sabila has been undergoing extensive preparation for the film, which will be the second movie of her career.

title: Oindrila returns hosting after a break
body: Entertainment Report : Oindrila is the younger daughter of legendary Bangladeshi film actor Bulbul Ahmed, widely known as a great hero of Bangladeshi cinema. From an early age, she has been involved in acting and singing. At one stage, she also became actively engaged in television hosting. After a break since 2017, Oindrila has returned to hosting on BTV with the cooking-based program ‘Amader Rosui Ghar’. The program recently began airing twice a week, every Sunday and Monday. Oindrila said, “At this moment, I am busy with BTV’s program ‘Amader Rosui Ghar’. Since it is broadcast twice a week, with eight episodes every month, I need to devote a considerable amount of time to this show.” Regarding her return to acting, Oindrila said, “I will return to acting if the story is beautiful and the character is beyond the conventional type. I enjoy acting the most. Even now, many fans and viewers request me to act again. I want to tell them that I will definitely return to acting if I get a good story and a strong character.”

title: For me, feminism means equality
body: Entertainment Desk : Koel Mallick is a popular actress from Kolkata. Although she previously acted mostly in conventional roles, she is now focusing on more meaningful and quality work. One of the three Bengali films set to be released at the end of the year is Mitin Mashi. At present, Koel is busy promoting the film. In a recent interview, while talking about her films and personal life, she was asked, “Your life seems absolutely perfect. Many people wonder whether life can really be this well-organized.” Responding to this, Koel said, “If I am selfish about anything, it is my peace. Because I can do anything in life to attain peace. As a person, I am not emotional at all. That does not mean my life has no problems. Life is not a road strewn with rose petals; it has many thorns, and I have faced them too. Those experiences have remained as lessons in my life. Whenever there is a problem in my personal life, I take some time and then address it by talking directly.” At one point during the interview, Koel spoke about feminism. She said, “For me, feminism means equality. Now that picture is changing. Unfortunately, many people are beginning to forget that. Our intention should never be to belittle anyone. If a woman says, ‘I am a feminist, so I will not iron my husband’s clothes,’ I have an objection to that. Because we are partners, not competitors.”

title: I Spent Ten Years Preparing Me for Cinema
body: Entertainment Desk : Tania Brishty is a contemporary actress and model. Although she is a familiar face in television dramas, she made her big-screen debut in 2015 with Akram Khan’s ‘Ghasphul’ . Recently, she has started shooting for her new film ‘Tribunal’ , which is expected to be released this upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr. Speaking about not being regular in films, Brishty said, “After becoming a Channel i Top Model, I had a film contract with them. At that time, I thought it would be very easy. Later, I realized that cinema is a much larger canvas. To survive here, you need talent, preparation-everything. So I decided that I had to prepare myself first. I took that preparation by working on the small screen. Over these ten years, I have shaped myself specifically for cinema.” She added, “Over the past few years, I was often asked-am I returning to films? Will I act on the big screen again? Now there is no need to say anything separately. I am returning through ‘Tribunal’-that is the answer. Even though it took a long time, I feel I am returning at the right moment.”

title: Messi and Shah Rukh in the same frame in Kolkata
body: Lionel Messi’s India tour began on Friday in Kolkata. On the very first day of the GOAT India Tour 2025, the meeting between Messi and Shah Rukh Khan became the center of discussion. Photos of the two global icons from different worlds went viral on social media within moments. At a closed-door event, Messi was joined by Luis Suárez and Rodrigo De Paul. In the presence of guests and organizers, they warmly exchanged greetings with Shah Rukh Khan. On the same day, Messi also inaugurated his 70-foot iron statue near the Salt Lake Stadium.

title: ‘Man vs Baby’ released on Netflix
body: The English series Man vs Baby, starring popular actor Rowan Atkinson, best known for Mr. Bean, was released on Netflix on December 11. The story follows Bingley (Rowan Atkinson), who takes a job as a caretaker at a school. He is in a cheerful mood as the school is about to close for the Christmas holidays. On the last day of classes, Bingley finds two unidentified children near the school. When no parents can be located, he begins taking care of them. While trying to manage the children, Bingley repeatedly finds himself in a series of humorous problems. In addition to acting in the series, Rowan Atkinson also co-wrote and co-directed it with Will Vedis.

title: Intimate scene was the reason behind Samantha’s divorce
body: A few days ago, Samantha Ruth Prabhu married filmmaker Raj Nidimoru. Earlier, she was married to Telugu actor Naga Chaitanya, but their marriage ended in divorce just three years later. Samantha and Naga Chaitanya were considered Tollywood’s “perfect couple.” While acting in an intimate scene in the series The Family Man 2, directed by Raj and DK, distance reportedly developed between Samantha and Naga Chaitanya. Although that particular scene was later removed from the series, there were objections even to the scenes that were aired. Not only Naga Chaitanya, but also his father and Samantha’s former father-in-law, Nagarjuna, reportedly had objections to it.

title: Atif Aslam’s concert cancelled
body: The December 13 concert in Dhaka by popular Pakistani music star Atif Aslam has been postponed. The reason for the cancellation is the organizers’ failure to complete the necessary local permissions, security clearances, logistics, and other formalities. Meanwhile, over the past few months, one concert after another has been cancelled in Dhaka. Regarding the cancellation of his concert, Atif Aslam expressed his regret to Bangladeshi fans on social media. In a post, he wrote: “Dear Bangladeshi fans, it is with great regret that I inform you that our concert in Dhaka on December 13 will not be taking place.”

title: Messi meets Shah Rukh Khan during GOAT India Tour
body: Football superstar Lionel Messi met Bollywood icon Shah Rukh Khan and his son AbRam in Kolkata on Saturday as his much-awaited GOAT India Tour got underway, marking the Argentine legend’s first visit to India in more than a decade. Visuals shared by news agency PTI showed Shah Rukh Khan and young AbRam posing with Messi at the venue ahead of the main programme. AbRam was also seen clicking pictures with the World Cup-winning footballer, drawing wide attention from fans. Messi is scheduled to virtually unveil a 70-foot statue of himself from Kolkata’s Salt Lake Stadium later in the day. The event is being attended by West Bengal Minister Sujit Bose along with several prominent personalities from sports and entertainment. Shah Rukh Khan arrived in the city earlier on Saturday with his son. His manager Pooja Dadlani was also spotted with them at the airport. Earlier this week, Shah Rukh hinted at meeting Messi in Kolkata, saying on social media that he was looking forward to a day dedicated entirely to the football legend at the Salt Lake Stadium. The GOAT India Tour marks Messi’s first trip to the country since 2011, when he played for Argentina in an international friendly at the same venue. Messi landed in Kolkata early Saturday and received a warm welcome from cheering fans at the airport. The three-day tour will cover four cities, with Messi scheduled to travel to Hyderabad later on Saturday, followed by visits to Mumbai and New Delhi in the coming days.

title: It’s not unusual to have money: Kushum’s reply on ‘sugar daddy’ querry
body: Entertainment Report : Seeing the glamorous lives of showbiz stars, especially heroines, many people assume that there must be a man behind their financial prosperity; the so-called ‘sugar daddy’. This idea has been prevalent in society for a long time. When a woman lives well on her own income, the credit is often given to someone else. This is why heroines or actresses often face uncomfortable questions. Actress Kushum Sikder is also on that list. Recently, while talking about her personal life and media rumours on a television show, the actress was asked such a question. The host asked her directly, “Do you want to be a sugar mummy?” Kushum jokingly said, “Oh my Allah! In an interview, I was asked – do I have many sugar daddies! Or do I have a godfather, or was one? At that time, I was a little annoyed but laughed and said, is there still time for sugar daddies? Now is the time to be a sugar mummy!” Explaining her position on this matter, she said, “These are very stupid things. Those who don’t know, they say this; those who have seen me recently, during the promotion of film ‘Shoroter Joba’. They may have seen my clothes, jewellery, and watch and wondered where all this money came from? That’s when I guessed, there must be someone helping!” Kushum said that he has been working in showbiz for more than two decades. In this regard, she said, “I have been in the media for 23 to 25 years. I have been earning since I was 21 years old. After working for so many years, it is normal to have some money. On the contrary, it is abnormal not to have any.”

title: Nisho shares his Eid movie’s shooting experiences in Kazakhstan
body: Entertainment Report : Actor Afran Nisho’s birthday was on December 8. Like every year, his fans celebrated the day with a special event. However, many assumed that Nisho would not be able to attend the event as he was in Kazakhstan shooting for the movie ‘Domm’. In the end, he surprised everyone by attending the birthday celebration with his fans. The shooting in Kazakhstan ended on December 6. After returning home, Nisho attended his birthday party at the invitation of his fans. ‘Domm’ movie’s director Redoan Rony and heroine Puja Cherry were present with him on that day. Naturally, the topic of ‘Domm’ came up. Director Rony told how difficult the shooting was under. One day, Nisho cut his hand while shooting in the mountains. It was not possible to provide him with advanced medical care immediately because the shooting took place in a remote area. Still, Nisho did not stop, and continued shooting risky scenes despite being injured. Sharing his experience of shooting the movie ‘Domm’, Nisho said, “We all want a story, we want a performance. The responsibility of a story like ‘Domm’ is on my shoulders; it is like a blessing for me. If I can’t fulfill it properly, then how will it be? I know that as a senior, the speed of the team depends a lot on me. At that time, this amputation of the hand, the amputation of the leg, whether medical support came or not, these are not issues. Apart from that, we had a very tight schedule. A 10-minute break there meant failing the schedule. I can confidently say that the team worked as hard as they did on this movie, I have never had to work so hard on any production. There were many obstacles there.” Despite various obstacles, the ‘Domm’ team completed the shooting in Kazakhstan on time. Nisho said, “With age and experience, the responsibility increases. Here, I didn’t think of myself as just an actor. I thought, I’m also a part of the producer. In the weather we worked in, there is no sunlight at 2:00pm. We never thought that sunlight would disappear at 2:00pm. Despite all these complications, we did not shoot for more than a day. We completed the work on time. We kept our word to those involved in the film.” The actor does not want to talk about the story of movie ‘Domm’ right now. He only said that such a story has not been worked on in the Bangladeshi film industry before. He hopes that everyone will enjoy the story and after watching the movie, everyone will be proud that it is a Bangladeshi movie. After shooting in Kazakhstan, ‘Domm’ will now be shot in the country. After a few days of rest, the actors will once again stand in front of the lights and cameras. Chanchal Chowdhury is also acting in it along with Nisho and Puja Cherry. ‘Domm’ will be released in theatres on Eid next year.

title: Glamorous Purnima in black saree
body: Entertainment Report : Dilara Hanif Purnima is a popular actress of Dhallywood. She continues to fascinate two generations of viewers equally with her looks and acting. This heroine, who started her acting career in the late nineties, has retained that seductive appeal even after two and a half decades. Purnima’s popularity on social media is also great. She regularly posts her pictures; and fans shower her with love and praise. Especially, fans are always interested in her ‘ageless’ beauty. Purnima posted a few new photos on her verified Facebook page. There, she is seen dressed in a black saree, along with matching jewellery. She wrote in the caption of the photo, “Black is my happy colour.” Immediately after the photo was released, the comment box was filled with praise from fans. Many also praise her new style, makeup, and fashion sense. Purnima rose to fame in 2003 with the India-Bangladesh joint production movie ‘Moner Majhe Tumi’. Later, she earned further acclaim for her performance in ‘Hridoyer Kotha’, directed by SA Haque Alik, in 2006. She has been consistently performing for over two decades, and is still relevant today for her beauty and sophisticated presence.

title: Alia receives special honour in Jeddah
body: Bollywood actress Alia Bhatt has been awarded the ‘Golden Globe Horizon Award’ at the Red Sea Film Festival in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. The award is given to the actress to recognise creative talent from around the world. The special honour was given at a gala dinner at the ongoing festival. Alia expressed her excitement after receiving the Golden Globes Horizon Award. She said, “The Golden Globes are an iconic part of the global awards show world, and I am thrilled to be a part of it. I look forward to continuing my career by telling more stories of powerful and capable women.”

title: Johnny Depp gives good news to audience at Saudi Film Festival
body: There is great news for fans of Hollywood’s popular actor Johnny Depp. The star announced the news at the Red Sea International Film Festival held in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. Johnny Depp is set to produce the first English-language film adaptation of the famous novel ‘The Master and Margarita’ by the legendary Russian writer Mikhail Bulgakov. The ‘Pirates of the Caribbean’ actor is giving a great gift to movie fans with the announcement of this new project. However, no separate director has been attached to this film. In addition, Depp’s own production company ‘In Dot To Film’ is working on this film.

title: Heels are my biggest fear now: Methila
body: Bangladesh’s Tangia Zaman Methila has been struggling a lot in the Miss Universe competition. She returned home last month after a four-week long trip to Thailand. Mithila is happy to be in the top 30 even though she didn’t win the crown. She recently appeared on a television show. There, the model-actress highlighted challenging moments on the Miss Universe stage. Especially the long time she had to wear heels during the competition, which was a big challenge for her. She said, “My biggest fear right now is that I don’t want to wear 6-7 inch heels anymore. Because throughout my journey, since I was a little shorter than the other contestants, I had to wear 7 inch heels the whole time. Because of that, I got a lot of scars on my feet.”

title: Chinmayi harassed by showing distorted pics, threatened with death
body: South Indian singer and dubbing artiste Chinmayi Sripada has been a victim of cyberbullying. She has alleged that an anonymous account on social media sent her nude photos and made threats. The artiste said that the entire family is under stress after the incident. In a post on Instagram, Chinmayi said that the unknown person not only stopped sending her derogatory pictures, but also continuously abused her in inaudible language. He even threatened to kill her two children. She has filed a complaint with the police against all these.

title: Cheating men keep infidelity a secret: Bhabna
body: Entertainment Report L Actress Ashna Habib Bhabna has made a place in the hearts of the audience with her acting skills from the small screen to the big screen. She entered the acting world through the TV drama ‘Not Out’. Then her film career started with ‘Bhoyonkor Sundor’. Along with acting, this actress is also quite active on social media. She often expresses her own thoughts on various issues related to her personal life or surroundings. Recently, there is a lot of discussion around a post of the actress. Although Bhabna did not directly mention any specific person or incident, in this post she talked about a cheating man and his betrayal. In her post, Bhabna expressed her faith in Allah. She wrote, “A cheating man keeps his infidelity a secret, but Allah reveals it to protect the woman he is hurting because Allah sees things that he can’t see.” Referring to the cheating man’s lies and silent broken promises, Bhabna further writes, “Every lie told in her absence, every promise silently broken, every moment when she cried and the man pretended that everything was fine.” “A man may think he is so clever that he can erase the traces of his deeds, but nothing hidden remains hidden forever. Allah reveals the truth not to destroy him, but to save his heart from a life of torment,” she added. Bhabna concluded by writing, “Betrayal may be done in secret, but its manifestation is divine protection. When Allah removes the veil, it is not punishment but salvation. And now I can proudly say Alhamdulillah.”

title: Kate Winslet objects to plastic surgery
body: Agencies : Many people are now resorting to plastic surgery to maintain their beauty. This trend has recently increased among new Hollywood actresses. Oscar-winning actress Kate Winslet has criticised the issue. In an interview with the Sunday Times, Kate said, “This generation of actresses is obsessed with looking perfect to get more likes on Instagram. It really bothers me.” Not only plastic surgery, many people take various medications to lose weight. Expressing annoyance about this, Kate Winslet said, “If someone thinks that their self-esteem will be determined only by their appearance, then that is terrible. Many people are taking medications to lose weight. They are spending a lot of money on Botox and fillers. These have become like addictions to them. They are not satisfied with their bodies and appearance. But in fact, they are not aware of how much these medications are harming them. They are neglecting their health. Overall, the situation is getting worse.” Kate Winslet said she never thought of resorting to these methods to prevent aging. The actress said that it is not only her, but also Helen Mirren, Toni Collette, Andrea Riseborough, Sigourney Weaver – all have shown the thumbs up to the trend of plastic surgery in Hollywood. Kate Winslet also said, “I love to see when the hands and face show signs of age. That’s life. Appearances change with age. Many of the most beautiful women in my eyes are over 70. Many women today have no idea about beauty, it frustrates me.”

title: What did Jaya hint about apples?
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actress Jaya Ahsan is a new surprise. She has made a place in the hearts of the audience with her looks and acting skills, and she is also quite active on social media. This time, this talented actress has been seen in a new avatar, which has impressed her fans. Jaya shared a bunch of pictures on social media. Her fashion statement in these pictures was completely different. The actress is seen wearing a red blouse with gorgeous stone work, with which she is wearing grey jeans. Jaya seems to have caught everyone’s attention with this fusion look of tradition and modernity. In the shared picture, a red tip on her forehead, a red and white rose on her head, and stylish sunglasses on her eyes gave her a very noble look. She was wearing stone bangles and bracelets. But the biggest surprise of this whole look was a small red apple in her hand. The heroine has posed in various poses with the apple. Sometimes she has taken pictures holding the apple in her hand, sometimes balancing it on her head, and sometimes even holding it close to her lips. Posting these pictures, Jaya wrote in the caption, “Don’t be an apple.” As soon as these exceptional pictures of Jaya were released, fans filled the comment box with love.

title: Drama based on story of a Facebook post, Ahona in its central role
body: Entertainment Report : Inspired by a story from a Facebook post, Mohin Khan made a drama titled ‘Poton’. He has written the screenplay of the drama as well as directing it. The screenplay of the drama is based on a woman. Ahona played the central role, while Rashed Shemanto played the role of her husband. Ahona is not working regularly like before. She shoots when she likes the story, script, and character. Regarding acting in this drama, she said, “I have acted in several dramas under Mohin’s direction before. The story idea and script of this drama were great. My character is quite challenging. There are many ups and downs. I have tried to portray the character. I hope the audience will like the drama when it is aired. I give thanks to Mohin for giving me the opportunity to work in a beautiful character.” The director also said that the drama ‘Poton’ will be released on the YouTube channel. The release date and channel name will be announced soon.

title: No matter how good AI is, real feelings belong to humans: DiCaprio
body: The world of the silver screen, Hollywood, is now in an atmosphere of suppressed tension, fear and anxiety because, artificial intelligence (AI) is taking over as the doer of all jobs. News is coming in that many have already lost their jobs. Actor Leonardo DiCaprio said, “AI may be useful for new or novice creators, it can be a good helping tool. It can lead to new types of visuals or work. But what art means – that which has the imprint of human thoughts, emotions, real experiences; that can only come from people.”

title: Priyanka Chopra warns Kapil Sharma!
body: Priyanka Chopra, who was once a fringe actress in Bollywood, is now an iconic name across the globe. After establishing herself in the Western entertainment world, she has now become a darling in the South Indian film industry. Director SS Rajamouli is set to start shooting for his big-budget film ‘Varanasi’. After that, Priyanka has started getting offers for big-budget South Indian films one after the other. For this reason, Priyanka is frequently coming and going from the US to India. However, the main reason for her return to India this time is to join the new season of the popular comedy show ‘The Great Indian Kapil Show’ as a special guest. After landing in Mumbai, Priyanka threw a kind of ‘warning’ to the host Kapil Sharma!

title: Actress Rhea doesn’t act, but she’s worth millions
body: Rhea Chakraborty has no interest in returning to Bollywood. After Sushant Singh Rajput’s death, she was involved in various controversies, but was later cleared of all charges. And then she took a different path; she left acting and focused entirely on business. And she has earned crores of rupees in that business! In a recent interview, Rhea said that her clothing brand ‘Chapter Two Drip’ has earned around 40 crore taka in the last one year. The brand’s name ‘Chapter Two’ symbolises starting the second chapter of life. She launched her online store in August 2024. She also established her own showroom in Bandra, Mumbai.

title: I didn’t think there was so much waiting for me in world: Shah Rukh
body: Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan attended a grand event in Dubai where he spoke about an incident in his life that changed the course of his life. The terrifying experience that came to him before he entered the world of Bollywood. Shah Rukh was a guest at the inauguration of a luxury commercial tower named after him in Dubai. He was also joined by his longtime friend and director Farah Khan. During a conversation with Farah, the actor recalled that difficult time in his life. Shah Rukh said, “The moment that changed my life came at a very young age, when I lost my parents. I felt like they had become stars in the sky. They would never see me again.”

title: DiCaprio’s “One Battle After Another” leads Golden Globe race with nine nominations
body: year’s Golden Globe Awards, securing nine nominations as Hollywood steps into its awards season. The film, centred on the abduction of a former revolutionary’s daughter, earned a spot in the best musical/comedy film category. DiCaprio and co-stars Sean Penn, Teyana Taylor, Benicio Del Toro and Chase Infiniti were all nominated for acting awards. Norwegian family drama Sentimental Value followed closely with eight nominations. Other major acting contenders this year include Dwayne Johnson, Timothée Chalamet and Wicked: For Good stars Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande. Despite its strong box office showing, the Wicked follow-up did not secure a best film nomination. Winners will be announced on January 11 in Los Angeles, a key milestone ahead of the Oscars in March. This year’s film lineup also includes nominations for Hamnet, Sinners, and Guillermo del Toro’s Frankenstein. Irish actors Paul Mescal and Jessie Buckley were recognised for their roles in Hamnet, while Chalamet received a nod for portraying table tennis champion Marty Mauser in Marty Supreme. George Clooney earned his 14th Golden Globe nomination for his performance in Jay Kelly, while co-star Adam Sandler secured a supporting role nomination. Emma Stone was recognised for her role in the dark comedy Bugonia, which also brought a nomination for Jesse Plemons. International cinema has had a strong showing, with Iranian filmmaker Jafar Panahi’s It Was Just an Accident receiving four nominations. Other foreign-language contenders, The Secret Agent and No Other Choice, earned three nods each. On the television side, British drama Adolescence scored four acting nominations — for Stephen Graham, Owen Cooper, Erin Doherty and Ashley Walters — and is competing for best limited series. Only The White Lotus, with six nominations, performed better among TV entries. The Pitt, Severance, Slow Horses, The Diplomat and Pluribus also made the shortlist for best TV drama. This year saw notable surprises, including Emily Blunt’s nomination for The Smashing Machine and indie actor Eva Victor’s unexpected best actress nod for Sorry, Baby. Director Chloé Zhao made history by becoming one of the few women nominated twice for a Golden Globe. Several actors, including Amanda Seyfried, Jacob Elordi and Jeremy Allen White, received double nominations across film and television categories. The ceremony, hosted for a second consecutive year by comedian Nikki Glaser, will also see competition for best original song, with nominees from Avatar: Fire and Ash and KPop Demon Hunters. Radiohead’s Jonny Greenwood received a nomination for best score for One Battle After Another.

title: Hema Malini shares emotional tribute on Dharmendra’s 90th Birthday: “Two weeks since you left me heartbroken”
body: Hema Malini shared an emotional message on what would have been Dharmendra’s 90th birthday, saying it has been “two weeks since you left me heartbroken.” Their daughters Sunny Deol and Esha Deol also posted touching tributes in memory of their father. On December 8, Dharmendra’s birth anniversary, Hema posted several photos along with a heartfelt note. The legendary actor passed away on November 24, leaving fans across the country stunned. “Dharam ji, happy birthday my dear heart,” she began. “It’s been more than two weeks since you left me shattered, trying to piece my life back together, knowing you will always be with me in spirit.” She continued, “The joyful memories of our life together can never fade. Reliving those moments brings me comfort and strength. I thank God for the beautiful years we shared, for our two wonderful daughters who reflect our love, and for all the cherished memories that will stay in my heart forever.” On his birth anniversary, she offered prayers for him, writing, “May God bless you with eternal peace and happiness, which you so richly deserve for your humility, kindness, and love for humanity. Happy birthday, my dearest love.” Hema ended her post by sharing two photos with Dharmendra, captioning them, “Our happy ‘together’ moments.” Earlier in the day, Sunny Deol shared a video tribute, while Esha Deol posted a set of photos remembering their father. Dharmendra passed away at his Mumbai residence on November 24. He had been admitted to Breach Candy Hospital with breathing complications but was discharged on November 12.

title: Golden Globes 2026 announces full list of film and TV nominees
body: The nominations for the 2026 Golden Globe Awards were announced on Monday, marking the start of Hollywood’s award season and setting the stage for the Oscars in March. This year’s shortlists highlight the biggest films, series and performances across drama, comedy, animation and international categories. Winners will be declared on 11 January. In film, Frankenstein, Hamnet, The Secret Agent, Sentimental Value and Sinners lead the drama lineup. The comedy and musical list includes titles like Blue Moon, Bugonia, Marty Supreme and One Battle After Another. It Was Just an Accident, No Other Choice and Sirât feature among the top non-English entries, while Zootopia 2, Elio and Arco compete for best animated film. Actors Jessie Buckley, Jennifer Lawrence, Renate Reinsve and Julia Roberts earned recognition in the drama category. For male actors, nominees include Joel Edgerton, Oscar Isaac, Dwayne Johnson and Jeremy Allen White. In comedy or musical categories, Cynthia Erivo, Emma Stone, Kate Hudson and Leonardo DiCaprio appear among the leading nominees. Supporting roles include Emily Blunt, Ariana Grande, Benicio Del Toro and Adam Sandler. Top directors Paul Thomas Anderson, Ryan Coogler, Guillermo del Toro and Chloe Zhao earned nods for their work. In television, The White Lotus leads with six nominations. Other contenders include The Diplomat, Severance, Slow Horses, Abbott Elementary, The Bear, Black Mirror and Adolescence. Notable TV acting nominees range from Helen Mirren, Bella Ramsey and Keri Russell to Sterling K Brown, Gary Oldman and Adam Scott. Comedy nominations include Kristen Bell, Ayo Edebiri, Selena Gomez, Steve Martin and Jeremy Allen White.
