This year also introduces a new category for podcasts, with Armchair Expert with Dax Shepard, Call Her Daddy and SmartLess among the nominees. The full list reflects a wide mix of global cinema, hit series and standout performances leading into the 2026 awards season.

title: Oscars to honor casting for the first time, spotlighting a vital filmmaking craft
body: Behind the world of Oz in the two-part “Wicked” films were the people responsible for choosing who would inhabit it. Long before filming began, casting directors were quietly shaping the production by selecting the actors who ultimately brought the story to life. “Our job is to know every actor out there — or know how to find the ones we don’t,” said Bernard Telsey, one of the industry’s leading casting directors who, along with Tiffany Little Canfield, cast both “Wicked” movies. Casting will receive long-awaited recognition at the next Oscars. The Academy Awards will introduce a new category honoring achievement in casting when the 98th ceremony airs live on ABC on March 15, 2026 — a milestone many in the field say is overdue. “It’s hard for people to understand what we do because it all happens behind closed doors,” Telsey said. “This award will strengthen the profession and raise awareness of our work.” The Emmys already feature three casting categories, and the Critics Choice Awards added one this year. Casting directors also have their own long-running Artios Awards. But the Golden Globes and Tony Awards still exclude the craft. “When casting is excellent, it can feel invisible — because it blends so well you don’t notice the fingerprints,” said Destiny Lilly, president of the 1,200-member Casting Society and a colleague of Telsey. She noted that casting often begins before most of the production team is hired. Telsey’s company, The Telsey Office, casts projects across film, television and theater — from movies such as “Mary Poppins Returns” to series like “The Gilded Age” and “Only Murders in the Building.” He made his name in theater, shaping casts for Tony-winning shows including “Hairspray,” “Kinky Boots” and “Maybe Happy Ending.” “Wicked” and its sequel “Wicked: For Good” were among his team’s most ambitious undertakings, requiring hundreds of performers across more than a year of filming on multiple continents. Though Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande now seem inevitable as Elphaba and Glinda, their casting wasn’t guaranteed. “You don’t really know until they’re in the room,” Telsey said. “Then you see the magic.” Telsey stays current by attending theater four or five nights a week and spending weekends watching TV and films. His team meets twice a week to discuss emerging talent. “Every day you feel like you’re behind,” he said. “There are always more actors to discover.” Casting directors typically begin by discussing a project’s vision with the director, writers and producers before assembling actors to audition. Lilly recently made waves by recommending comedian Bill Burr for his Broadway debut in “Glengarry Glen Ross,” believing his energy suited Mamet’s dialogue. She emphasized that crossover between stage and screen is now routine. Telsey agrees: “Good acting is good acting. The technical demands differ, but the craft is the same.” Telsey, whose breakthrough came with the original casting of “Rent,” said the rise of global productions, streaming platforms and virtual auditions has dramatically reshaped casting. “We’re always expanding our reach,” he said. “Time is short, budgets are shrinking, and the need to find the right cast quickly is only growing.”

title: Katrina Kaif, Vicky celebrate 4th wedding anniversary after welcoming baby boy
body: Actor couple Vicky Kaushal and Katrina Kaif are celebrating their fourth wedding anniversary while adjusting to parenthood after the arrival of their first child. The couple welcomed a baby boy on November 7, receiving warm wishes from fans and industry colleagues. Katrina has largely stayed off social media since the birth, but Vicky shared a heartfelt selfie with his wife on Instagram to mark their anniversary. In the photo, Vicky gazes lovingly at Katrina, who smiles at the camera. He captioned it: “Celebrating today… blissful, grateful and sleep deprived. Happy 4 to us.” Fans and friends quickly responded, with messages like “Mama and Dada” and “New papa and mommy in town.” Filmmaker Zoya Akhtar also sent heart emojis for the new parents. The couple tied the knot in December 2021 at Rajasthan’s scenic Six Senses Fort Barwara in a private ceremony attended by family and close friends. Professionally, Vicky was last seen in the historical drama Chhaava, while Katrina starred in Merry Christmas opposite Vijay Sethupathi.

title: Jovan, Totini in triangular love story
body: Entertainment Report : Capital Drama’s new drama titled ‘Hridoy Ghore’ is bringing the tension of college life, family struggles and an unexpected love triangle. Farhan Ahmed Jovan, Tanjim Saiyara Totini and Mariya Shanto played the lead roles in this drama. Written by Mejbah Uddin Sumon and directed by Rubel Hasan, the drama highlights the love hidden behind friendship and the harsh reality of life. In the story, the friendship between Raha (Totini), a student of a church college, and Rafin (Jovan), a boy from a poor family, gradually turns into love. Raha herself struggles to meet the financial strain of Rafin’s family. The story takes a turn when Rafin grows closer to the rich man’s daughter, Jerin (Mariya Shanto), through his work at the showroom. When Jerin starts providing large amounts of financial support to Rafin’s family, Rafin gradually starts to distance himself from her. The situation escalated at a restaurant. Raha got excited after seeing Rafin and Jerin together and got into a fight, the video of which quickly went viral on social media. Faced with family pressure and this complex equation of relationship, Raha finally decided to leave Rafin herself. It is expected that the performances of Jovan as Rafin, Totini as Raha and Mariya Shanto as Jerin in the drama will touch the hearts of the audience. The drama ‘Hridoy Ghore’ will be released on Capital Drama’s YouTube channel on December 11.

title: ‘Audience going to watch a different Apu Biswas’
body: Entertainment Report : Dhallywood actress Apu Biswas is coming in a new look, with a new look. In a recent interview, she said that this time the audience will watch a ‘different Apu Biswas’ on the screen. She is sure that this change will impress the audience compared to her previous work. Apu Biswas said, “This time the audience is going to watch a different Apu Biswas, I’m sure they will see a change. In many movies in the past, maybe one artiste always presented the best. But today you will see this different Apu Biswas.” Talking about the reason behind this change, Apu said, “I’m spending time in the gym, this has caught the attention of the audience. And how new I will be, the audience will understand only after finishing the movie. Actually, I want to say this about the movie ‘Durbar’, everyone will really see a completely new Apu Biswas.” Praising her current team, the actress said, “I will say from the beginning, I’m a lucky artiste. The team I got this time, I didn’t get a like team, and I got a family.” Incidentally, Apu got known in 2006 with ‘Koti Takar Kabin’. Before that, her career started with a supporting role in movie ‘Kaal Mohakaal’. The movie was directed by Amjad Hossain. After that, Apu Biswas became a regular by pairing up with Shakib Khan.

title: I don’t want to join any political party: Sohini
body: Agencies : Rumours of Sohini Sarkar, a popular actress of West Bengal, joining politics started after the Abhaya incident. At that time, the way Sohini was active and vocal about the whole incident, many assumed that she might soon be seen on the political stage. There was a reason behind such a thought. Many Tollywood actors and actresses have been seen joining politics after speaking out on social issues in the past. However, even after a year of the Abhaya incident, this actress has not been seen joining any political party till now. However, recently, during the promotions of the film ‘Raghu Dakat’, discussions resumed over an incident involving Sohini’s dancing with a Trinamool leader. In this context, Trinamool spokesperson Kunal Ghosh also made oblique comments about the actress. Sohini has finally clarified her position. In an interview given to Indian media, she directly announced her entry into politics. Sohini said, “Even if an offer comes to me, I still do not want to join any political party in any way, in any sense. Be it Trinamool or Congress, BJP or CPM, I do not want to be part of any political party. If I ever become part of a political party, I will have nothing more to say. I will have to become completely silent then.” In recent years, it has been seen that many stars of the small and big screen are actively involved in political parties. While there was a time when artistes kept themselves away from political matters, now that picture has largely reversed. From Dev to big stars like Mithun Chakraborty, they are now actively involved in politics.

title: Deepika opposite Vicky, new pair in epic?
body: There is a lot of excitement in Bollywood as the possibility of seeing two Bollywood stars Vicky Kaushal and Deepika Padukone together on the big screen for the first time is looming. Deepika seems to be mesmerising the audience with new surprises almost every day. Now her name is associated with director Amar Kaushik’s much-awaited mythological epic film. Deepika is being considered for the lead female role in director Amar Kaushik’s dream project ‘Mahabharata’. If these rumours are finally true and this collaboration becomes a reality, then this will be the first on-screen pairing of Vicky and Deepika.

title: What Rhea Chakraborty says about marriage
body: Bollywood actress Rhea Chakraborty has always been open about important matters in her personal life as well as her professional life. Now, she has opened up about one of the most important decisions in a girl’s life, especially motherhood. Recently, while talking about the societal expectations and pressures surrounding marriage and motherhood, Rhea made it clear that even though she is ready to become a mother, she has no qualms about getting married. Recently, Rhea said that at the age of 33, she is thinking about egg freezing or egg preservation. She said, “I’m 33 years old. I recently went to a gynecologist for egg freezing. I am also thinking about doing it.”

title: Atif Aslam’s concert to be jointly organised
body: Concerts featuring foreign artistes are being postponed one after another due to lack of permission. Naturally, there were concerns about two concerts by Pakistani singer Atif Aslam scheduled for this month. To allay those concerns, the organisers, Main Stage and Spirits of July, have decided to cancel separate events and hold a joint concert by Atif instead of two. Atif Aslam’s concert will be held at the Bangladesh-China Friendship Exhibition Centre in New Project Town, Purbachal on December 13. Bangladesh’s Nemesis band and Fuad and Friends will also perform with Atif on that day.

title: Netflix faces criticism for buying Warner Bros
body: The biggest topic of discussion in Hollywood right now is Netflix and Warner Bros. Netflix is going to own Warner Bros, the oldest and most popular studio in Hollywood. It was officially announced on Friday that Netflix is buying Warner Bros. Discovery’s TV, studio and streaming business for $72 billion. Through this, popular platforms like HBO and HBO Max will also come under Netflix’s control. Netflix is currently the most powerful company in streaming world, and if this deal is implemented, the balance of power in Hollywood will tilt even more towards this platform. Warner Bros has announced that it has initially decided that the company will split into two parts starting next year. One part of Warner will be acquired by Netflix. The other part, Discovery Global, will include CNN and other channels.

title: All girls should be free to move around: Keya Payel
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actress and model of the small screen, Keya Payel, has made a place in the hearts of the audience in a short time with her fluent acting skills. The star recently spoke about her personal life in an interview. Kaya Payel said that all girls should be free. According to her, this freedom is essential to lead a good life. In response to a question about marriage, she did not hold back and said that she is reluctant to take such a big decision in life in secret. The actress said, “If I get married, I will inform everyone. It is beautiful to announce the marriage. I want everyone to be blessed on such a beautiful journey in life. All girls should walk independently.” She also has a special expectation from her future in-laws. The actress wants the family she will marry into to embrace her wholeheartedly. She herself will embrace them. In this context, Keya Payel also said, “I have spent one life with my parents, I will spend another life with another parent. Then another Keya Payel will be born.”

title: Shahid Mahmud Jangi’s 70th anniversary to be celebrated Dec 12
body: Entertainment Desk : Shahid Mahmud Jangi is a popular lyricist of Bangladesh. Those who listened to the band’s songs in the 80s and 90s are more familiar with the name. Apart from Souls, Renaissance, LRB, he has written songs for many solo artistes. He has written many timeless songs like ‘Hridoy Kadamatir Kono Murti Noy’, ‘Aj Je Shishu Prithibir Aloy Esechhe’, ‘Ami Bhule Jai Tumi Aamar Nou’, ‘Ek Din Ghumbhanga Shohore’, ‘Jatin Sir er Class e’, ‘Tritiyo Bishwa’, ‘Somoy Jeno Kate Na’. He is still writing. Shahid Mahmud will turn 70 on February 6 next year. An event has been organised to celebrate the seven-decade life of this lyricist through songs and chats. The event titled ‘Apon Aloy Shahid Mahmud Jangi: Gaane Gaane Sottur’ to be organised by Ajob Karkhana on December 12. The event will begin at 5:00pm at Russian House in Dhanmondi. After the introductory speech and the guests’ recollections about the lyricist, the cover of the memoir book titled ‘Apon Aloy Shahid Mahmud Jangi: Gaane Gaane Sottur’ will be unveiled. Edited by Joy Shahriar, this book features memoirs about the lyricist by Naqib Khan, Samina Chowdhury, Faisal Siddiqui Bogi, Foad Nasser Babu, Kumar Bishwajit, Pilu Khan, Nasim Ali Khan, Partha Barua, Liton Adhikari Rintu, Golam Morshed, Bappi Khan and many others. It highlights various incidents from the lyricist’s life. At 6:30pm, songs written by Jangi will be performed by Rafiqul Alam, Nasim Ali Khan, Bappa Majumder, Pantho Kanai, Suman Kalyan, Joy Shahriar, Kishore Das, bands Souls, Renaissance and many others. The festival celebration committee includes Naqib Khan, Partha Barua, Pilu Khan, Joy Shahriar, Shamim Ahmed, Enam Elahi Tonti, Suman Kalyan, Shakil Khan, Hasan Asad, among others.

title: Misha Sawdagor explains why artistes leaving the country
body: Entertainment Report : Many stars of the Bangladeshi showbiz world have migrated abroad. They have settled there. Some occasionally come back to the country and work. In recent times, the tendency of stars to go abroad has increased significantly. Many current artistes including Amit Hasan, Symon Sadik, Zayed Khan, Mahiya Mahi, Saju Khadem are on this list. Actor Misha Sawdagor, President of the Film Artistes’ Association, spoke about the artistes going abroad. He said that the tendency of artistes to go abroad has increased due to the decrease in work. Misha Sawdagor’s family members have also settled in the United States. He himself spends half of the year in the US. Recently, on a television show, the actor spoke about artists settling abroad. According to him, if there was work in the country, artists would not have to go abroad. In this regard, Misha said, “What else are artistes supposed to do if there is no work? Once, I worked on four or five films in a day. I started at 7:00am and it went on till 2:00am. Now that FDC is almost closed. Did any of the artistes who have gone abroad want to leave the country? My friend Amit Hasan, the hero of so many films, has also gone abroad. Apart from that, Moushumi, Emon, Alexander Bo have left. Many have left the country recently. Mahiya Mahiya is also in the US. If I say my own thing, I can’t do anything except acting. Those who have gone cannot be blamed. If there was work, they would have worked here.” Misha also said, “Whether our artistes have work or not, they have to maintain a lot of things. They have to keep a look, have a car, use a good mobile phone, wear good clothes, and keep their drawing room decorated. Apart from that, we work for the family to keep the family members well. But if there is no work, if the income stops, then what will an artist do? Not everyone will understand the sacrifices of artistes. If they go there (abroad), at least they can survive by working and with their families.”

title: Where did Mahi run to at 7 in the morning?
body: Samira Khan Mahi is a popular actress of small screen. Recently, Mahi shared some of her shooting experiences with her fans amidst the intense winter. She has been shooting in different parts of the country for several days. However, she has not revealed the name of the project, but has been sharing various moments from the shooting on social media. In a recent video, the actress talked about the hardships of her shooting life with some humour and some disappointment. In a video, Mahi said, “The hardest part is waking up at 7 in the morning in this winter to go to the shoot. Finishing the shoot at 1 in the morning, going to bed at 3 and waking up at 6! This is one of the saddest parts of my life.”

title: Hrithik gets 30,000 marriage proposals just for 1 film!
body: Bollywood actor Hrithik Roshan rose to fame overnight after the release of the film ‘Kaho Na Pyaar Hai’ in 2000. His skyrocketing success in his first film was such that he received around 30,000 marriage proposals in just a month. Recently, while participating in a popular Indian talk show, the actor himself spoke about the excitement of the beginning of his career. Hrithik used the back door of his house to handle the crowd of fans. He said that after the first movie became a superhit, there was a constant crowd of fans in front of his house.

title: What Bubly doing in olive grove?
body: Entertainment Report : Shobnom Bubly, a popular film actress of Dhallywood, who once started her career as a newsreader, is now a full-fledged actress. Not only has she won the hearts of the audience with her acting skills on the silver screen, but she is also quite active on social media. The film star often shares moments and feelings from her life with her fans. In line with this, she recently shared a series of pictures where she is seen in an olive grove. In the pictures, Bubly is seen in a pastel-coloured dress, and her sweet smile with her hair open seems to blend with the liveliness of nature. Posting the pictures, the heroine wrote in the caption, “Sour sweet winter olives, dear nature.” However, the comments after this post caught the attention of netizens. Many expressed their love for olives. One netizen wrote,”’Olives are a tempting food that more or less everyone craves.” Incidentally, Bubly made her big screen debut in 2016 with the film ‘Bosgiri’ opposite Shakib Khan. Her acting skills quickly brought her recognition in her first film.

title: Sajjad Hossain to play Tommy Mia on screen
body: Entertainment Report : Tommy Mia moved to Britain with his parents at the age of 10. He started his career by washing dishes in a restaurant as a student. At that time, he decided to choose cooking as a career. After that, he did not have to look back. He became an internationally renowned chef. He has also worked with culinary artists from Bangladesh. Tommy Mia’s Hospitality Institute has trained international-class chefs in several places including Dhaka and Sylhet. Now, the biography of this culinary artist is coming to the big screen. This biopic titled ‘CTM’ will be directed by Moniruzzaman Monir. Next year, Tommy Mia’s Dhallywood Awards 2026 will be organised in collaboration with Tommy Mia MBE. The event will be held in London in October. A group of popular stars of the country will participate in this event, initiated by the Bangladesh Film Directors’ Association. Sajjad Hossain will play the role of Tommy Mia on screen. Before coming to acting, he himself worked as a chef. Sajjad trained at Tommy Mia’s Institute of Management in 2007. After that, he worked as a chef in a restaurant in London. Later, he moved to the country to pursue acting. Sajjad made his debut in Dhallywood with the movie ‘MR Nine’. He then acted in the movies ‘Mona: Jinn-2’ and ‘Meghna Kanya’. His ovie ‘Prem Puran’ awaiting to release. Major portion of the CTM movie will be shot in London.

title: Neha’s indecent gestures on stage, singer faces fire
body: Popular Bollywood singer Neha Kakkar has been embroiled in controversy over one of her live stage performances. Recently, a video of Neha Kakkar’s gestures and pouring water on herself while singing at a concert went viral, leading to mixed reactions among netizens. While some called it a ‘brave performance’, many called it ‘indecent’ and an ‘attempt to gain cheap popularity’. In the viral video, Neha is seen singing on stage in a leopard-print tight-fitting dress. At one point during the performance, she picks up a water bottle and pours it over her body. The scene quickly went viral on social media. The controversy was sparked by Neha’s special choreography.

title: Aryan returning to the big screen
body: After a long stint on the small screen, West Bengal actor Aryan Bhowmik is finally returning to the big screen. His performance in serial ‘Video Bouma’ has already won the hearts of the audience. Immediately after the end of that serial, he announced a new project without taking any break. The actor is looking to cement his place on the big screen with new film. He will be seen in new film ‘Astaraag’. The shooting of the film has already started in full swing. The shooting is going on in and around Kolkata. Another popular face of the small screen, Shrima Bhattacharya, will be seen opposite him.

title: Farah Khan says Akshaye Khanna “deserves an Oscar” for Dhurandhar
body: Filmmaker Farah Khan has praised actor Akshaye Khanna’s performance in Dhurandhar, saying he “truly deserves an Oscar” for his role in Aditya Dhar’s new action drama released on December 5. The film, featuring Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, R. Madhavan, Sara Arjun, Arjun Rampal and Sanjay Dutt, has earned strong reviews from critics and audiences since opening in cinemas. Among the ensemble cast, Akshaye’s intense portrayal of Rehman Dakait has drawn widespread acclaim, with social media flooded with praise for his performance. The track FA9LA, which highlights the character’s larger-than-life persona, has also gone viral, adding to the film’s popularity. On Monday, Farah Khan — who worked with Akshaye in Tees Maar Khan — shared a fan-made reel on Instagram that paired scenes of Akshaye from Dhurandhar with a moment from their earlier film. In the clip, actor Akshay Kumar is seen saying, “Woh raha mera superstar, mera Oscar,” a line fans linked to Akshaye’s latest performance. Posting the reel, Farah wrote: “Akshaye Khanna truly deserves an Oscar,” accompanied by laughter emojis. Meanwhile, the makers of Dhurandhar have confirmed a sequel. The second installment, teased in the first film’s post-credit scene, is set to release on March 19, 2026 — just three months after the original. The first film ran for 3 hours 34 minutes, though the runtime of the sequel has not yet been announced.

title: Afsana Mimi, judge of Dhaka Film Fest
body: Entertainment Report : The 24th edition of the Dhaka International Film Festival will be held next year. It will begin on January 10. About 267 full-length and short films from 91 countries will be screened during the 9-day festival. The festival will be organised by the Rainbow Film Society with the theme ‘Aesthetic Films, Contemplative Viewers, Enlightened Society’. The organisers are currently busy preparing. The names of the jury members for the two categories were announced yesterday. Actress and director Afsana Mimi is on the list of judges. Afsana Mimi will be in charge of the Women Filmmaker category, which showcases feature-length films, short films and documentaries made by women filmmakers. The Best Director, Best Documentary and Best Fiction categories are selected by an independent jury consisting of female filmmakers, artists and cultural experts. Apart from Mimi, the jury for this category includes UK-based Croatian documentary filmmaker and educator Aleksandra Markovic, Iranian-Australian filmmaker and visual artist Ronak Taher, renowned Philippine film and stage actress Geraldine Villamil and Paris-based American teacher and filmmaker Marion Standefer. The festival will also feature the ‘Twelfth International Women Filmmakers Conference’ on the role of women in film. Women filmmakers and researchers from around the world will participate in the conference, which will be held at the Dhaka Club on January 11 and 12. The jury for the Spiritual Films category, in addition to the Women Filmmakers category, has been announced. The jury members for this category are Bangladeshi writer and producer Tanvir Hossain, Swiss project manager Teresa Vina, Brazilian audiovisual artist and photographer Milena Quarz, German filmmaker Daria Silfstein, and Iranian producer Ehsan Kaveh. This year, the Dhaka Festival will have a total of 10 categories, including Women Filmmakers and Spiritual Films. The other categories are Bangladesh Panorama, Asian Cinema Section, Retrospective, Tribute, Wide Angle, Cinema of the World, Children’s Films and Short and Independent Films. The films will be screened at the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy, National Museum Auditorium and Alliance Française Auditorium.

title: Netflix taking over H’wood empire, political intrigue may be eliminated
body: Agencies : The popular streaming platform Netflix is acquiring the legendary film studio Warner Bros. Discovery and the popular HBO streaming network. Netflix said on Friday that it is buying Warner Bros. Discovery for $72 billion. This is not just any ordinary deal-it is a kind of Hollywood drama, with powerful buyers, political intrigue and multiple tense dramas. The acquisition is actually going to be the story of the rise of a victorious monster. If the deal is completed, it will be almost impossible for Netflix to compete with it. But with regulators and rival bidders still in the fray, the story is far from over. Key issues are capturing the attention of political and industry circles ahead of the massive deal: Netflix has been solidifying its position in Hollywood for years, now the world’s largest streaming subscription service and the largest producer of new content. But this deal-the industry’s largest in years-will take Netflix to new heights. What’s more, it will add to its archive- Netflix will gain access to a catalog of nearly a century of classic titles and famous franchises. Netflix will add HBO’s roughly 128 million subscribers to its existing subscriber base of more than 300 million. “Netflix is already the largest streaming service, and now with HBO Max added, it would arguably be out of reach,” said Mike Proulx, vice president at research firm Forrester. The deal brings ‘Looney Tunes’, ‘Harry Potter’, ‘Friends’ and HBO’s hit shows such as ‘Succession’, ‘Sex and the City’ and ‘Game of Thrones’ to the same platform as popular shows such as Netflix’s ‘Stranger Things’. The purchase also includes TNT Sports outside the US. Netflix expects the deal to close within the next year to a year and a half. But executives have not yet been clear about how Warner Bros. and its flagship brand HBO will be integrated into Netflix’s existing services. Netflix co-CEO Greg Peters called the HBO brand ‘very strong’ and said it would give them ‘a lot of options.’ Netflix could bundle films and programmes together in various bundles, but analysts say they would be surprised if the HBO brand were to disappear entirely. Netflix’s dominance could allow it to charge more to its subscribers. On the other hand, if viewers pay for one streaming service instead of two, their costs could be reduced.

title: Acting in that scene was embarrassing: Jessica Alba
body: Hollywood actress Jessica Alba has opened up about her experience of performing one of the most difficult scenes of her career. She had to perform a nude scene in the 2005 superhero film ‘Fantastic Four’, which the actress was already uncomfortable with. She described the scene as ‘incredibly humiliating’. Jessica Alba, 44, of ‘Sin City,’ opened up about her experience at the Red Sea Film Festival in Saudi Arabia. “I thought it was gross. In real life, it was very humiliating,” the actress said of performing nude scenes in ‘Fantastic Four’,” according to the New York Post.

title: Nachiketa in hospital, 2 stents inserted in heart
body: Popular singer Nachiketa Chakraborty of West Bengal has been admitted to the hospital after suddenly falling ill. He was taken to a private hospital in Kolkata after feeling discomfort in her chest on Saturday night. There, two stents were inserted in his heart. The singer is currently under the observation of doctors. According to family and hospital sources, the 61-year-old singer was suffering from physical stress due to continuous music performances for several days. He was admitted to a hospital along the Eastern Metropolitan Bypass at around 2:00am on Saturday. After tests, doctors identified a problem in his heart and quickly decided to insert two stents.

title: Falling in love at 60 was unexpected: Aamir
body: Bollywood’s Mr Perfectionist Aamir Khan has got back into a relationship at the age of 60. After his separation from his second wife Kiran Rao, he had a long-term relationship with a woman named Gauri; which was the talk of the town. Now, in a recent interview, Aamir himself commented that his love affair with Gauri was ‘unexpected’. Aamir introduced his girlfriend Gauri to everyone at his last birthday party. He also said that he never thought that he would fall in love again at this age. Regarding his unexpected relationship with Gauri, Aamir said, “I never thought that I would find someone like this again in my life. I thought that I might have to walk the rest of the way alone. But after meeting Gauri, the whole situation changed. Gauri has brought stability to my life.”

title: ‘Mehendi Ranga’ has nothing to do with marriage: Kona
body: Entertainment Report : On December 3 and 4, singer Kona shared two pictures of her hands with mehendi (henna) on social media. After that, rumours arose that the artiste is getting married again. Kona herself added fuel to the fire of rumours. Although she posted the picture, Kona did not say anything else about it. As a result, rumours of Kona’s marriage quickly spread. Last Friday, it was learned that this was actually a song promotion because, Kona’s new song ‘Mehendi’ was released that evening. The wedding rumours that have been spread by the photo of a hand with ‘mehendi’ have come to the attention of some people. But she didn’t think it would spread so much. In this regard, Kona told media, “I shared the picture of the shooting of the song titled ‘Mehendi’ on Facebook. I wrote ‘Mehendi’ on my hand with the picture of my hand. I didn’t understand what would happen after that. Many people called me and asked what the real story was. I didn’t know what to say. Besides, the song was supposed to be released the next day. Then the whole matter would be clear. So, I kept quiet. I have nothing personal to do with this picture; it has nothing to do with my marriage. It’s just a song.” The song ‘Mehendi’ was jointly written by Badhan and Jamshed Chowdhury. Nish has sung the vocals along with Kona. The music of the song has been arranged by Sanjoy. The video has been directed by Chandan Roy Chowdhury and Riaz Ali. Sunerah, Maisha Nazia, Manjita Roy and a few others have been models. Kona is also seen in the video. The video of the song ‘Mehendi’ has been released on the Kinetic Music YouTube channel. The song has received about 2 million views in 24 hours of its release. Kona said that she is having a busy time with her songs. Kona’s first theme song for BKSP was released last week. Earlier, Kona’s song titled ‘Bhitor O Bahire’, composed by Fuad Al Muktadir, was released in November. In addition, she is working on several songs with US-based musician Muza. The singer said that the songs will be released continuously.

title: Abul Hayat looking for ‘Sokhina’
body: Entertainment Report : In addition to acting, noted actor Abul Hayat regularly writes and directs. Until a time, he regularly devoted his time to acting. Now he is not giving time to acting as he used to. He works selectively. If he likes the story and character, he acts only after reaching an agreement with the director on ancillary matters. Recently, the actor has completed work on a drama directed by director Selim Reza. In it, he played the role of actress Keya Payel’s grandfather. He will be shooting for a drama by Chayanika Chowdhury for the next two days. On December 10, he will be shooting for the promotional video of Arafat Mohsin Nidhi’s web series titled ‘Atka’. In addition to acting, Abul Hayat is preparing to produce a drama for the upcoming Eid. The title of the drama is ‘Sokhina’. He is also writing the screenplay for ‘Sokhina’ based on the story of Rabeya Khatun. Abul Hayat said that he has already prepared the script for the drama. Now he is looking for the actress to play the title role in the drama. He is looking for an actress who can portray the story properly. At the same time, he is also looking for Sokhina’s co-star. He said that he wants to finish the selection of artistes to act opposite Sokhina this month. After that, he will start shooting. In this regard, Abul Hayat said, “Now my thoughts are on Sokhina. I’m looking for an artiste for the character of Sokhina. I want to finish the selection of the artiste as soon as possible and start shooting. I want to finish shooting the drama by the end of this month or next month. The plan is to air the Sokhina drama on Eid-ul-Fitr.” Talking about his busy schedule, Abul Hayat said, “I have worked in a few dramas and web series so far. I’m not working as hard as before. I try to choose the stories and characters that I like. Most of the time I have left, I feel comfortable staying at home. My family also wants me to stay at home and rest. Even then, I don’t want to. I feel helpless if I don’t act. Please pray that Allah keeps me healthy and well.”

title: Deepika Kakkar wants to live for her son
body: As an actress, it is natural to present yourself attractively in front of the camera or audience. But Indian actress Deepika Kakkar is now not willing to worry about external beauty, weight gain or hair loss. Her only goal now is to get healthy for her only child at any cost. She said about being diagnosed with cancer, “When I first learned that I had cancer, all I could see was my son’s face. When I was going to be admitted to the hospital for treatment, I couldn’t take my son with me.”

title: Artist Bipasha Hayat Shares Intimate Moment Showing the Power of a Mother’s Touch
body: A few days ago, I asked my mother to knit a sweater for me. She said, “Do you want to keep it as a memory because I’ll die someday?”I replied, “I might die before you. I just want your art to carry my touch.” Then my mother said, “There are so many sweaters in the market-will mine be any different?” I answered, “I don’t want just a handmade sweater. I want one made by the very person because of whom I exist in this world, and because of whom all my deeds-good or bad-belong only to me.” Bipasha Hayat

title: ‘The Difficult Bride’ featuring 3 actresses
body: Entertainment Report : Filmmaker Rubaiyat Hossain has been working on the film The Difficult Bride for a long time. She has taken the screenplay to various film festivals and secured international funding. The film has received grants from five countries. Finally, the cast has been announced. National Film Award-winning actresses Azmeri Haque Badhan, Reekita Nondine Shimu, and Sunerah Binte Kamal will star in The Difficult Bride. Joining them is Zainin Karim Chowdhury, according to what the director told the media outlet Variety. The story follows a young woman who dreams of a fairytale wedding. But deep inside, she suffers from a complicated illness. She tries various home remedies to solve the problem, but when nothing works, her mental stress increases. One day at a beauty salon, she begins to imagine a mysterious long-haired woman. The shooting of the film has already been completed. Speaking about the cast, Rubaiyat Hossain said, “Every actor has given their all. They have delivered their best. I am grateful for their trust, generosity, impeccable artistry, and strong determination.” The director shared that she has been working on the story for nearly two decades. In 2006, she first considered making The Difficult Bride as a short film, but later decided to develop it as a feature-length production. Rubaiyat Hossain added, “I have carried this story in my mind for 21 years and rewritten it many times. It has been part of half of my life. Finally, with an amazing team, I’ve been able to make this film. It feels like a miracle to me.” Portuguese filmmaker Leonor Teles is the cinematographer for The Difficult Bride. Several other international crew members have also worked in various departments. The film is co-produced by France’s François d’Artemare, Germany’s Anna Kaczko, Portugal’s Pedro Borges, and Norway’s Ingard Lill Houghton alongside Rubaiyat Hossain.

title: Perfectionist Kushum Shikder
body: Entertainment Report : At one time, Kushum Shikder was regularly seen on both the big and small screens. She earned a place in the audience’s hearts through films like Lal Tip, Gohine Shobdo, and Shankhacheel. Yet in recent times, she has been appearing on screen far less frequently. She has finally clarified her position on the matter. In a recent program on Channel Twenty-Four, the popular film and television actress explained why she has not been seen in new projects. When the host asked whether she had suddenly disappeared, Kushum replied, “Where have I disappeared? If you’re talking about work, I’m simply not interested in doing dramas right now. I’ve received many film offers. I could have worked if I wanted to. It would have been possible to say yes and start shooting. But I’m a bit particular, a bit of a perfectionist. In most of the proposals, I felt there were shortcomings somewhere, or the people making them were not fully prepared. That’s why I didn’t take them.” Kushum said that after the release of Shoroter Joba, she received offers for at least 12 films. However, she turned down all of them. Explaining the reason, she said, “I’m a slow-paced person. I work slowly. I believe that when you take your time, the quality turns out better. One year is too little for a film. It took me two years to make Shoroter Joba. And if you count the writing, it takes even longer. If I get a story I like and a properly prepared project, I will definitely do it.” Regarding her appearance and fitness, she said, “I try to keep my mind very fresh. I avoid lying as much as possible. I try to be a grateful person. I have a strong capacity for being amazed, and I have the power to love. I nurture these qualities. I believe that if these remain within you, they show on the outside as well. They help keep a person beautiful.”

title: Adhora awaiting ‘Ritukamini’
body: Entertainment Report : Film actress Adhora Khan is waiting from Canada for the release of her movie Ritukamini. In the film, Adhora plays the role of a village girl, starring opposite popular television actor Shajal. Adhora has previously acted opposite several leading actors, including Symon Sadik and Bappy Chowdhury. Ritukamini is directed by Zahid Hossain, who earlier directed the film Matrityo. Adhora’s expectations for Ritukamini are quite high. She said, “The story of Ritukamini is truly unique. In our country, films based on such themes have hardly been made. Director Zahid bhai is a talented filmmaker. The story, the filmmaking style, and the performances of every artist are wonderful. Overall, Ritukamini is a complete film, and I myself am eagerly waiting to watch it in theaters.” The film also stars Fazlur Rahman Babu, Deepa Khandakar, Rina Khan, and several others. Adhora’s previously released films include Nayok, Matal, Pagoler Moto Bhalobashi, and Sultanpur. Another of her films, Dokhino Duar, directed by Syed Wahiduzzaman Diamond, is awaiting release.

title: Netflix to acquire Warner Bros. for $72b
body: Hollywood’s historic studio Warner Bros. is set to be acquired by the OTT platform Netflix. For $72 billion, Netflix has agreed to buy Warner Bros. Discovery’s film and streaming businesses. Beating out Comcast and Paramount, Netflix secured the deal. Warner Bros., the owner of major franchises such as Harry Potter and Game of Thrones, as well as the streaming service HBO Max, is one of the most influential names in the entertainment industry. Once this agreement is finalized, Netflix is expected to become an even more powerful force in global entertainment.

title: Shah Rukh’s Son Aryan in legal trouble again
body: Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan’s son Aryan Khan has landed in legal trouble once again. A complaint has been filed against him at a local police station after he allegedly made an “indecent” gesture in public at a nightclub in Bengaluru. The incident sparked widespread criticism after a video of it went viral on social media. The incident took place on November 28. At a pub in Bengaluru’s Ashok Nagar, Aryan was hanging out with friends when he allegedly showed his middle finger in public, making an obscene gesture. Someone present recorded the moment and shared the video online.

title: Shajal and Apu in murder mystery story
body: Popular actor Abdun Noor Shajal has signed on for a new film titled Durbar. In this movie, actress Apu Biswas will be acting alongside Shajal for the first time. The film is directed by Kamrul Hasan Fuad, marking his debut as a director. According to reports, the movie is a murder-mystery thriller that will also blend romance and drama. Written and scripted by Abdullah Zahir Babu, the film also features Jannatul Noor Moon and Sanju John. Shooting is scheduled to begin on December 16. However, before filming starts, the lead actor and actress are expected to participate in an official photoshoot on December 14. The film is planned for release during next year’s Eid-ul-Adha.

title: ‘Dhurandhar’ Breaks ‘Saiyaara’ Record
body: This year, ‘Saiyaara’ has been one of Bollywood’s most successful record-breaking films. The movie starring Ahan Panday and Anit Padda created a storm at the box office. However, at the end of the year, Ranveer Singh’s ‘Dhurandhar’delivered a surprising turn. On its opening day, it broke the box-office record previously held by ‘Saiyaara’. According to Sacnilk’s report, ‘Dhurandhar’earned 27 crore rupees on its first day, whereas ‘Saiyaara’ had collected only 21 crore rupees on its opening day. Meanwhile, Deepika expressed pride in her husband’s success, saying, “Watched ‘Dhurandhar’. Every moment of the 3-hour-34-minute film is worthwhile.

title: Early backlash follows Netflix move to buy Warner Bros
body: NN ONLINE: Netflix’s planned 72 billion dollar acquisition of Warner Bros. and its film and television operations drew swift criticism across the entertainment industry on Friday, with guilds, lawmakers and Hollywood figures warning that the merger could hurt consumers, workers and theaters. Executives from both companies defended the agreement, saying it would strengthen content offerings and benefit global audiences. Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav said the deal would help preserve “the world’s most resonant stories for generations to come,” while Netflix co-CEO Ted Sarandos said it would “give audiences more of what they love.” Cinema United chief Michael O’Leary said Netflix’s business model does not support theatrical releases and warned that the deal could lead to theater closures, job losses and harm to local communities. Actor Jane Fonda, speaking for the Committee for the First Amendment, called the agreement an alarming escalation of media consolidation that she said threatens the entertainment industry, the public and First Amendment principles. The Producers Guild of America said the industry must navigate rapid economic and technological shifts while safeguarding livelihoods, theatrical distribution, creative opportunities, consumer choice and free expression. It said legacy studios hold cultural value beyond their content libraries and that the Netflix deal must meet these standards. Sen. Roger Marshall of Kansas said the acquisition bid, which he estimated at 82 billion dollars, would be the largest media takeover in history. He warned that allowing one company to control both content and distribution would pose significant antitrust concerns and threaten prices, choice and creative freedom. Sen. Elizabeth Warren of Massachusetts described the planned merger as an “anti-monopoly nightmare.” She said a combined Netflix–Warner Bros. entity could dominate nearly half the streaming market, push subscription prices higher, reduce consumer options and put workers at risk. The Writers Guild of America said the takeover is precisely the kind of consolidation antitrust laws are designed to stop. It said the outcome would cut jobs, reduce wages, worsen working conditions, raise costs for viewers and shrink the diversity of available content, urging regulators to block the deal. Rep. Laura Friedman of California said repeated consolidation has already cost many film and television jobs and added that any merger should be judged on its impact on competition and employment. Her district includes Hollywood as well as the headquarters of Netflix and the Warner Bros. studio. Former WarnerMedia CEO and Hulu co-founder Jason Kilar said on X that selling Warner Bros. Discovery to Netflix would be one of the most effective ways to reduce competition in Hollywood. The proposed deal now awaits regulatory scrutiny.

title: Apu Biswas looks stunning in golden saree
body: Entertainment Report : Dhallywood actress Apu Biswas often presents herself in different guises. Recently, she showed herself in a new guise on social media; as soon as it was revealed, fans and admirers were mesmerised by the heroine’s enchanting beauty. Recently Apu posted a series of pictures on her official Facebook page. It can be seen that Apu Biswas is dressed in a golden colored saree and matching jewellery. She is wearing jewellery like necklaces, pendants, bangles and diamonds. Also, the flower garland in her hair adds a different dimension to the whole outfit. Not only that, he also wrote a surprising thing in the caption! She wrote, “This person has immense authority and is the root of all success.” Apu Biswas originally participated in a photoshoot. And that’s where the heroine’s incredible beauty emerged. Fans praise the style of this heroine, who regularly presents herself in a new way through modelling and photoshoots; this time too was no exception. A fan commented, “Apart from being a heroine, Apu Biswas is a style icon.” Meanwhile, Apu Biswas is returning to a new movie after a break of almost two years. The name of the romantic-action and thriller genre movie is ‘Secret’. In the movie, she is acting opposite actor Ador Azad. The shooting of the movie will begin by the end of this month under the supervision of director Bandhan Biswas.

title: Kajal, Shah Rukh’s sculpture unveiled in London
body: Agencies : A new sculpture of Bollywood’s ‘Romance King’ Shah Rukh Khan and his co-star Kajol has been unveiled in London’s Leicester Square. The sculpture has been installed to mark the 30th anniversary of the longest-running blockbuster film in Indian cinema history, ‘Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge’. The sculpture was officially unveiled on Thursday in rainy weather. It joins sculptures from Harry Potter, Paddington and Bridget Jones as part of Leicester Square’s ‘Scenes in the Square’ trail. Shah Rukh Khan was asked about his own advice for newlyweds during the unveiling of a sculpture in London. Shah Rukh responded with a joke. Before Shahrukh could answer, actress Kajol joked, “All his films are about pre-marital love, not post-marital love!” Agreeing with Kajol, Shah Rukh Khan said with a smile, “Till now, you were someone I could advise. But after marriage, you are on your own!” However, Shah Rukh did not forget to give some important advice. He said, “Till then (before marriage), I think I did the right thing. You should have romance, sing songs.” Kajol immediately added, “And of course, watch DDLJ.”

title: Anushka expresses anger by sharing video of bad experience on plane
body: Agencies : Singer Anushka Shankar, daughter of famous Indian sitar player Ravi Shankar, recently had a bad experience while travelling on an Air India flight. Allegedly, due to the negligence of the airline authorities, her very beloved and important sitar was broken. Anushka posted a video on social media expressing her anger over such an unexpected incident. In the video, showing the broken sitar, the British artiste of Indian origin said, “This country is a country of music and culture. But this accident happened there. This is the first time I have flown on an Air India flight and this is the first time I have experienced such a thing. I’m truly devastated.” The multiple Grammy-nominated artiste also said that in her 17-year career, she has never had such an incident. No musical instrument has ever been so damaged. She alleged that she had paid extra money as a ‘special handling charge’ to ensure that the sitar reached its destination properly. She questioned why Air India showed such negligence even after charging that cost. Anushka captioned the video, “My beloved sitar has broken due to such irresponsible behavior of Air India. This is only a result of negligence.” Anushka’s video quickly went viral on social media and drew a storm of criticism. Celebrities like Zakir Khan and Vishal Dadlani commented on the video.

title: Justin Trudeau seals relationship with Katy Perry
body: Agencies : Long-rumoured romances have finally been confirmed. Pop singer Katy Perry and former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau have officially announced their relationship on an international diplomatic stage. The pair confirmed their relationship by attending a luncheon with former Japanese Prime Minister Fumio Kishida and his wife Yuko. It is reported that Katy Perry postponed her ongoing ‘The Lifetimes World Tour’ to attend this diplomatic lunch with Trudeau in Tokyo. Justin Trudeau shared a photo of the meeting with Kishida on X, writing, “It was great to see you @kishida 230. Katie and I were delighted to have the opportunity to sit down and talk with you and Yuko. Thank you, Fumio, for your friendship and your continued commitment to the international order and a better future for all.”

title: Farin surprised with her voice, created storm
body: Popular TV actress Tasnia Farin has firmly established herself in the music world. There have been discussions about her new song for quite some time now. Finally, her duet song ‘Mon Golbe Na’ with musician Imran Mahmudul has been released. Through this song, Farin has not only made her debut as an actress, but also as a full-fledged singer. However, Farin also made her debut as a producer with this new song. The song has been produced under the banner of Farin’s own production company ‘Faring Films’. Farin and Imran also have chemistry as models in the video directed by Nahian Ahmed.

title: Wedding rumours surround Kona’s photo
body: The country’s popular vocalist Dilshad Nahar Kona is busy with her own songs on stage or in projects at home and abroad. But her personal life outside of singing has come into the spotlight again. Last Wednesday, she posted a picture on her official Facebook page, which has sparked fresh speculation. The picture shows the bride wearing a green sari, with beautifully applied henna on both hands and flowers on her forehead. Next day, Kona released another picture. In it, she can be seen with her hands painted with henna, and a ring on her ring finger. Someone else is holding that hand! And after that, speculations about the singer’s marriage skyrocketed.

title: Aryan under police watch for indecent at nightclub
body: Bollywood King Shah Rukh Khan’s son Aryan Khan is in the news again after he was accused of making obscene gestures towards a crowd at a nightclub in Bengaluru. Aryan went to the nightclub with his friends on November 28. He was accompanied by Karnataka Minister Zayed Khan, son of Jamir Ahmed, and Md Nalapad, son of local MLA NA Harris. Seeing joy of guests at the club, Aryan performed Madhyama from the balcony; after a video of such a performance went viral on social media, locals demanded action from the police. Police have collected CCTV footage of incident are investigating.

title: Rashmika opens up about marriage for first time
body: There have been many rumours about the marriage of South Indian actress Rashmika Mandanna for months. A picture of her wearing a ring on her hand also increased the speculation; fans think that it is the engagement ring. Although Rashmika and her boyfriend actor Vijay Deverakonda have been silent about the matter until now. But for the first time, Rashmika has opened her mouth about it. In a recent interview, Rashmika was asked a direct question about engagement and marriage. She said, “I don’t want to say ‘yes’ or ‘no’ to the marriage rumours. When the time comes, I’ll tell everyone.”

title: Cameron didn’t use AI in movie ‘Avatar’
body: Agencies : The time is now for technology. The use of artificial intelligence (AI) is also increasing in cinema. Many believe that this technology was also used in James Cameron’s movie ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’. However, before the release, James Cameron made it clear that AI was not used as a substitute for artists in any episode of the movie Avatar. He took this decision out of full trust and respect for the artistes. James Cameron has opened new doors in the world of visual effects technology. Especially with the magic of performance capture technology, the blue characters of the movie ‘Avatar’ have come to life as if they were a figment of imagination. So, everyone thought that this time he would surprise the audience even more with the help of AI. However, the director did not follow this path. So, Cameron wanted to clarify the matter to everyone before the release of the movie. In an interview with ComicBook.com, James Cameron said, “I’m not against generative AI. I just want to make this clear, this technology was not used in the Avatar movie. We respect the actors, we don’t replace them.” He added, “For years, people have had the idea that we are doing something strange with computers, where the need for actors is disappearing. Performance capture technology is not replacing actors, but rather creating a new art form by combining the actor’s skills with the director’s ideas. At the opposite end of this technology is AI. Where AI can create a character, actor or entire scene with just the right writing and instructions. That seems scary to me. That’s why we don’t do that.” The third installment of the Avatar series, ‘Avatar: Fire and Ash’, will be released worldwide on December 19. In this story, fire has come in the form of horror. The Ash People live around the volcano. They know how to control fire. Jack Sully-Netiris fight against this violent race. The first installment of Avatar was released in 2009. The second installment, ‘Avatar: The Way of Water’, comes in 2022.

title: Tanzika’s 2 web films at end of this year
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : Tanzika Amin has been working in the media for almost two decades. However, she has made a new name for herself after the arrival of OTT. Tanzika caught the eye two years ago after the release of Ashfaque Nipun’s ‘Mohanagar 2’ web series. She has received praise from everyone, from showbiz people to the general audience. After that, Tanzika has acted in several other contents on OTT. Two web films starring Tanzika Amin will be released on two different platforms this month. One is Sharaf Ahmed Jibon’s ‘Dimlight’, and the other is Raihan Rafi’s ‘Amimanshito’. Tanzika is very happy with the news of the release of two web films at the end of the year. She said that she will be seen in two different characters in the two web films. The actress said, “In the last month of this year, two web films starring me are being released on OTT. This is a great joy for me. I’m coming in front of the audience with two different types of work. I have tried to portray the two characters with my best. The audience will tell me how I did after watching. If they like it, I will be happy.” Tanzika plays the role of a housewife from a middle-class family in movie ‘Dimlight’. The actress said about the movie, “‘Dimlight’ is made about the story of this time. It is actually the story of all of us. The story of the movie is made about the story of midlife crisis. My character’s name is Tania. Mosharraf Karim plays the role of my husband. The movie will be released on December 11 on Chorki.” Tanzika acted in the web film ‘Amimanshito’ two years ago. It was stuck for so long due to being stuck with the Censor Board. Finally, the web film will be released on iScreen this month. Tanzika said, “Although it is old, this is one of my favourite works. Here I will be seen in the role of a journalist. Imtiaz Barshan is playing the role of my husband. He is also a journalist. One night, the couple is murdered in their house. The story of this film is about the mystery of who or why killed them.” ‘Amimanshito’ is based on the murder of the controversial journalist couple Sagar-Runi. This is also hinted at in the movie’s teaser. Therefore, the audience has a special interest in the movie. Tanzika is somewhat afraid due to this expectation of the audience. In this regard, she said, “I had to hurry a little to play the role of a journalist. Because, playing such a role is very challenging. After all, she is a journalist; the character is already established on her. Everyone has such high expectations for this job, and I’m a little afraid of how much I will be able to fulfill it. However, I have confidence. From the producer to the crew – everyone has done their best. I hope everyone will like it.”

title: Band Nemesis, Fuad to perform on same stage with Atif Aslam
body: Entertainment Report : Popular Pakistani singer Atif Aslam is coming to Dhaka to perform again. The concert is being organised by Main Stage. They said that Atif will perform at the Bashundhara Residential Area in the capital on December 13. Nemesis band and Fuad and Friends will also perform with Atif Aslam on that day. The organisers have said that this is not just a concert, but a festival for the youth. Everyone will experience an unforgettable night with Atif Aslam, one of the most popular musicians in South Asia. Along with Atif, Bangladesh’s Fuad and Friends and Nemesis will also be on the stage. However, despite adequate preparations, there are concerns about this concert because, several concerts of foreign artistes have been canceled recently. Various organising organisations had announced half a dozen concerts with artists from home and abroad in November to December. This list included artists from India and Pakistan along with popular bands and artists from the country. But due to security issues, one concert after another is being canceled due to lack of permission from the administration. Three concerts have already been announced to be postponed.

title: I don’t feel like I did anything wrong or unfair: Iman
body: Indian singer Eman Chakraborty is in the news for a different reason this time. At the invitation of West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee, she went to the Nabanna assembly hall and sang a song about the development record of the Trinamool government in the last 15 years. Iman performed this ‘Unnoyoner Panchali’ in her melodious voice in the presence of the Chief Minister, and after the video went public, there was a lot of sarcasm and criticism. Hearing a song directly for development of a political party in voice of such an artiste, various comments started flying in various circles, starting from social media. Many have also called her a ‘sold out’ artiste.

title: Arifin Shuvoo burns on shooting set
body: Bad news for Arifin Shuvoo fans! This Dhallywood actor has reportedly been burnt on the set of a shooting. Although no clear statement has been received from those involved in the matter; Shuvoo’s condition is also not clear. Shuvoo’s new movie ‘Malik’ was being shot in secret, at a secluded location outside Dhaka. After this incident, director Saif Chandan wanted to stop shooting, but Shuvoo did not give him a chance even for a moment. After receiving first aid, he stood in front of the camera again; he didn’t want to return without finishing the shooting for that day. Despite the injury to his leg, he is still continuing to shoot regularly.

title: Swara left helpless during shoot
body: Bollywood actress Swara Bhaskar has expressed her discomfort with the outfit used in a song scene of her popular film ‘Veer Di Wedding’. Originally, she was made to wear a swimsuit during the shooting of the film. But the actress felt ashamed of herself. As a result, she became helpless and had to choose a different way to cover her shame. Swara said that she was so small that she felt almost ‘half-naked’. So she had to go to the shooting set wrapped in a towel.

title: Actor Tinu Karim on life support
body: Actor Tinu Karim, who has worked on both small and big screens for over two decades, has been put on life support. He was admitted to a hospital in the capital on Wednesday after his physical condition deteriorated severely. His wife Humaira Nowshin confirmed the matter to media. She said that Tinu had been undergoing treatment at a hospital in capital since Nov 24. He had gone to his village home in Barisal on Nov 8. He suddenly fell ill there. As his oxygen levels in his body were dropping dangerously, he was rushed to Dhaka on Nov 24. He was then admitted to the ICU of a hospital in Dhaka.

title: Tere Ishk Mein collects Rs 76 crore in six days at box office
body: Dhanush and Kriti Sanon’s Tere Ishk Mein has raked in Rs 76.75 crore at the box office in its first six days, ahead of the release of Dhurandhar tomorrow (December 5). Despite a slight dip on Wednesday, the film continued to perform steadily. According to Sacnilk, Tere Ishk Mein earned Rs 6.75 crore on Wednesday, taking its total to Rs 76.75 crore. The film had earlier seen strong numbers, with Rs 17 crore on Saturday, Rs 18.75 crore on Sunday, and Rs 16 crore on its opening day. Trade analyst Taran Adarsh noted that discounted ticket pricing helped sustain audience interest, adding that the film is on track to cross the ₹100 crore mark. The film marks Dhanush’s third collaboration with director Anand L. Rai, following Raanjhanaa (2013) and Atrangi Re (2021). Its trailer, highlighting a love story with a toxic lover, generated significant buzz on social media. NDTV critic Saibal Chatterjee praised the lead actors’ performances, noting their effort to convey intensity and passion, though he felt the film’s plot remained overly complicated.

title: ‘Jee Le Zara’ starring Priyanka, Alia, and Katrina
body: The highly anticipated Bollywood film ‘Jee Le Zara,’ centered on a female-centric friendship story, is once again in the spotlight. After a four-year wait, director-actor Farhan Akhtar has shared hopeful news about the start of shooting. In an interview with The Deccan Chronicle, Farhan revealed that the delay was due to the busy schedules of Priyanka Chopra, Alia Bhatt, and Katrina Kaif. He said, “Coordinating the schedules of the three lead stars for this film was challenging. But now all the issues have been resolved. We are starting very soon.”

title: Afshana Mimi in trouble over facebook
body: Afshana Mimi, a popular actress from the 1990s, has recently come under scrutiny on social media. Over the past two weeks, many people in the entertainment industry have noticed friend requests being sent from a Facebook account named “Afshana Karim Mimi” to artists, media professionals, and acquaintances. It’s not just friend requests—private messages are also being sent via Messenger. The matter was quickly brought to the attention of Afshana Mimi herself. She confirmed to the media that the account is fake. She said, “This is a completely fake ID. I do not use any social media. I don’t know who is running it.”

title: Rumours about Mrunal’s love life again
body: There has been no shortage of rumors about Mrunal Thakur’s love life since she stepped into Bollywood from the South Indian film industry. A while ago, there were rumors about her being romantically linked with South Indian superstar Dhanush. Now, it is being said that the actress is smitten by cricket star Shreyas Iyer. However, whether this new romance news is true or not remains unclear to her fans. Recently, she shared a funny video on Instagram with the caption, “They talk, we laugh. P.S.: A rumor is free publicity, and I love free things!”

title: Miley Cyrus’s engagement rumours reach a peak
body: Hollywood star Miley Cyrus seems to be stepping into a new chapter of her life. Her recent appearance gives such an indication. She attended the premiere of Avatar: The Way of Water with her boyfriend Max Morando. After quite some time, the couple was seen together on the red carpet. But it wasn’t just their presence—Miley’s sparkling diamond ring on her left hand caught everyone’s attention. From the day of the movie premiere to her birthday photos, the same ring has been seen on her hand. Since then, fans have been speculating: has Miley gotten engaged? To her partner, Max. However, neither of the stars has commented on this yet.

title: Solitude teaches me reflect anew: Tama Mirza
body: Entertainment Report : Tama Mirza is a prominent actress of the current era. She has been praised for her performances in works such as Friday, Khanchar Vitor Ochin Pakhi, Surongo, Amlonama, and most recently, Dagi. She recently returned to the country after a trip to Bangkok. Speaking about her travels, she said, “I have been to Bangkok a few times before. This time, the purpose of the trip was to give myself some quality time. A few days ago, the film Mon Je Bujhe Na, which Tama had acted in 11 years ago, was released. When asked about it, Tama said, “We finished shooting the film 11 years ago. I played the female lead opposite Arifin Shuvoo. Personally, I feel a film should ideally be released within three years of completing shooting. Otherwise, its merit gets lost, and it could affect the reputation of the artists as well. I acknowledge that a producer invests a lot of money. Releasing a film from so long ago can be disappointing both for the audience and for us.” When asked about upcoming films or web series, Tama replied, “I don’t want to say anything just yet. I have spoken with several production houses, and I have a few scripts in hand. Which one I will start shooting first has not been decided. However, I never compromise on the story or the character, so I want to take my time in making that decision.” Tama enjoys her leisure time. She said, “When I’m not shooting, I listen to music, read books, watch films, or cook. I like trying out new recipes. Most of all, I enjoy being alone—walking around my house with a cup of tea in hand, reflecting on where I went wrong in life and how I can do better. This solitude teaches me to think afresh.”

title: Sarika busy with hosting
body: Entertainment Report : For more than five years, popular actress Sarika has been hosting BanglaVision’s popular talk show Amar Ami. She is not only an actress but also gets to interact with singers and film artists on the show—people she might never have met or talked to if it weren’t for her hosting. Through these conversations, she has learned a lot about them, which is why Amar Ami is a show very close to her heart. Last week, Sarika spent time in Greece with her husband Rahir. Before that, she traveled to France, Italy, and the Netherlands. Sarika mentioned that, since she hasn’t acted in dramas over the past three years and is currently fully focused on Amar Ami, she wants to use her free time to explore different parts of the world at her own pace. After returning from Greece, she has been busy with Amar Ami and managing her only daughter’s exams. Sarika said, “I am now hosting Amar Ami regularly. Since I had never hosted a show before, the beginning was challenging for me. Even so, I have come to thoroughly enjoy hosting during this time.” The last time Sarika appeared as an actress was in Raihan Rafi’s Amlonama (for an OTT platform). In the meantime, she has also worked on a project by Abdullah Sadeer. However, she is not aware that it is a web series or film.

title: Siam-Idhika pair up
body: Entertainment Desk : Dhallywood star Siam Ahmed has wrapped up the shooting of Raihan Rafi’s film Andhar. After completing this project, he is set to start a new movie, Rakshas, which has already generated excitement among audiences. There had been long-standing speculation about the film’s leading actress. Names like Prarthana Fardin Dighi and Sabila Noor were mentioned, but the makers took their time to make a final decision. It has now been confirmed that Kolkata-based actress Idhika Pal has been finalized as the heroine. A contract with her is expected to be completed this week. If all goes well, this will be the first film featuring the Siam-Idhika pairing. The production company has announced that shooting for Rakshas will begin in Dhaka this month, with some scenes planned to be filmed in Sri Lanka and Malaysia.

title: 3 actresses return with new films
body: Entertainment Report : Soon, two actresses of Dhallywood, Apu Biswas and Bidya Sinha Mim, will return to the silver screen. On the other hand, Tania Brishty, a regular face in contemporary dramas, is preparing to return to the big screen after nearly six years. Apu Biswas last appeared in Lal Shari, produced by her own production company. The shooting was completed at the end of 2022. She is returning under the direction of the same director, Bondhon Biswas. The new film is titled Secret, and Ador Azad will star opposite Apu. This will be the first film pairing of the two. Shooting is scheduled to begin in December. Speaking about her return to films, Apu Biswas said, “I am ready to return to work. I am preparing for a new film and will do my best to meet the audience’s expectations.” It is also rumored that, besides Secret, Apu Biswas has joined another film in which she will again star alongside Ador Azad. Bidya Sinha Mim has begun shooting a new film, whose title has not yet been finalized. Arifin Shuvoo will star opposite her, marking the third film pairing of the two. The action-genre film is being directed by Saif Chandan. A picture of Arifin Shuvoo from the shooting set has already gone viral on social media. The film is scheduled to release on the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr. Besides films, Mim will also appear on OTT platforms in the new year. She has already completed shooting a web series, though she did not want to provide details before the production company’s official announcement. Tania Brishty began her film career in 2015 with Akram Khan’s Ghasful. She appeared in a few more films but did not achieve significant success on the silver screen. Her last film, Gowendagiri, was released in 2019. After a long hiatus, Tania Brishty is returning to the big screen. She will be seen in Raihan Khan’s Tribunal. Shooting for the film has already been completed. The story of Tribunal combines courtroom drama with crime thriller elements. The cast also includes Tarik Anam Khan, Ador Azad, Moushumi Hamid, Rakib Hossain Evan, Saira Akter Jahan, and Milan Bhattacharya, among others.

title: Shakib’s film ‘Antaratma’ releasing today on iScreen
body: Entertainment Report : Shakib Khan’s two films titled ‘Borbaad’ and ‘Antaratma’ were released in theatres on Eid this year. Although ‘Borbaad’ was a hit, ‘Antaratma’ failed due to lack of promotion. The film is now coming to the OTT platform iScreen. The release of ‘Antaratma’ was announced on Monday on the Facebook page of iScreen. This heart-warming story, a blend of emotion and action, will be available on the platform from December 4. ‘Antaratma’ is made by Wazed Ali Suman. In it, Darshana Banik from West Bengal acts with Shakib Khan. In the story, it can be seen that Prothom’s (Shakib) parents are killed by terrorists in his childhood. Prothom grows up to be a terror of terrorists. He lacks nothing. However, he is very lonely. He meets Rupkotha (Darshana). He falls in love with her. He also gets married. However, Prothom’s life does not come to stability. The movie ‘Antaratma’ was shot four years ago in 2021. It was scheduled to be released on Eid that year. Later, the movie’s release was delayed due to some unknown reason. This year, it was suddenly announced to be released on Eid. However, it did not do well in theaters. It was pulled from cineplexes before the first week was over. ‘Antaratma’ could not attract audiences even on single screens. One of the reasons for failure of ‘Antaratma’ was the lack of promotion. Shakib was completely silent about ‘Antaratma’ despite being vocal about the film’s failure. Others also did not have much of a role. However, heroine of ‘Antaratma’ Darshana Banik was an exception. Although she could not come to Bangladesh for promotion, she regularly posted about the movie on social media. The film ‘Antaratma’ is produced by Sohani Hossain under the banner of Torongo Entertainment. It also stars Shahed Sharif Khan, Aruna Biswas, Jhuna Chowdhury, and others.

title: ‘Nishi’ to premiere at European Film Festival in BD
body: Entertainment Desk : The short film ‘Nishi’, jointly directed by Golam Rabbani and Zahirul Islam, won the award at the 35th Environmental Media Association (EMA) Awards in the United States last October. This time, the film will be shown in Bangladesh. The production company, International Academy of Film and Media, said that the Bangladesh premiere of ‘Nishi’ will be held at the German Cultural Centre in Dhaka on December 6 at 3:00pm during the European Film Festival in Dhaka, said a press release. Regarding Bangladesh premiere, director Golam Rabbani said, “The short film is being shown in different countries of the world. It has already received awards, and it may receive more. But the joy of being able to show the film to the Bangladeshi audience is different. Many people have personally requested to watch the film. This premiere created that opportunity.” ‘Nishi’ is a film produced in collaboration with the European Union Bangladesh, Green Film School Alliance and UNESCO Dhaka. The story follows Lalchan, a timber merchant, who wants to marry Nishi, the minor daughter of a tea worker, in exchange for a tubewell to help alleviate the watercrisis. The final editing, colour and sound of this film was done at famous Lodz Film School in Poland. The cinematography was done by Natalia Pusnik, a former student of this film school.

title: Palash, Parsa Evana suddenly look royal!
body: Entertainment Desk : The popular pair of small screen, Ziaul Haque Palash and Parsa Evana, have suddenly appeared in a new look. This look has created a lot of curiosity among the audience! Recently, these two stars were spotted on social media in royal attire. They were wearing gorgeous traditional attires, which made fans feel like emperors and empresses! Ever since Parsa Evana shared this photo on her verified page recently, the comments section has been flooded with curious comments from fans. Many have praised their chemistry as a couple. However, it has been learned that it is not for any new drama or web film, but Palash and Evana will soon be seen in a new commercial for a beverage product. This picture, which was released on social media, was a special look for that commercial. It is worth noting that the pair gained great popularity by playing the roles of ‘Kabila’ and ‘Eva’ in drama series ‘Bachelor Point’.

title: Bombay Experience stages concert, Masterclass in Dhaka
body: Entertainment Desk : Alliance Française de Dhaka organiased a special jazz concert featuring renowned artistes from several countries. The concert titled “Alexandre Herre’s Bombay Experience” was held on December 3 at the Liberation War Museum auditorium in the capital’s Agargaon area. Apart from this, a masterclass has been organised with three artistes of Bombay Experience at Dhanmondi office of Alliance Française de Dhaka (AFD) on December 4, said a press release. Alexandre Herrere’s Bombay Experience is a music collaboration project that seeks to bridge the gap between Carnatic rhythms, Indian hip-hop, and contemporary jazz music. The project features French pianist Alexandre Herrere, drummer Pierre Monjard, and bass player Gael Petrina, along with Indian mridangamist B C Manjunath and rapper Manmeet Kaur.

title: I don’t understand anything except work: Madhuri
body: Bollywood actress Deepika Padukone’s demands regarding working hours have been causing a wave of controversy from Bollywood to Tollywood. In a recent interview, Deepika said that she will never work more than eight hours. However, amidst this controversy, veteran actress Madhuri Dixit has broken her silence. Her candid confession has put Deepika’s claim in question again. Madhuri said, “When the shooting of ‘Mrs Deshpande’ was going on, I worked more than 12 hours almost every day. I think of everyone as my own. I am a huge workaholic. I don’t understand anything except work.”

title: Actress Sudipa a victim of harassment
body: West Bengal’s actress and anchor Sudipa Chatterjee was harassed by an app cab driver on the streets of Kolkata. Her young son Adidev was with her. She and her child are terrified by this unexpected incident. Sudeepa said she used an app cab to reach a specific destination instead of using her personal car. She was taking a cab from her shop on Bondel Road in Kolkata to her grandfather’s house in Newtown. While in the car, Sudipa requested the driver to stop at a sweet shop for just five minutes. The app cab driver asked her to stop at the shop for five minutes and asked her to add another ‘stop’. Sudipa initially agreed but later thought, why add an extra stop for just five minutes? That’s when the problem really started.

title: Musician Imran becomes father
body: Popular musician Imran Mahmudul has made a place in hearts of music lovers with his own tunes. He is also quite active on social media. Now he has given good news to his fans. Imran has become a father. He has informed his fans and fans about this happy moment in his personal life through a post on social media. He wrote, “Alhamdulillah, Alhamdulillah, Alhamdulillah.
