I became a father for the first time. Allah has gifted me with a beautiful, healthy baby girl.”

title: Raj Ripa was robbed, lost her iPhone as gift
body: Actress Raj Ripa was robbed at gunpoint recently while she was on her way to an awards ceremony. Her mobile phone was snatched from a moving car in capital’s Bangla Motorway. Raj Ripa told the media that her stolen phone was an iPhone 13 Pro Max model. In her words, “This phone is not just a phone set for me, it is a very emotional thing for me. Because, I was a part of a bold action scene in movie ‘Mukti’. At that time, director Iftekhar Chowdhury was very happy with my performance. He was happy and gifted me the phone set.”

title: I don’t want to say anything that will cause controversy: Apu
body: Entertainment Report : Apu Biswas is a popular actress of Dhallywood. If everything goes well, the shooting of her new romantic-action-thriller film, in which Ador Azad will be seen as her hero, is going to start in December. In such an atmosphere, the heroine recently faced journalists about her new film, professional life and various discussions on social media. At that time, in response to a question about his personal life, Apu Biswas clarified that she is not willing to discuss personal matters in a professional setting. Regarding the controversy that has repeatedly arisen on the same issue on social media, Apu said that she does not want to say anything that will repeatedly put her in the face of controversy. In the words of the heroine, “I will not create controversy by telling you anything that you will repeatedly throw arrows at me. So, I feel that I will not raise any such question, any such topic in the media that will repeatedly question me.” When asked what the secret to her beautiful appearance is, Apu Biswas said, “As far as I know, people become beautiful when they receive love. So, I think I have become beautiful because of the love of my fans, viewers, and loved ones.” At the event, a journalist asked about the relationship between Apu Biswas’ son Joy and Shakib Khan. In response to the question, Apu smiled softly and asked back, “Well, what is the relationship between father and son like, is that in question?” After that, Apu Biswas clarified her position on her personal life. She said that Shakib Khan advised her not to bring personal life into her professional life. The heroine said, “The person you literally named me (Shakib Khan) is a renowned actor. … When he faces you, he faces his workplace to you. … In that context, I myself also… he told me that when you go to the camera, you are just an Apu Biswas. So, you present your profession, not the person or the place.”

title: Pori Moni gives 30-day challenge
body: Entertainment Report : Dhallywood’s popular heroine is Pori Moni. She often catches the eye with her tasteful sarees and aesthetic outfits. This time, this heroine has taken a new initiative around the Bangladeshi traditional dress, the saree. She has started a different challenge. She has created a new craze on social media by throwing a challenge to wear a saree for 30 days in a row. Pori Moni announced on social media, “Starting today, the challenge of wearing a saree for the next 30 days. Come on, Monura.” She also jokingly wrote with a special note, “Whoever fails, I will take him to Sylhet for a tour.” Immediately after her announcement, there was a huge outcry among fans. Many congratulated the actress in the comments, saying that they had accepted the challenge. Acting and fashion; Pori Moni is now a name of great presence in all fields. Apart from acting, she is also known as an entrepreneur. Her fashion brand ‘Body’, established for women and children, has already gained popularity. Is this challenge to increase the interest of the new generation in sarees? According to netizens, Pori Moni’s initiative will further advance the saree culture.

title: People getting married beautifully, I can’t even have a love affair: Srilekha
body: Entertainment Report : Tollywood’s popular actress Srilekha Mitra has always been in the news for her frank comments about her personal life. For a long time, she has been spending her life centred around her only daughter Oishee. Although she has been in the news at various times about her personal relationships and experiences of being single, she has never decided to get married. Srilekha once again made candid comments about her personal life in a post on her Facebook on Sunday. There, she wrote, “People are getting married beautifully and I can’t even have a love affair. I’ve really grown old.” She has been seen making similar statements about marriage and love before. In an interview last year, Srilekha said that she has no plans for a second marriage, “I haven’t yet met someone who makes me feel like this is the person. I don’t feel like living my life my own way anymore.” Highlighting the freedom of being alone, she added, “I can’t stand fighting over the TV remote, someone snoring next to me-all of this anymore. I love being with dogs. I live like a king with them.” Srilekha has been the centre of discussion many times for her outspoken comments outside of her acting career, and criticism of the nepotism of Tollywood. Recently, she has also been involved in directing along with acting. She started her journey by directing a short film titled ‘And the Roof’.

title: I will never advertise food products again in my life: Dr Ejaz
body: Entertainment Report : The popular face of showbiz is Dr Ejazul Islam. Who is better known as Dr Ejaz. He has won the hearts of the audience by playing diverse roles. Especially in the many dramas and movies of the late novelist Humayun Ahmed, his characters still delight the audience. Recently, this actor told about a bad experience. He also expressed his anger. Dr Ejaz was disappointed after being summoned by the Consumer Affairs Department and accused of cheating customers after being involved in an advertisement for an online company called ‘Khati-Ghee’ (Pure Ghee). Finally, he made it clear that he would never advertise any food products again in his life. A victimised buyer told the media that he was not convinced even after seeing various advertisements online. But he bought it on faith after seeing Dr Ejaz promoting ghee. Later, he was cheated due to the poor quality of the product. Such allegations quickly spread on social media. In this situation, the Consumer Affairs Department summoned Dr Ejaz. He also said that a director of the company showed him the BSTI logo on the product. So, he assumed that the product was tested and of good quality. “If the company is really selling adulterated products, the Consumer Affairs Department should investigate and take strict action,” said Ejaz. The actor has already submitted a written complaint in this regard. However, despite filing a complaint, the advertisement is still being circulated on social media. He tried to talk to the company to stop the matter, but to no avail. Ejaz said, “I have told you to stop advertising and stop deceiving people. But they are not listening. I have reported the matter to the Consumer Affairs Department.” Finally, expressing his decision, Dr Ejaz said, “After this incident, I have made a firm decision – I will never advertise food products again in my life. I hope no one can exploit people’s trust again.”

title: Sophie isn’t in movies, yet she earns crores
body: Bollywood actress Sophie Choudhary has recently faced a lot of criticism for how she lives a luxurious life despite not working regularly in Bollywood. She has only been seen in a few films. The ones she has done are not hits either. But now her luxurious life has come into spotlight. The actress has opened up about the criticism. Sophie said on social media that a large part of her main income comes from hosting and stage performances. Sophie said, “I have been hosting music shows for 17 years. I’m the number one female host in the country. I’m called to host various corporate events, weddings or live events. Everyone knows the amount of competition in Bollywood.”

title: Did actress Samantha  get married secretly?
body: After a long period of speculation, South Indian actress Samantha Ruth Prabhu is getting married for second time – such news is doing the rounds in Indian media. They got married on Monday morning at the Linga Bhairavi temple in Coimbatore according to Hindu rituals. However, as there are no official photos of the wedding and no statements from the two stars, some media outlets are claiming that the matter is a secret marriage. Samantha had long planned to choose Bollywood director Raj Nidhimru as her life partner after overcoming the emotional pain of her breakup with actor Naga Chaitanya.

title: Ranbir chose Deepika over Alia!
body: Bollywood’s Ranbir Kapoor wants to relaunch his grandfather Raj Kapoor’s production house RK Films. Rumour has it that he could team up with Deepika Padukone in the banner’s first film. The new project could be a modern remake of the 1956 hit ‘Chori Chori’. In October, news of Ranbir’s plans to revive RK Films surfaced. Sources said that this time the plan has taken a step forward. Ranbir wants the new film to bring back the touch of Raj Kapoor’s work in a modern presentation. His team is also reportedly excited about the project.

title: Ex-boyfriend puts fashion influencer’s body in suitcase
body: The disappearance of Austria’s popular fashion influencer Stefanie Pieper has been a mystery ever since. But no one could have imagined that the consequences would be so horrific. The body of the 31-year-old woman was recently recovered from a suitcase. Police say that Stefanie was strangled to death by her ex-boyfriend! He has even confessed to the brutal murder. Citing Austrian media, Stefanie’s body was stuffed into a suitcase and buried in a forest in Slovenia after being strangled to death. Two male relatives of the accused have also been arrested in the case.

title: “So Edible”: Deepika Padukone swoons over Ranveer Singh’s new look
body: Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh, who recently welcomed their first child, Dua Singh Padukone, continue to charm fans with their adorable chemistry. Known as one of Bollywood’s most stunning couples, they often win hearts with their public displays of affection—whether it’s holding hands in public or leaving sweet comments on each other’s posts. Deepika’s latest remark on Ranveer’s Instagram is another addition to their endearing moments. On Sunday, Ranveer shared photos showcasing his striking look from the IFFI closing ceremony. Wearing a sleek black bandhgala paired with matching shoes and dark sunglasses, he looked every bit the style icon. Deepika couldn’t resist chiming in, commenting, “Oh soo edible.” You can see the post and her comment below. In terms of upcoming projects, Ranveer is gearing up for Aditya Dhar’s Dhurandhar, scheduled to hit theatres on December 5. The movie features an impressive ensemble, including Sanjay Dutt, Akshaye Khanna, Sara Arjun, R. Madhavan, and Arjun Rampal. Reports suggest that the film will be released in two parts. According to Bollywood Hungama, the first installment arrives on December 5, while the second is tentatively slated for a summer 2026 release, with May 29 being eyed as the preferred date—an empty slot that would allow for a solo opening, just like part one. The same report also noted the film’s hefty runtime: Part 1 is expected to run approximately 3 hours and 32 minutes, though the exact duration will be confirmed once the CBFC completes the certification process. Ranveer’s most recent appearance on screen was in Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani.

title: Hridoy Khan’s short film ‘Trapped’ to release this month
body: Entertainment Report : Six years after making his short film ‘Trapped’, singer-composer Hridoy Khan is finally ready to release it. The project, shot in New York and completed years ago, remained shelved for reasons he never publicly disclosed. Hridoy first teased ‘Trapped’ back in 2020 with the song ‘Ochena’, written, composed, performed, and arranged by him. The film resurfaced this June again with another track titled ‘Sada Kalo’, where he appeared wandering alone through New York streets. But until now, the film itself has never seen daylight. That changes this December. Hridoy dropped the official trailer on Saturday, confirming that ‘Trapped’ will be released this month-though he has not yet announced the exact date. The 25-minute short follows a young man named Hridoy who unknowingly walks into a trap and becomes entangled in the drug trade. Forced to work for traffickers, he drifts through a bleak routine until one evening he meets a young woman named Mona. With her, he begins imagining a way out-a life unchained from fear and compromise. But when Mona is murdered before his eyes, Hridoy snaps into a new plan. The film asks whether he can outrun his past or if he is destined to fall into yet another trap. ‘Trapped’ was filmed entirely in New York, with Hridoy Khan both directing and playing the central role. He stars opposite Monalisa, joined by several local performers from the city’s Bangladeshi community. Though this is his first time acting in a short film, Hridoy is no stranger to being on camera. He has appeared in many of his own music videos, worked in commercials, and even acted in a TV drama. Speaking about directing the short, Hridoy said, “Since childhood, I’ve had a soft spot for videography. Even before my music career took off, I used to shoot videos. I never did professional videography, but I’ve edited videos and done colour grading on and off. Acting and directing at the same time, though-that’s genuinely tough.”

title: MTV pulling plug on global music channels
body: Entertainment Desk : MTV kick-started a new era of music and pop culture in 1981, when it went on air for the first time, emblematically playing ‘Video Killed the Radio Star’ as its debut music video. More than four decades later, the channel, now owned by US media giant Paramount Skydance, will wind down its international music broadcasting by the end of the year as it struggles to compete with online streaming and social media. MTV Music, MTV Hits and its 80s and 90s music shows will be shut down in the UK and other European countries in the coming months, sources at Paramount confirmed to AFP. These music channels will stop broadcasting at the end of the year in France, Germany, Poland, Australia and Brazil as well, according to various media reports. It has been declared the ‘end of an era’ by dismayed fans and former MTV video jockeys — the beloved music presenters known as VJs who appeared on millions of screens at the height of the network’s popularity. However, the conditions that made MTV ‘revolutionary’ simply “don’t exist anymore”, said Kirsty Fairclough, a professor of screen studies at Manchester Metropolitan University. The rise of digital streaming platforms like YouTube and TikTok has “completely refigured how we engage with music and images”, the researcher on popular culture told AFP. Viewers or listeners now expect ‘immediacy’ and ‘interactivity’ that sitting in front of the television to watch rolling music videos cannot provide, she added. James Hyman, who directed and produced MTV Europe’s dance music shows in the 1990s, agrees the network thrived before the internet was ubiquitous.

title: Why H’wood panicking about AI heroine Tilly Norwood?
body: Agencies : Artificial intelligence (AI) is one of the hottest topics in Hollywood right now. Especially when professional actors are worried about losing their jobs, the arrival of an AI-created actress has caused quite a stir in the industry. This AI-created heroine has been named Tilly Norwood. But why is there so much discussion about it? Basically, this super-human artificial actress has been unveiled by an AI production studio called ‘Particle Six’. Its creator is actor and comedian Elaine van der Velden. Elaine recently spoke to Sky News about the issue. She tried to dispel the fears of actors losing their jobs. She insisted, “Tilly Norwood was not created to take away jobs in the traditional film industry. Rather, these synthetic or artificial artists will help more actors get jobs in the future.” The producer, who believes that AI is the future of entertainment, added that AI entertainment is now evolving into a completely different genre or genre. Norwood is built to be part of this AI genre and will be a star in it. The entire Hollywood industry has been caught in a web of fear about AI for a long time. They are already living in fear of losing their jobs; especially those who read the industry’s scripts (script readers). At a time when the emergence of Tilly Norwood has caused film-related concerns, the rise of AI artists will further narrow the scope of human work in the future.

title: Month-long Jatra performance fest begins today
body: Entertainment Desk : The Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy (BSA) is organising a month-long traditional Jatra (folk theatre) performance festival throughout December to celebrate Victory Month. The festival, running from December 1 to 31, will feature daily performances at 6:30pm at the Experimental Theatre Hall. Jatra troupes from various parts of Bangladesh have registered to participate in the event, said a press release. Tickets for the performances are priced at Tk100, with all proceeds going directly to the respective performing troupes. This initiative aims to provide financial support to artistes working to preserve this traditional art form. In addition to the evening performances, the National Theatre Hall’s open courtyard will host patriotic Jatra song concerts daily from 5:00pm, celebrating Bangladesh’s liberation spirit during Victory Month. Organised by the Drama and Film Department of BSA, the festival seeks to revive interest in Jatra. It is a traditional theatrical form that has been an integral part of Bengali cultural heritage for centuries.

title: Spare my children: Celina Jaitley
body: Bollywood actress Celina Jaitley is currently going through a difficult time due to her divorce and legal complications. The news of her divorce has been in the news for a long time. The actress has made a heartfelt plea to the media not to publish pictures of her children while reporting on her ongoing legal battle with husband Peter Haag. In a message on social media, Celina said, “I’m in a legal battle with my husband. Please do not bring up pictures of my children when publishing that news. At least spare them.”

title: Pakistani Mufti to marry Aishwarya, name her ‘Ayesha Rai’
body: Controversial Pakistani religious figure Mufti Abdul Qavi has expressed his desire to marry Bollywood actress Aishwarya Rai Bachchan. He recently appeared on a podcast and claimed that the actress will propose to him only after she divorces her husband Abhishek Bachchan. Mufti Kavi said in the podcast that he is aware of the problems in Abhishek and Aishwarya’s marital life. The podcast host asked, “How will he marry a non-Muslim?” To this, Kavi replied that Aishwarya will be converted to Islam and named ‘Ayesha’. “A beautiful woman like Aishwarya Rai will write Ayesha Rai as her name. I would really enjoy seeing that.”

title: Suhana shares Ananya’s sunburnt picture
body: Bollywood actress Ananya Panday’s close friend Suhana Khan shared a look from her new film on social media. Tagging Ananya, Suhana wrote, “I’m so obsessed with you.” After the post was published, a new discussion has started among fans about the friendship between the two stars. Suhana shared a photo from Ananya’s upcoming film ‘Tu Meri, Main Tera’. In the photo, Ananya is seen in a very bold look. However, in that picture, Ananya is seen looking tanned in the sun! Seeing Ananya in such a state, netizens started a huge discussion.

title: I’ll not act in any more TV serials: Jeetu Kamal
body: For several months now, there has been a lot of discussion about the serial ‘Chirdin e Tumi Je Aamar’. The ongoing conflict between the two main faces of the serial, Jeetu Kamal and Ditipriya Roy, has repeatedly surfaced on social media. In a post on social media, Jeetu wrote, “I don’t make any decisions in my life without informing you, my fans or viewers, for whom I have been able to be a hero. So, I will also inform you about the decision I’m going to make today. Today I’m going to make a big decision and that is – I will not act in any more TV serials in the future.”

title: 28 Years of love life
body: Bollywood actors Ajay Devgn and Kajol have been married for nearly 25 years. Recently, they completed 28 years of their love life. In 1997, they paired up in the film Ishq. After working together in that movie, the star duo decided to get married. On the occasion of the film’s 28th anniversary, Ajay became nostalgic. On Friday (28 November), he shared a heartfelt post on his verified Instagram, posting pictures with Kajol and their children. The photos were accompanied by the background music of the Ishq movie title track. The film was directed by Indra Kumar. Released in 1997, it earned more than 500 million rupees and became the third highest-grossing Hindi film of that year.

title: Niloy becomes father to baby girl
body: Popular small-screen actor Niloy Alamgir has become the father of a baby girl. On Thursday night (27 November), Niloy and Tasnuva Tabassum Hridoy welcomed their first child into the world. Sharing the news of becoming a father, Niloy posted on his official Facebook page, “Alhamdulillah, I have become the father of a baby girl. Her name is Rushda Maimanah. Please keep us in your prayers.” Niloy Alamgir and Tasnuva Tabassum Hridoy got married on 7 July 2021. Their relationship began on Facebook, which later turned into love, and they eventually tied the knot in a family ceremony. While it was Hridoy’s first marriage, it was Niloy’s second. Earlier, in 2016, he married model-actress Shakh.

title: ‘Wicked’ earns $226m in first week
body: The popular Broadway musical adaptation Wicked: For Good is dominating the box office with a record-breaking performance. In its first week, the film has grossed $226 million worldwide. It earned $150 million in the United States and Canada. In 78 other countries, the movie brought in an additional $76 million, bringing its first-week total to $226 million. According to studio data, the film has already secured a spot among the highest-earning music-based movies of all time. It also ranks as the third-highest opening week in the history of musical films – behind The Lion King (2019) and Beauty and the Beast (2017).

title: Studio round begins in ‘Magic Bauliana’
body: The show Magic Bauliana is currently airing on Maasranga Television. This folk music reality show is broadcast every Friday and Saturday at 9 PM. After the audition round and the master selection round, the studio round has now begun. From the 40 contestants selected during the audition round, 19 have advanced to this stage. From here, the top 10 and then the top 3 contestants will be chosen step by step. The main judges of the competition are Shafi Mondol, Partha Barua, and Nigar Sultana Sumi. Aisha Khan is hosting the show. With the aim of introducing Baul music from Bengal to the younger generation and audiences around the world, this reality show is being held for the fifth time on Maasranga Television.

title: Fascist allies, terrorists lurking inside political parties: Home Adviser
body: NN ONLINE: Home Affairs Adviser Lt Gen (retd) Md Jahangir Alam Chowdhury on Sunday voiced concern over the growing presence of fascist allies, terrorists and miscreants within political parties, highlighting the potential threat to national stability. “The government has information that some leaders and activists of political parties are allowing such individuals to enter their parties without proper verification,” he told reporters after a meeting of the Core Committee on Law and Order at the Secretariat. The adviser urged the political parties to be aware of the fascist allies, terrorists and miscreants lurking inside various political parties. “We are receiving reports that some leaders and activists of various political parties are unknowingly giving space to fascists, terrorists and miscreants in their parties,” Jahangir Alam said. He called upon party leaders to identify such elements and distance themselves from them, adding that they may seek assistance from law enforcement agencies if necessary. “If political parties strengthen internal vigilance and identify and keep away individuals with criminal backgrounds, the overall law and order situation will become more stable,” the adviser added.

title: One after another concerts by foreign artistes being canceled
body: Entertainment Report : At the beginning of winter, several event organizers announced half a dozen concerts featuring both local and international artists. Alongside popular Bangladeshi bands and singers, artists from India and Pakistan were also included in the lineup. However, due to security concerns and the lack of administrative permission, these concerts are being canceled one after another. Already, three concerts have been postponed, and there is rising concern among music fans about the fate of the remaining three. Pakistani singer Ali Azmat was scheduled to perform in Dhaka on November 14. Titled “Legends Live in Dhaka,” the concert was also supposed to feature Nagar Baul James. Ali Azmat arrived in Dhaka three days earlier to join the concert. However, on the morning of the event, the organizers announced that it had been postponed. Shortly after, the concert of the popular Pakistani band Jal was postponed as well. Organized by Stage Co, the event was scheduled to take place on November 28 at Swadesh Arena on the 300 Feet road in the capital. Titled “Sound of Soul,” the concert was also set to include performances by two Bangladeshi bands, Warfaze and Level Five. Most recently, the concert of Indian singer Anuv Jain was canceled due to security concerns. The event was scheduled for December 12 at Courtside, Madani Avenue. However, the organizer, HypNation, postponed it on November 25. Meanwhile, Pakistani band Kaavish and singer Atif Aslam are expected to perform in Bangladesh in the coming weeks. On December 5, Kaavish is scheduled to perform at “Wave Fest: Feel the Winter,” alongside Bangladeshi bands Shironamhin and Meghdol at Courtside, Madani Avenue. The show is organized by Prime Wave Communication. Atif Aslam is also set to perform in Dhaka on December 13 in a concert organized by Main Stage. Additionally, he is expected to perform at a charity show titled “Echoes of Revolution 2.0.” Rumors have been circulating on social media that the show might be canceled as the organizers have reportedly not yet received venue approval. However, Main Stage recently confirmed that Atif Aslam’s concert will take place as scheduled.

title: Entertainment Report : Arifin Shuvoo is currently shooting for a new film
body: Entertainment Report : Arifin Shuvoo is currently shooting for a new film. Opposite him stars Bidya Sinha Mim. The pair were last seen together in the thriller Sapluudu, directed by Golam Sohrab. After four years, they are teaming up again. Although the shooting is in full swing, the director Saif Chandan, along with the lead actors, has remained tight-lipped about the project. The film is directed by Chandan, marking his seventh directorial venture. His most recent film Local featured Ador Azad and Bubly. This is the first time he is working together with Shuvoo and Mim as a pair. According to the director, the film’s title has not yet been finalized. However, another source has hinted that the title could be either Malik or Shikar. Multiple sources from the production unit have confirmed that filming is progressing with great momentum. Shooting began earlier this month in Paba, Rajshahi, and is currently taking place in Natore. The story belongs to the action genre, where viewers will see Shuvoo and Mim in a completely fresh look. A source revealed that Mim trained for one and a half months for the film. She has received training in martial arts, body language, and action choreography. Arifin Shuvoo has also devoted a similar amount of time to his preparations. The film is planned for release during the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr.

title: Apu returns to shooting
body: Entertainment Desk : Popular actress Apu Biswas has been away from the big screen for quite some time. Her last film was Laal Shaari. Since then, she has been busy with business and other engagements. Not only that, she has transformed herself by losing weight and taking on a completely new look. Meanwhile, the latest news is that Apu will be appearing opposite Ador Azad in two upcoming films. Speculation about their pairing gained momentum after a Facebook post by choreographer Mahfuz Kadir. In a photo, Apu Biswas, Ador Azad, and director Bondon Biswas were seen together. Although Mahfuz Kadir clarified that the photo was taken at an event, fans and film enthusiasts believe the duo is set to work together in multiple movies. One of the films will be directed by filmmaker Bondon Biswas, and work is expected to begin next month. Apu Biswas said, “I am ready to return to work. A new film is about to begin. However, I cannot disclose who I will be working with or under whose direction at the moment. An official announcement will be made soon by the production company.”Previously, Ador Azad paired with Bubly in nearly half a dozen films, and their on-screen chemistry earned significant praise from audiences.

title: Badhan enters new relationship
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actress Azmeri Haque Badhan has entered a new relationship. Although she finds the idea of being in a relationship “fearful,” she shared that she needs someone by her side-someone to talk to and rely on. However, Badhan has not yet revealed the name of her new partner. Speaking to the media, Badhan said, “It was quite difficult for me to get into a new relationship. But I need someone to talk to, someone to stay by my side. That’s why I have stepped into a new relationship.” Reflecting on her past marriages, she said, “I fell in love at a young age, and my parents arranged my marriage. Then the marriage ended. The second one also ended. So, the past stories are quite frightening.” “Last year, I went through a breakup. That relationship lasted four years. It’s been around two to three months since I got into a new relationship. Honestly, relationships seem frightening to me. My previous marriages and experiences have created this fear.” Explaining why she decided to try again, the actress added, “It is difficult for me to be in a relationship. But at the end of the day, I need someone-a companion to talk to, someone who will be there for me. The relationship has just begun. With time, I will make my decisions.”

title: Sohini out, Mimi in
body: Entertainment Desk : A new surprise has arrived regarding the much-discussed film Emperor Versus Sarat Chandra from the other side of the border. About four months ago, during the announcement, it was revealed that Sohini Sarkar, Rudranil Ghosh, and Satyam Bhattacharya would star in the film. But after the first look was released, a major change came to light – from the lead actress to several key cast members, many have been replaced. The latest update is that Mimi Chakraborty will replace Sohini Sarkar. Stage actor Buddhadeb Das has replaced Rudranil Ghosh, and Rik Chakraborty will be seen instead of Satyam Bhattacharya. When asked about the reason behind these changes, director Srijit Mukherji said, “The producer can better answer why Mimi was chosen instead of Sohini. Casting often changes due to various reasons.” This film also marks the first collaboration between Mimi Chakraborty and Srijit Mukherji as director, which has created additional curiosity around the project.

title: Bangladesh has lost a truly talented artist.  Selim Haidar had been performing with me for more than thirty years. Together, we traveled almost the entire world and performed in countless concerts-holding endless memories.  I always hoped from the bottom of my heart that he would recover and perform in my concerts again. But that did not happen… I am deeply saddened by his departure. Runa Laila
body: Bangladesh has lost a truly talented artist. Selim Haidar had been performing with me for more than thirty years. Together, we traveled almost the entire world and performed in countless concerts-holding endless memories. I always hoped from the bottom of my heart that he would recover and perform in my concerts again. But that did not happen… I am deeply saddened by his departure. Runa Laila

title: Mosharraf now stand-up comedian in web film
body: Entertainment Report : Actor Mosharraf Karim has made the audience laugh with comedy in all mediums, whether it is drama or cinema. This time he is coming as a stand-up comedian. He will be seen in such a character in the web film ‘Dimlight’ based on Sharaf Ahmed’s life. The story, screenplay and dialogues of the film have been written by Nahid Hasnat. ‘Dimlight’ will soon be released on the OTT platform Chorki. The director said that he tried to show a problem like a man’s midlife crisis by resorting to comedy. Sharaf Ahmed Jibon said, “Nothing can be seen in a lot of light and complete darkness. If you want to see something, moderate light is needed. We have various problems in our lives, some of them can be seen, and some cannot. ‘Dimlight’ is needed to show those invisible problems to the audience in a simple way.” Mosharraf Karim sees the story of ‘Dimlight’ from a different perspective. According to him, life is covered by various kinds of layers – starting from the daily layers, to the layers of sugar, toothpaste, and children’s school fees. Relationships are covered by that layer. There are no flowers or the scent of flowers. Mosharraf Karim said, “These layers gradually cover love, love can’t be found anymore. Again, something needs to be pushed and it is understood where the soul is. The moral of life is very calm, cold-tempered.” Along with Mosharraf Karim, Tanjika Amin, Parsa Evana, Sharaf Ahmed Jibon and others also acted in the film. Actress Tanjika Amin said about this new web film, “After listening to the story, I felt that the story should be told at this time and right now. It is a story of life that I have seen and known, and the audience also knows.” Meanwhile, actress Parsa Evana said, “We will see a fascinating story of the life we lead – a simple and easy, very fresh story. Where there is confusion, humour, crisis and relatable.” ‘Dimlight’ is the sixth film from the Ministry of Love project. Previously, the project has released ‘Something Like an Autobiography’, ‘Last Defenders of Monogamy’, ‘Kachher Manush Dure Thuiya’, ‘Forget Me Not’ and ’36-24-36′.

title: Feedback founding guitarist Selim Haider no more
body: Eentertainment Report : Selim Haider, one of the founding members and guitarist of the popular band Feedback, has passed away. He breathed his last at around 10:00pm on November 27, while undergoing treatment at a hospital in the capital. Feedback confirmed his death through a post on social media yesterday. It was learned that Selim Haider had been suffering from cancer and several other health complications. Foad Nasser Babu, another founding member of Feedback, said that his funeral prayer was held on Friday after Jumu’ah at the Hatirpool Pukurpar Jame Mosque in the capital. Before forming Feedback, Selim Haider’s first band was ‘Sannyasi’, where renowned singer Sheikh Ishtiaq was the vocalist. He later played lead guitar for Feedback and for Maksud O Dhaka. Most recently, he was part of the bands ‘Ullash’ and ‘Selim Haider & Friends’. Among his compositions, two of Feedback’s popular songs are ‘Aydin Chirodin Robe’ and ‘Oy Dur Theke Dure’. The guitarist, who played on countless tracks, also collaborated with renowned artiste Runa Laila. Although primarily a lead guitarist, he was also skilled in bass, rhythm and keyboard.

title: Torsa’s new film ‘Mati’
body: Entertainment Report : Model and actress Rafah Nanjeba Torsa caught the eye by winning the Miss World Bangladesh beauty pageant in 2019. That year, she represented the country at the international stage of Miss World. Since then, she has gradually started working in various media outlets. Torsa has recently written her name in a new movie. The screenwriter and director of the movie titled ‘Mati’ is Syed Shamser Tarif. Director Shamsher Tarif said that ‘Mati’ is being made in a rural context. The story will depict people’s dreams, struggles, and a life lived in harmony with the soil and the river. The shooting of the movie ‘Mati’ is underway in various locations in Maheshpur, Mathpara, and Ichamati River, bordering Jhenaidah district. The shooting has been going on there since the beginning of this month. If everything goes well, the director wants to release the movie on Eid-ul-Azha 2026. Talking about this new movie, Torsa said, “I’m very excited about the movie. I liked its story and characters. The entire story revolves around the Ichamati River and the lives and struggles of people on both sides of it. There will be a great arrangement of flowers and love here. We have been shooting for about a month. It will take a few more days to finish. Everyone is trying their best to portray the story correctly on screen.” Alvi Mamun is acting with Torsa in this movie. He said, “The story of ‘Mati’ is a little different. Although the setting is rural, the story is not like other movies. The characters have progressed in accordance with the story. The character I played is also extraordinary. I believe everyone will like it. I have been working on the character for a year. I had to learn a lot of new things for the movie. I have started shooting with all kinds of preparations.” This is Torsa’s second movie. She has already completed a movie titled ‘Nirjon Shakkhor’. Khairul Basar is with Torsa in it. After the shooting, the editing work of this movie is currently underway.

title: I fell in love with Tawsif’s dedication: Neela
body: Entertainment Report : Popular small screen actor Tawsif Mahbub and Miss World Bangladesh Shammi Islam Neela have teamed up for the first time in a drama. The drama they are starring in is titled ‘First Love’. Neela recently spoke highly of her co-star Tawsif at a press conference. Neela said, “I fell in love with Tawsif Bhai’s hardworking, dedication and vision. In short, he is an extraordinary person. When I felt like I couldn’t do it anymore after working 24 hours a day, then when I saw this man sitting and telling everyone, ‘Yes, do this, do this, do this,’ then my shot. Well, okay, he was also maintaining the namaz beautifully. I think everyone here has fallen in love with these things.” Calling Tawsif an ‘amazing person’, Neela further said, “I don’t really understand how a person can be or how a person can be. But Tawsif Bhai, I will say that he is an amazing person. So, I was already in love with his work, but now I feel like I have fallen in love with his dedication and patience all over again.” Regarding ‘First Love’, Neela said that this is her first work, her first acting as a leading actress. In her words, “First work, first leading actress feels like, wow! I’m finally becoming a heroine. Now whether I can be a heroine completely, the audience will decide. But as a lead actress, I always thought that if I do, I will do the heroine’s character and if not, I will do nothing.” Highlighting the importance of this work, Neela said, “Good thing is not just the lead role character, it is a good work with a good team. And again, I said that since first love is not something to be forgotten, I think I will not be able to forget it since it is my first work.” She said to audience, “Maybe if you like it, you will see more works in the future, but the first work is the first. So, I think that all of you who are here, all of you are witnesses of my first work, ‘First Love’. InshaAllah, those who are in my audience or those of our audience who will watch it, will also remember the first love or will remember that, no, there was a work called ‘First Love’, Thank you.”

title: Blame the mindset, not the clothes: Aishwarya
body: Bollywood actress Aishwarya Rai Bachchan has spoken out about the harassment and taunts women face in public. She has strongly said that women should never be blamed for their dress or grooming. Instead, the former Miss World has urged women to walk with confidence and hold their heads high and fight for themselves when necessary. Aishwarya recently attended an event as the brand ambassador for an international cosmetics brand. There, she was asked how women should deal with harassment on streets.

title: How much Jennifer Lopez charge for singing at a wedding?
body: Popular US pop star Jennifer Lopez has made headlines after performing at a lavish post-wedding reception in Udaipur, India. Her fee has come to light after videos of her performing at the wedding of Netra Mantena, daughter of US-based businessman Rama Raju Mantena, and tech entrepreneur Vamsi Gadibaju went viral on social media. According to a report by Page Six, the 56-year-old artiste was paid a whopping sum to perform at the reception. Lopez performed at recent high-profile event, not at a concert, but at a private family event. She performed there and received a fee of 2 million US dollars or about Tk178.6 million.

title: ‘I won’t resign, though NCP deviated from founding goal’: Samantha
body: NN ONLINE: National Citizen Party (NCP) has deviated from its original political objective by joining an alliance led by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, but there is no justification for her to resign from the party, said NCP Senior Joint Convener Samantha Sharmin on Sunday evening. In a Facebook post, Samantha said she learned from Jamaat’s press conference that the NCP had formally joined the Jamaat-led alliance of like-minded parties. Samantha said such a move was not supposed to happen, citing the statement made by alliance spokesperson and NCP Convener Nahid Islam on the day the Democratic Reform Alliance — comprising three parties — was launched. Referring to the alliance formed on December 7 with NCP, Amar Bangladesh Party (AB Party) and Bangladesh Rashtro Songskar Andolan, Samantha said the Rashtro Songskar Andolan has already accused the NCP of breaching the agreement. “Such a position undermines the initiative to build a third political force and damages the NCP’s mainstream political course. The Rashtro Songskar Andolan has alleged that NCP violated the agreement. The party even moved towards seat-sharing without formally informing the alliance,” she writes. Stating that the NCP has strayed from its core objective, Samantha alleged that “some individuals within the party deviated from its founding aspiration in exchange for a few parliamentary seats at 5:30pm on December 28, 2025.” Despite her strong criticism, Samantha said, she would not resign from the party. “I see no justification for resigning, as I formally subscribe to all the official narratives of the NCP. Even if some individuals have deviated, as a party NCP remained in the right position,” she wrote. Earlier in the afternoon, Jamaat Ameer Dr Shafiqur Rahman announced that the NCP and Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) had officially joined the Jamaat-led alliance of eight like-minded parties. He, however, said no final decision has yet been taken regarding seat-sharing. No NCP representative was present at the Jamaat alliance’s press conference. Later, NCP’s media cell said the party would hold a press conference later at night to formally announce its decision to join the Jamaat-led alliance.

title: Inqilab Moncho‘s blockade triggers traffic jam on Dhaka-M’singh highway
body: NN ONLINE: A massive traffic jam was created on the Dhaka-Mymensingh highway on Sunday following a blockade enforced by Inqilab Moncho, demanding the swift arrest and trial of those responsible for the killing of martyr Sharif Osman bin Hadi. A group of protesters blocked the highway in front of Uttara’s BNS Centre, causing a long tailback on both sides of the road. During a visit to the area found protesters chanting slogans demanding justice for Sharif Osman bin Hadi. Due to the blockade, commuters faced severe suffering as vehicular movement on the highway came to a halt. A pedestrian said he had been waiting for several hours to travel from Uttara to Jatrabari, but no buses were operating on the route.“We, the common people, always suffer because of such demonstrations. It is really painful,” he added.

title: Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury sworn in as 26th Chief Justice
body: NN ONLINE: Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury of the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court was sworn in today as the 26th Chief Justice (CJ) of Bangladesh. President Mohammed Shahabuddin administered the oath of office during a ceremony at Durbar Hall of the Bangabhaban here. Chief Adviser Prof Muhammad Yunus witnessed the ceremony. Advisers to the interim government, judges, chiefs of the three services and Supreme Court (SC) lawyers, including SC Bar Association leaders, among others, were present at the oath-taking ceremony. Cabinet Secretary Dr Sheikh Abdur Rashid conducted the oath-taking ceremony at about 10:35 am. Earlier, President Mohammed Shahabuddin, under the authority bestowed upon him under Article 95 (1) of the Constitution, appointed Justice Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury as the country’s 26th Chief Justice. Earlier the law ministry issued a gazette notification on the appointment on December 23, saying the appointment will come into effect from the day Zubayer Rahman takes oath of office. Meanwhile, the tenure of the country’s 25th Chief Justice Syed Refaat Ahmed ended on Saturday (December 27) as he went on retirement. A lawyer by background Zubayer Rahman Chowdhury was enrolled in the District Judges’ Court in 1985 and as an advocate of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court in 1987. On August 27, 2003, he was appointed as an additional judge of the High Court Division. Two years later, he became a permanent judge of the High Court Division. On August 13, 2024, he was elevated to the Appellate Division of the Supreme Court. After completing his LLB (Hons) and LLM degrees from Dhaka University, Chowdhury obtained another Master’s degree in international law from the UK. Throughout his judicial career, Justice Chowdhury participated in a number of international conferences, seminars, training programmes and courses in Brussels, Belgium (1988); Prince Edward University, Canada (1990); Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia (2000, 2002 and 2006); Quebec, Canada (2001); Singapore (2007); and Nepal (2012).

title: Prof Yunus welcomes growing Bangladesh-Pakistan engagement
body: NN ONLINE: Chief Adviser Prof Muhammad Yunus on Sunday welcomed the growing interactions between Bangladesh and Pakistan; and emphasised the importance of increased visits, as well as cultural, educational and people-to-people exchanges among SAARC member states. He highlighted the need for boosting Bangladesh-Pakistan trade and hoped that both countries would find new opportunities for investment and joint ventures during Pakistan High Commissioner Imran Haider’s tenure. The Chief Adviser made the remarks when Imran Haider paid a courtesy call on Chief Adviser Prof Yunus at the State Guest House in Dhaka. The Pakistani High Commissioner pointed out that bilateral trade has recorded a 20 percent growth compared to last year, with business communities from both countries actively exploring new investment opportunities. He also highlighted a significant increase in cultural exchanges, adding that Bangladeshi students have shown strong interest in higher education opportunities in Pakistan, particularly in medical sciences, nanotechnology and artificial intelligence. Haider said Pakistan has witnessed a rise in patients traveling to its leading hospitals for liver and kidney transplants, and noted that Pakistan is ready to offer training and academic opportunities in transplantation-related medical fields. The Pakistan High Commissioner said that Dhaka-Karachi direct flights are expected to start in January. SDGs Affairs Principal Coordinator and Senior Secretary Lamiya Morshed was also present at the meeting.

title: Tajnuva Jabeen quits NCP over alliance-forging concerns
body: NN ONLINE: Tajnuva Jabeen, joint convener of the National Citizen Party (NCP), resigned from the party on Sunday, expressing strong objections to the manner in which its electoral alliance was formed. She made the announcement in a post on her verified Facebook account. In the post, Tajnuva said many were assuming her objection stemmed from ideological or gender-related concerns regarding the alliance with Jamaat-e-Islami, but stressed that the real issue was “far more alarming.” “What is more frightening than ideology is the process through which this has been done. It is being labelled as political strategy or an electoral alliance. I would call it a planned move, carefully staged to reach this point,” she writes. Emphasising that trust matters more than ideology, she said the party had recently invited nominations from across the country with much fanfare, issued 125 nominations, but later decided to strike seat-sharing arrangements for only 30 constituencies—effectively barring the rest from contesting the election. “They dragged the matter to the very last moment so that no one could even contest as an independent candidate. Tomorrow is the last day for submitting nominations,” she writes, adding that although she currently has no intention to run independently, “everything has been thrown into chaos and disowned in the blink of an eye.” Expressing frustration, Tajnuva also dismissed media reports suggesting she opposed the alliance out of fear of losing her nomination. “I had clearly written earlier that if negotiations took place in my constituency, I would not contest the election. No matter how tough the opponent was, I was ready to fight. But that opportunity was not given,” she said. She alleged that while Jamaat-e-Islami was negotiating seat-sharing for 70 constituencies with the Charmonai Pir-led group, the party born out of the mass uprising was being allocated only 30 seats. Tajnuva had initially received the NCP’s primary nomination for the Dhaka-17 constituency and had been actively campaigning there for several days. Her resignation comes a day after senior joint member secretary of the NCP, Dr Tasnim Jara, stepped down on Saturday over the party’s decision to forge an alliance with Jamaat ahead of the 13th national parliamentary election. Besides, 30 members of the party have sent a letter to NCP convener Nahid Islam, stating their unwillingness to join any alliance with Jamaat. A central leader of the NCP, speaking on condition of anonymity, told UNB that more resignations are likely in the coming days. “Not only Jara and Tajnuva—more leaders will leave the party. In particular, women leaders holding senior positions are not interested in aligning with Jamaat,” the NCP leader said.

title: Tanushree on a trip marries an expatriate
body: The incident is truly like a movie. Bengali actress Tanushree Chakraborty went to Las Vegas, USA, to meet her expatriate boyfriend. But even the heroine herself did not think that this meeting would lead to a five-month love affair! This heroine, known as ‘Deep Freeze’, is now married after spending some private moments. Their wedding was held at a five-star hotel there. Several moments from there have gone viral on social media; which is now a hot topic in Tollygunge. The groom’s name is Sujit Basu. He is an IT engineer by profession and lives in Atlanta. He has been an expatriate for 28 years.

title: Netflix suffers disaster upon release of ‘Stranger Things 5’
body: After a long wait, the fifth season of the popular web series ‘Stranger Things’ has been released on popular streaming platform Netflix. However, just a few minutes after its release, Netflix suddenly crashed. Thousands of viewers suffered greatly due to such a disaster. The outage came shortly after the first four episodes of the series’ fifth season were released on November 27. Many fans took to social media to express their anger, especially those trying to watch the episodes on their TV sets. Nearly 14,000 customers in the United States have reported Netflix outages.

title: Why showbiz stars suddenly writing numbers on their hands & cheeks?
body: Entertainment Report : For those who regularly follow various stars in the entertainment industry, this may come as a surprise! Some stars have different numbers on their cheeks and some on their hands. Many may not understand this as it is a sudden occurrence. But knowing its secret may upset many fans. This trend was especially seen among female artistes – such as actresses, singers or models. Many may understand what the matter is! Because, along with publishing the numbers, they are writing the slogan ‘My Number, My Rules’. Basically, this is a new protest movement of stars against digital violence and cyber bullying. A group of female stars of the country have participated in it on social media. It is known that the number that the stars are publishing in their photos indicates how many times they are victims of online harassment or cyberbullying on average every day. Actress Nusrat Imroz Tisha started this movement on November 25. Writing the number ‘9’ with her picture, she said that she faces at least 9 harassments every day. Tisha wrote in her Facebook post, “Numbers to voices, let’s share our stories. Tell the story of your number, raise your voice louder. People may only see a number, but I can see everything I’ve endured and overcome.” Finally, she called on everyone to stand up against digital violence using the hashtag ‘My Number, My Rules’. Responding to Tisha’s call, many other stars from the film, drama, and music worlds have joined the protest movement. They are revealing the number of daily harassments they face, sending a message about the level of violence and harassment women face online. For example, actress Prarthana Fardin Dighi’s number is 3, actress Runa Khan’s number is 24, actress Moushumi Hamid’s number is 72, actress Ashna Habib Bhabna’s number is 99+, and actress Sabnam Faria’s number is the highest, 1000, which means, she is harassed thousands of times every day. Also, singer Sajia Sultana Putul’s number is 9, model and actress Maria Nur has written 7. Meanwhile, in protest, actress Mousumi Hamid has highlighted the pain of being harassed in her post. She wrote, “They said, ‘It’s just a comment. Ignore it.’ I ignored it not once, not twice, not thrice, but many times. But it didn’t stop. This number has increased. This is my story. And it starts with a number now.” It is worth noting that for a long time, female actors have been subjected to various forms of harassment on social media, but have not received any remedy for it. As this violence is increasing day by day, the stars have now broken their silence and chosen these ‘numbers’ as their language of protest. The main goal of this movement is to stop violence against women and cyberbullying through digital media and create awareness against it.

title: Rumours about Malaika’s love life
body: Agencies : Bollywood’s fitness queen Malaika Arora’s personal life has been the subject of much discussion and criticism by netizens for a long time. Meanwhile, she has been in the dark ever since she ended her relationship with actor Arjun Kapoor. But can love remain a secret anymore? Now she has made headlines with the hand of a mysterious boyfriend who is about the same age as her. According to an Indian media report, Malaika was recently seen with a man at an Enrique Iglesias concert in Mumbai. Since then, the rumors have been going around. That man is young diamond merchant Harsh Mehta. Ever since this concert, news of their love affair has been spreading. Now, the rumours have intensified at the Mumbai airport. Although the actress and her alleged boyfriend did not want to be caught on camera together, it was not to be. Malaika and Harsh arrived at the same terminal at around the same time on Wednesday afternoon. Malaika was slightly ahead, while Harsh was seen following her in casual attire wearing a mask. Upon reaching the parking area, the two were seen getting into the same car. Malaika got into the car first and seconds later, Harsh Mehta entered the same car. This scene has sparked fresh discussions about their relationship.

title: Why so much discussion about me: Rukmini
body: West Bengal actress Rukmini Maitra has been seen in Mumbai and the Arabian Sea more than Kolkata lately. Fans say that her beloved star is no longer seen in the city as before. However, dispelling all speculations, Rukmini is now spending her time in Kolkata busy with the promotions of her upcoming movie ‘Hanti Hanti Pa Pa’. Rukmini said, “Everyone is talking about my Mumbai commute now. But I have had a deep connection with the city of Maya since childhood. My father used to say, if I do well in my exams, he will take me to Mumbai and buy me whatever I want.”

title: Deol family organises memorial service of Dharmendra
body: Bollywood’s ‘He-Man’ Dharmendra passed away on November 24 after a prolonged illness. Bollywood and his fans are in shock over the death of the legendary actor. The actor’s family has taken the initiative to remember his colourful career with respect and love. Although it was initially rumoured to be held next week, it was held on Thursday (November 27) evening. The memorial service was organised at a five-star hotel in Mumbai. The late actor’s family, close friends and Bollywood celebrities were present here.

title: Please support female artistes a little: Xefer
body: Entertainment Report : Popular singer and actress Xefer Rahman is always in the news for her unconventional songs and eye-catching fashion statements. In a recent video message, she talked about the behind-the-scenes work of her songs and her experience as a female artiste. At the same time, she requested her fans to give more support to female artistes. In her video message, Xefer lamented to her fans, saying, “I have been with music for many years now. Many people think that I might be beautifully prepared and sing on stage or in videos. I mean, what else is a vocalist, which is completely fine. Because in reality, we humans don’t show ourselves how much work we do behind the scenes. So, you don’t know, this is also normal.” In Xefer’s words, “I don’t just sing in the real sense, I actually do a lot of things. From composing songs to making songs, producing songs, sitting down with lyrics, pre-planning it, what the music video will be like or where the song will go, all of this planning and every visualisation.” Xefer said, “Many of you don’t know that I’m not just a vocalist; I actually write songs, compose songs. 90 per cent of my songs are composed by me. I mean, I compose myself, sing myself, and I was involved in the lyrics, what else is called co-writing.” Demanding increased support for female artistes, she said, “I would say that please support artistes a little, especially female artistes a little. We have to break many barriers socially and work. Then when we feel many kinds of boundaries, then we become very demotivated.”

title: Celina alleges torture against her husband
body: Bollywood actress Celina Jaitley has approached the court on charges of financial abuse. She has filed a case in Mumbai’s Andheri court, accusing her husband Peter Haag of financial abuse. In this case, the actress has demanded compensation of about 50 crore rupees. After a long period of speculation, Celina has now opened her mouth. The actress wrote, “I’m going through the most turbulent storm of my life right now. I never thought I would have to fight this fight alone. I have no parents, no support. I never imagined that a day would come when the roof over my head would fall off.”

title: Diljit couldn’t be the best actor!
body: The 53rd International Emmy Awards were held in New York, where popular Indian actor Diljit Dosanjh and director Imtiaz Ali’s much-talked-about film ‘Amar Singh Chamkila’ raised expectations by receiving nominations in two categories. However, the artiste had to return empty-handed at Monday night’s event. The film ‘Amar Singh Chamkila’ was nominated in the ‘Best Television Movie/Mini-Series’ category. Despite not winning any awards, Diljit and Imtiaz made a splash on the red carpet at the International Emmy Awards. The actor-singer bowed in his familiar pose with folded hands.

title: Shilpa moves court
body: Bollywood actress Shilpa Shetty is currently facing various problems. In the meantime, she has approached the Bombay High Court seeking protection of her personality rights. She has raised the matter with ‘Bigg Boss’ fame lawyer Sana Raees Khan. Shilpa has approached the court. Shilpa’s main complaint is that various social media websites are using her name and photo incorrectly without permission. Some unscrupulous people are using fake pictures for publicity purposes. Not only that, but the actress’s pictures and videos are being distorted and circulated.

title: When will Dev and Rukmini get married?
body: The relationship between Tollywood superstar Dev and heroine Rukmini Maitra has been the subject of intense speculation for many years. The chemistry between the pair on screen and in real life has always intrigued fans. But when will they get married? This question never leaves them. Recently, while giving an interview, Rukmini faced the same question again from a fan. Hearing the question about marriage, she said, “The day we all stop asking these questions, that day we will suddenly surprise everyone. Everyone will be very surprised then.” Dev said, “I don’t want to be a Khan. I’m quite happy being Dev. I’m quite happy where I’m, with whom I’m with. But that doesn’t mean I’ll lead a single bachelor life for the rest of my life. Marriage is a matter of fate. But it’s not that I don’t want to get married. I will definitely do it.”

title: I went down to river on winter morning: Bhabna
body: Actress Ashna Habib Bhabna she has captured the attention of audience with her acting skills on both small and big screens. Apart from acting, she is also quite active on social media. Bhabna went down to the river on a winter morning and enjoyed water sports. She shared a bunch of pictures of that moment with her fans. In shared photo, she is seen wearing a black T-shirt, her hair loose, and holding a water-hyacinth flower. Her enchanting look with flower has caught the attention of netizens. Meanwhile, the caption reads, “I went down to the river on a winter morning. Tell me, what is the name of the river?”

title: Producer questions Tisha’s ‘professionalism’
body: Popular small screen actress Tanjin Tisha has recently taken a strong stand against the controversy and misinformation spread on social media surrounding Indian director MN Raj’s film ‘Bhalobasar Morshum’. In an official statement, she has called all the information and rumours related to this ‘complete lies and slander’. However, based on this controversy, the film’s producer Sariful has made a counter-allegation to the former Indian media. He questioned Tisha’s professionalism and said, “She (Tanjin Tisha) does not know what professionalism is.”

title: Methila returns  home after  ‘Miss Universe’
body: Entertainment Report : Tangia Zaman Methila represented Bangladesh in the recently concluded 74th edition of ‘Miss Universe 2025’ in Thailand. Although the crown was not won in the final round, she became the first Bangladeshi to make it to the top 30. Methila also came third out of 121 countries in the ‘People’s Choice’. The model and actress returned home after the ‘Miss Universe’ competition. Her flash fiction titled ‘Thursday Night’ is scheduled to be released on OTT platforms today (November 27). Methila arrived at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka at around 3:30pm on Tuesday. After returning home, she said that she wants to use her ‘Miss Universe’ experience to help new models showcase Bangladesh on the world stage in the future. While talking in this regard, Methila said, “All of the top 30 are the most qualified. They also have the ability to carry the ‘Miss Universe’ crown. I’m proud to be able to showcase Bangladesh with honour on this journey. This achievement is an honour for Bangladesh because; we had to compete with 121 countries to get to this place. This is the first time that Bangladesh has won a position in ‘Miss Universe’. The way the people of Bangladesh came forward and voted for this achievement, this is our victory.” Methila also said, “Every day of ‘Miss Universe’ brings new experiences. I want to share that experience with new ones. While I was at ‘Miss Universe’, I promised myself that I would support everyone who will go to ‘Miss Universe’ in the future because, I have that experience. I have seen that to achieve success, the help of experienced people is very necessary. The whole of Bangladesh has to stand by the contestants. I want everyone, including the country’s experienced makeup artists, camerapersons, hair designers, dress designers, to come forward.” After ‘Miss Universe’, Methila wants to focus on acting. She said that she received a movie offer while the competition was going on in Thailand. Meanwhile, Methila’s flash fiction ‘Thursday Night’ is being released on OTT platform Chorki. Zahid Pritam has made it in the investigation thriller genre, inspired by a true incident. The trailer of ‘Thursday Night’ was recently released. It shows Methila attending a Thursday night party with her friends. The next morning, she feels the marks of an unexpected incident on her body. However, the 12 hours she had left are gone from her memory, she can’t remember anything. The police investigate to find out what happened during that lost time. Soumya Jyoti, Farrukh Ahmed Rehan, and Towhidul Tamil play the roles of Methila’s friends in the fiction. Samira Khan Mahi plays the role of a police officer.

title: Ditipriya quits serial due to conflict with hero Jeetu
body: Entertainment Desk : Ditipriya Roy returned to the small screen after a long time with the help of production company, AVF. Her pairing with Jeetu Kamal in Zee Bangla’s popular serial ‘Chirodin Tumi Je Aamar’ caught the eye from the very beginning. However, due to the personal feud between Jeetu and Ditipriya, ‘Chirodin Tumi Je Aamar’ was repeatedly making headlines. All in all, the future of the serial was uncertain. This time, that uncertainty became even more intense. Ditipriya left the serial. Ditipriya has left me forever, citing physical and mental illness. She had frequent conflicts with Jeetu Kamal while doing this serial. The production company and channel authorities have repeatedly tried to resolve the issue. But to no avail. Ditipriya did not want to act with Jeetu again. After the fight, the two didn’t shoot together because Ditipriya allegedly told Jeetu not to touch her. Because of that, Jeetu decided to leave the serial after being humiliated. Later, with the intervention of the channel, he returned to shooting. However, it was learned that Ditipriya approached the Women’s Commission and the Artistes Forum after Jeetu joined. She said that she could no longer do the serial due to physical and mental incapacity. After several meetings, the Artistes Forum said in a press release on Monday that normally a two-month notice is given to quit a job. However, keeping in mind Ditipriya’s physical and mental illness, it has been made 15 days. The actress will be parting ways with the serial after 15 days. The channel authorities are looking for a new heroine to replace her. The conflict between Jeetu and Ditipriya started with a Facebook post last August. Jeetu posted a photo of the shooting on Facebook to promote the serial. Seeing it, Ditipriya felt that the photo was ‘inappropriate’. When she informed the production house about the matter, Jeetu removed the photo from Facebook. But the matter did not stop there. Even though they acted together as a pair, Jeetu and Ditipriya did not talk to each other during the shooting. However, the ice melted at some point.

title: Band members shouldn’t sing solo songs: Partha
body: Entertainment Report : The vocalist plays an important role in a band. His voice brings the band’s songs to life. The audience easily recognises a band through the vocalist. Therefore, the band’s vocal artiste or vocalist easily becomes popular than the other members. Taking advantage of this opportunity, many artistes sing in mixed albums outside the band. Some also make solo albums. However, vocalist of band ‘Souls’ Partha Barua believes that band members should not sing solo songs. Partha recently appeared as a guest on a TV channel’s ‘Nineties Music Story’ programme, which tells the story of bands from the 1990s. He talked about various topics including how he joined ‘Souls’ as a keyboardist and later became a main artiste, recording at that time, studio culture, and songwriting. Partha Barua said, “I believe that the artiste of the band should not sing separately in any way. Because, no matter who is in a band, there are four or five people, everyone has an effort. The one who sings is the frontliner. Everyone knows the frontliner more. That is why the vocalist becomes popular first. The greed for fame is a terrible thing. If he separates from the band (in the hope of more fame) and makes a mixed album or a solo career, the band will suffer. There is no disagreement about this.” Partha has also sung in mixed albums outside the band. He said that he sang in mixed albums to earn extra money. However, according to him, it is not right for artists to release solo songs while in the band. In this regard, Partha said, “I could have earned some money by singing in mixed albums. That is why I did it. Although I have some good songs in mixed albums but I have never done a solo album. I had a pretty good offer at that time. If I had done a solo album at that time, I would have gotten a lot of money. What I believe is that I got recognition by singing for ‘Souls’. My income is already a little more than the other members, where is the fault in controlling myself?” With the evolution of time, the number of audio production companies has decreased. Artistes are releasing songs on their own YouTube channels.

title: Thai court issues arrest warrant for Miss Universe co-owner
body: NN ONLINE: A Thai court has issued an arrest warrant for the media mogul co-owner of the Miss Universe beauty pageant over alleged fraud worth $930,000, a court official told AFP on Wednesday. This year’s Miss Universe contest concluded last week after a streak of scandal including a tantrum by the host and allegations of sexism. But after Miss Mexico was crowned winner, a fresh outrage has hit Anne Jakapong Jakrajutatip — whose JKN Global Group co-owns the contest. The South Bangkok Civil Court issued a warrant for Jakapong on Tuesday after a plastic surgeon accused her of fraud and concealing information when persuading him to invest in JKN in 2023. “The defendant invited (the plaintiff) to invest knowing her inability to return the money within the appointed time,” said a court statement shared with AFP on Wednesday. A verdict in the 30 million baht ($930,000) case was scheduled Tuesday, but Jakapong failed to appear in court and the warrant was issued because her behaviour “could be interpreted as fleeing”, it said. The court has rescheduled the verdict to December 26, but some local media reported Jakapong had left for Mexico amid rumours of mounting financial woes. The Miss Universe Organization said in a statement earlier this year “these legal proceedings are entirely separate” from its operations. Miss Universe 2025 wrapped up in Bangkok on Friday, after drama stirred by a public bust-up between a male competition host and the eventually victorious Miss Mexico, Fatima Bosch. In a livestreamed event, the host singled her out for failing to post promotional content and allegedly called her “dumb”, prompting Bosch to lead a walk-out. He apologised after a weepy news conference, though his behaviour drew the attention of Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum who praised her compatriot for speaking out. The Miss Universe contest was formerly owned by US President Donald Trump. Jakapong’s JKN Global Group bought it for $20 million in 2022, but later sold half its stake to Mexican firm Legacy Holding Group USA for $16 million. In 2024, the Stock Exchange of Thailand delisted JKN shares after the company failed to submit financial statements and was found to have falsified them.

title: Tanjin Tisha’s statement in response to embezzlement
body: Entertainment Report : TV star Tanjin Tisha has recently entered the film industry. She has already started shooting for her debut movie. In the meantime, the actress has been cornered by one accusation after another. After the allegations of fraud by two fashion houses, an Indian producer has now accused Tisha of embezzlement. Sharif Khan, the producer of the film titled ‘Bhalobasar Morshum’, claims that Tisha has embezzled about Tk4.5 lakh from him. In this situation, Tanjin Tisha has made her position clear by making an official statement on social media. Tanjin Tisha wrote on Facebook, “Recently, I was supposed to do the movie ‘Bhalobasar Morshum’ with Indian director MN Raj. Some wrong information has been spread on social media regarding this. This matter has come to my attention, which is actually completely false and fabricated. When I signed the movie, and I signed the contract through my lawyer. It was clearly mentioned that all the responsibilities related to my foreign travel are the director and producer. That is, they are responsible for getting the visa, flight tickets and all the responsibilities for staying and eating there. But unfortunately, they could not get my visa. Even I tried personally; but I failed to complete the visa process.” Blaming the producer for the visa-related complications, Tisha also wrote, “Since visa-related complications are the director’s responsibility according to the contract, I cannot be held legally responsible for this matter. This is the director’s failure. At that time, I waited for 2 months for a visa and did not get it. As a result, in the meantime, they included someone else for the role I had contracted with and made him act. I later signed a contract for a movie in Bangladesh, the shooting of which is currently underway. Cinema is a place of professional honour for me, which I never wanted to ruin, and I will not want to. But since the director could not start work as per the schedule due to his failure and signed a new person there, I was forced to withdraw from it.” Complaining against producer Sharif Khan, Tisha wrote, “Line producer Sharif once told me to return one-third of the money, and again told my lawyer to return some of the money, and again he is trying to extort money by damaging my career by giving false information to journalists, which is just an evil attempt.” Tisha further wrote, “In the contract I have, there is no clause that says I have to return the money if there is any problem due to the fault of the director. I have always been a person who respects the law, if they can prove it in the court of law, I’m obliged to return the money and if the court gives such an instruction, then I will definitely accept it and return the money.”

title: Ador, Bubly’s film to be released on Eid-ul-Fitr 2026
body: Dhallywood Entertainment Report : Ador Azad and Shabnam Bubly started shooting for a movie titled ‘Pinik’ late last year. At that time, it was announced that it would be released on Eid this year. However, the makers changed their decision at the last minute. Despite planning to release it on Eid-ul-Azha, Durga Puja, and other occasions, ‘Pinik’ could not reach the theatres. ‘Pinik’ is finally releasing on Eid next year. This was announced by director of the movie, Zahid Jewel. The production company will soon officially announce it through a press conference. Zahid Jewel said, “The time has been taken to release ‘Pinik’ to give a good movie. If everything goes well, the audience will be able to watch the movie on Eid next year.” The movie is being produced by Euro Bangla Entertainment. Actor Shimul Khan is in charge of co-production. He said that ‘Pinik’ was stuck because of the remaining shooting of a song. The shooting of that song was recently completed. Shimul Khan said, “I was waiting for the shooting of the song. It was supposed to be completed two-three months ago. But in between, our heroine was out of the country. Apart from that, we gave enough time for post-production. That’s why the work was delayed a bit.” ‘Pinik’ is made in the genre of mystery and psychological thriller. Director Jewel said, “Story of ‘Pinik’ is very strong. Some make action, some thriller, some horror or romantic. ‘Pinik’ is made by combining all genres. The audience will enjoy watching the movie.” Aliraj, Fazlur Rahman Babu, Azad Abul Kalam, Momena Chowdhury, Masum Bashar, Samu Chowdhury, Sharif Siraj, AK Azad Setu, and others also acted in movie ‘Pinik’.

title: Singer Puja marries for 2nd time
body: Popular singer Badhon Sarker Puja has tied the knot for the second time. She tied the knot with model and employee Subhankar Sen on Monday. The singer herself confirmed the marriage to the media. Puja, who is excited about her new life, told media, “We have known each other and had a great friendship for the past year. Finally, yesterday we got married in a family ceremony. I ask everyone for their blessings.” Puja’s husband, Subhankar Sen, is a model by profession and works in a private organisation. More than 10 of Puja’s songs have crossed the milestone of 1 crore views on YouTube.

title: Appeal to not listen to rumours about Atif’s concert
body: Popular Pakistani singer Atif Aslam is once again coming to Dhaka to immerse audience in boundless enthusiasm and flow of youth. The artiste will enthrall Dhaka in the concert titled ‘X Force Presents Atif Aslam at Main Stage Show’ on December 13. The organisers were in trouble due to rumours that Atif was not coming, and even the venue was not finalised. However, the organiser, Main Stage Inc., said that the exact name of the venue is not being disclosed for now due to security reasons; this opportunity is being used to spread confusion.

title: Men should stop commenting on women’s clothing & weight: Huma Qureshi
body: Agencies : Celebrities share updates of their personal lives with their fans on social media. On the other hand, a group of detractors are always ready to criticise. Especially female celebrities often have to face ugly attacks and sarcasm. Popular Indian actress Huma Qureshi has now protested against such criticism and cyberbullying. She claims that obscene comments or attacks on women on social media should be considered a serious crime like attempted molestation on the street and should be punished accordingly. In a recent comment, Huma Qureshi expressed her anger, saying, “There are some people on social media who first tell me to post a picture in a bikini.
