And if I actually post it, then they comment, ‘What are you doing?’ This kind of double-dealing is as annoying as it is very sad.” She believes that there should be similar punishments for social media, just as there is for harassing or making fun of a woman on the street. “There should be no difference,” the actress said. “If you send obscene pictures or obscene comments to my inbox, you should be punished too,” she added. In Huma’s words, “I just want to say one thing: stop commenting on what women wear when they go out, their makeup, their lifestyle, their work, what time they get home at night.” Incidentally, Huma’s performance in series ‘Delhi Crime 3’ and ‘Maharani 4’ has been highly appreciated. Huma has now made a bigger place in the hearts of the audience with her strong acting skills in these two series.

title: This void cannot be filled: Amitabh
body: Bollywood’s legendary actor Dharmendra passed away on November 24 after suffering a heart attack. Amitabh Bachchan is left in a deep void with the passing of his dear friend. After attending his friend’s last rites, ‘Big B’ expressed his condolences on social media last night. Amitabh is feeling a strange emptiness after losing his longtime friend Dharmendra. He wrote, “A strange emptiness! The air around him has diminished.” In his words, “Another pillar has bid farewell forever, leaving the stage of life. He has created a deep silence amidst the countless noises. This void cannot be filled.”

title: Zubin’s death was not accident, but murder, claims Assam CM
body: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma on Tuesday said the death of legendary singer Zubin Garg was not an ‘accident’ but ‘outright murder’. He was speaking in the Assam Assembly on Tuesday during a discussion on the adjournment motion moved by the opposition over death of Zubin Garg. Zubin Garg, who was in Singapore to participate in the North East India Festival (NEIF), an Indian cultural festival, died at the age of 52 while scuba diving in Singapore on September 19. Himanta Sharma said, “After initial investigation, Assam Police has confirmed that this is not a ‘death due to negligence’, it is a straight murder.”

title: Oyshee opens up about escaping from being blocked at concert
body: Entertainment Report : A small and cottage industry and trade fair was going on in Shimultali, Gazipur on Saturday night. A concert was organised there. Popular singer Fatima Tuz Zahra Oyshee performed at this concert. The entire venue was packed with thousands of spectators. However, during the concert or shortly after it ended, some miscreants suddenly vandalised the fair, spreading tension throughout the area. After the incident, news spread through various media outlets that Oyshee and her team members, who were on stage during the clash, were trapped. At one point, they climbed over a wall to escape the concert venue. During this time, the agitated crowd also vandalised her personal car. However, Oyshee has claimed that this news is a complete rumour. She clarified, “The concert ended beautifully and naturally. Her group left the venue safely. The vandalism and fighting at the fair took place shortly after they left.” Oyshee’s mother Nasima Mannan also claimed that some news reports are giving wrong information. She said, “Many news reports are saying that Oyshee was blocked. But nothing like that happened at all. The fight started after Oyshee left the concert.” After the incident, Oyshee also issued a statement on her official Facebook page. In the statement, the singer wrote, “The untoward incident that occurred at the Shimultali Small and Cottage Industries Fair in Gazipur after I left my concert yesterday. Neither I nor my team had any involvement in it. The incident occurred after we had safely left the venue.” She also wrote, “Some incorrect and untrue information is being spread about me on various platforms. They are completely baseless.” Meanwhile, sources close to the fair organisers said that the situation at the fair became heated around 10:30pm due to an argument over the price of cigarettes. Vandalism began shortly after.

title: If no action is taken, situation will become more complicated in future: Kriti Sanon
body: Agencies : The air in the Indian capital Delhi is becoming increasingly toxic day by day. The level of air pollution has reached such a terrible level that Bollywood actress Kriti Sanon has expressed deep concern about it. At the press conference of her upcoming film ‘Tere Ishq Mein’, the actress expressed her concerns about the environment of her city as well as the film. At a recent press conference in Delhi, Kriti Sanon said that Delhi’s air quality or ‘Air Quality Index’ (AQI) has crossed 430, which is very risky for public health. This situation has made her very worried. Speaking to the media present at the press conference, Kriti said, “If proper measures are not taken in time, the situation will become more dire. It is the responsibility of all of us to look into this matter. The time has come to look into this serious matter. If effective steps are not taken now, this situation will become more and more complicated in the future.” In recent times, the shooting of several films in Delhi has been cancelled or postponed due to the pollution and security situation. It is worth noting that the shooting of Kriti’s film ‘Cocktail 2’ with Shahid Kapoor and Rashmika Mandanna was also postponed due to the high pollution in Delhi and the recent blast scare. On the work front, Kriti will be next seen in Aanand L Rai’s Tere Ishq Mein, which stars South star Dhanush. The director has said that the film is a spiritual sequel to his popular film ‘Raanjhanaa’. The film will be released in both Hindi and Tamil.

title: Let’s all find a path to peace together: Shah Rukh
body: Bollywood actor Shah Rukh Khan has opened up about the Jammu and Kashmir attack in April this year and the Delhi blasts in November. He paid tribute to those who lost their lives in these incidents. King Khan said, “Let us all find the path to peace together. Forget caste, religion and discrimination and walk on the path of humanity so that the fight of our brave martyrs for the peace of the country does not go in vain.”

title: Dharmendra dies, B’wood stars at crematorium to pay last respects
body: Agencies : An era in Indian cinema has come to an end. Actor Dharmendra passed away at the age of 89. He was admitted to Mumbai’s Breach Candy Hospital earlier this month. He was discharged from the hospital as his physical condition improved. When news of his death spread in the media on November 11, Dharmendra’s family denied it. Hema Malini and Esha Deol said that he was responding to treatment and was stable. Since then, the actor was being treated at home. Two weeks after the incident, an ambulance was seen leaving Dharmendra’s house on the morning of November 24. Security was tightened in front of his house since morning. Many Bollywood stars were seen going to the Pawan Hans crematorium in Juhu. Amitabh Bachchan, Salim Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Aamir Khan, Salman Khan, Sanjay Dutt, Akshay Kumar, producer Anil Sharma and many others have already reached the crematorium. Dharmendra’s family has not yet made any official statement. However, leading Indian media outlets including the Indian Express, Hindustan Times, and Times of India have confirmed the news of Dharmendra’s death from police sources. Meanwhile, Bollywood stars have started paying tribute to Dharmendra on social media.

title: From school teacher’s son to B’wood’s ‘He-Man’
body: Entertainment Desk : After a colourful career spanning six decades, Dharmendra migrated to the country of no return. His full name is Dharmendra Kewal Krishnan Deol. But his beginning was extremely uncertain. He received only 51 rupees as remuneration for his first film! The story of how he became a legend of Indian cinema from the son of an ordinary school teacher in Sahnewal, Ludhiana, will be worth the screenplay of the film. Dharmendra’s father was a school teacher by profession. He wanted his son to study and become established. But his son’s mind was set on his dream hero Dilip Kumar. Standing in front of the mirror, he would imagine himself as Dilip Kumar, and dream of becoming a star on the big screen. Despite his father’s strong objections, his mother became the charioteer of his son’s dreams. It was mainly with his mother’s encouragement that Dharmendra participated in the Filmfare Talent Hunt and won the winner’s crown. Then, with his mother’s permission, he moved to the city of dreams, Mumbai. Dharmendra made his debut as a hero in 1960 with the film ‘Dil Bhi Tera, Hum Bhi Tere’. While reminiscing about his first income on the stage of a reality show, he revealed a surprising fact. In his words, “There were three producers shooting that film. They would sit in three separate cabins. I would be seated in the middle cabin. The strange thing is, the three producers came separately and put 17 taka in my pocket each.” That is, his total remuneration as the hero of the first film was only Tk 51. The young man who received 51 rupees that day later built a huge empire with his own skills. He has become one of the most influential actors in Bollywood by giving one hit movie after another. Not only himself, but his entire family is an integral part of Bollywood today. His two sons Sunny Deol and Bobby Deol are powerful actors. His wife Hema Malini, known as the ‘Dream Girl’, and his elder daughter Esha Deol have also made their mark in acting. Despite his father’s disapproval, Dharmendra, with the courage given by his mother, has carved his name in golden letters in the pages of Bollywood history.

title: Security concerns surrounding Taylor Swift’s wedding
body: American music star Taylor Swift is set to tie the knot next year. After a long-term relationship with American football star Travis Kelce, the singer is now looking forward to getting married. While the wedding of this high-profile star couple in the world is hotly debated among fans, there are also security concerns. Taylor Swift’s security team is currently on ‘high alert’ due to the potential dangers associated with her star status and the risk to public life.

title: Poster asking for bride for Rukmini, curiosity spreads across city
body: Posters with the words “Want a husband” and a picture of actress Rukmini Maitra are hanging in various alleys of Kolkata city in West Bengal. Suddenly, seeing such posters, it arouses curiosity among the passers-by. The poster has the words “Want a husband” written in large black and white, along with detailed information about the husband’s qualifications. At first, many thought that this was an announcement about Rukmini’s personal life. But the name of Deepak Chakraborty was mentioned as the owner of the poster! The question arose, who is this Deepak? Later, it was learned that this is the name of the character of actor Chiranjit Chakraborty! This clears up some confusion. This is part of the promotion of upcoming movie ‘Hanti Hanti Pa Pa’ starring Rukmini.

title: Ronit Roy wants to improve mental health
body: Popular Indian actor Ronit Roy, known as ‘KD Pathak’, recently revealed that it has become necessary for him to stay away from the digital world, i.e. social media, for some time for personal care and mental well-being. The actor has given a statement on social media regarding this. Ronit wrote, “I know you all love me very much. The love I have received from you is indescribable in one word. I feel like I’m at a point in my life where it is very important to stand and think about myself and my family. I started following this path to improve my mental health. However, it is temporary. But I can’t say exactly when I will return to social media.”

title: Bollywood legend Dharmendra dies in Mumbai at 89
body: Bollywood legend Dharmendra, often called the industry’s “He-Man,” passed away in Mumbai on Monday at the age of 89, news agency IANS reported. His death came just 12 days after he was released from Breach Candy Hospital, where he had been admitted in late October due to breathing difficulties. The actor would have celebrated his 90th birthday on December 8. Dharmendra began his film career in 1960 with Dil Bhi Tera Hum Bhi Tere and initially portrayed everyday characters in movies like Anpadh, Bandini, Anupama, and Aaya Sawan Jhoom Ke during the 1960s. He later moved on to prominent leading roles in classics such as Sholay, Dharam Veer, Chupke Chupke, Mera Gaon Mera Desh, and Dream Girl. His most recent appearance was in Teri Baaton Mein Aisa Uljha Jiya, alongside Shahid Kapoor and Kriti Sanon. His upcoming film, Ikkis, featuring Agastya Nanda, Amitabh Bachchan’s grandson, is scheduled for release on December 25.

title: Mim returning to screen after 2-year hiatus
body: Entertainment Report : Bidya Sinha Mim has not released any new work for more than two years. In October 2023, she was last seen in the Tollywood movie ‘Manush’ opposite Jeet. She was seen on OTT a few months before that. In between, she shot for the government-funded movie ‘Digonte Phuler Agun’, but it has not yet seen the light of day. After that, there has been no news of any new movie or Mim’s work on OTT. However, Mim is ready to return to the audience after a break. Mim said that 2026 will be her comeback year. Even though she was not seen acting, Mim was always busy promoting various brands. On Saturday, she went to the inauguration of a fashion house. There, she said that she will meet the audience again in the cinema hall next year. It is known that Mim has already finished shooting for a new movie and web series. However, the actress didn’t want to talk about it in detail before the official announcement from the production company. Mim had a great time before going on hiatus. It started with Raihan Rafi’s film ‘Poran’. She was at the centre of discussion by playing the role of ‘Ananya’ in this movie, which was released on Eid-ul-Azha in 2022. Then, her performance in the same director’s movie ‘Damal’, which was released that year, was also praised. The following year, Mim was seen in Dipankar Dipon’s movie ‘Antarjal’ and Sunny Sanwar’s web series titled ‘Mission Huntdown’.

title: Popy fears for her safety
body: Entertainment Report : Former Dhallywood actress Sadika Parvin Popy has expressed deep concern over her safety. She recently alleged that she is being threatened frequently due to disputes over family property and land. Popy recently told a media outlet that she has been being threatened in various ways for almost a year. The main focus of her complaint is her cousin’s husband, Tarek Ahmed Chowdhury. Popy said that even after hearing the news of the death of a close relative, she could not go to Khulna due to the threats. According to the actress, “Tarek called me and told me that if I went to Khulna, they would try to kill me. I couldn’t go there because of my own safety concerns.” Popy alleged that the land she bought from her uncle Kabir Hossain in 2007 is currently being occupied by her cousins Mukta and Tarek. She is threatened in various ways when she tries to use the land. Popy also claims that she has been harassed in the past by political influence. She appealed to the administration to look into the matter seriously. However, accused Tarek Ahmed Chowdhury claimed that the matter was ‘baseless’ and that he had not threatened anyone. Family disputes and property-related complications surrounding Popy have been making headlines for some time now. In July this year, another uncle of Popy, Mia Babul Hossain, also held a press conference alleging land grabbing against the same person. Earlier, in early February this year, Popy was also accused of attempting to seize land. At that time, Popy’s sister Firoza Parvin filed a general diary (GD) against her at Sonadanga Police Station in Khulna city. After that incident, Popy came out in public with her husband and children. Amidst this controversy, the actress said that there is very little chance of her returning to acting in a new film for now.

title: ‘Squid Game’ now in Hollywood
body: Agencies : The popular Korean series ‘Squid Game’ has come to an end with its third season. However, the last episode left a twist. The audience was surprised by the appearance of Oscar-winning Hollywood actress Cate Blanchett at the very end of the series. Ever since the scene of her playing tag with a homeless person on the streets of New York was seen, the buzz about a Hollywood version of ‘Squid Game’ has been strong. However, there was a haze as there was no announcement from the makers. That has been cleared up a bit this time. According to Collider, the shooting of ‘Squid Game: America’ will start next year. It will be directed by renowned Hollywood producer David Fincher. And Squid Game director Hwang Dong-hyeok will be associated with this project as a producer. Although the official announcement of the ‘Squid Game: America’ series has not yet been made. However, the shooting dates have been found on the Film and Television Industry Alliance website. According to the organisation’s list, the series will be shot from February 26 next year in various locations in Los Angeles and California. Although inspired by the Korean ‘Squid Game’, it will not be a remake of the original series, but rather a Hollywood version with a new story. However, the basic format will remain the same. The series may be released in 2028. ‘Squid Game’ first came to Netflix in 2021. After the skyrocketing popularity of the first season, two more seasons were released in December 2024 and June of this year. ‘Squid Game’ still maintains its position as Netflix’s most popular series.

title: Trudeau’s ex-wife Sophie breaks silence on Katy Perry affair
body: Agencies : There has been a lot of talk recently about the romance between American pop singer Katy Perry and former Canadian Prime Minister Justin Trudeau. They have been seen hanging out in public, chatting in coffee shops, and even having intimate moments; that’s when the romance rumours started. When the discussion about Katy Perry-Trudeau’s relationship was at its peak in the Western entertainment world, Trudeau’s ex-wife Sophie Gregoire broke her silence on the matter. In a recent podcast, Sophie said that although these issues affect her, she doesn’t really want to worry about it; rather, she wants it to be something beautiful and avoid controversy. The podcast host also applauded the ex-wife of the former Canadian Prime Minister for her response. Sophie said, “We all know that as humans, these things can affect us, it’s natural. But how you react is your decision. So, I try to listen to the melody rather than the words.” Sophie said that many issues that are spread in public can cause mental anxiety, saying, “What I do with these is my decision. What kind of person I want to be through this is also my decision.” Sophie also said that giving yourself the freedom to be frustrated, angry, or sad is important for mental health, as she believes it’s important to express these feelings without holding them back. At one point during the podcast discussion, the host mistakenly referred to Sophie as a ‘single mom’, and Sophie immediately corrected it. Sophie said, “I’m not a single mom at all. I have a partnership with a father (Justin Trudeau) who has a deep love and responsibility for my children.” Justin Trudeau and Katy Perry were first seen together on a dinner date in Montreal in July. Trudeau then attended a sold-out concert of Katy Perry’s ‘Lifetimes Tour’ in Canada. Meanwhile, Katy Perry ended her seven-year relationship with actor Orlando Bloom in June of this year. They were engaged for six years.

title: My soul is in India, I’m in America: Mahi
body: Mahiya Mahi is a popular actress of Dhallywood. Apart from acting, she is also very active on social media. She regularly shares her personal life, feelings, hobbies, and work updates with her fans. Currently, this heroine is staying in America. However, even though she is physically there, her mind is in the neighbouring country of India. She shared a bunch of pictures. In picture, she is seen in a very cheerful mood and was wearing a stylish long suit and black sunglasses. Although it was captured on camera on the streets of America, the caption of the picture is what has made the fans think. In caption of the pictures, Mahi wrote, “My soul is in India and I’m in America.”

title: Ranveer dances with Trump’s future daughter-in-law
body: A video of Bollywood actor Ranveer Singh dancing with Bettina Anderson, the fiancée of US President Donald Trump Jr’s eldest son, has gone viral on social media. The two recently performed together at a lavish wedding ceremony in Udaipur, Rajasthan, India. Ranveer first exchanged greetings with Trump Jr and Bettina on the stage. Then, he held Bettina Anderson’s hand and started dancing to the popular song ‘What Jhumka’ from his film ‘Rocky Aur Rani Ki Prem Kahani’. Seeing Ranveer’s lively dance steps, Bettina also quickly joined in and made the stage sparkle.

title: It’s easy to give up but I didn’t stop: Samantha
body: Popular South Indian actress Samantha Ruth Prabhu is also very conscious about her fitness besides acting. She often shares pictures of herself sweating in the gym on social media. Recently, she shared a picture of her muscular back on Instagram with netizens. Samantha shared a photo of herself showing off her toned back in gym clothes on her Instagram. She captioned it with a story about her fitness journey. She captioned the picture, “A few years ago I almost gave up hope of building a strong back. I thought it wasn’t in my genes. Seeing other people’s shapely backs made me think I could never have one. But I was wrong.”

title: Shraddha injured on shooting set
body: Bollywood actress Shraddha Kapoor has been injured on the set of a film. The actress sustained a leg injury while shooting for a film. She was rushed to the doctor. She is currently resting on the advice of doctors. Doctors have said that there is no reason to fear. However, she has been advised to take complete rest for a few days to relieve the stress and reduce the pain in her legs. It is expected that she will return to the set soon after recovering.

title: SRK pays tribute to terror attack victims, calls for unity and peace
body: Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan honored victims of the 26/11 Mumbai attacks, the Pahalgam terror incident, and the recent Delhi blast at the Global Peace Honours 2025 ceremony on Saturday. Organized by the Divyaj Foundation under the leadership of Amruta Fadnavis, the event brought together survivors, families of victims, dignitaries, national leaders, and artists to remember those affected by these tragic attacks. During his speech, Shah Rukh expressed his condolences to the families of the victims and saluted the bravery of security personnel who lost their lives. He urged citizens to uphold humanity and respect the sacrifices of Indian soldiers. “When asked what you do, reply with pride that you protect the nation. When asked your earnings, say you earn the blessings of 1.4 billion people. And if asked whether you are ever afraid, look them in the eye and say, those who attack us feel it,” he said. The actor called for unity across caste and creed, emphasizing that peace among citizens strengthens India. “If we have peace among us, nothing can shake India, defeat India, or break the spirit of its people,” he concluded. The ceremony, held at Gateway of India, was attended by celebrities and dignitaries including Nita Ambani, Devendra Fadnavis, Tiger Shroff, Manisha Koirala, Vikrant Massey, and others.

title: Paayel victimised by casting couch
body: Entertainment Desk : Whether in Bollywood or Tollywood, the roots of the casting couch run deep everywhere. Many aspiring models and actresses often fall victim to sexual harassment under the guise of work opportunities. Recently, former Tollywood commercial film regular Paayel Sarkar opened up about her own experience with the casting couch. In a podcast, Paayel said, “A producer from our industry demanded certain favors from me.” The host then asked clearly-“Sexual favors?” Without any hesitation, Payel replied, “Yes, that’s what it was.” Paayel revealed that this happened during a difficult phase of her career. The producer took advantage of that situation.

title: I want to do work that is truly impactful Sunerah
body: Entertainment Report : The drama series Eita Amaderi Golpo has recently begun streaming. In it, Sunerah Binte Kamal plays the character Sayra. This is Sunerah’s first appearance in a long-running television drama. Speaking about the series, she said, “This drama highlights the importance of family bonds. My intention to do something different is what led me to this project. It’s becoming a new experience for me.” The series is directed by Muhammad Mostafa Kamal Raj and is being aired on the Cinemawalla YouTube channel. She appeared in guest roles in the films Daagi and Utsob. When asked how those short appearances have influenced her career, Sunerah said, “These decisions have had a significant impact on my career. Even with limited screen time, my characters in both films sparked discussion. I want to do work that is impactful for me. You will find me where the character truly matters. It doesn’t matter how long I am on screen-the real question is how much my character contributes to the story. I want the audience to see the character, not me. Acting, to me, is the language of the soul-each time I break, and each time I rebuild myself anew.”

title: 3cr taka! What else ‘Miss Universe’ getting?
body: Entertainment Desk : Fatima Bosch, crowned as ‘Miss Mexico’, has won the 74th Miss Universe title. The 25-year-old surpassed 120 contestants from around the world to claim the crown. Last year’s winner, Victoria Keir Theilvig, crowned Fatima on stage. Overwhelmed with emotion after receiving the crown, Fatima was seen crying as she hugged the other contestants. After her victory, she said, “No woman of the 21st century can remain a puppet. I am here to represent all the women of the world.” Fatima was born in Santiago de Teapa in the Tabasco state of Mexico. She studied fashion design in Mexico. In September 2025, she won the title of ‘Miss Universe Mexico’, becoming the first woman from Tabasco to achieve the honor. Following this win, she went viral on social media-her Instagram followers surpassed 990,000, and her TikTok following reached 690,000. The Miss Universe organization has not yet officially announced how much prize money Fatima will receive. However, winners typically get 250,000 USD, which is roughly 3 crore taka. The 2024 winner, Victoria Keir Theilvig, also received 250,000 USD. Fatima will receive a monthly allowance of 50,000 USD (about 60 lakh taka), which she can use for travel and various activities. The crown she received is valued at 5 million USD (approximately 61 crore taka). In addition to cash prizes, Fatima will also get a luxurious apartment in New York City.

title: Farin becomes Shakib’s heroine
body: Entertainment Report : A few months ago, at an award ceremony, Tasnia Farin expressed her desire to become Shakib Khan’s heroine. She said she wanted to audition for the role. Shakib responded with approval, saying that Farin wouldn’t need an audition. Soon after, rumors began circulating that Farin would star opposite Shakib Khan in the film Prince: Once Upon a Time in Dhaka. Finally, the official announcement has arrived. The production company Creative Land Films has officially revealed the name of the heroine of Prince-Farin will be starring opposite Shakib Khan. Sharing a smiling photo of herself signing the contract on Facebook, Farin wrote, “A new journey is about to begin. My heart is full of love. I am preparing for Prince.”

title: Diana returns to Paris 28 years after her death
body: Princess Diana, the globally beloved royal who died in a car accident in Paris in August 1997, has now “returned” to the city. She is seen wearing her iconic “revenge dress,” which she donned after her husband Prince Charles’s affair became public. On Thursday, France’s Grévin Wax Museum unveiled its latest attraction- a wax statue of Princess Diana. Like London’s famous wax museum, the Grévin Museum in Paris already featured statues of the current King Charles III and the late Queen Elizabeth II.

title: Prosenjit-Debashree in Praktan 2
body: Prosenjit Chatterjee and Debashree Roy were once one of the most popular on-screen pairs. Their relationship began on the big screen, eventually turning into love and then marriage. After three years of married life, they divorced in 1995. Recently, in an interview with Indian media, Prosenjit was asked whether the duo would ever return together in films. He responded that he has no issues working with Debashree Roy at this moment. They have even discussed work earlier. Director Shiboprosad Mukherjee and Nandita Roy had planned to make Praktan 2 with the two of them along with Rituparna Sengupta.

title: Deepika didn’t sell herself for money
body: She received lucrative offers involving large sums of money, but Bollywood actress Deepika Padukone turned them down for a specific reason. In a recent interview, she said, “I’ve received many hefty offers throughout my career, but I’ve never bowed down to money. I’ve never taken on a role that had no purpose in the film just for the sake of money.” She added, “Maybe ten years from now I’ll question the decisions I’m making today. But as of now, I’m doing what feels right to me. And experience is life’s greatest wealth. It’s because of my experiences that I’ve been able to make many decisions easily.”

title: Popular Korean K-drama couple getting married
body: They have been in a relationship for a decade, and both are well-known faces in K-dramas. Kim Woo bin and Shin Mina first met in 2015 while working together on a commercial. That same year, they confirmed their relationship to the media. Although the star couple has rarely been seen together in public, they have now officially announced their marriage. Kim Woo bin and Shin Mina’s 10-year relationship is finally heading toward a new chapter. The couple will tie the knot on December 20 in a family ceremony in Seoul, attended by close friends and family members.

title: Katrina, Vicky become parents to a baby boy
body: Bollywood couple Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal have become parents to their first child, a baby boy, Vicky announced on Friday. “Blessed,” Vicky and Katrina wrote in a joint post on Instagram, sharing a note. “Our bundle of joy has arrived. With immense love and gratitude, we welcome our baby boy,” read the note. Katrina and Vicky tied the knot on 9 December, 2021, in a traditional Hindu wedding ceremony in Rajasthan after dating each other for about two years. Reacting to the announcement post Friday, Kareena Kapoor Khan wrote, “Kat welcome to the boy Mumma club. And so happy for you and Vicky.” Industry friends Maniesh Paul, Guneet Monga, Nimrat Kaur, Anshuman Jha, Shreya Ghoshal, Patralekhaa and Dia Mirza extended their best wishes to the couple. Reports of Katrina’s pregnancy surfaced online earlier this year. The rumours gained momentum around late July 2025, when a video went viral of Katrina Kaif and Vicky Kaushal taking a ferry to Alibaug. Katrina wore a loose, oversized white shirt in that video, which triggered speculation that she might be pregnant. In addition to being an actress, Katrina is also an entrepreneur. She launched her own line of cosmetics, Kay Beauty, in 2019. Vicky is currently shooting for Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s upcoming film Love & War. Slated to hit theatres on March 26, 2026, the film also stars Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor.

title: De De Pyaar De 2 Box Office Day 6: Ajay Devgn-Preet Singh’s film nears Rs 50cr
body: Ajay Devgn and Rakul Preet Singh’s latest film, De De Pyaar De 2, which hit theaters on November 14, continues to perform steadily at the box office. Directed by Anshul Sharma, the romantic comedy is approaching the Rs 50 crore milestone. On its sixth day (November 19), the film earned Rs 3.50 crore, according to industry tracker Sacnilk, taking its total collection to Rs 47.75 crore. The first Wednesday saw an overall occupancy of 8.84 percent. Night shows had the highest turnout at 12.37 percent, followed by evening shows at 8.76 percent, afternoon screenings at 8.05 percent, and morning shows with the lowest occupancy of 6.19 percent. Alongside Devgn and Rakul, the film stars R. Madhavan in a pivotal role, with Ishita Dutta, Meezaan Jaffrey, Javed Jaffrey, and Gautami Kapoor also in the cast. The soundtrack is composed by Yo Yo Honey Singh, Jaani, Aditya Dev–Payal Dev, Avvy Sra, and Sagar Bhatia, with lyrics by Kumaar, Sagar Bhatia, Jaani, Karan Aujla, and Honey Singh. R. Madhavan recently shared his experience working with Ajay Devgn, emphasizing the collaborative environment on set. “With Ajay, there’s no sense of competition. The story’s success ensures the film works, and he creates a comfort level that makes working easy,” Madhavan told The Times of India. Produced by T-Series Films and Luv Films, De De Pyaar De 2 is expected to release on Netflix in January 2026.

title: Sushmita Sen Faints During “Hectic” Miss Universe Shoot at the Taj Mahal
body: NN ONLINE: In 1994, Sushmita Sen, who went on to become Miss Universe, posed for an unforgettable photoshoot in front of the Taj Mahal—an experience that turned out to be more challenging than glamorous. Designer Ritu Kumar recently shared a video from her archives capturing the iconic shoot. She captioned it, “Sushmita Sen’s Miss Universe Photoshoot,” and offered a behind-the-scenes glimpse into the preparations. Kumar recalled, “In 1993, I signed an agreement with the Miss India team to design clothes for the contestants. When Sushmita won the Miss India title in 1994 and subsequently Miss Universe in the US, I had the privilege of creating her wardrobe for the tour. I sent her outfits made from bandhani, zardozi, kurta-pajamas, and saris, all of which were well received.” The designer also shared the story behind the Taj Mahal shoot. Upon Sushmita’s return to Delhi after her US tour, Kumar received a frantic call. The shoot was scheduled for the next day, but the outfits sent were too casual—shorts and t-shirts, deemed inappropriate for the historic mausoleum. “At night, we rummaged through the store, found a pink sari, quickly tailored a blouse, and gathered some key pieces. Within hours, we were ready,” Kumar wrote. She added, “The shoot was hectic, and poor Sushmita even fainted at one point, but the final images were worth every bit of effort.” Kumar fondly remembered the moment: “I still think of her in that pink sari, crowned, with UP Police personnel around us applauding. These images were featured across the country’s leading publications, giving credit not just to us but, most importantly, to the weavers.” Sushmita Sen, a former Miss Universe, gained widespread recognition in films like Biwi No 1, Main Hoon Na, Do Knot Disturb, and Maine Pyaar Kyun Kiya. She returned to acting with the International Emmy-nominated series Aarya, recently appearing in its third season. She also starred in Taali, portraying transgender activist Shreegauri Sawant.

title: Miss Universe in controversy again, questions raised about impartiality
body: Agencies : The voting process for the Miss Universe pageant has been the subject of much controversy. Viewers in several countries, including the Philippines, have expressed anger over the sudden extension of the voting period without prior announcement. Many have questioned the impartiality of the contest due to the organisers’ decision. According to the rules, the audience’s voting opportunity was supposed to end last Wednesday night. But according to the Miss Universe Bangladesh authorities and the Miss Universe app, the voting time for the ‘People’s Choice’ round has suddenly been extended. According to the new deadline, voting will be possible until 10:59pm on Thursday by going to the ‘People’s Choice Extended’ option. In addition, voting in other categories such as ‘National Costume’ and ‘Evening Gown’ will be possible until 10:59pm on the 21st. There have been mixed reactions among netizens on social media regarding the issue. Some are seeing an opportunity to advance their favorite contestant by getting more voting time, while the leading contestants are feeling anxious. As a result, there have been various reactions; questions have also been raised about the impartiality of the organisers. A netizen expressed his anger and wrote, “I doubt whether Miss Paraguay is being given such an advantage because she is the girlfriend of a judge. While people in Bangladesh and the Philippines are struggling to get votes, buying votes with huge sums of money and extending the time is unfair to ordinary contestants.” Although the Miss Universe Bangladesh authorities did not express any objection to the matter. In this year’s edition, the contestant representing Bangladesh, Tangia Zaman Methila, was slightly behind in the votes. In that regard, Bangladesh also got an opportunity to bring Methila ahead in the votes. Meanwhile, two members of the main judging panel have recently resigned, alleging rigging in the selection process of the contestants. One of the resigning members claimed that there are some people in the temporary jury who have personal relationships with some of the contestants. He also commented that this poses a risk of creating a conflict of interest. In the meantime, a new controversy has arisen over the extension of the voting time.

title: Nancy, Imran sing new version of old playback song
body: Entertainment Report : A few months ago, the production company Anupam Music re-arranged the song titled ‘Assalamalaikum Biayin Shab’ from the movie ‘Premer Jwala’. The song, which was released last September, was sung by Syed Omi and Dilshad Nahar Kona. Now, Anupam Music is bringing out the second version of the song ‘Ami Pathore Ful Photabo’. The song ‘Ami Pathore Ful Photabo’ was used in movie ‘Shesh Thikana’ released in 1997. It was sung by Andrew Kishore. The song was written by Milton Khandaker and the music was arranged by Alam Khan. The first two lines of the song ‘Ami Pathore Ful Photabo’ have been used as the bridge line in the new song. Hence, the song has been titled ‘Ami Pathore Ful Photab 2.0’. Although Andrew Kishore sang alone in movie ‘Shesh Thikana’, the song has been sung in a new arrangement by Nazmun Munira Nancy and Imran Mahmudul. The song has been written by Ahmed Rizvi. The music has been composed by singer Imran himself. The recording has already been completed in Imran’s studio. While talking about the song, Imran said, “‘Ami Pathore Ful Photabo’ is a popular song. It has been rewritten using the hook line of that song. I sang this song with Nancy Apu after a long time. The last time we both sang the song ‘Ninduke’ from the movie ‘Lipstick’. I hope everyone will like the new song too.” Imran also said that Nancy has recorded another song along with this song. Nancy’s co-artiste in it is Mohammad Milon. Imran wrote the song in addition to composing the melody and music. Amit Hasan lip-synced to the song ‘Ami Pathore Ful Photabo’ in movie ‘Shesh Thikana’. Shabnur was with him. This time too, the shooting of the song’s video will be held in Malaysia in a big event. It will be produced by Saikat Reza. If everything goes well, the shooting will take place next month. The model of the song will be finalised before then. ‘Ami Pathore Ful Photabo 2.0’ will be released on Anupam Music’s YouTube channel on the occasion of the New Year.

title: Catherine catches eye in teaser of ‘Moana’
body: Agencies : ‘Moana’ is a very popular name among animation lovers. This musical adventure movie by Disney was released in 2016. The movie was a great hit with both young and old. It grossed around $700 million. Eight years later, in November 2024, Disney brought out its sequel ‘Moana 2’. It also took the box office by storm, grossing over $1 billion. Moana’s story will once again be seen on the big screen but this time in live action. That is, not in animation like before, this time the characters are played by real artistes. Of course, there will be some animation as well. Disney recently released the teaser of the live action ‘Moana’. The movie will be released on July 10, 2026. In the story of ‘Moana’, Moana, a princess of a Polynesian island, disobeys her parents’ orders and embarks on a dangerous voyage. Her goal is to save her home. Along the way, she is accompanied by the god Maui and his pet rooster. They encounter various animals and dangerous situations. In both films, ‘Moana’ is voiced by Auli’i Cravalho and Maui is voiced by Dwayne Johnson. Dwayne Johnson also played the role of Maui in the live-action film. Although Auli’i Cravalho voiced the lead character in two episodes of the animation, he did not want to act in front of the camera. So, he joined the new film as an executive producer. And the role of ‘Moana’ has been taken by 17-year-old Sydney-born actress Catherine Lagaia. She was previously seen in three episodes of Prime Video’s ‘The Lost Flowers of Alice Hart’ series. Catherine Lagaia is making her debut in a leading role with the ‘Moana’ movie. Catherine Lagaia said, “I’m very happy to play this role because Moana is one of my favourite characters. My grandfather also came from the Polynesian island nation of Samoa, Sabai. As a result, I have the impression of the people of the Pacific Islands. Moana looks a lot like me. It feels good to be able to play a character from that region on screen.”

title: Rukmini will grace stage of ‘Didi No 1’
body: The new movie ‘Hanti Hanti Pa Pa’ starring West Bengal actress Rukmini Maitra and Chiranjit Chakraborty is set to be released on the big screen on November 28. However, before it hits the theatres, Rukmini is appearing on small screen. As part of the movie’s promotion, she is coming to stage of Zee Bangla’s popular reality show ‘Didi No 1’. This special episode will be aired on Zee Bangla next Sunday. Along with Rukmini, popular small screen actresses like Sneha Das, Anindita Roy Chowdhury, Ritabrata Dey and Sanghamitra Talukdar are also participating in this episode, which is packed with dancing, singing and chatting.

title: Girls, save your eggs: Upasana Kamineni
body: Recently, a video of Upasana Kamineni, wife of South Indian actor Ram Charan, went viral on social media. She was speaking at IIT Hyderabad and spoke about the need for more egg conservation for the younger generation of women. The video has faced severe criticism since it went viral. Many netizens have accused Upasana of promoting her company for her business. In her words, “I see that the number of boys’ hands here is much higher than that of girls. That is, the country is changing. This is a sign of progress. Girls, save your eggs. This is the greatest peace in life.”

title: Sonam Kapoor going to be mother again
body: Rumours have been flying in Bollywood for quite some time. Finally, Bollywood actress Sonam Kapoor has put a seal on those rumors. Anil’s daughter is going to become a mother for the second time. At the end of the year, she gave this good news to her fans by releasing a picture of her baby bump. Sonam shared a series of pictures of herself on social media on Thursday. In the picture, the actress is seen wearing a pink skirt and top. She is holding her baby bump in both hands. She wrote, “Mom” in the caption.

title: Hardik Pandya and girlfriend Maheika Sharma – A love story at the gym
body: New day, new updates from cricket star Hardik Pandya’s Instagram. Fans didn’t need a hint to guess who features in Hardik’s “Big 3.” The cricketer posted a series of pictures including himself, his girlfriend Maheika Sharma, his son Agastya, and his pets. Among the images, fans have already picked a favourite: a snapshot of Hardik and Maheika praying together. In another, Hardik is seen planting a kiss on Maheika’s cheek. The couple also shared fun moments from their workout sessions. In one photo, Hardik lifts Maheika onto his shoulder while she takes a mirror selfie. Hardik captioned the posts, “My big 3,” accompanied by love emojis, the sacred Om symbol, and a cricket bat. Birthday Celebrations Hardik marked his 32nd birthday on October 11 with Maheika at a private beach, reportedly in the Maldives. The celebrations appeared intimate, with cozy beach photos and pictures of the couple dressed up for a night out. Previous Marriage Hardik had married Natasa Stankovic in 2020, but the couple announced their separation in July last year. Hardik stated that after four years together, they decided to part ways mutually, emphasizing their commitment to co-parenting their son, Agastya, who remains the centre of their lives.

title: Jessia Islam seeks votes for herself
body: Entertainment Report : Jessia Islam came into the limelight after winning the 2017 Miss World Bangladesh competition. Although the results of that pageant were controversial, and Jessia herself was criticised, she was unable to establish a strong position in the Bangladeshi showbiz scene even after winning the title of the best beauty. She has not had a significant presence in the world of drama, cinema or modelling. Rather, various incidents in her personal life have brought her to the center of more controversy. However, this time, this model and actress is representing Bangladesh on the world stage in a completely different context. Jessia has participated from Bangladesh in the world’s most prestigious beauty pageant, ‘Miss International 2025’. And to survive in the race for the best on this stage, she wants to become one of the top 20 beauties in the initial stage. She is asking for votes to fulfill this goal. Jessia recently posted a video message on social media. In it, she said, “Hello, I am Jessia Islam, ‘Miss International 2025’. With your support, I can go a little further and make it to the top twenty.” She also said, “Download the ‘Miss International’ app to support me. Voting will be counted through credit cards, and the first vote is free for everyone. So encourage your family and friends to vote too.” Jessia does not see this fight as just a personal victory. In her words, “Because if I win, not only will I win, but the whole of Bangladesh will win. I hope everyone will support me to take Bangladesh a little further in the world arena. Thank you all.” Incidentally, besides modelling and acting in dramas, Jessia Islam has been seen acting in two films. She acted as a guest artiste in the psychological thriller film ‘Dard’, a joint production of India and Bangladesh. The film stars Shakib Khan and Sonal Chauhan in the lead roles. Jessia played the role of an agent in the film ‘Masud Rana-9’. Meanwhile, Jessia was in a relationship with YouTuber Salman Muktadir. Due to that relationship, they had an unwanted incident on a public street one night, which sparked a storm of criticism on the internet.

title: Adele is now in acting
body: Agencies : Adele has taken a break from singing for the time being. She announced her break after finishing her ‘Weekends with Adele’ tour in 2024. She said that she is taking this break to give more time to her personal life and to test herself in other creative endeavors. The singer also said that she has no plans to return to singing anytime soon. New news has come from Adele during this apparent break. She is starting acting. She will make her film debut with ‘Cry to Heaven’. Fashion designer and producer Tom Ford will make the film based on Anne Rice’s 1982 novel ‘Cry to Heaven’. The setting is an 18th-century Italian town. The story is about music. It is a story of two people from different social backgrounds who find their place in the world of opera. It is not yet known which role Adele will play in it. Apart from Adele, ‘Cry to Heaven’ also stars Nicholas Hoult, Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Ciarán Hinds, Thandie Newton, Colin Firth, George MacKay, Wayne Cooper, and others. ‘Cry to Heaven’ is Tom Ford’s third film after ‘A Single Man’ and ‘Nocturnal Animal’. It is currently in the pre-production stage. Shooting will begin in London and Rome from January. The film is scheduled to be released in late 2026. Adele was supposed to make her acting debut earlier. She was supposed to act in the movie ‘The Death and Life of John F. Donovan’ released in 2018, but she didn’t. The director of the movie is Xavier Dolan, who directed the video for Adele’s song ‘Hello’. At that time, Adele said, “I will definitely act in one of his movies. It may get some criticism, but I will do it.” Adele’s acting wish is coming true these days!

title: It’s a matter of luck to have someone like Abir as friend: Jaya
body: Entertainment Report : Jaya Ahsan is equally popular in West Bengal beyond the borders of the country. Her friendship with Abir Chatterjee is very old and the chemistry of this pair on screen is also very popular in the industry. Recently, Jaya’s words have taken her fascination with Abir Chatterjee to another level. Jaya said that although she has worked with many people in the industry, Abir is one of the exceptional ones. He is a very easy-going person. In Jaya’s words, “I have worked with him the most. And the biggest thing is, Abir is my most comfortable zone in the industry. I have never seen him criticising anyone in any chat or anywhere. I have never heard Abir say anything that could hurt anyone. That’s why his place in my life is much higher. He is a more uncritical person. Although everyone likes a bit of a sour story every now and then. But he must have it in him too, no one can find it. Or we can’t see it.” “Actually, there is a lot to learn from Abir. It’s not an easy task to maintain a family and career life at the same time. Abir maintains his family life in a very beautiful way by prioritising his family. it is a matter of great luck to have a person like him as a friend.”

title: Huma responds to Twinkle’s comment
body: Agencies : Bollywood actress Twinkle Khanna and Kajol’s recent talk show ‘To Much’ is now in the spotlight for various reasons. A new controversy has started surrounding their comments on the show on the definition of ‘cheating’ or extramarital affairs. In the wake of these comments, actress Huma Qureshi has now directly expressed her opinion. A few days ago, Janhvi Kapoor and Karan Johar came as guests on the show. The discussion turned to cheating. Kajol and Twinkle agreed that cheating someone mentally rather than physically is the real cheating. According to them, even if the partner has sex with someone else, it is less serious than emotional cheating. However, Bollywood actress Huma Qureshi has given a strong response to this statement. She clearly stated that cheating has no place. Huma said, “There is no room for cheating. If someone has sex with someone else despite having a partner, that is also cheating. And if someone lies to their partner that is cheating.” She also claims to be ‘old school’ when it comes to relationships. In her words, “I’m old school when it comes to love. So, I don’t have any such thoughts about cheating. I’m very possessive about it,” she said. “If my partner touches anyone other than me, I can’t accept it. Then I’d rather be alone,” she added.

title: 3rd marriage of actress Meera not going to last
body: Meera Vasudevan, a popular actress of South Indian cinema, is also getting married for the third time. Mira announced the divorce in a post on her Instagram. On Monday, Meera posted a picture of herself on Instagram and wrote, “Me, actress Meera Vasudevan. I’m officially announcing that I have been single since August 2025. I’m in a very beautiful and peaceful phase of life.” Mira and Bipin first met on the sets of a popular TV serial. Over time, their professional relationships develop on a personal level. The couple tied the knot in May 2024. Mira officially separated in August, but announced it a few months later.

title: Tasnia Farin seeks safety of artistes
body: After this incident of Mehazabien Chowdhury, popular actress Tasnia Farin has opened her mouth about the safety and honour of the artistes, She gave an important message on her social media. Farin wrote, “Stop harassing artistes by filing false cases against them. In order to advance the industry, it is important to ensure the safety and dignity of artistes.” As soon as Farin’s status was revealed, the discussion among netizens began. Many people have commented that when artistes are getting involved in unwanted legal troubles one after another, it is very important for influential personalities in the world of art and culture to come forward to protect their safety and dignity.

title: Atif Aslam to sing in Dhaka again
body: Popular Pakistani singer Atif Aslam is once again coming to Bangladesh to perform at a concert in Dhaka on December 13. The event was confirmed by the organising organisation ‘Main Stage’. According to Main Stage’s Facebook page, the concert is titled ‘Atif Aslam at Main Stage Show’. This grand open-air concert will be held at Bashundhara Ground in the capital. The venue gates will open for the audience at 1:00pm on the day of the concert. The concert will start at 5:00pm and will continue till 10:30pm.

title: Shaon calls ‘Indian spy’, demands immediate arrest
body: Actress Meher Afroz Shaon has given a status on Facebook on Monday calling those who took the bulldozer to Dhanmondi Number 32 as ‘Razakars’. Humayun Ahmed’s second wife Shaon has come under fire on social media for calling students and mobs ‘Razakars’. Many have criticised the actress and called her an ‘Indian spy’. Angry netizens have demanded that she should be arrested and brought under the law, calling him an Awami cultural fascist.

title: Doly Sayontoni to sing old songs in new arrangements
body: Entertainment Report : Old songs in new music arrangements – this has been a trend in the music industry for a few years. Old popular songs are also being used in movies. Sometimes parts of old popular songs are being added to new songs. This time, popular singer Doly Sayontoni is joining this list. She is planning to re-release the popular songs she has sung. Doly Sayontoni had received an offer from the production company to sing old songs a long time ago. But she did not agree at that time. After the success of the song ‘Lichur Bagane’ in Shakib Khan’s film ‘Taandob’, which was released on Eid-ul-Azha, Doly has changed her mind. She has decided to re-release the popular songs she has sung. While talking in this regard, Doly said, “Several companies made me offers. At first, I wondered if the new music arrangement would be able to take the place that the old songs have among the audience. However, in the case of others, I see that they are getting a good response. I sang the song ‘Lichur Bagane’ used in Shakib Khan’s movie two decades ago. The production company asked me to sing it again. I did not agree. But Pritam did it, and it created a stir across the country.” Doly Sayontoni has been in Canada for almost a year. There, she will lend her voice to a new arrangement of her song ‘Hey Jubok’ next week. After this song, she will work on a few more songs. The singer said, “Last Friday, a producer from Bangladesh called. He has re-arranged ‘Hey Jubok’ and wants me to sing it. This time, I didn’t say no. I have decided to join the trend. I will lend my voice to the song next week. Apart from that, I will also gradually re-sing the other songs that I have sung that have become popular.”

title: ‘None of us will rise if Methila is dragged down’
body: Entertainment Report : Model and actress Tangia Zaman Methila is representing Bangladesh in the 74th edition of the beauty pageant ‘Miss Universe’. She is preparing to shine on the global stage when she is facing a fierce debate on social media over an old video. Recently, Methila opened up about the old controversial ‘washroom video’ on live. She is embarrassed by the constant negative campaign from netizens. Coming live, Methila admitted that the incident was about seven to eight years old. At that time, she was accompanied by small screen actress Samira Khan Mahi. Actress Samira Khan Mahi has stood firmly by her friend Methila in the face of controversy and criticism. She shared a video message criticising this tendency to drag Methila down. Sharing the video on social media, Samira Khan Mahi wrote in the caption, “If you belittle the person who represents Bangladesh, the country itself becomes small.” Supporting Methila, she further said, “None of us will rise if Tangia Zaman Methila is drags down. Our strength is to support those who fight for the love of the country.”

title: Satisfaction that dancing gives me, I didn’t get from acting: Malaika
body: Agencies : Bollywood actress Malaika Arora has faced criticism for her divorce and age. Recently, she was accused of dancing in an indecent manner. A large section of the netizens are demanding that how could she dance in such a manner when she has a 23-year-old son at home? Now Malaika has opened up about this. She said, “I don’t focus on anything other than the truth in life. I don’t listen to negative words. Those who want to troll will do it. I keep myself and my family away from such annoying comments.” To those who have questioned the actress’ dancing, Malaika said, “Actually, the peace and satisfaction that dancing gives me, I didn’t get from acting. So, dancing is the peace of coming home to me.” Malaika has been praised whenever she dances to an ‘item’ song on screen. Be it ‘Chhaiya Chhaiya’, ‘Munni’ or ‘Anarkoli Disco Chali’. The actress was recently seen in Honey Singh’s music video ‘Chilgam’. As soon as a glimpse of the video was released, netizens called Malaika ‘indecent’. In the video, Honey is seen standing and singing. Malaika is dancing next to her. Sometimes she is chewing gum; sometimes she is dancing with her tongue out.

title: What we know about ‘Black Panther 3’
body: Agencies : Director Ryan Coogler has confirmed that the third installment of the Marvel Cinematic Universe franchise, which has been a hit with fans around the world, is coming, ending the wait for fans of the Marvel Cinematic Universe. He recently attended an event during the promotion of the film ‘Sinners’. When asked about the third installment, he said, “Maybe if I were you, I would say, ‘I’m not saying yes, but I’m not saying no either.’ But we are all working hard on this. This is our next film.” Legendary Oscar-winning actor Denzel Washington may be making his Marvel debut with this film. Denzel himself recently revealed that Coogler is writing a character for him in ‘Black Panther 3’. Later, Coogler confirmed the rumors, saying, “I’m looking forward to working with Denzel. If he’s interested in this film, then this film will happen.” After the first ‘Black Panther’ film was released in 2018, led by Chadwick Boseman, it became more than just a movie, but a cultural revolution due to its Afro-futuristic design, Wakanda politics, and the iconic character of T’Challa. However, Chadwick’s untimely death in 2020 was a huge blow to the entire Marvel team. His absence led to the creation of ‘Black Panther: Wakanda Forever’, where Shuri (Letitia Wright) emerged as the new ‘Black Panther’, protecting her brother’s legacy, and Ramonda’s death brought a flood of emotion to the story.

title: I was alert the whole time: Sushmita Sen
body: Bollywood actress Sushmita Sen suffered a sudden heart attack two years ago. Her heart was found to be 95 per cent blocked. The actress had to undergo an urgent angioplasty to deal with the situation. In a recent interview, she recounted that terrifying moment. She said that despite such a big incident, she didn’t want to lose consciousness even for a moment. In fact, she remained fully alert throughout the entire angioplasty procedure. “That nature didn’t allow me to become unconscious. And that is why I came back alive. I was afraid that if I fell asleep after becoming unconscious, I would never wake up again.”

title: Mahima didn’t know she had cancer in her body
body: Bollywood actress Mahima Chowdhury has been suffering from breast cancer for a long time. She has been talking about this issue since 2022. She used to go for checkups regularly every year since she was diagnosed with cancer. However, there were no symptoms in her body beforehand. Mahima said, “There were no symptoms in my body. I could not even imagine that I was suffering from breast cancer. Cancer is a disease that can only be detected through screening. So, if you get checked every year, it is possible to start treatment at an early stage.”

title: Parachute didn’t open after jumping, Ajay had terrifying experience
body: Bollywood star Ajay Devgn had a terrifying experience while skydiving. While training, he witnessed the tragic death of a man right in front of his eyes. He did not survive after jumping from a plane because the man’s parachute did not open. Ajay mentioned that terrifying day in his life. He said that he had gone to the United States to take training in sky diving. That is where the accident happened. He said, “Immediately after I went there, I had a terrifying experience. I saw that someone had jumped from a plane, but his parachute did not open. After that person, it was my turn to sky dive.”

title: Disha’s father fears for his safety despite surviving
body: A couple of months ago, Bollywood actress Disha Patani’s father Jagdish Patani narrowly escaped a major tragedy when a few rounds of gunfire were fired in front of her house, creating panic. He narrowly escaped being hit by a bullet. The police then brought the situation under control. The two miscreants involved in the incident were later punished by firing squad. In such a situation, Disha Patani’s father, who was concerned about his safety, finally got a license from the administration to possess a personal firearm.

title: FIR lodged against Ajaz Khan for sharing objectionable content on social media
body: An FIR has been registered against actor and Bigg Boss contestant Ajaz Khan for allegedly circulating fake news and objectionable content on social media. Rajesh Dandotiya, Additional Deputy Commissioner of Police (Crime Branch, Indore), confirmed that Khan was summoned to the police station after the FIR was filed. His mobile phone was seized in connection with a two-month-old case. The ADCP said 32 social media accounts were blocked and complaints were filed against 68 others over the circulation of misleading content. The case pertains to a video allegedly shared on Khan’s social media handle containing highly objectionable material. Khan attended the station for questioning for three hours after receiving the notice and cooperated with authorities, Dandotiya added. This is not the first time Khan has faced legal action over social media posts. Earlier, an FIR was filed against him for an offensive video targeting a YouTuber and his family. In October, the Delhi High Court granted him anticipatory bail on furnishing a Rs 30,000 bond and one surety.

title: Arrest warrant issued against Mehazabien
body: Entertainment Report : Popular model and TV actress Mehazabien Chowdhury has been embroiled in legal complications. A Dhaka court has issued an arrest warrant against Mehazabien and her brother Alisan Chowdhury in a case filed against them for allegedly embezzling Tk 2.7 million, threatening and intimidating them in exchange for being a partner in a family business. According to court sources on Sunday, the accused in the case were scheduled to appear in court. However, as they did not appear in court, Dhaka Executive Magistrate Court-3 Afroza Tania issued an arrest warrant against them on November 10. At the same time, the report regarding the arrest has been scheduled for December 18. According to the case, the accused, by offering various inducements to Mehazabien Chowdhury as a partner in her new family business, paid a total of Tk 27 lakh in cash and through bKash on various dates and times, claiming to have known the plaintiff for a long time. After that, the actress and her brother did not take the initiative to start their business activities for a long time, and when the plaintiff asked for money at various times, she delayed it for a long time, saying that she would give it today or tomorrow. It further states that when he later went to ask for the money owed on the afternoon of February 11, they asked him to come to a restaurant near Hatirjheel Road on March 16. When he went to the spot that day, Mehazabien and his brother along with 4/5 other unidentified people abused him in foul language. They said, “You will not go to our house to ask for money from now on and if I see you in front of our house again, I will kill you”, saying these things, they threatened the plaintiff with death and intimidated him. When the concerned Bhatara went to the police station to resolve the matter, the police station authorities advised him to file a case in the court. In this incident, Amirul Islam filed a case under Section 107/117(3) of the Criminal Procedure Code at the Executive Magistrate’s Court in Dhaka. Meanwhile, on Sunday, Mehazabien posted on social media claiming that news about the case had spread. In the post, the actress wrote, “Some baseless ‘case’ news is being spread online using my name. I request all my journalist colleagues to please refrain from publishing any unverified and untrue news.”

title: Runa Laila’s famous song in Coke Studio Bangla
body: Entertainment Desk : Legendary singer of the subcontinent Runa Laila has sung in a total of 18 languages including Bengali, Hindi, Punjabi, Urdu, and English in her long 60 years of musical career. One of her timeless songs is ‘Dama Dum Mast Kalandar’. Finally, the song will be heard anew on Coke Studio Bangla. It was released on the platform’s YouTube channel on Sunday evening. Ever since the third season of Coke Studio Bangla was announced, there have been rumours that Runa Laila will be singing this time. Although the authorities have been silent about the matter since the beginning. Last year, the artiste herself confirmed the news of her participation, but did not reveal anything about the song. However, ending all speculation, the teaser of the song was released on November 14 and it was announced that the full song would be released on Wednesday evening. Although the recording of the song was completed long ago, it took so long to release it as Coke Studio Bangla’s activities were closed for almost a year. Two years ago, Runa Laila performed this song with the Coke Studio team at a domestic event in Kolkata. Coke Studio Bangla’s music curator Shayan Chowdhury Arnab and composer Shuvendu Das Shuvo and many others were present at the event. It is worth noting that today (November 17) is Runa Laila’s birthday. Coke Studio Bangla is releasing this special song just before her birthday to pay tribute to the legendary artiste.

title: I can’t win if I don’t wear a bikini: Methila
body: Entertainment Report : Model and actress Tangia Zaman Methila is representing Bangladesh in the 74th edition of the world’s most prestigious beauty pageant, ‘Miss Universe.’ After winning the crown of ‘Miss Universe Bangladesh 2025’ last September, she flew to Thailand, the main stage of the competition, carrying the country’s flag, in late October. Methila shared a video message from Thailand regarding the ongoing debate among netizens on social media. In it, she expressed her intense anger and disappointment towards the people of the country and highlighted the harsh reality of the competition. In the video, Methila said, “I don’t care if people from other countries troll me, but the people of our country are seeing how much I’m struggling. If a good contestant from such a big country comes and tries so hard, so disciplined, does everything on time, puts in so much effort, learns so much, and does so much, but doesn’t get appreciation from the people of their own country, then it’s very painful.” Regarding wearing a bikini, she said, “And how many times do I have to say that if I don’t wear a bikini, I won’t be able to make it to the top thirty. So you want me to win. So, if I want to win, then I have to wear a bikini. There’s actually no religion here. If I want to win here, if Bangladesh has to win, then I have to study.” In her words, “This place is a very big place. There is competition with so many people and everyone is good. No one is bad here, everyone is good. So to compete with them, I have to do a lot better, and the people of my country have to come a lot further.”

title: Kangana gets trolled by netizens
body: Bollywood’s queen Kangana Ranaut has always been in headlines for her controversial comments. Now, she has made a comment about the birth of a daughter, which has sparked a new storm of controversy in various circles, including social media. Kangana spoke about the attitudes towards sons and daughters in Asian families. She said, “You can talk to every family in Asia and see. Especially when it’s a second daughter, it makes more sense. It could be that a family is very highly educated. They want to show that in their eyes, both boys and girls are equal. But I’m telling you, after having a daughter, everyone thinks about this. Even actors and actresses and big families see the same picture.”

title: Munni from ‘Bajrangi Bhaijaan’ returning to film
body: Anybody can remember little Munni from the 2015 blockbuster Bollywood film ‘Bajrangi Bhaijaan’. Harshaali Malhotra won the hearts of audience by playing the role of that sweet, silent Pakistani girl. After almost a decade, Harshaali is now returning to film with help of South Indian cinema. She is going to play an important role in 65-year-old Telugu superstar Nandamuri Balakrishna’s upcoming film ‘Akhand 2’. This is going to be her Telugu debut and this news has created a lot of excitement among her fans.

title: Actress Mehazabein, her brother get bail upon surrender
body: A Dhaka court on Sunday granted bail to popular actress Mehazabien Chowdhury and her brother Alisan Chowdhury in a case over embezzlement of Tk 27 lakh. Judge of the Dhaka Executive Magistrate Court-3 Afroza Tania granted bail when she along with her brother surrendered before the court, said Mehazabein’s lawyer Tuhin Hawladar. Earlier, in the day, a Dhaka court issued warrants for their arrest. According to the case statement, Mehazabien took Tk 27 lakh from plaintiff Amirul Islam through Nagad and bKash, promising to make him a business partner in a new family venture. When Mehazabien and her brother did not initiate any business activities for a long period, Amirul asked for his money back but they delayed repayment. On February 11, after Amirul again sought the refund, the accused asked him to meet at Hatirjheel Road on March 16. Upon reaching the designated spot, Amirul was verbally abused and threatened with death by Mehazabien, her brother, and 4–5 others if he appeared near the actress’ residence, it said. Amirul filed a case with Dhaka Executive Magistrate on March 24.

title: “Shabnur Accuses Film Production Team of Unprofessionalism, Criticizes Poor Management and False Promises”
body: Those associated with the production and direction of this film have displayed unprofessional behaviour from the very beginning. Even before shooting began, they released a low-quality poster, which was widely criticized on social media. During the shoot, the unit remained disorganized and poorly managed. I was initially told that some scenes and songs would be shot abroad and that the editing would also be done outside the country, but in reality, I did not see any reflection of these claims. (Regarding allegations of unprofessionalism against the filmmaker) Shabnur

title: I’m not ready for OTT Yet: Niha
body: Entertainment Report : Naznin Niha is one of the most popular actresses and models of the present time. She has won the hearts of viewers by acting in quality dramas. Alongside television dramas, she is now set to appear as the model in singer and music director Imran Mahmudul’s song “Shudhu Tomake Chhara.” Regarding this, Niha said, “Imran has been a good friend of mine even before I entered the media. I had promised him long ago that I would work in one of his music videos. I was the model for his song ‘Jane Mon,’ and people received it quite well. Recently, he offered me to model for the song ‘Shudhu Tomake Chhara,’ and I agreed.” Explaining why she has been appearing less frequently in dramas, Niha said, “I’m working less these days. I’m giving time to my studies and spending time with my family. If you notice, I have always done fewer projects from the beginning. Honestly, I don’t enjoy working continuously. The less I work, the more the audience stays interested in me. I still haven’t become fully skilled and experienced in acting, so doing too many projects won’t help. I want to work less but take time with whatever I do. That way, I can learn. My schedule will get busy again from next month.” When asked why she hasn’t appeared on OTT platforms while many of her contemporaries have, Niha explained, “I have received many offers for OTT. But I haven’t found stories or characters that I feel are right for me. I’m not fully prepared for OTT yet. Everything has its own time. I will do it when I’m ready. For now, television dramas are where my heart is, and I want to stay here.” Finally, speaking about pairing up with co-stars, Niha said, “I want to work with everyone. I don’t want to be paired with only one person while having fewer projects with others. Because of this, every project I do gets a good response. My works with Ziaul Faruq Apurba, Farhan Ahmed Jovan, Tawsif Mahbub, and Yash Rohan have all been well received by the audience. There will be more projects with others in the future. I want people to feel that whichever pair I work in, it looks good. I don’t want to work in a one-dimensional way.”

title: Kona’s new song ‘Bhetor O Bahire’
body: Entertainment Reporter : After a long time, Fuad Almuqtadir and Dilshad Nahar Kona have teamed up to create a uniquely styled song. The title of their new collaboration is “Bhetor O Bahire.” The lyrics are written by Abdar Rahman, while the tune and music arrangement are done by Fuad Almuqtadir. The music video has been produced by Kinetic Team. Recently, the song was released as a video on Kona’s official YouTube channel. Regarding the release, Kona said, “I have been working with Fuad since the beginning of my career. I’ve lent my voice to albums, singles, film playback songs, and even advertisement jingles composed and arranged by him. The audience has appreciated all of those works. Our understanding in creating something new is wonderful. With that expectation in mind, we created another unique production like ‘Bhetor O Bahire.’ About the song, Kona mentioned that it is one of her personal favorites. Although it was recorded a long time ago, it was never released. “From the beginning, I wanted to publish it with a stunning music video that matches the theme of the song. That’s why we took some extra time to release it,” she added. Meanwhile, besides releasing this solo track, both Fuad and Kona are busy working on several new projects. Fuad is currently in the United States organizing his work, while Kona continues to engage in solo and duet tracks, regular playback singing, jingle recordings, and stage shows.

title: Amitabh Reza marries again
body: Entertainment Desk : Bangladeshi filmmaker Amitabh Reza Chowdhury, who has been staying in New York, USA, for the past few months, has stepped into a new chapter of his life. On Friday morning (local time), he married screenwriter and director Mushficaa Maasud-his third marriage. Both of them confirmed the news. On Thursday night, Amitabh posted a photo on Facebook with the caption: “Sometimes a fellow traveler, sometimes a comrade-in-arms, but I never imagined I’d spend my life with someone more mischievous than me. Ah, life…” He added, “Yes, it’s now official; a promise to live with both light and shadow… Let’s begin, my dear Mushficaa Maasud.” It is worth noting that before this, filmmaker Amitabh Reza was married to actors Nowrin Hasan Khan Jenny and Meem Rashid.

title: Hania Aamir as Shakib Khan’s future co-star
body: Entertainment Desk : When asked whom she prefers- Shah Rukh Khan or Shakib Khan- Pakistani actress Hania Aamir chose Shakib Khan. Last September, she visited Dhaka at the invitation of Sunsilk. At that time, Hania said, “I think you all like Shakib Khan a lot, so I like Shakib Khan too.” Since then, rumors have been circulating that Hania Aamir will be acting opposite Shakib Khan. Amid these discussions, Shakib Khan has confirmed that he is indeed in talks with HaniaAamir for a film. Content creator Rafsan the Chhoto Bhai recently featured Shakib Khan in one of his vlogs. Rafsan published the vlog on his YouTube channel last Friday afternoon. In the video, Shakib Khan is seen telling Rafsan, “I’ve watched several of your vlogs with my future heroine, with Hania.” At that moment, someone nearby asked whether Hania Aamir would be starring in a movie with him. Shakib Khan replied, “Yes, we’re discussing a film.” He has not yet revealed which film it will be.

title: Richi’s protest
body: Entertainment Report : Recently, several Facebook profiles and pages have been posting political content using the name of the country’s popular actress, Richi Solaiman. These pages, created under her name, have shared posts supporting the lockdown announced by the Awami League. The posts spread quickly across various platforms, and some online news portals even published reports on the matter. This has put Richi in an embarrassing and uncomfortable situation. From her one and only official profile, the actress wrote: “I am Richi Solaiman, an actress. I have both patriotism and political awareness. But since politics is not my profession, I never make any political posts nor do I engage in political discussions. Therefore, I express my deep concern that various so-called unknown online portals are using my photos and name to spread political messages. I want to clearly state that these are not my statements, and I strongly condemn such disgraceful actions.” Meanwhile, Richi has taken legal action regarding the matter. The actress said, “I respect the law. My lawyer is taking necessary steps. A General Diary (GD) has been filed against the responsible parties. The police’s Cyber Crime Unit has also been informed. Many people may face similar situations due to such rumors and fabricated news. Therefore, taking legal action is essential. I am proceeding in that direction.”

title: Rajkummar-Patralekhaa become parents
body: On their fourth wedding anniversary, they received the greatest gift of their lives. Bollywood stars Rajkummar Rao and Patralekhaa have welcomed a baby girl into their family. On Saturday morning, they shared the happy news with their fans through an Instagram post. Coincidentally, today marks their fourth wedding anniversary. In their Instagram post, they wrote, “The greatest blessing from the Creator on our fourth anniversary.”

title: Swastika reveals secret weight loss method
body: Popular Kolkata actress Swastika Mukherjee has unveiled a new look after losing weight. Netizens noticed her transformed appearance when she shared a short video featuring her open hair and kohl-lined black eyes. A fan asked her, “How much weight have you lost?
