How did you achieve such a change?” Swastika replied, “Yes, I have been losing weight for six months. I’ve been doing a brisk walk for 30-45 minutes every day. I ate only one meal a day-no roti, rice, or bread. I avoided all fried foods. I couldn’t give up sweets or chocolate entirely, but I completely cut out foods that rapidly increase fat. It takes time, but you have to stay consistent.”

title: Bajrangi Bhaijaan’s Munni on big screen
body: Harshaali Malhotra, who won hearts worldwide as the little Munni in Salman Khan’s blockbuster Bajrangi Bhaijaan, is all grown up now, ten years later. She is set to make her debut in the Telugu film Akhandha-2, starring superstar Nandamuri Balakrishna and directed by Boyapati Srinu. While details about her franchise role are being kept strictly under wraps, a special event for the movie was held on Friday. Harshaali was seen alongside Balakrishna at the event, where she shared her excitement about the new film.

title: Ahad Raza drove rickshaw in Dhaka
body: Popular Pakistani actor from South Asia, Ahad Raza Mir, is currently in Dhaka. He arrived in the city last Friday (November 12) to attend a special inaugural event. He has shared a series of photos and videos from his Dhaka visit on social media, which have already caught the attention of his countless fans and followers. In the shared photos and videos, he can be seen sitting in the driver’s seat of a rickshaw in the middle of a park, with his feet on the pedals! Not only did he drive a rickshaw, but the actor also tried Dhaka’s traditional street snack, fuchka. The scenes of him driving the rickshaw and tasting fuchka quickly went viral on social media.

title: Film actor Rajib’s 21st death anniversary toady
body: The 21st death anniversary of film actor Wasimul Bari Rajib was today. He acted in more than 200 Bangla films. Although successful as a villain, he has also acted in different roles in many films. On November 14, 2004, the actor lost his battle against cancer and left his loved ones and fans in tears. Today (November 14) marks the 21st anniversary of his passing. Rajib was born on January 1, 1952, in Dumki Upazila of Patuakhali district. The talented actor made his debut with the film “Rakhe Allah Mare Ke” in the early 80s. He was featured as the lead actor in the film “Khokonshona”. Rajib was involved in various film-related institutions and organisations. His production company was Friends Movies. He served as the manager of Bangladesh Film Development Corporation (BFDC). He also served as the president of Jatiyatabadi Film Council. Before starting acting in films, Rajib worked at Titas Gas Company. Apart from acting, Rajib also possessed outstanding leadership qualities. In addition to his duties as the managing director of BFDC, he was the founding organising secretary of Bangladesh Jatiotabadi Samajik Sangskritik Sangstha (Jasas), a cultural affiliate of BNP. Later, he served as the general secretary and president of the organisation. Rajib won the National Film Award four times in the “Best Supporting Actor” category.

title: Shah Rukh Khan unveils ‘Shahrukhz Danube,’ the first real estate project named after him
body: Shah Rukh Khan attended a lavish event in Mumbai alongside Rizwan Sajan, founder and chairman of the Dubai-based Danube Group, to launch a landmark property named Shahrukhz. Hosted at a luxury hotel, the event marked a major milestone — SRK is now the first actor to have a tower named in his honor. SRK shared that Rizwan insisted the launch happen in India rather than Dubai. “I really wanted this event to take place here because this is where I come from,” he said. “As this project progresses, I hope it helps people build better and more fulfilling lives.” SRK Says His Mother Would Have Been Proud “My mother would be very happy. It’s a huge honor,” he remarked. “When my kids visit, I’ll tell them, ‘Look, your dad’s name is written here.’ I’ve reviewed the building plans for the last two months — it’s modern, accessible, and perfect for people beginning their journey in Dubai.” SRK’s Stage Moments Go Viral Shah Rukh delighted fans by striking his iconic arms-wide-open pose on stage. He also mimicked his famous “Don” walk and delivered the memorable Om Shanti Om line: “Itni shiddat se maine tumhe paane ki koshish ki hai…” He kept the energy high as he danced to “Chaiyya Chaiyya” with Farah Khan and Rizwan Sajan. About the Tower The Shahrukhz project is expected to take three to four years to complete and will stand 56 stories tall. A statue of SRK’s classic pose will greet visitors at the entrance, offering a perfect photo spot. Sharing what drew him to the project, SRK said: “When Rizwan explained the vision — creating a place for people coming to Dubai with dreams of homes and businesses — I knew that if I could contribute or inspire them, it would be the greatest gift.”

title: Unexpected incident at Shreya’s concert
body: An unfortunate incident took place at a concert by popular Indian singer Shreya Ghoshal. The concert was held at the Bali Yatra Ground in Cuttack, Odisha on Thursday evening. The crowd created chaos, resulting in two audience members losing consciousness in a stampede. A large number of spectators had gathered to listen to their favourite singer’s performance. During the concert, a sudden commotion started in the crowd and the situation took a terrible turn due to excessive pressure. At one point in the chaos, two audience members lost consciousness on the spot. They were rushed to a nearby hospital for immediate treatment.

title: Not Rachna, this time Mir to handle ‘Didi’
body: A sudden change has been made in hosting of popular television show ‘Didi No 1’ in West Bengal. Instead of actress Rachana Banerjee, another familiar face from West Bengal, radio jockey and presenter Mir Afsar Ali, will be seen hosting the programme. The new promo of Zee Bangla’s popular reality show has created curiosity among the viewers about this change. Viewers were surprised to see Mir replacing Rachana. The production company of the show has said that this change is temporary. Mir will be host for the first three episodes. After that, Rachana will return.

title: James, Ali Azmat’s concert postponed
body: The much-awaited concert by popular Bangladeshi rock artiste Nagarbaul James and Pakistani Sufi-rock band Junoon vocalist Ali Azmat has been postponed. The event, titled ‘Legends Live in Dhaka’, was postponed after organisers failed to obtain the necessary approval from the local administration. The concert’s organiser, Asen Communication, confirmed the news in an urgent announcement on social media. “Due to some unavoidable circumstances, today’s show ‘Ali Azmat x James – Legends Live in Dhaka’ has been postponed,” the company said.

title: Sherlyn in hospital after being in trouble for trying to be attractive
body: Sherlyn Chopra is one of the most talked about actresses in India. She has often been in the news for her outrageous outfits and controversial comments. Now, it has been revealed that the actress is suffering from physical complications caused by cosmetic surgery. Basically, she had surgery to increase the size of her breasts; as a result, she is in great danger and is rushing to the hospital. Sherlyn was rushed to the hospital after experiencing severe pain in her back, neck and shoulders, where she underwent surgery to remove the artificial ‘implant’. She is currently said to be recovering.

title: Methila, Bangladesh leads with the most votes
body: Entertainment Desk : Bangladesh’s representative Tangia Zaman Methila is on her way to creating new history on the stage of the 74th ‘Miss Universe’ competition. The model, who competed with contestants from 121 countries around the world, is currently at the top of the list in the “People’s Choice” votes. The news of this success was confirmed on social media by ‘Miss Universe Bangladesh’ and Methila’s personal pages. ‘Miss Universe Bangladesh’ published a message on their official page announcing the achievement. It said, “We did it Bangladesh. Now Bangladesh is number one. Keep voting for Bangladesh until November 19. Unstoppable Bangladesh.” Meanwhile, in a recently released photo of Methila, she is seen celebrating in a white floral dress with the Bangladesh flag in her hand. Another post appealed for votes, saying, “Bangladesh is now in the top 1 of ‘People’s Choice’. Keep voting hard until November 19 to maintain this position!” However, the voting battle is not over yet. This “People’s Choice” vote will continue until November 19. If Methila can remain at the top of the vote count during this period, she will directly win the title of ‘Miss Universe’. This number of votes fluctuates with contestants from other countries during the competition. Therefore, it is not possible to say for sure the final result right now. Methila’s fans are voting relentlessly to keep her in this position and are urging others to vote.

title: Priyanka returns armed with a saree
body: Agencies : Priyanka Chopra is back after six years. This is her first time joining an Indian film since 2019. Priyanka is playing the role of ‘Mandakini’ in SS Rajamouli’s ‘Globetrotter’. In this, the desi girl is returning to her desi look. Wearing a yellow saree and carrying a pistol, Priyanka stunned in an action look. Three stars from three industries have joined Rajamouli’s ‘Globetrotter’ movie. Rajamouli’s mega project features Telugu superstar Mahesh Babu, Malayalam industry’s Prithviraj Sukumaran and Bollywood’s Priyanka. The shooting has already started in Hyderabad. A few days ago, the director revealed Prithviraj’s look in a negative role. Priyanka’s look was revealed on Wednesday night. However, the actress said that the character is more glamorous than what is seen in the first look. Hollywood has been Priyanka’s permanent home lately. After the movie ‘The Sky Is Pink’, she has acted in one Hollywood movie after another. She was looking for an opportunity to return to Bollywood. Farhan Akhtar was supposed to return with ‘Jee Le Zara’. However, the schedule of this movie has been postponed again and again due to various reasons. Finally, she is making a royal comeback with Rajamouli’s new movie. Priyanka sees ‘Globetrotter’ as a big opportunity for herself. She said, “The film will usher in a new era in Indian cinema. I am very happy that I am making a comeback to Indian cinema with such an extraordinary work.” Priyanka said that since ‘Globetrotter’ is a Telugu language film, she has also learned Telugu to work in it.

title: ‘Millimetre’ from ‘3 Idiots’ married Turkish beauty
body: Agencies : Everyone must remember the college assistant character ‘Millimetre’ from the iconic Bollywood movie ‘3 Idiots’! Despite his short screen presence, he made a place in the hearts of the audience. After that, he was not seen on a large scale anymore, but recently there was news about him that cine fans may be happy to hear. The ‘Millimetre’ fame actor Rahul Kumar is married. But his wife is not a Bollywood beauty, but Kejiban Dogan, a resident of faraway Turkiye. Recently, some pictures and a video of their wedding went viral on social media, which is now the center of discussion about this actor. According to NDTV, Rahul Kumar and his wife Kejivan were recently caught on camera by a photographer in Delhi. That’s where their identity and love came to light.

title: Shabnur angry about unprofessionalism
body: Entertainment Report : Popular film actress Shabnur has expressed her anger and disappointment with the production company after some footage of her new film ‘Rangana’ was leaked on YouTube and social media before its theatrical release. While fans are excited about the news of her return to acting with this film after a long break, she said she is deeply saddened by the incident. In a lengthy post on her verified Facebook page on Friday, Shabnur expressed her anger over the incident. She questioned the lack of professionalism in the film industry, saying that it has become difficult to make quality films in today’s film industry and those artistes are losing the respect they deserve. In a Facebook post, Shabnur wrote, “I’m a big screen actress. My work is not for free viewing on YouTube. If I had known earlier that this project would be released as YouTube content instead of cinema halls, I would never have participated in it.” The mahurat of the movie ‘Rangana’ was held in February 2024 and Shabnur was also optimistic about the excitement of the fans. After the mahurat, she also shot some parts. However, the work remained incomplete due to various complications. Shabnur said that she had talked to the producer and would complete the shooting of the remaining parts in December after returning to the country. But she was shocked that the footage was released without permission before that. She wrote in the post, “I never said that I would not work on the film ‘Rangana’ again. So why were the incomplete clips of the film released on YouTube and Facebook without my permission? Now it is being said again that all the old scenes will be removed and a new shoot will be done, which is completely unacceptable.” Shabnur mentioned the unprofessional behaviour of the production company from the beginning. She said that a low-quality poster was released before the work began, which was widely criticised. She also accused the shooting unit of mismanagement and breaking the promise of shooting and editing abroad. Stating that her long-earned reputation and professional status have been severely damaged by this incident, Shabnur said, “This is not only a personal loss for me, but also a sad and disappointing incident for the entire Bengali film industry.”

title: Tanjin Tisha charged with fraud, death threats
body: Entertainment Report : On the one hand, the shooting of her first movie, on the other hand, one after another of allegations of fraud – all these have made popular TV actress Tanjin Tisha the centre of discussion and criticism. Last month, Tisha was accused of not promoting a saree from an online fashion house. However, the actress claims that she received the saree as a gift. Earlier this month, the online fashion house ‘Aponia’ filed a case against Tisha. This time, in addition to not returning the saree, new allegations of death threats have been made against the actress. On Thursday, fashion house, Sanaya Couture’s owner and fashion designer Ayesha Anum Fayzah Sanaya Chowdhury filed a general diary (GD) against Tisha at the capital’s Gulshan Police Station on charges of fraud and death threats. In the GD, the entrepreneur mentioned that on December 13, 2024, Tanjin Tisha took a saree worth Tk75,000 from her to wear at an event. She was supposed to return the saree the next day after wearing it, but she has not returned it yet. When Tisha asked her to return the saree on December 15 on Facebook Messenger, Tisha threatened to kill her on December 17 with inaudible language and abuse her. She even threatened to harass her through DB. After that, Tisha told the entrepreneur on March 13 and May 18 of this year that she would not return the saree. Recently, after learning about a saree-related case against Tisha through various media outlets, the entrepreneur requested her to return the saree again on Facebook Messenger. But this time, Tisha has also threatened to sue and make the video viral, the GD states. In addition, entrepreneur Sanaya said that she has kept a record of her conversation with Tisha and screenshots of the messenger. In this regard, Sanaya said, “Tisha has taken clothes from me before, but I have always had to make many requests to get them back. This time, she is not returning a saree worth Tk75,000; on the contrary, she is threatening me. Now I’m worried about my safety.” Tisha told media that a group is deliberately doing this against her. She will speak in detail after knowing everything.

title: Muza-Sanjana’s new song ‘Maiyya’
body: Entertainment Report : A new song by US-based musician Muja has been released. The pop-qawwali fusion based song titled ‘Maiyya’ features London-based artiste Sanjana singing with Muza. The song, which has lyrics like ‘Maiyyar Kotha Aamar Eto Bhalo Lagilo/ Pola, Aamar Kotha Shuina Prem Jagilo’, is jointly written by Badhon and Muza. The music has been arranged by musician Muza. Muza said that the lyrics of the song try to emphasise a woman’s personality over her beauty. He said, “We are usually obsessed with someone’s beauty. After talking, that liking can increase even more because of the personality. That’s what we wanted to put in the lyrics.” Regarding the creation of the song ‘Maiyya’, Muza said, “The song was made keeping in mind various festivals, especially the wedding season. It is very special to me because no echo or reverb effect was used in my voice in the song. I wanted to give the audience a new voice. The song is of the pop genre, with a touch of qawwali.” Sanjana said, “We have known each other since the release of Muja’s first song. The beginning of the creation of the song ‘Maiyya’ was like a scene from a movie. Suddenly, someone opened the door of the dark studio and came out, we exchanged greetings, and then we started working on the song.” The song ‘Maiyya’ has been choreographed by Ridy Sheikh. She choreographed Muja’s first song in 2018. They have worked together again after seven years. Ridi Sheikh said, “Since it is a wedding season song, I have planned it that way. Not only the dance moves are important here, but the set design, costumes, lighting, number of dancers is important elements. So, emphasis has been placed on everything.” The song has been released on Muza’s YouTube channel.

title: Mim in royal mood in maroon dress
body: Entertainment Report : Dhallywood’s popular actress is Bidya Sinha Mim. Apart from acting in various films, she is also active in the modelling world. She likes to portray herself in different forms and avatars at different times. This time too is no exception. The actress appeared among her fans on social media with a bunch of new pictures on her birthday. On Thursday afternoon, the heroine posted a dozen pictures on social media. As her beauty spread, her fans were fascinated. In the pictures, Mim is seen in a unique blend of classic and elegant. She was wearing a sleeveless, floor-length dress in dark brown or maroon, which made her look attractive. The dress was complemented by a thin black belt at the waist. Also, her open hair had vintage waves, which gave her outfit an ‘Old Hollywood’ glamour. Sometimes she was captured in multiple poses with stylish sunglasses on her eyes, sometimes with sunglasses on her head. With a gentle smile and a confident posture, Mim looked like a princess standing in front of a palace. As soon as Mim’s ‘Maroon Queen’ look was revealed, the comment box was filled with praise from fans. However, Mim has another identity; she is called the ‘travelling girl’! Apart from her usual acting and modelling, the heroine likes to travel to different parts of the country and abroad. Sometimes she goes to Thailand, sometimes to the Maldives, and sometimes to a European country – she often comes into the spotlight by showing herself from there.

title: Tarique signs nomination papers for Dhaka-17, Bogura-6 polls
body: NN ONLINE: BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman on Sunday signed his nomination papers to contest the 13th national parliamentary election from Dhaka-17 and Bogura-6 constituencies with the party’s electoral symbol, the Sheaf of Paddy. Tarique signed the nomination papers in the evening at the BNP Chairperson’s Gulshan office in the presence of party coordinators of the two constituencies, said BNP media cell member Sayrul Kabir Khan. For the Dhaka-17 constituency, BNP Chairperson’s Advisory Council member Abdus Salam has been appointed as the chief coordinator, while Advisory Council member Prof Dr Farhad Halim Donar will also play a key coordinating role in leading the election activities. Party sources said Tarique’s nomination papers for both the Dhaka-17 and Bogura-6 constituencies will be submitted on Monday. Earlier, BNP Standing Committee member Salahuddin Ahmed said Tarique will contest the upcoming parliamentary election from two seats—Bogura-6 and Dhaka-17—as part of the party’s election strategy. The 13th parliamentary election is scheduled to be held on February 12 next year.

title: BANGLADESH EPISODE OF RIYADH SEASON
body: Entertainment Desk : Riyadh Season has started for the sixth time in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. 14 countries are participating in this event, which started on October 10. Special days have been allocated for each country. On those days, specific countries will present their music, dance, traditional costumes and food. The Bangladesh phase started on November 11. The event titled ‘Bangladesh Culture’ will continue till November 14, said a press release. Musicians Asif Akbar, Monir Khan, Belal Khan, Akash Mahmud, Ishrat Jahan Jui, Pushpita Mitra, Humaira Ishika, DJ Turin, actress Prarthana Fardin Dighi and many others are participating. On the first day, Akash Mahmud, Muhammad Imran, Humaira Ishika and DJ Turin MNR performed at Al Suwaidi Park in Riyadh. On Wednesday, Belal Khan, Pushpita Mitra, Ishrat Jahan Jui and DJ Turin MNR performed. Belal Khan, Muhammad Imran, Humaira Ishika and DJ Turin MNR were also on stage on November 13. Monir Khan sang as a special attraction on that day. Asif Akbar will sing as a special attraction on the last day. Akash Mahmud, DJ Turin MNR, Pushpita Mitra and Ishrat Jahan Jui will also sing on the last day. Actress Dighi has confirmed that she will participate in a special performance at this event. However, it is not known at which event she will perform.

title: It’s important to have lasting marital relationship: Kajol
body: Bollywood actress Kajol has once again stirred controversy after making a comment on married relationships. According to her, “It is important for a married relationship to have an expiry date.” Kajol’s comment has already sparked a heated discussion on the internet. Many are asking if there are any problems in her long married life with husband Ajay Devgn. Recently, Kajol said, “Is there any guarantee that you will marry the right person at the right time? That’s why it’s important to have a renewal option. But if the marriage has an expiration date, neither of the two will ever have to suffer.”

title: Priyanka creates storm with her new look
body: Priyanka Chopra, who has crossed the boundaries of Bollywood and made her place in Hollywood, is returning to Indian cinema. After the acclaimed film ‘The White Tiger’ in 2021, she is now acting in the film ‘Globetrotter’ directed by the legendary director of South Indian cinema S.S. Rajamouli. As soon as the first look of Priyanka’s character ‘Mandakini’ was released on November 12, social media was flooded with praise. She is seen wearing a yellow saree and pointing a gun in one hand, firing. Sharing the poster, Priyanka wrote in caption, “She is more than what she appears to be, welcome Mandakini.”

title: Sonakshi drops from Salman’s ‘Asian Tour’
body: Actress Sonakshi Sinha and Salman Khan have a long-standing relationship in Bollywood. The actress often accompanies Salman at various events in the country and abroad. Similarly, Sonakshi was also supposed to be on the actor’s upcoming ‘Asian Tour’. But suddenly, there was a big change in the poster. Sonakshi has been replaced by South Indian star Tamannaah Bhatia. And this change has sparked new speculations. There are now rumours in the air that Sonakshi is pregnant. And that may be the reason why she is not able to be a part of Salman’s tour this time.

title: Rashmika faces criticism for her period comment
body: While talking about menstruation or periods on actor Jagapathi Babu’s Zee Five talk show ‘Jayammu Nischayammu Ra’, South Indian film actress Rashmika Mandanna made a comment that is being discussed and criticised on social media. Rashmika said on a talk show, “Men should also have periods, so that they can also feel the intense pain that women experience during these days of the month.” Since the statement was released, discussions and debates have started on social media for and against. Facing criticism, the actress recently expressed her regret.

title: Brad Pitt sues Angelina Jolie again over sale of French winery
body: Hollywood actor Brad Pitt has filed a new lawsuit against his ex-wife Angelina Jolie over the sale of their shared French winery, Château Miraval. According to People magazine, Pitt’s legal team recently submitted fresh documents in court, presenting communications between Jolie’s representatives regarding her 2021 sale of her stake in the winery, which the former couple co-owned. The filings included an email from November 2023 in which Jolie’s lawyers responded to Pitt’s claims for $35 million in damages. They argued that Pitt “created his own burdens” by initiating the lawsuit and must now bear the cost of producing documents that may or may not support his damage claims. Jolie’s team also alleged that Pitt was seeking ongoing compensation for harm to Miraval’s business operations and continued to withhold documents explaining the need for a four-year non-disclosure agreement covering alleged personal misconduct. Pitt first sued Jolie in 2022, claiming she violated their agreement by selling her share without his consent. The legal battle has since dragged on, with both sides accusing each other of withholding information. The next court hearing is scheduled for December 17. Pitt and Jolie, who share six children — Maddox, Pax, Zahara, Shiloh, Vivienne, and Knox — separated in 2016 after 12 years together. They finalized their divorce in December 2024.

title: Michael biopic trailer out: Jaafar Jackson to play his legendary uncle
body: The first trailer of Michael, the much-anticipated biopic on late pop legend Michael Jackson, has been released, giving fans a glimpse of the King of Pop’s remarkable journey. Directed by Antoine Fuqua and written by John Logan, the film stars Jaafar Jackson — Michael Jackson’s nephew — in the lead role, portraying the global icon’s rise to fame and lasting influence on music and dance. The movie also features Miles Teller, Larenz Tate, and Laura Harrier in key roles. It is scheduled for worldwide theatrical release on April 24, 2026, after being moved from its earlier October 2025 date, according to Variety. The trailer opens with the line, “I know you have been waiting a long time for this,” before taking viewers through the pop star’s meteoric career, signature performances, and creative brilliance. It highlights Jaafar’s stunning recreations of Jackson’s famous dance moves, including the moonwalk, with the tagline: “Honour your past and embrace the future.” Produced by Graham King, John Branca, and John McClain, Michael aims to celebrate the life and legacy of one of the most influential entertainers in history. Universal Pictures India shared the teaser on Instagram, calling the film “a powerful cinematic tribute to the King of Pop.”

title: Priyanka Chopra unveils Mandakini character poster from SS Rajamouli’s Globetrotter
body: The makers of SS Rajamouli’s highly anticipated action-adventure film, starring Mahesh Babu, have released the first look of Priyanka Chopra Jonas as Mandakini, marking her much-awaited return to Indian cinema. The film, tentatively titled SSMB29, is Chopra’s first collaboration with the director of RRR and Baahubali. In the character poster, Priyanka is seen in a mustard yellow saree, wielding a gun, and striking a commanding pose over rocky terrain in a dramatic, windswept setting. Sharing the image on social media, she wrote: “She’s more than what meets the eye… say hello to Mandakini.” Globetrotter is shaping up to be one of the most ambitious Indian films in recent years, reportedly drawing inspiration from African exploration adventures. Earlier, Rajamouli had unveiled Mahesh Babu’s first-look poster on the actor’s 50th birthday, featuring a rugged chest adorned with a rudraksh mala with a trishul and Nandi pendant, hinting at the film’s mythic undertones. The director also introduced Prithviraj Sukumaran’s character, Kumbha, described as “sinister and ruthless,” in a menacing all-black outfit seated on a high-tech wheelchair. The makers confirmed that the official title and first full glimpse of Globetrotter will be revealed on November 15 at a major launch event at Ramoji Film City, Hyderabad. The event will also be live-streamed on JioHotstar.

title: Dilara Zaman returns with 7-episode series
body: Entertainment Report : A seven-episode drama series titled ‘Dadir Bhag’ has been made with veteran actress Dilara Zaman. The story revolves around the main character of the series, ‘Dadi’ (paternal grandmother). Dilara Zaman has played the role of ‘Dadi’. Other characters include Jamil Hossain, Moonmoon Ahmed Moon, Noresh Bhuiyan, Reshma Ahmed, Momo Shiuli, Amin Azad, Shuchona, etc. The drama series is written by Bidyut Roy based on the story of actor Jamil Hossain and directed by Mahfuz Islam. It will be released on the YouTube channel named ‘Jamil’s Zoo’. The two main characters of the series are played by Moonmoon Ahmed Moon and Jamil Hossain. This year, ‘Mirakkel Akkel Challenger’ famed actor Jamil Hossain and actress Moon got married. Jamil has worked in several dramas together with his wife Moonmoon. From there, the two got to know each other. And that acquaintance develops over time and feels good. Moon grew up in Dhaka. She completed her BBA from Eastern University and pursued higher education in Malaysia. Moonmoon gained recognition as a model in advertisements. Her fluent acting also made her famous in dramas. Her dream came true by acting with Dilara Zaman in the series ‘Dadir Bhag’. She is a fan of actress Dilara Zaman. Her personality and acting fascinated Moon. That is why she dreamed of acting with Dilara Zaman. Moon played the role of Dilara Zaman’s granddaughter in this series. Regarding talking about the experience of acting with her and fulfilling her dream, Moon said, “Respected Dilara Zaman is the pride of Bangladesh’s drama and cinema. MashaAllah, how beautiful she is still. How beautifully she speaks, how sincerely she behaves. I really wanted to act with her. That dream has come true, and I acted in the role of her granddaughter. I understood the love and affection she always holds in her, while working with her. Such a great artiste, yet what a simple life she leads. I’m fascinated by her humility, smile and acting. I’m blessed, proud and very excited to work with her. This is a great achievement in my life.” Dilara Zaman said, “The story of the series ‘Dadir Bhag’ is very beautiful. Before death, grandfather leaves all his property to his grandmother. The story is about the division of that property. I really enjoyed doing the work. Everyone was so sincere that they didn’t let me suffer in any way. Moonmoon Ahmed Moon is a very kind and sweet-smiling girl. I pray that she can become a great artiste and that her dreams about acting come true.”

title: Francis Ford Coppola loses everything making movies
body: Agencies : Francis Ford Coppola has probably never had such a bad time in his 60-year career. This Hollywood director has earned the status of a legend in world cinema with the movies ‘The Godfather’, ‘The Conversation’, ‘Apocalypse Now’. He had wanted to make a movie titled ‘Megalopolis’ for many years. The movie, made with his own money, was released in September 2024. But something that has never happened in his career for so many years, is happening. It was a complete failure at the box office! Francis Ford Coppola spent $120 million to make ‘Megalopolis’. But the box office returned only $14.4 million. After spending so much money on a movie and losing his investment, Coppola is on the verge of a financial ruin. He is now facing a dark time after losing everything. He is selling whatever he has left to cover this huge loss. Coppola auctioned off his expensive watches at the end of October. His personal collection included many luxury watches, one of which was worth over $1 million. The New York Times reported that Coppola has decided to sell seven watches from his collection. The watches will be auctioned off at Phillips Auction House in New York on December 6 and 7. The most expensive watch among them was kept by him for about eight years. He designed the watch himself. In addition to all these hobby watches, Coppola had to sell an island he bought. On November 8, The Hollywood Reporter reported that Coppola had bought an island in Belize, Central America. The island, called Coral Cay, is 8 miles long. The director would occasionally go there for vacations. Coppola sold his favorite island for $1.8 million. Francis Ford Coppola first achieved success with the movie ‘The Godfather’. Later, in addition to making movies, he was involved in various businesses including resorts and lifestyle brands. Through this, he became wealthy. However, he lost all his savings while building ‘Megalopolis’. In an interview, he said, “I don’t have any money now because; I invested all my money in building Megalopolis. I also took some loans. It’s all gone. It will take 15-20 years to recover this loss. But that time is not in my hands.” The science fiction film ‘Megalopolis’ is set in the backdrop of the Roman Empire. It stars Adam Driver, Jon Voight, Giancarlo Esposito, Nathalie Emmanuel, Dustin Hoffman, and others. Although it received praise from some critics upon its release, most criticised Coppola.

title: Mental illness that spreads filth: Sporshia
body: Entertainment Report : Orchita Sporshia is a popular actress of the small screen. She started her acting career with ‘Parachute’ oil advertisement. The advertisement titled ‘Bondhu Teen Din’ gained immense popularity among the audience. After that, she has made a place in the hearts of the audience with her acting skills. Apart from acting, Sporshia is also quite active on social media, where she shares her favourite things with her fans. In a post, Orchita Sporshia wrote, “Just saying whatever you want about someone doesn’t prove anything. Either the person you try to belittle becomes small, or you become big by belittling someone. You just spread filth unnecessarily.” The actress said, “Speaking bad words about any other girl or girls is a family mental illness. The country, society and our lives should be based on healthy politics, healthy mentality, and good education.” Incidentally, Orchita Sporshia has also gained fame for acting in dramas, in addition to modelling and TV commercials. She rose to fame as an actress in 2013 after acting in ‘Impossible 5’, directed by Airtel.

title: Blackpink’s Rose thrills to get Grammy nomination
body: Agencies : Rosé was sitting in front of the TV screen when the Grammy Awards nominations were announced. She was joined on a video call by the other three members of the Blackpink band, Jisoo, Jennie, and Lisa. The names of the artistes nominated in the Record of the Year category were being announced on TV. Rosé’s name came out at the very end. The Blackpink members burst into joy upon hearing it. And Rosé said, “I can’t believe my life! It’s still taking time to understand everything.” Rose’s name has appeared in not just one category, but three categories in the Grammy Awards nomination list announced on November 7. She has been nominated in the Record of the Year, Song of the Year, and Best Pop Duo/Group Performance categories. Through this, Rose has created history in K-pop. She is the first South Korean female artiste to be nominated for a Grammy. Rose has achieved this success with the song ‘Apaate’. Bruno Mars has sung with her in it. The song was on Rose’s first solo album ‘Rosie’, which was released last year. Since its release, ‘Apaate’ has been at the top of the Billboard top list – everywhere from YouTube. As a result, there was speculation throughout the year that Rose could get a Grammy nomination this time. Finally, that idea came true. If Rose really wins a Grammy this time, leaving behind Bad Bunny, Sabrina Carpenter, Deutsch, Billie Eilish, Lady Gaga, and Kendrick Lamar; then it will be another major achievement in the history of K-pop.

title: Hema Malini angry over media reports of Dharmendra’s death
body: Bollywood’s veteran actor Dharmendra is on ventilator support and fake news of his death has been circulating on various platforms, including social media. Dharmendra’s wife Hema Malini and daughter Esha Deol have finally spoken out against the rumours, calling them ‘baseless’ and ‘unforgivable’. As the rumours were rife, Esha Deol wrote in a statement, “Fake news is being spread. My father’s condition is stable and he is slowly recovering. I request everyone to maintainprivacy of our family.” Hema Malini has expressed further anger over the fake news being spread about his health condition.

title: Is Iman Chakraborty entering politics?
body: Recently, singer Iman Chakraborty has been seen at several events with West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee. She was also present at the Kali Puja at the Chief Minister’s house. So, the question naturally arises – will Iman be seen on the political stage this time? However, when asked about joining politics, Iman gave a clear answer – “That doesn’t mean that she will ask me to stand for election. Didi loves my songs very much. I think she is an ardent listener of my songs, just like my other listeners. If any proposal comes to me, I will definitely think about it and discuss it. But nothing much has happened so far.”

title: Model’s mysterious death, boyfriend flees leaving body behind
body: The mysterious death of a model in Sehore of Madhya Pradesh, India, has created a sensation. 27-year-old model Khushboo Ahirwar has died. However, the incident has become even more mysterious as her boyfriend abandoned her in the hospital and fled. This information has been published in the Indian media. Khushboo was found dead on Monday morning. Her boyfriend Kashim was with her. But he left the model at the hospital.

title: I stayed at Salman’s farmhouse for 2/3 days: Shehnaaz Gill
body: Bollywood’s brother Salman Khan’s house is called ‘Galaxy’. His fans often gather in front of his house. But people are much more interested in Salman’s farmhouse. Salman met Shehnaz from ‘Bigg Boss 13’. Since then, she has been his darling. Shehnaaz said, “We went during the filming of ‘Kisi Ka Bhai, Kisi Ki Jaan’. We stayed for two or three days, we had a lot of fun. We used to travel here and there on bikes and ATVs. Salman used to pick fruits from trees. Sir is a very patriotic person. He is very hardworking, works all day like a farmer.”

title: Kabori’s last film to premiere at int’l fest
body: Entertainment Desk : Noted actress Kabori’s last film was ‘Ei Tumi Sei Tumi’. However, she couldn’t complete the film. She died in 2021 while some parts of the shooting were still pending. After Kabori’s death, her son Shaker Chishti completed the production of the film. Shaker Chishti has completed the work on the movie ‘Ei Tumi Sei Tumi’ in 2023. Now it is time for the release. However, Shaker Chishti is trying to screen it at international film festivals in different countries before releasing it in the country. He has already submitted the movie to several international festivals. After that, he will plan to release it in the country’s theatres. Shaker Chishti told the media that completing the film was a challenge for him. In this regard, he said, “Finishing my mother’s unfinished work was a big challenge for me. I finished the work in a short time. I have submitted the film to a few international festivals outside the country. The film will be released in the country if it is screened at those festivals.” However, Shaker Chishti didn’t say exactly when the film will be released in the country. He said that everything depends on the international screening of the film ‘Ei Tumi Sei Tumi.’ In addition to directing, Kabori wrote the story, screenplay, and dialogues of the movie ‘Ei Tumi Sei Tumi’. Two periods are highlighted in this movie. Along with the story of the present day, the story of the Bangladesh Liberation War will be revealed. Nishat Nawar Salwa and Raihan Riyad have played two lead roles in the movie.

title: Mim spreads charm in b’day atmosphere
body: Entertainment Report : Dhallywood actress Bidya Sinha Mim’s birthday was November 10. The actress always celebrates this special day with her family. The day before, Mim showed herself in a different look and a different mood. It is heard that the heroine celebrated her birthday this year with a family event. However, Mim has another identity; she is called a travel girl! Apart from her familiar acting and modeling, the heroine likes to travel to different parts of the country and abroad. Even in the midst of such a birthday atmosphere, her wanderings do not stop. On Sunday (November 9), Mim published some pictures. There, she can be seen having a great time at the Cox’s Bazar beach. Although the heroine mentioned that the pictures were taken the day before; the heroine had been on a trip to Cox’s Bazar two days before her birthday. In several photos posted on Facebook, Mim is seen in a pink dress, capturing a unique beauty in the combination of sea, sun, and sky. At this time, her pure smile in the breeze of the beach and the glow of the sunset seems to bring up a story of happiness and peace.

title: Azam Khan’s band ‘Uccharon’ ready for concert
body: Entertainment Desk : It was reported last June that Azam Khan’s band ‘Uccharon’was resuming its activities. Azam Khan’s daughter Aroni Khan had said that the band was returning with renewed enthusiasm. Now it has been learned that ‘Uccharon’ is ready for concerts in the country and abroad. A tripartite agreement was signed between Azam Khan’s family, band members, and an agency recently to manage the activities of the band, said a press release. According to the agreement, all copyrights and ownership of Azam Khan’s name, image and creations will remain with his family. The ‘Uccharon’ band will be active in performing and promoting his songs; and Cool Exposure will handle all promotions, royalty management, concerts and commercial activities. On behalf of Azam Khan’s family, his daughter Aroni Khan, head of the band Dulal Joha, and CEO of Cool Exposure Ershadul Haque Tinku signed the agreement. Dulal Joha, head of the band, said, “This agreement is a historic step to showcase Azam Khan’s musical heritage in a new way to the whole world. We want to spread his songs on the international stage as well as the country.” Azam Khan formed the band ‘Uccharon’ with his three friends Neelu, Sadek and Mansur after returning from the Liberation War. The band, which started its journey in 1972, sang ‘Eto Sundor Duniyay Kichhui Robe Na Re’ and ‘Char Kalema Sakshi Debe’ on BTV that year. These two songs made Azam Khan and the ‘Uccharon’ band popular. After that, Azam Khan gave many more songs along with this band. The band’s activities stopped after Azam Khan’s death on June 5, 2011. On June 22, ‘Uccharon’ performed on stage after 14 years at an event titled ‘Guru Reloaded’ to mark Azam Khan’s death anniversary.

title: Bubly attracts attention in guise of queen
body: Entertainment Report : Shabnam Bubly is the leading heroine of Dhallywood now. She started her career as a newsreader on television, but later gained wide recognition among the audience through acting in films. This actress is constantly being praised by her fans and admirers for her acting skills. Apart from acting, Bubly is quite active on social media. She often shares her favourite moments with her fans. In continuation of this, the actress recently shared some pictures with her fans on Facebook, which quickly caught everyone’s attention. In the shared picture, she is seen wearing a lehenga as a queen. She caught the attention of netizens with her sweet smile and a bag in her hand. Sharing the picture, Bubly wrote in the caption, “Always wear your invisible crown, just like a true queen.” Meanwhile, fans have praised Bubly’s looks in the comment box. One netizen wrote, “Mashaallah Apu, all the pictures are beautiful.” Another wrote, “She looks like a doll.”

title: Shraddha in strange kingdom of Zootopia
body: Agencies : Shraddha Kapoor has a hidden talent for imitating other people’s voices. This talent is sometimes revealed in various interviews. This time, Shraddha is appearing on a bigger scale as a voice actress. The sequel to Disney’s popular animation movie ‘Zootopia’ is coming this month. Shraddha’s voice will be heard as Judy Hopps in the Hindi version of ‘Zootopia 2’. Walt Disney Studios India made the announcement at an event held in Mumbai recently. Shraddha was present there. She said how excited she is to lend her voice to the character. Shraddha Kapoor said, “I’m very happy to be associated with Zootopia 2 by lending my voice to the character Judy Hopps in Hindi. Not only me, my family members are also excited about the work.” Shraddha’s voice is heard in the voiceover. She continues to narrate the movie in the style of Judy Hopps.

title: What Rhea uses to do to forget her mental pain
body: Bollywood actress Rhea Chakraborty has been through a difficult time in last five years, to say the least is an understatement. Following the sudden death of actor Sushant Singh Rajput in 2020, she was embroiled in multiple lawsuits. She had to face personal mental anguish, from jail custody to extreme calls for ‘boycott’ in society. Recently, the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) gave her a ‘clean chit’ in this case, a decision that Sushant’s family is still opposing. The entire incident had such a profound impact on Rhea’s mental health that she eventually started suffering from ‘post-traumatic stress disorder’ or PTSD.

title: I don’t want Govinda as my husband anymore: Sunita
body: Bollywood actor Govinda’s wife Sunita Ahuja has once again come into the limelight after saying that she no longer wants him as her husband. After 38 years of marriage, she has now openly expressed her opinion. In a recent interview, Sunita said, “I have learned a lot. Why one more birth? I don’t want to have Govinda as my husband even in seven births.” She said that Govinda doesn’t give time to his wife, he is always busy with heroines.

title: Fraud of lakhs of rupees in name of Neha Kakkar
body: A major fraud using the name of popular Bollywood singer Neha Kakkar has been reported in Mumbai. A lawyer lost over five lakh rupees after being lured by a fake online trading platform. Lawyer Shabnam Muhammad Hussain Sayed (45) has filed a complaint with Mumbai’s Worli police station. According to the police, in June this year, she saw an advertisement on social media for a so-called international trading platform. The advertisement featured Neha Kakkar as the brand ambassador and promoted the platform as a reliable investment medium.

title: Aparajita gets into controversy with her candid comments
body: West Bengal’s actress Aparajita Aadhya has always been open about her personal life. However, in a recent interview, she made some comments about her reincarnation and reincarnation, which has sparked heated discussions, criticism, and trolling on social media. She told Indian media, “I definitely believe in reincarnation. I myself am the next birth of my grandmother. Nirupama Aadhya is me. I believe in this very much. I’m my grandmother.” In her words, “There are many things that can’t be said, that can’t be known without sadhona. But I think this is my last birth. I will not be born again after this.”

title: Haq box office collection Day 3: Emraan Hashmi, Yami Gautam’s film nears Rs 10cr mark
body: NN ONLINE: Emraan Hashmi and Yami Gautam’s courtroom drama Haq is showing steady progress at the box office, inching closer to the Rs 10 crore milestone after its third day in theatres. Directed by Suparn S Varma, the film opened in cinemas on November 7. According to industry tracker Sacnilk, Haq earned Rs 3.75 crore on its third day (November 9), bringing its total domestic collection to Rs 8.85 crore. The movie recorded an overall Hindi occupancy rate of 23.60 percent on its first Sunday, with the highest turnout during evening shows at 35.98 percent. Afternoon shows followed with 24.56 percent, while night and morning screenings saw 24.30 and 9.54 percent occupancy, respectively. After collecting Rs 1.75 crore on its opening day and Rs 3.35 crore on the second day, Haq continues to perform well in major cities and is expected to cross the Rs 10 crore mark soon. Inspired by the landmark Shah Bano case of 1985, the film portrays the story of a 62-year-old Muslim woman, Shah Bano Begum, who sought alimony from her former husband, lawyer Mohd Ahmed Khan, after their divorce. Emraan Hashmi plays Khan, while Yami Gautam takes on the role of Shah Bano. The case led to a historic Supreme Court verdict granting her maintenance under Section 125, later overturned by the Rajiv Gandhi government — a move that triggered nationwide debates on secularism, women’s rights, and the Uniform Civil Code (UCC). Produced by Junglee Pictures, Insomnia Films, and Baweja Studios, Haq also stars Vartika Singh, Danish Husain, Sheeba Chadha, and Aseem Hattangady in key roles.

title: Pori Moni reveals secret to maintain fitness
body: Entertainment Report : Pori Moni, a popular actress of Dhallywood, often comes to the centre of discussion through her personal life and bold statements. This time, at an event, the star actress spoke about her current lifestyle and the secret to maintaining fitness. Pori Moni said at the event, “I’m not doing anything special. I’m eating rice and ice cream. I can’t even go to sleep properly, I can’t even wake up properly, I can’t even follow a routine. I’m trying really hard to live a ‘maintained lifestyle’.” “But since both children are small, their sleep schedules sometimes get up and down, so I have to keep up with them,” she added. The actress also said, “Basically, I get my fitness back by running after them.” She frankly admitted that this natural process of taking care of her child as a mother is helping her stay naturally fit. On the other hand, Pori Moni also expressed her different perspective on birthdays and gifts. In her words, “I think the fact that everyone wished a little, said Happy Birthday, that’s a big gift to me.”

title: Rumours of joining politics Tahsan responds
body: Entertainment Report : Popular musician Tahsan has been in the news for months after announcing his retirement from singing. There has been a lot of discussion, criticism, and debate surrounding him. Many have said that he has quit singing due to religious reasons. There have also been rumors that he has joined a religious political party. Tahsan has finally opened up about the issue. At a recent event in the capital, Tahsan said, “When I said I was quitting singing at a concert in Melbourne, there were very few people there. I didn’t think it would spread like this across the country. Just as I have gradually taken a break from acting, I will also take a break from singing. I’m a bit of an emotional, poetic person. I said it in such a way that it spread. A lot has happened as a result of that one word of mine. At one point, I saw that my picture was being linked to a political party by wearing a hat. I’m doing politics!” Tahsan believes that this has been done out of the addiction to going viral. He said, “I think these are part of the game. Like a game. Now some people are addicted to going viral. It is happening all over the world. That is why you have to think carefully about what you say. You have to think about what will happen when.” Tahsan said about his decision to quit singing, “This is not the first time. I have taken a break in my career several times. When I left the Black Band and started a solo career, I stopped performing live for a few years. Then, when I went to the United States for my master’s degree, I didn’t release any song for two years. I didn’t even do concerts. Now I’m going on another break. I feel like I have received much more love than I was supposed to in last 25 years. If I continue like this, the matter will become boring. I have given another answer in another place. That is also true. There is another answer. But I can’t give it publicly. Because, every person has some personal experiences in their life that are so incredible that they cannot believe it themselves. I don’t want to say anything that becomes a national issue.”

title: Subhasree excited about success of her film
body: Agencies : Tollywood actress Subhashree Ganguly is riding high on continuous success. After film ‘Indubala Bhater Hotel’, her new web series ‘Anusandhan’ has also created a stir on digital platforms. Thousands of viewers watched the series on the first day. This talented actress has proven herself once again. But not only ‘Anusandhan’, this year she was also seen in the film ‘Grihapravesh’. Film ‘Dhumketu’ did fairly well at the box office. But is there any film outside her own film, whose success Subhasree was seen to be very excited about? In an interview with Indian media, Subhashree said, “Apart from my film, I’m currently very happy with the success of Koel’s film ‘Sharthopor’. It is such a beautiful film, I really liked Koel’s extraordinary performance.” “Such a film was much needed. I’m very proud of Koeldi. The success of the film ‘Sharthopor’ gave courage to five more directors and producers to come forward,” she added. In her words, “Many of you may already be planning to make such films in the future. All of these films are a source of great pride for all of us.”

title: Is Shakib’s new look copy of Prithviraj?
body: Entertainment Report : Megastar Shakib Khan is currently in the film industry. The hero is appearing on the screen with one new look after another. Recently, the look of his upcoming movie ‘Soldier’ was revealed; and the audience’s interest around it is at its peak. At such a time, the King Khan of Bangladesh appeared in public in this look. And there is a lot of discussion about his look. But now there is news that may upset Shakib fans. Movie fans say that Shakib Khan has been seen in this look before; in the look of a hero from another movie. Just as much discussion is being had about Shakib Khan’s look at this time, there was a similar discussion at one time; that was mainly in the Malayalam industry in South India. Yes, actor Prithviraj Sukumaran of that industry had adopted this same look; so the question remains, did Shakib copy Prithviraj’s look? It’s like the first glimpse is captivating! A strong and stylish expression hidden behind a black outfit, a mustache; who wouldn’t remember such a look! If you put the two looks of the two heroes side by side, you can see that Shakib and Prithviraj – both are seen in black denim jackets or shirt-jackets, on which contrast stitching of white thread is done. This high-visibility stitching has given the entire outfit an extraordinary design element, which has brought a sophisticated revolutionary touch to the look. The design and cut of both the clothes are almost exactly the same. There is a similarity in the glasses and mustache! Both have sharp and thick mustaches on their faces. Along with sunglasses, which make their looks mysterious and dashing? However, there is a difference in the sunglasses! Shakib has used aviator style sunglasses, which adds a classic heroic look to his look. On the other hand, Prithviraj is wearing a tortoiseshell frame with black lenses in the first look. Later, however, he also uses aviator style glasses, which makes the similarity even clearer.

title: I’m the voice of Meta AI: Deepika
body: Deepika Padukone is now at a new peak of success. She is no longer just a 500 crore net worth or the highest paid actress. Recently, in an unexpected initiative, she has joined Meta AI as the new voice. The actress herself has shared the news of her new journey on social media. Deepika recently opened up about that difficult time in an interview. She said, “Right now I’m the voice of Meta AI. But there was a time when I was just starting out in Bollywood, my voice and accents were being made fun of a lot. Many things have happened to me that I have had to silently fight to achieve and win. So, these are nothing new to me.”

title: Why Sydney Sweeney attracted to older men?
body: Hollywood actress Sydney Sweeney has recently entered into a new relationship with music entrepreneur Scooter Braun. Since the matter came to light, there has been renewed discussion about her personal life; especially why she is always attracted to men much older than herself. Sweeney, 28, is dating Scooter Braun, 44. While many are curious about this large age gap in a relationship, relationship expert and sex psychologist Sophie Rose explained the issue to the Daily Mail.

title: Everyone makes me a product: Prosenjit
body: There was a time when actor Prosenjit Chatterjee was the main driving force behind the Tollywood industry. This year, during Durga Puja, Prosenjit’s film ‘Debi Chaudhurani’ competed with several other films at the box office. While others were worried about the competition, Prosenjit remained silent. He said that he was not interested in the matter at all. The only goal of an actor is to present his best to the audience. Prosenjit said, “I don’t think anyone puts me in any competition. I don’t participate in all these competitions. Although there was a time when I used to participate in these competitions, there was a time when I couldn’t work outside, couldn’t do Hindi films because then everyone was depending on me.”

title: Koel Mallick gives tips about love
body: Koel Mallick is one of the most popular actresses in Tollywood. Along with acting, her behaviour and personal life are all in the spotlight. However, the heroine is not seen talking much about love or personal life. She keeps this matter a little away from the limelight. But this time she gave special tips about love to the new generation of fans. Koel said, “Relationships are not like noodles that are made in two minutes. It’s not like every time, every moment will be very beautiful, very happy, or happening. A relationship means giving a word, a commitment. There is a purity, a loyalty in that commitment.”

title: When I mentioned quitting music at my concert in Melbourne, there were very few people in the audience
body: When I mentioned quitting music at my concert in Melbourne, there were very few people in the audience. I never thought it would spread across the entire country like this. Just as I gradually took a break from acting, I will also take a break from music. I’m a bit emotional – a poetic person. Some people are saying I’m getting into politics. Nowadays, some people are obsessed with becoming viral. That’s why one has to think carefully before speaking – you never know which words might cause what reaction. For now, I just want to return to a simple, ordinary life. Tahsan Khan

title: Glamorous actresses set for silver screen stars
body: Entertainment Report : Over time, commercial cinema has undergone significant changes. Popular TV drama actresses are now making their way onto the silver screen one after another. In this era of globalization, talented television directors are also stepping forward to create modern and internationally styled films. Meanwhile, mainstream cinema finds itself cornered by political shifts, lack of compelling stories, and a shortage of skilled artists, theaters, and audiences. part from Shakib Khan, no other actor seems to have gained strong acceptance among viewers. Several young and in-demand actresses from television are eagerly waiting to act alongside Dhallywood’s “King Khan,” Shakib Khan. Among them, SabillaNur and TanjinTisha have already landed opportunities to star opposite him. MehazabienChowdhury and TasniaFarin, after establishing themselves on TV and OTT platforms, are now striving to become regular faces in films. Among the glamorous models and TV actresses preparing for the big screen, SafaKabir’s name comes first. The model-actress expressed her desire to act in films. Safa said, “People have been asking me for a long time when they will see me in movies. I also want to see myself on the big screen, but I feel hesitant. Recently, many popular TV actresses have started doing films, and some people criticize them, calling them ‘TV heroines.’ Such comments can be discouraging. But we, as artists, always want to move to the next level, and for that, we need everyone’s support and love. I believe I’ll be able to share good news very soon.” Another beloved TV actress is Samira Khan Mahi. In just a few years of her career, she has acted in over a hundred dramas, most of which have been praised by both audiences and critics. Mahi’s dream is to work in films-the biggest medium of entertainment-and she is steadily moving toward that goal. She said, “A good story, strong character, talented director, and skilled co-actors are all important for the big screen. I need to prepare myself further for films. I’d also like to work alongside experienced and capable co-stars.” Another rising star from television is TanzimSaiyaraTotini. Although she has acted in TV dramas and web films, she hasn’t yet appeared in cinema. Totini said, “I’ve received a lot of love from drama audiences, and when I step into films, I want people to love me the same way. I do want to act in movies, but not right now. I want to be fully prepared before making my debut on the silver screen.”

title: Shakib Khan’s per-minute rate Nearly two lakh taka!
body: Entertainment Desk : Actor Shakib Khan – the country’s most popular film star – is also the most expensive celebrity in Bangladesh’s showbiz industry. His remuneration for films is sky-high, and recently, he set a new record by appearing at a brand event. Shakib attended the inauguration of an international accessories brand’s new showroom in Banani, Dhaka, as the chief guest. Although his presence was brief, it instantly went viral on social media. According to reports, Shakib Khan received 35 lakh taka for a 20-minute appearance at the event. This means his per-minute rate is nearly two lakh taka. Shakib Khan himself has not yet commented on the fee or the duration of his appearance.

title: Bubly in new film
body: Entertainment Report : After her last movie Jongli, actress ShabnamBubly had been away from the big screen for nearly a year. Now, she has finally shared exciting news with her fans-Bubly will play the lead role in DhakaiyaDevdas, opposite actor Ador Azad. The film is directed by ZahidHossain, who said the story revolves around modern love and the complexities of relationships. Ador Azad will portray a modern, heartbroken lover, while Bubly plays the central character. At the film’s inauguration ceremony, Bubly said, “The name itself gives you an idea of what the story is about. It’s a beautiful and well-structured story. Nowadays, most films are action-oriented, so I believe audiences will appreciate this one for its focus on love and heartbreak.” Talking about the plot, Ador Azad explained, “Since the film is titled DhakaiyaDevdas, the story naturally carries that essence-but in a new form and perspective. It’s about love and loss, filled with deep emotional undertones.” The director believes that Bubly and Ador’s on-screen chemistry will reach new heights in DhakaiyaDevdas, giving the film a unique appeal. Previously, the popular pair worked together in Talash, Local, Pinnic, and Khela Hobe. Fans are eagerly waiting to see them together again on the silver screen. Meanwhile, Bubly has also been making headlines for her recent royal-themed photoshoot. In a series of pictures shared on social media Thursday evening, she appeared as a true “Hollywood diva.” Dressed in an off-shoulder white floral top and a black gown, posing on the bonnet of a luxury sports car, Bubly instantly set the internet abuzz.

title: Koel shares her thoughts on love
body: Entertainment Desk : KoelMallick is one of the most popular actresses in Bengali cinema, with countless admirers. Apart from her acting, her personality and personal life often remain the subject of discussion among her fans. However, the actress rarely speaks about love or her personal relationships. This time, Koel has shared some special tips on love for her young fans. In an interview with an Indian media outlet, she said, “A relationship is not like instant noodles that are ready in two minutes.” She added, “It’s not like every moment will be beautiful, joyful, or happening. A relationship means giving your word-a commitment. And within that commitment lies a certain purity and loyalty.” In her words, “Love is not like changing clothes. It’s not about-‘I don’t like this one anymore, let’s try that one.’ You can’t say, ‘I’ve worn the red dress for too long and I’m bored, so I’ll wear the blue one now.’ Relationships don’t work that way. Maybe I’m a bit old-fashioned, but that’s the way I love to love.”

title: Michael’s biopic teaser released
body: Michael Jackson – one of the most talked-about figures of the 20th century. A name known to everyone, from eight to eighty. His biopic “Michael” is set to hit theaters on April 24, 2026. The one-minute-and-twelve-second teaser, released on Thursday (November 6) night, has already taken social media by storm. Fans’ excitement proves that the love for the “King of Pop” remains undying. Directed by Antoine Fuqua, the film stars Jaafar Jackson, Michael’s own nephew, in the lead role.

title: College girls change their boyfriends every week
body: Akshay Kumar and RaveenaTandon were one of the most popular Bollywood couples of the 1990s. Their love and eventual breakup became a hot topic at the time. Although their relationship even reached the stage of engagement, it ultimately didn’t last. Recently, after many years, Raveena spoke about it and said, “I had completely forgotten about it. I always feel that we were a hit pair at one time. Even now, when we meet, we chat and have fun conversations. Everyone moves on in life. Nowadays, college girls change their boyfriends every week. I don’t understand why there’s so much discussion just because a relationship didn’t work out. It happens.

title: A new surprise from father-son
body: Aryan Khan’s OTT series “Bad Boys of Bollywood” created quite a stir with just a one-minute appearance by Bollywood’s King, Shah Rukh Khan. That brief on-screen moment between father and son left audiences wanting more. Now, the wait seems to be coming to an end – according to close sources, Shah Rukh Khan will be seen in Aryan Khan’s upcoming full-length feature film. The screenplay is reportedly in its final stages, and pre-production is underway. However, Aryan chose not to cast his father in his debut project, wanting to first establish his own position in the industry.

title: Orlando Bloom now in Bangladesh
body: Hollywood actor Orlando Bloom, famed for The Lord of the Rings, has arrived in Bangladesh. He is visiting Dhaka on a four-day trip as a UNICEF Goodwill Ambassador, according to a press release from UNICEF. After arriving in Bangladesh, Bloom has already visited the Rohingya camps in Ukhiya, Cox’s Bazar. In an Instagram post quoting Orlando Bloom, UNICEF wrote, “I have returned to Bangladesh after more than eight years. This time, I came to Cox’s Bazar, home to the world’s largest refugee camp. More than one million Rohingya refugees live here, over half of them children.

title: Entertainment Report : Pooja Sengupta is a Bangladeshi dancer, choreographer, director, and also the Artistic Director o
body: Entertainment Report : Pooja Sengupta is a Bangladeshi dancer, choreographer, director, and also the Artistic Director of ‘Turongomi’. She has been praised for performing at various events both in the country and abroad. This time, Pooja is going to France to conduct dance sessions and participate in festivals in addition to receiving higher training in dance. Pooja will be staying in Nice, France from November 13 to January 28 at the invitation of Jean Loringet of Jazz Dance Company of France. There, she will take advanced training in Laban Movement Analysis, conduct a session on traditional dance of Bangladesh for artists in France. Apart from this, Pooja will participate in the 25th Cannes International Dance Festival to be held in Cannes, France this month with Jean Loringet of Jazz Dance Company. Among the dance theatre and choreographies directed by Pooja Sengupta are: ‘Waterness’, ‘Anamika Sagarkanya’, ‘Nondini’, ‘Hochimin’, ‘Adamya’, ‘Dhara Toru Kavya’, ‘Aranya’, and ‘Resolution’. In addition to dancing and directing, Pooja is a researcher. She has been conducting research since 2011 with the aim of creating her own dance style in Bangladesh. Pooja has conducted dance workshops at Bangkok University in 2014 and at the Philippine Dance Exchange in 2018-19. In 2018, her papers were presented at the Dance Education Conference organised by Capital Normal University and Beijing Dance Academy in China, and Herzen State University in Russia. Her articles on dance have been published in multiple journals in China, Russia, and India. In 2018, Pooja received the Nurul Quader Award. In 2019, Turongomi School of Dance became the first Bangladeshi dance educational institution and Pooja Sengupta became a member of the International Dance Council UNESCO as a dancer. In 2022, Pooja was awarded the Friendship Medal by the President of Vietnam for her production of Ho Chi Minh. Apart from this, she has received various other awards in recognition of her works.

title: I wasn’t in that clip, should report the news after knowing it: Tanjin Tisha
body: Entertainment Report : Popular small screen actress Tanjin Tisha has been finalised as the heroine in Dhallywood’s big-budget film ‘Soldier’. Tisha will star opposite megastar Shakib Khan. But a discussion has recently arisen around the film. The beginning of which is centered on the leaking of a video of the shooting floor where Shakib Khan and a woman are seen on the shooting set. And when that video of the dance steps spread, netizens claim that the woman is Tanjin Tisha; and this is what the discussion is about. The actress was recently questioned by reporters regarding that video. Tisha claimed, “None of my clips in ‘Soldier’ have been released yet. I was not in that video. You have spread false news, you are wrong.” Tanjin Tisha said, “Sometimes it’s good to know the news a little bit. I know I am going to do a big job.” The actress is very excited about the new film. In this regard, she said, “I am very excited. Although I’m not alone, it is the work of the whole team. I always say, it is a team work.” The shooting of ‘Soldier’ has already begun. Tisha stood in front of the camera with Shakib Khan for the first time on October 11. This film, which is based on the story of patriotism, is being directed by Shakib Fahad. It is being heard that if everything goes according to plan, ‘Soldier’ could be released next December.

title: Ador-Bubly’s new film ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’
body: Entertainment Report : A new movie titled ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’ is being made in the context of the people, society and culture of old Dhaka. It will be made by Zahid Hossain. Ador Azad and Shobnom Bubly will play the two main characters. The official journey of the movie ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’ began on Friday with a mahurat ceremony at a club in the capital. The director informed that ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’ is basically a love story. The traditions of Old Dhaka will be presented in the story of two people. Director Zahid Hossain said, “This is a love story. This story will be presented in the mix of our centuries-old traditions of Old Dhaka. Old Dhaka is a place where there is a mix of different religions, races, and cultures. Everyone celebrates Sakrain, Eid, Muharram, and New Year together. There are many other cultures that many of the current generation do not know. These cultures will also emerge through the story of two people.” Regarding the title ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’, Zahid Hossain also said, “The title ‘Devdas’ has been used metaphorically. Those who fail in love, think of themselves as Devdas. In the story of this movie too, the hero starts thinking of himself as such after failing in love. That is why the movie has been named ‘Dhakaiya Devdas.’” The director said that the shooting of the movie ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’ will begin during the Sakrain Festival in January. He wants to shoot in real locations during the festival to accurately portray the traditions of old Dhaka on screen. Apart from Ador and Bubly, Tariq Anam Khan, Shahiduzzaman Selim, Rashed Mamun Apu and others will also act in the movie, which is produced and presented by Excel Films and Revolution Movies International. ‘Dhakaiya Devdas’ is the fourth film of the Ador and Bubly duo. Ador Azad and Shobnom Bubly started their journey on the big screen as a pair with Saikat Nasir’s ‘Talash’. The film was released in 2022. Their second film ‘Local’ was released in 2023. It was directed by Saif Chandan. Last year, they acted in Zahid Jewel’s ‘Pink’. Although there was talk of the film being released on Eid this year, it didn’t happen. The film awaiting to release.

title: ‘Kaffara’ to premiere at Cairo Film Fest
body: Entertainment Desk : The 46th Cairo International Film Festival will begin from November 12 at the Cairo Opera House in Egypt. The international premiere of Bangladeshi film ‘Kaffara’ will be held at festival, said a press release. The film, starring Farhana Hamid, has been selected in the International Panorama section of the festival. It is directed by Tanvir Chowdhury. The festival authorities confirmed the information by sharing the poster of the film ‘Kaffara’ on social media last Tuesday. The story of the movie ‘Kaffara’ revolves around the Imam of a local mosque and his wife. The Imam is suffering from remorse after a tragic incident. His wife tries to save him from the pain of guilt. Raihan Uddin plays the role of the Imam, and Farhana Hamid plays the role of his wife. This movie marks Raihan’s debut on the big screen. The movie is jointly produced by Tanvir Chowdhury and Barkat Hossain Palash. Director Tanvir Chowdhury said that ‘Kaffara’ will be screened at the Cairo Festival on November 18. He will be present during the screening. This year’s festival will end with the announcement of the winners on November 21. Actress Farhana Hamid said, “The story is about the mental conflict and understanding with oneself. The movie is premiering at the Cairo Film Festival-this is news of pride and joy for us. Starting from the director, every artist and crew member has worked hard and worked with care. So this achievement is an inspiration for everyone.” Shahria Pulak, MA Maruf, Monisa Archi, and others also acted in ‘Kaffara’.

title: TikToker Samiya says she left Pakistan
body: Pakistani social media influencer and TikToker Samiya Hijab has been embroiled in controversy for various activities, from personal video leaks to her own. Now, she has sparked controversy again with an explosive comment. As a result, Samiya is now in exile. Recently, the TikToker claimed on social media that her clothes were getting smaller, and that the mindset of the Pakistani nation was to blame for this. In her viral video, she also said that she was forced to leave the country due to the judgmental behaviour of the people and the government. In that video clip, Samiya expressed extreme frustration with the mentality of the people of Pakistan who wear hijab. She said, “If her style of dress changes over time, it is not her fault.” She directly complained, saying, “It is the fault of the nation.”

title: Katrina becomes mother, Vicky confirms the news
body: Finally, a new guest has arrived in the house of Bollywood star Katrina Kaif and actor Vicky Kaushal. Katrina has given birth to a son at the age of 42. Vicky confirmed the good news on social media on Friday morning. Vicky wrote, “The reason for our happiness has come to this world.” He added a heart emoji to the post.

title: Hrithik’s ex-wife loses a loved one
body: Bollywood actor Hrithik Roshan’s ex-wife Sussanne Khan has lost her closest person. The actor’s ex-mother-in-law, i.e. Sussanne Khan’s mother Zareen Khan, recently passed away. She was 81 years old at the time of her death. Zareen was suffering from old age-related ailments. She died suddenly of a heart attack. Her husband, director Sanjay Khan, and her children are mourning her death. Zareen was active in acting and modeling from the 1960s to the early 1970s. She appeared in several films, including ‘Ek Phool Do Mali’ and ‘Tere Ghar Ke Samman’. She also worked in writing and interior design.

title: Nabila wants to be more careful
body: Entertainment Report : Actress Masuma Rahman Nabila became a hot topic after the release of Amitabh Reza Chowdhury’s ‘Ainabaji’ in 2016. Nabila’s discussion started again after the release of Raihan Rafi’s ‘Toofan’ last year. Her performance in ‘Toofan’ was praised. However, although she is satisfied with the movie, the actress has regrets about the scope of the character. So, she wants to be more careful when the film ‘Toofan 2’ is made. After the release, the producer announced that the second part of the movie ‘Toofan’ would be made. However, no official announcement has been made yet. Last month, rumours suddenly spread that ‘Toofan 2’ would be released on some Eid of 2027. Nabila said that there has been no discussion with the producers about ‘Toofan 2’ yet. However, she is willing to act in the sequel. Nabila said, “‘Toofan’ is a good movie. The audience has received it well. I’m looking forward to acting in ‘Toofan 2’. However, I will be a little more careful so that my character can be further established. I can present myself in a more different way.” In movie ‘Toofan’, Shakib Khan had two heroines opposite him. Nabila was accompanied by West Bengal’s Mimi Chakraborty. Nabila played the role of costume designer Julie. Although her performance was praised, the scope of the character was limited. Nabila said that due to lack of time, several scenes of her part were not shot. However, the actress wants to be more aware of her character in the next episode. Nabila said, “The shooting did not happen the way my character was in the script. I don’t blame anyone. The time was very short. My part was shot at the end. The first part took a long time to shoot, so there was less time at the end. There are various restrictions from the producer’s side, there are budget issues. Because of these reasons, several scenes from my part could not be shot. So at the end of the day, there is a place for sadness.”Nabila has acted in another movie titled ‘Banolata Sen’. The movie is directed by Masud Hasan Ujjal. It also stars Khairul Basar, Sohel Mondal, and others. The movie, produced with government funding, awaiting to release. Nabila is currently busy with her hosting duties. She will be hosting the cooking show ‘Starship Fusion Kitchen’, which has been airing since yesterday. Nabila will be joined by two local and international chefs in each episode of this show.

title: Mira Nair overjoyed at her son Mamdani’s victory
body: Agencies : At the age of just 34, Indian-American Johran K Mamdani has made history by becoming the first Muslim mayor of New York. Behind his success is a strong family atmosphere.
