Johran’s mother is Indian-American filmmaker Mira Nair, a bold name in world cinema. Her films do not have commercial flashiness, but stories of people, society, pain, migration and self-struggle. She is the director of internationally acclaimed films like ‘Salaam Bombay’, ‘Monsoon Wedding’, ‘Mississippi Masala’. Johran’s father is renowned Gujarati writer Professor Mahmud Mamdani. He is a thinker of Indian origin from Uganda. Zohran grew up with Bengali culture because of his mother. He closely watched his mother’s film world from a young age. Mira was born in the Bengali-dominated Rourkela in Odisha, India. Therefore, there is an influence of Bengali and Bengali language in her life and work. She also taught her son Zohran Mamdani the Bengali language. She introduced him to Bengali culture. Her son even played a role in Mira Nair’s decision to make the film ‘Namesake’, which is based on the story of a Bengali family migrating to America. When Mira was offered the opportunity to direct ‘Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix’ in 2007, she hesitated. At that time, the teenage Zohran himself was a Harry Potter fan and asked his mother to make ‘Namesake’. Zohraan has been elected mayor of New York as a candidate for the Democratic Party. Mira Nair is very excited about her son’s victory. Her father Mahmud Mamdani is also happy. Sharing a picture of her son on Instagram, Mira wrote, “He is not only my son, he is a symbol of hope for our time.” Mira said about her son, “I’m amazed by my son’s courage and way of speaking. What I like about him is that he has unequivocally accepted the diversity of this world. I am optimistic about the hope he has shown. He has a vision to see this world. And that is not the greed for power. He has always stood for equality, justice and the working people.” Mira Nair’s first feature film, ‘Salaam Bombay!’, won the Cannes Film Festival’s Camera d’Or in 1988. It was also nominated for an Oscar in the Best Foreign Language Film category.

title: Angelina Jolie in trouble after visiting Ukraine
body: Agencies : Hollywood star Angelina Jolie, known for her humanitarian work around the world, recently visited Ukraine. But her secret visit to war-torn cities has sparked some unexpected events. This is Jolie’s second visit to Ukraine as a goodwill ambassador for the United Nations Children’s Fund (UNICEF). She had previously visited Lviv after Russia invaded in 2022. But this time she traveled to other war-torn areas in southern Ukraine, including the more dangerous, frontline city of Kherson. During the trip, Jolie visited several children’s hospitals, maternity wards and other emergency services. In photos circulating on social media, the Oscar-winning actress is seen wearing a bulletproof vest and helmet. In other photos, she is seen smiling with children in the city, which was recently hit by Russian airstrikes. However, during this trip, an unexpected incident occurred. According to the international media outlet Politico, a member of Jolie’s team, who was her driver, was arrested at a checkpoint and ordered to be directly recruited into the Ukrainian army. It is understood that Jolie’s visit was not coordinated with the Ukrainian government and she entered the country on foot. Although the Ukrainian Army Land Forces later shared a statement about the incident, which was quickly deleted. They neither confirmed nor denied the incident.

title: What Madhuri says in her post amidst controversy
body: Bollywood actress Madhuri Dixit’s controversy seems to be going on. Recently, at a Canadian event, she was late to the stage, causing chaos. The audience complained that Madhuri came on stage almost three hours after the scheduled time. After this incident, organisers of the event blamed Madhuri’s team, but the heroine herself had to face the wrath. Viewers demanded a public apology. But in this atmosphere of controversy, Madhuri, instead of commenting on Canadian event, posted a post thanking Toronto. Madhuri wrote on her social media, “I received love from Toronto. After ‘Meet and Greet’ event there, it’s time to go to New Jersey, Chicago and New York.”

title: BJP leader files case against Salman
body: Bollywood star Salman Khan is in legal trouble now. The actor has been accused of spreading false information in an advertisement for a paan masala company. A security court in Kota, Rajasthan, India has already issued a notice against Salman and the company. This allegation has been made by Rajasthan lawyer and BJP leader Indermohan Singh Honey. He claims that the advertisement of Rajshree Pan Masala is misleading the customers. Although the advertisement mentions ‘saffron-infused cardamom’ or ‘saffron-infused pan masala’, the amount of saffron used in the packet for the common consumer is not realistic.

title: Case filed against Tanjin Tisha, DB to investigate
body: A case has been filed in a Dhaka court against popular actress Tanjin Nahar Tisha on charges of fraud and breach of trust over a saree. Md Aminul Islam, an executive of ‘Aponia Fashion’, filed the case in the court of Metropolitan Magistrate Jewel Rana in Dhaka on November 5. Plaintiff’s lawyer Salimullah Sarkar confirmed the case information and said that the DB police have been ordered to investigate the allegations and submit a report by February 18. Tisha joined ‘Aponia’ online page and looked at various sarees and chose a saree with a market price of Tk28,800 from there. The saree was delivered to her house.

title: Rashmika showed off her engagement ring
body: There has been a lot of talk about the engagement of South superstar Vijay Deverakonda and actress Rashmika Mandanna for a long time. Although neither of them has yet spoken about it, the curiosity and speculation among their fans is increasing. Amidst this speculation, Rashmika recently appeared on actor Jagapathi Babu’s talk show to promote her new film ‘Girlfriend’, and it was there that she showed off her engagement ring for the first time in front of the camera.

title: Meghan Markle set for big screen return: reports
body: Prince Harry’s wife Meghan Markle is to make her return to the big screen, media reported Wednesday, with a small cameo role in a film being shot around Los Angeles. The Duchess of Sussex was reportedly shooting scenes for “Close Personal Friends,” which features “Emily in Paris” star Lily Collins, alongside Jack Quaid, Brie Larson and Henry Golding. Entertainment title Variety said the comedy “revolves around a ‘regular’ couple that meets a celebrity couple while on a trip to Santa Barbara.” Markle starred in legal romp “Suits” for seven seasons before her fairytale wedding to the second son of Britain’s King Charles. But she has not acted in seven years, after indicating she was giving up the profession. The couple, who live in California after a bust-up with the British royal family, no longer have access to the public purse, relying instead on a pricey deal with Netflix and Markle’s nascent lifestyle brand. The Netflix deal has spawned the popular, if much-mocked, series “With Love, Meghan,” which features Markle as a thriving domestic maven in a fictionalized home, hosting guests, harvesting honey and mixing bath salts. Despite being blasted by critics as “pointless,” it has been extended for a second season, and a holiday special is due in December. The couple have struggled to capture the public’s imagination since “Harry & Meghan,” a six-episode tell-all about their relationship and exit from the House of Windsor, which drew 23 million views in its first four days — a record for a Netflix documentary. Harry and his wife stepped away from royal duties in 2020 as relations with his family — especially his brother William — spiralled. His blockbuster memoir “Spare” in January 2023 upset Buckingham Palace with its criticism of family members, including William’s wife Catherine and his stepmother Queen Camilla. He has since voiced hopes for a “reconciliation” and in September met Charles, 76, in London, months after it was revealed the monarch is undergoing treatment for an undisclosed cancer. Harry’s uncle, Andrew, was stripped of his royal titles last month, after years of scandal over his friendship with convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, a one-time friend of US President Donald Trump.

title: Very excited, don’t want to say anything except team: Tanjin Tisha
body: Entertainment Report : Small screen actress Tanjin Tisha has made a place in the hearts of the audience with her acting skills. Recently, at a press conference, she talked about her acting career, new work and long break. She does not want to limit herself to just the small screen or OTT. Regarding this, Tisha said, “I never say I won’t do drama or I never say I won’t do OTT. I am an actress, if I like the story, if I have a place to act, it can be anything. Even if it’s a stage play, which I have never done, I will do that too.” She said that she needed this break for a very good and big project. In her words, “I felt like I needed a break for a very good and big project.” “So, I haven’t worked for a long time, that’s my thinking. I haven’t worked for a long time. It’s not like I signed and then I didn’t work,” Tisha added. The actress said, “I’m going to do a good job, a big job. I’m very, very excited. I don’t want to say anything except to my team. I need all your prayers and support.” In Tisha’s words, ‘I’m standing here because of good work. There is nothing in life without good work. So, I want to stay with good work. And I want to tell the rest of the details when the work is successfully completed.”

title: Ritwik Ghatak’s birth centenary celebrations across the country
body: Entertainment Desk : The birth centenary celebration of twins Ritwik Kumar Ghatak and sister Pratiti Devi was organised on November 2 in the capital. The event was organised by the Ritwik Kumar Ghatak and Pratiti Devi Birth Centenary Celebration Committee at Chhayanaut Sanskriti Bhaban. Ritwik and Pratiti were born on the same day, November 4, 1925, in Rajshahi in Bangladesh. Producer Habibur Rahman Khan, playwright Ramendu Majumder, actor Abul Hayat, Mofidul Haque, Sultana Kamal and many others were present, said a press release. Ritwik Ghatak Film Society has organised a special programme at Ritwik Ghatak’s residence in Rajshahi. The national anthem and mass music, lamp lighting, discussion on Ritwik and screening of his biopic ‘Meghe Dhaka Tara’ was held from yesterday. Bangladesh Federation of Film Societies, Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy (BSA) and Bangladesh Short Film Forum have undertaken a year-long programme to celebrate the birth centenary of Ritwik Ghatak. The inaugural ceremony was held at the National Art Gallery Auditorium of BSA in the capital yesterday. Film ‘Titas is Ekta Nodir Naam’ was also screened. A special seminar titled “Ritwik Ghatak’s Titas Ekti Nadir Naam Film: Malo’s Epic Creation of Life-Reality” was held at the Bangla Academy in the capital on Tuesday. Habibur Rahman Khan, Dr Md Selim Reza, Prof Dr Fahmida Akhter, Dr Zakir Hossain Raju and Prof Mohammad Azam were present. Alliance Française de Dhaka hosted ‘Ritwik Ghatak at the Centenary’ yesterday. Moinuddin Khaled delivered a commemorative lecture. Film ‘Komal Gandhar’ was screened at 4:00pm and film ‘Jantrik’ at 6:30pm organised by Dhaka University Film Society. The Zahir Raihan Film Institute is organizing an event to commemorate the birth centenary of Ritwik Ghatak at Lalmatia Housing Society School and College on November 4 at 4:00pm. Essay readings, open discussions, and film screenings will take place there.

title: Novel ‘Mayar Singhasan’ about Runa Laila to be published on artiste’s b’day
body: Entertainment Report : Runa Laila is a renowned singer and composer of the subcontinent. She has already crossed six decades of her musical career. As a vocalist, she has been honoured with more than 300 awards from different countries of the world. Her journey in the world of music is still ongoing. Acclaimed fiction writer Abdullah Al Muktadir has written a novel about this renowned singer. The subject of the novel ‘Mayar Singhasan’ is the emergence, struggle and evolution of Runa Laila in the popular culture of Bangladesh. The novel will be published on Runa Laila’s birthday on November 17. It is being published by Chandrabindu Prokashoni. The cover of the book was designed by Rajib Datta. According to writer Muktadir, ‘Mayar Singhasan’, written about Runa Laila, is not just a novel; it is a journey of the human mind through music. The feelings hidden in Runa Laila’s songs, the obsession with time, love and loneliness – all combined, the novel will take the reader to a magical world of music. The words, filled with the author’s pen, seem to take shape in music, and the story is born from within that music. Writer Abdullah Al Muktadir said, “Runa Laila is a popular artiste, a virtuoso performer. Her songs move the hearts of the listeners. Whenever I hear Runa Laila’s voice, I feel like I have reached another time, where there were fewer people and more melodies. This novel is actually the story of that journey.” In a video message, Runa Laila expressed her best wishes for the novel ‘Mayar Singhasan’. While sharing her feelings in this regard, Runa Laila said, “The book ‘Mayar Singhasan’ was written about me. It was written for me. Everyone should read it, I hope you like it.”

title: I don’t like very neat men at all: Malaika
body: Agencies : Bollywood actress Malaika Arora has been the subject of much discussion and criticism on social media recently. Netizens are saying that Malaika has a new love in her life. Malaika is currently dating a diamond merchant named Harsh Mehta. In a past interview, Malaika had said, “I like men who are a bit rough and sharp-looking. I don’t like men who are very neat, fair-skinned, and have a shaved mustache and beard.” She also told what qualities a man she likes should have. In her words, “He should be able to flirt openly with courage. I like someone who can kiss well.” According to Malaika, a man should have a strong jaw and be outspoken. In that interview, Malaika was also asked about her second marriage. She said, “I am a very romantic person. I believe in love. So, it won’t happen in the future, it can’t be said now.”

title: I felt ashamed even after losing weight: Sonakshi
body: Bollywood actress Sonakshi Sinha is gearing up for the release of her upcoming film ‘Jatadhara’. In an interview, she opened up about her acting journey, especially her weight and the sarcasm on social media. Sonakshi said, “When I came here, I tried my best to lose weight. Even though I managed to do some, people were not satisfied. Now I think, let it all go. If people don’t see it and they don’t recognise it and they just want to hate me for stupid reasons, then that’s their problem. ‘I was ashamed of my body even after losing 30kg and even after debuting in ‘Dabangg’, people didn’t stop making fun of me.”

title: Shah Rukh, Priyanka were first considered for 2 States: Chetan Bhagat
body: Author Chetan Bhagat has revealed that Bollywood stars Shah Rukh Khan and Priyanka Chopra were initially considered for the film 2 States, before Arjun Kapoor and Alia Bhatt were finalized. In an interview with Pinkvilla, Bhagat said, “For 2 States, bigger stars were being talked about. Shah Rukh Khan was being considered. There was also a time when Vishal Bhardwaj was going to make it. Then names like Saif Ali Khan and Priyanka Chopra were discussed.” He added that he was unsure about the final casting when a new director and two relatively new actors were chosen. “Arjun was just one film old, and Alia had only done Student of the Year. I wasn’t convinced. But it turned out to be amazing casting — their freshness and youth made the film what it was,” he said. Bhagat also shared that several actors had turned down roles in Kai Po Che!, another film based on his novel The Three Mistakes of My Life. “All the stars rejected it, so we had to cast Sushant Singh Rajput, Rajkummar Rao, and Amit Sadh. I had little hope from the movie, but it became one of the best adaptations,” he said. 2 States, produced by Dharma Productions, became a major hit in 2014, striking a chord with young audiences for its portrayal of an inter-cultural romance inspired by Bhagat’s own life.

title: Salman Khan faces legal notice over “misleading” pan masala ads
body: Bollywood actor Salman Khan has been issued a legal notice by the Kota Consumer Court following a complaint alleging that advertisements for Rajshree Pan Masala, endorsed by him, are “misleading.” The complaint was filed by senior BJP leader and Rajasthan High Court advocate Inder Mohan Singh Honey, who requested a ban on such ads and questioned claims that the product contains “saffron-infused cardamom” and “saffron-infused pan masala.” Honey argued that saffron, priced at nearly Rs 4 lakh per kilogram, could not realistically be an ingredient in a product costing just Rs 5. The petitioner also raised concerns about the influence of these ads on young people, noting the link between pan masala consumption and rising cancer cases. “Salman Khan is a role model for many. Celebrities should not promote products that encourage youth to consume pan masala, a leading cause of mouth cancer,” Honey told ANI. The Kota Consumer Court has taken cognisance of the matter and scheduled a hearing for November 27, 2025, while responses from the actor and the company are still awaited.

title: Shabnur celebrates Halloween with her son
body: Halloween is a popular festival in the Western world. Dhallywood stars were also seen participating in the festival; one of them is film actress Shabnur. Shabnur posted three photos on his verified Facebook profile last Friday evening. She is currently in Australia; she captured himself from there. In the pictures, she is seen dressed as a ghost with her only son; some of them are seen as mummies, others as zombies. They have fun with the scary costumes. In the caption of the post, Shabnur said that this was just for fun, and jokingly described herself as a ‘cool mom’.

title: It’s like London Bridge has fallen in love with my pics: Apu Biswas
body: Apu Biswas is one of the most successful and popular heroines of Dhallywood. Outside the silver screen, she is quite active on social media. This time, she went to London for a vacation and shared a bunch of pictures with his fans. In the picture, she is seen being captured on camera next to the famous London Tower Bridge. In the shared picture, Apu is seen in a very cheerful mood. She was wearing a white coat, matching sunglasses and loose hair. Her sweet smile has captured the hearts of netizens. Apu also added a stunning caption. She wrote, “It’s like London Bridge is falling in love with my pictures.”

title: I don’t understand politics at all: Aparajita
body: Actress Aparajita Aadhya of West Bengal is known for her straightforward and straightforward approach to her personal and professional life. She recently expressed her views on the possibility of joining politics and personal criticism. Aparajita said, “One day I saw a round table meeting about me, I went there and said, ‘I’m very happy that you’re discussing me. Everyone may have been very hesitant to hear what I said, but I felt that when someone was discussing me, they were able to forget their own sorrows for a while. I don’t understand politics at all. That’s why I will never join politics. I think everything is not for everyone. That’s why I don’t dwell on what I don’t understand.”

title: Shah Rukh Khan hints at possible Ra.One sequel
body: Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan has hinted that a sequel to his 2011 superhero film Ra.One might happen in the future, saying “if the time ever feels right, we might do it again.” The actor made the remarks while interacting with fans during a private event in Mumbai on his 60th birthday on Sunday. Reflecting on Ra.One, which co-starred Kareena Kapoor and Arjun Rampal, Shah Rukh said the film was “ahead of its time” and close to his heart. “Anubhav (the director) worked really hard to make it. I was expecting it to start a new trend because I always feel I should make films that inspire others to try new ideas,” he said. The actor admitted that Ra.One didn’t fully meet his expectations back in 2011, though it performed well and connected with audiences. “I thought everyone would say, ‘It’s a superhero film!’ Not just that — it was also about visual effects. Maybe people weren’t that familiar with technology like PlayStations, video games, or iPads back then. Today, everyone has smartphones. It would probably be more acceptable now,” he said. When asked about the possibility of a sequel, Shah Rukh Khan said it depends on director Anubhav Sinha, who helmed the original film. “He’s the one who made it, and only he can make it again. We worked really hard on it. God willing, if the time ever feels right, we might do it again. It’s easier now anyway,” he said. Ra.One featured Shah Rukh in a dual role alongside Arjun Rampal as the villain, with supporting performances by Kareena Kapoor, Armaan Verma, Shahana Goswami, and Satish Shah.

title: Film starring Tama, coming after decade with change of director, producer
body: Entertainment Report : The OTT platform is a blessing for Tama Mirza. Through this medium, she has made a new name for herself with ‘Khachar Bhetor Achin Pakhi’ and ‘Shat Number Shooting Floor’. After that, she also made her mark on the big screen with ‘Suranga’ and ‘Daagi’. However, Tama Mirza made her debut in cinema a decade and a half ago. At that time, she acted in several films. Among these, there are some films whose shooting has not been completed and some films whose shooting has been completed but have not been released. One such film is ‘Mon Je Bojhe Na’. Tama acted opposite Arifin Shuvoo in this film. The film is being released in theatres across the country on November 7, a decade after the start of shooting. However, the title of the film has changed, not only that, the director and producer have also changed. The shooting of this movie started in Sri Lanka in 2013. At that time, it was titled ‘Lovely: Mon Bojhe Na’. The movie was supposed to be directed by the late director Sohanur Rahman Sohan, but he backed out before the shooting started. The shooting started under the direction of Faizul Islam Shaheen, who was in charge of producing the movie under the banner of The Rain Pictures. After returning home, he gave the responsibility of this movie to Shahadat Hossain Liton. Then the shooting continued under his direction. The news of the end of the shooting was also published around 2016. After that, no trace could be found. Finally, the movie is seeing the light of day. However, no one is in charge of the director and producer of the movie. According to the clearance certificate of the Film Certification Board, the movie was directed by Ayesha Siddika under the banner of Impress Telefilm. The new title has been given, ‘Mon Je Bojhe Na’. Announcing the release of the movie, director Ayesha Siddika wrote on Facebook, “Produced by Impress Telefilm, directed by Ayesha Siddika, a heart-touching romantic and family story ‘Mon Je Bojhe Na’ is coming. It is releasing on November 7. In every frame of this movie, we have tried to highlight the story of society, life and human feelings. Your love and support will make our journey worthwhile.” When asked about this, director Shahadat Hossain Liton said that he stepped down after completing some parts of the film. Later, Ayesha Siddika finished it.

title: New series on family stories ‘Eta Amaderi Golpo’
body: Entertainment Report : Mohammad Mostafa Kamal Raz, the director of popular drama series like ‘Graduate’, ‘Mike’, ‘Family Crisis’, ‘Family Crisis Reloaded’, is bringing a new drama series based on family stories titled ‘Eta Amaderi Golpo’. Starting from November 5, the new episode of this series will be released on the Cinemawala YouTube channel every Wednesday and Thursday at 12 noon. Besides directing, the series’ screenplay was written by Mostafa Kamal Raz. Irfan Sajjad, Keya Payel, Khairul Basar, Sunerah Binte Kamal, Intekhab Dinar, Deepa Khandakar, Monira Akhter Mithu, Nader Chowdhury, Shilpi Sarkar Apu, Dicon Noor, Mahmudul Islam Mithu, among others, have played various roles. Regarding talking about the series, director Mostafa Kamal Raz said, “This is our story series that highlights the importance of family bonds and relationships. The main strength of our society is family. I believe that stories centered on family always leave a deep mark on the hearts of the audience. That is why we have kept the tagline of this series ‘Family begins, family ends’. We have tried to show family bonds, love, conflict and compassion in the story. That is our main effort so that the audience can find pieces of their own lives here.” Three songs have been composed for this serial. The title song written by Mahmud Manzoor is composed by Arfin Rumey and sung by Dola Rahman and Arfin Rumey. The song titled ‘Se Manale’ written by Tariq Tuhin is sung by Shahriar Marcel with his own melody and arrangement. A song titled ‘Jani Na’ written by Siam Sarkar is composed and sung by Prottoy Khan. Sushmita has also sung with him.

title: Shafiq Tuhin, Prottoy Khan’s song about Bangladesh Army
body: Entertainment Report : A song has been made about the Bangladesh Army. This special song has been written by Shafiq Tuhin. The song titled ‘Manobotar Joy Hok’ has been composed and sung by Prottoy Khan. The song was released on the official Facebook page of the Bangladesh Army on October 31. The music video has been made by Kishor Neel. Shafiq Tuhin said about the song, “The Bangladesh Army is a place of our trust, confidence and pride. They extend a helping hand to humanity at any critical moment in the country. The role of the Army in the welfare of the country and its people is undeniable. Therefore, I’m very happy to have the opportunity to sing about the Bangladesh Army. I have been receiving a lot of response to the song since its release. I’m grateful to everyone who supported me in making the song.” Prottoy Khan said, “The Bangladesh Army is our pride. This song is about them. We tried to compose a melody that everyone would like, to sing it beautifully. I hope the song will be a milestone in our career.” Lyricist Shafiq Tuhin, who not only wrote the song but also sang and composed it, won a national award for the song. On the other hand, Prottoy Khan, who followed the path of his father Ripon Khan and elder brother Hridoy Khan, entered music. In addition to singing, he also composes music and arranges music. He has also been seen acting. In 2012, Prottoy acted in a drama titled ‘Rhythm’ with Apurba and Porshi. After that, he became a model in various advertisements and songs. This year, he acted in a drama series directed by Samrat Jahangir. Prottoy played the role of a musician in it.

title: Life can become hell: Shehnaaz Gill
body: Indian actress Shehnaaz Gill has a strange reluctance to get married. In a recent interview, she revealed the reason behind her unwillingness to get married. According to her, a woman’s life can become ‘hell’ if the marriage is not right. Shehnaz has no plans to get married at present. However, she also commented that it is difficult to say anything about what will happen in the future. Shehnaz said, “In her personal life, things are like in the movies. After leaving your parents’ house, you dedicate your entire life to a son.”

title: Shah Rukh seems to be getting younger even at 60: Shashi Tharoor
body: Congress MP, writer and former diplomat Shashi Tharoor joined the procession of celebrities wishing Bollywood king Shah Rukh Khan on his 60th birthday. Tharoor shared a witty message for Shah Rukh in his classic style. He said in his post, “I have to admit that this number 60 is suspicious to me. Some fact-checkers and some forensic experts have investigated whether Shah Rukh is really 60 or not. After the investigation, they have come to this conclusion – there is no way to tell from looking at the picture that Shah Rukh is 60 years old. They have also confirmed in the investigation that no photoshop or AI is used in any of Shah Rukh’s pictures.”

title: Actress Moushumi turns 52
body: Arifa Parvin Moushumi, a popular actress of Bangladeshi cinema, turned 52 on November 3. However, she is also spending this time in the United States; with her mother, daughter and sister. This popular heroine moved to New York in October 2023; since then she has not returned to the country. Moushumi has celebrated her birthday in the USA for the past two years. This year is no exception. Although she is not in the country, it has been reported that her husband and actor Omar Sani organised a special celebration for the day.

title: Riju apologises in face of criticism over saree controversy
body: West Bengal actor Riju Biswas is being discussed and criticised on social media. He is in a lot of trouble over a screenshot of a message sent by Riju saying, “I like sarees.” Those who received such messages from Riju’s work have united. Although Riju did not deny it. In an interview, Riju said, “Is it obscene to say that I like wearing a saree? I just praised it.” The actor apologised on Facebook Live. Riju said on the live that his mother was also being insulted in various ways. Riju’s mother is suffering from cancer. The actor had already said that.

title: Allu Arjun wins ‘Most Versatile Actor’ at Dadasaheb Phalke Awards 2025
body: Popular actor Allu Arjun wins ‘Most Versatile Actor’ at Dadasaheb Phalke Awards 2025has added another accolade to his illustrious career, winning the Most Versatile Actor of the Year award at the Dadasaheb Phalke International Film Festival Awards 2025, one of India’s most prestigious celebrations of cinema. The announcement was made through the festival’s official social media channels, which hailed the actor’s achievement, stating, “Congratulations to Allu Arjun for this prestigious recognition, celebrating his exceptional range and cinematic impact!” The grand award ceremony took place on October 30 at the NSCI Dome, SVP Stadium in Mumbai, bringing together leading names from Indian cinema to honour excellence in film, art, culture, and heritage. Expressing his gratitude after receiving the honour, Allu Arjun wrote on social media: “Thanks to the Dadasaheb Phalke International Film Awards for this incredible honour. Truly humbled. My warm congratulations to all the winners across categories this year. A sincere thank you to my audience for your continued love and support… I humbly dedicate this award to my fans.” The recognition follows a string of successes for the acclaimed actor. Earlier this year, Allu Arjun won the Best Actor title at both the South Indian International Movie Awards (SIIMA) 2025 and the Gaddar Telangana Film Awards for his powerful performance in Sukumar’s “Pushpa 2: The Rule.” Released in 2024, Pushpa 2: The Rule — the sequel to the 2021 blockbuster Pushpa: The Rise — became a major box-office success, featuring an ensemble cast including Rashmika Mandanna, Fahadh Faasil, Jagapathi Babu, Sunil, and Rao Ramesh. Allu Arjun is now set to headline an upcoming untitled sci-fi action film directed by Atlee, currently referred to as Project AA22 x A6, alongside Deepika Padukone. Further details about the project are yet to be announced.

title: Totini’s wait is over
body: Entertainment Report : Tanjim Sayara Totini is a familiar face of the small screen. She also has experience working in OTT. At the beginning of her career, she was seen in the web series ‘Taqdeer’ in 2020 and the anthology film ‘Ei Muhurte’ in 2022. After that, Totini didn’t act in any other web content. She was busy with dramas. The actress is returning to OTT after a break. Totini’s web film ‘Tomar Jonnyo Mon’ will be released on Chorki on November 6. Shihab Shaheen has made ‘Tomar Jonnyo Mon’. In this, Yash Rohan is with Totini. They have acted together in many dramas. This time they have teamed up in OTT. In the story, it can be seen that two people from two cities go to Cox’s Bazar at the same time. They meet there. Then, due to a misunderstanding, various incidents start happening. Regarding talking about the web film, Totini said, “It is a romantic genre story. There is a great twist at the end. The main motif of this story is that a person’s external beauty is not everything, but inner beauty is the real thing.” When asked about the reason for the long break in OTT, the actress said that she was waiting for a good story and a favorite character. Totini’s wait is over. In this regard, she said, “My career started with OTT. After being busy with dramas, I received many offers from OTT. I always felt that if I work on the web, I should act in a story and character where I would have the opportunity to act. I was waiting for such work.” Totini has also been seen on the big screen this year. She had a guest role in the movie ‘Jaya Aar Sharmin’, which was released last May. It is being said that she is the heroine of this movie. Is that really true? When asked, Totini said, “I have not signed a contract for any new movie yet. I will not lie; I have received several movie offers. There have been talks. But just talking does not mean working on the movie. I have to believe in myself, I have to understand – why should I do the character? From that point on, it seems that I should wait a little longer.” Sharing her plans for the movie, Totini said, “I want to be involved in a movie where I will be satisfied. Movie is a big thing. You have to prepare yourself for a long time. So, I think you should do a movie only when you feel ready, when the character is memorable. I don’t want to do a movie just to do it, to become popular for six months. Just like I’m creating a place for myself in drama, I want to create my own identity in the movie too, create a place for myself.”

title: Asif wants to start music school at BFDC
body: Entertainment Report : Asif Akbar is now doubly busy with music and cricket. A few days ago, he returned to the country after completing a two-month music tour in the United States. Immediately after returning, he rushed to fulfill his duties on the cricket field. In the meantime, Asif said that he wants to start a music school for new musicians. Asif wants to set up a music school in the BFDC complex under construction in Tejgaon. He wants to build the school on the model of music schools in the United States. So, during his visit to the USA this time, he visited various schools. He has taken pictures and videos of those schools. Asif Akbar said, “I have always sung with new artistes. It is my habit to work with young people. There are many talented boys and girls in our country, but due to lack of opportunities, they are not able to do good work. There are no good, world-class music schools in the country for those who want to learn music. So, I want to start a music school in the new complex that is being built in BFDC. I was thinking about the matter for a long time. This time, I went on a tour of USA and brought pictures and videos of various music schools. I will build this school on the model of those schools. We have gaps in many things; it is time to fill them up.” “Once I used to play cricket, but new responsibilities have come to my shoulders regarding cricket. I have already started working on that. The achievements I have as a vocalist have created a kind of responsibility, and I want to fulfill that responsibility properly. So, this is my plan for the newcomers, he also said. Asif will also work with youth in cricket. He has been given the responsibility of the age-based team by the Bangladesh Cricket Board from where the future leaders of the Bangladesh cricket team will emerge. He has already submitted his work plan to the board. Asif said, “I have about 10 songs in the works. I haven’t done them because I was out of the country. I have returned home after a music tour of about two months. Now I have started getting busy with cricket again. I will be busy; I have to move forward with everything. I will do the songs in between. Apart from that, I don’t do songs for all the channels and companies like before. If I have good lyrics and melodies, I produce them myself. I want to make good songs for myself, for my fans and listeners.”

title: Sarika Sabah returns to drama after 2 years
body: Entertainment Report : Small screen actress Sarika Sabah came into the spotlight with the drama series ‘Family Crisis’. She became a regular face on the small screen. However, she became irregular from mid-2023. After a break, Sarika returned to acting through the web series ‘Gulmohar’. The series was released last May. This time, she returned to drama after two years. The drama ‘Emon Dine Taare Bola Jay’ starring Sarika Sabah was released on YouTube last Thursday. The drama was made by Zahid Pritom. Sarika was seen in a special role in it. Although the scope of the character was small, the character of Roshni played by her impressed the audience. Apart from Sarika, Towsif Mahbub, Mir Rabbi, Priyonti Urbee and others also acted in this drama. Sarika Sabah said, “The second inning of my career has begun. With this drama, I worked on a fiction after two years. I mainly took a break for two reasons. The first is fitness. I didn’t want to see myself that way. And the second reason is the ‘Gulmohar’ web series. I had to spend a lot of time preparing for it, so I didn’t work on the drama.” Sarika Sabah wants to be a regular in acting again. While talking in this regard, the actress said, “After acting in the drama series ‘Family Crisis’, I had to do the same kind of work, which I didn’t like. This was another reason for the break. I always want to act in different roles. If I get such a role, then I will be seen regularly.” Sarika also said that she will soon appear in front of the audience with some new work.

title: New drama series ‘Moholla’ on Boisakhi TV
body: Entertainment Report : A new drama serial titled ‘Moholla’ is being aired on Boishakhi TV from first day of this month. The drama series is written by Bidyut Roy and directed by Faridul Hasan, based on the story of old Dhaka. The drama serial is being aired every Saturday, Sunday and Monday at 8:40pm. In the story of the ‘Moholla’, it can be seen that eternal rivals Masum and Babu get into a conflict over a minor incident in a neighborhood of old Dhaka. Their enmity is hereditary. Masum’s father, Hakim Munshi, and Babu’s father, Belayet Sardar, once had a deep friendship. But for some reason, they became enemies. Because of their sons Masum and Babu, that enmity does not decrease, but rather becomes more pronounced. On the other hand, Masum and Babu love former councilor Bijli’s two daughters, Aduri and Moyna. The story progresses through various complications. The series stars Zaher Alvi, Tonmoy Sohel, Irene Sultana, Iffat Ara Tithi, Abdullah Rana, Reshmi Ahmed, Siam Mridha, Rocky Khan, Mukit Zakaria, among others.

title: I’ll marry without getting into love relationship: Durefishan
body: Durefishan Saleem is a popular Pakistani actress. She made her debut by playing a supporting role in drama ‘Dil Ruba’. She then won hearts of the audience with her acting skills. She has gained immense popularity in Bangladesh by playing role of ‘Shibra Shahmir’ in drama ‘Ishq Murshid’ with Bilal Abbas Khan. Recently, rumours of Durefishan’s love marriage with Bilal have started circulating on social media. Meanwhile, an old interview of Durefishan has gone viral. In an old interview, presenter asked her, “What are your thoughts on a boyfriend?” Durefishan replied, “I will never get into a romantic relationship with anyone. I will marry straight away without falling in love.”

title: What Aishwarya thinks about separation
body: Bollywood’s popular couple Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Abhishek Bachchan are often the subject of divorce rumors. Although neither of them has commented publicly on the matter, an old interview has recently resurfaced, in which Aishwarya shared her views on marriage and divorce. In 2009, Aishwarya and Abhishek attended a programme hosted by American television star Oprah Winfrey. In the programme, Aishwarya reacted to the question of host. She said, “We don’t let such thoughts enter our minds. Marriage is a lifelong commitment for us, the joy of being with family is the real thing.”

title: Zayed Bhai is all girls’ favourite: Nusraat Faria
body: Nusraat Faria is a glamorous actress of Dhallywood. Her stylish look and smooth acting have brought her immense popularity. She participated in the 39th FOBANA Convention held in Canada last month. She performed at the gala night there. Talking about an experience from that trip, the actress highly praised her colleague Zayed Khan. Faria said, “Zayed Bhai is a sweet-hearted person. He is becoming more handsome day by day. He is doing a lot of workouts and workouts. I think he has become the favorite of all the girls in Bangladesh now.”

title: AI causing fear in Hollywood
body: Hollywood is in a state of fear over AI. Especially those who read the industry’s scripts (script readers) are in this fear. Their job is to read the stories of movies or series, point out mistakes and give suggestions on how to make the story better. But now they have only one fear, that AI will soon take away this job. This is according to a report by the international entertainment media outlet Variety. An experiment has also begun to see who can give better opinions, humans or AI.

title: ‘King’ Title Reveal: Silver-haired Shah Rukh Khan stuns in a bold new look
body: NN ONLINE: Produced by Red Chillies Entertainment and Marflix Pictures, King is slated for release in 2026. On his birthday, Shah Rukh Khan received a special gift for fans — director Siddharth Anand unveiled the title reveal video of their upcoming film King, marking the duo’s second collaboration after Pathaan. The title reveal video celebrates SRK’s legendary career and serves as a birthday tribute from Siddharth Anand. In the teaser, Khan appears in a powerful, never-before-seen avatar, introduced with the line, “Sau deshon mein badnaam, duniya ne diya sirf ek hi naam” — King. Fans were quick to spot a clever Easter egg: SRK brandishing a King of Hearts card as a weapon. His ashy hair, trademark ear accessories, and striking presence have already set social media abuzz. Promising a completely fresh take on the superstar, King teases a thrilling reinvention of SRK that’s set to captivate audiences worldwide. Billed as a slick, high-octane action entertainer, the film aims to redefine cinematic style, charisma, and energy. Touted to be Siddharth Anand’s most mass-appealing project yet, King will elevate his signature brand of action filmmaking to an all-new level. The film is scheduled to hit theatres in 2026.

title: Fans gather outside Shah Rukh Khan’s Mannat to celebrate his 60th birthday
body: NN ONLINE: As the clock struck midnight in Mumbai, the streets outside Shah Rukh Khan’s residence, Mannat, were filled with fans celebrating the superstar’s 60th birthday on Sunday. Devoted fans from across India gathered to wish the “King of Bollywood” and catch a glimpse of him on his balcony. Crowds held banners and posters reading “We love you SRK” and “Happy Birthday King Khan,” while chanting his name. Many traveled long distances to join the celebrations. Among them was Prince Singh, a devoted fan from Kolkata and member of the “SRK Warriors.” He told ANI, “We undertook a 33-hour train journey just to catch a glimpse of SRK. We hope to see him today or tomorrow. It was difficult to reach here because thousands want to come, but the police are controlling the crowd.” Shah Rukh Khan’s journey from a young soldier in the TV series Fauji to one of the world’s biggest movie stars has inspired fans across generations. Born and raised in Delhi, he first appeared as Abhimanyu Rai in Fauji in 1989, quickly winning hearts. He later acted in Circus and other television shows before making his Bollywood debut in 1992 with Deewana, earning the Filmfare Award for Best Male Debut. His breakthrough came with Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge in 1995, where he played Raj, a charming NRI in love, earning the title of the ultimate “King of Romance.” Over the years, he has delivered memorable performances in films such as Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham, Swades, Devdas, and My Name Is Khan, strengthening his bond with audiences. Even at 60, Shah Rukh Khan continues to dominate both the box office and the hearts of millions of fans, who eagerly await his next project, King.

title: Mim awaits new film
body: Entertainment Report : Although she is a film actress, Bidya Sinha Mim is also a popular model. She serves as the brand ambassador for some of the country’s top companies. It is often said that among all the celebrities in Bangladesh, Mim represents the highest number of brands. Every month, she stays busy shooting new commercials for different products. In early November, she is scheduled to travel to the Maldives for a new advertisement for Berger. Upon her return, news of her next film might be announced. Mim last appeared on the big screen in ‘Poran’, directed by Raihan Rafi, which was released during Eid-ul-Azha in 2022. Since then, she has acted in ‘Damal’ by the same director and ‘Antarjal’ by Dipankar Dipon, but none have matched the impact of ‘Poran’. Mim said, “If I wanted, I could have done 10 to 15 films after ‘Poran’. But they wouldn’t have been of the same quality. I’m waiting for good projects.” Mim believes it’s better not to act in any film than to do a dozen substandard ones in a year. In her words, “It’s not like I’ll do a film just because someone offers it to me. It’s better not to act than to work in low-quality films. There’s no point in disappointing the audience’s expectations.” In recent months, Mim has read scripts for nearly half a dozen films, most of which she liked. She is currently in talks with several directors, and an exciting announcement from the actress is expected soon.

title: Sunerah changes herself
body: Entertainment Report : Modelling, cinema, OTT, television dramas – Sunerah Binte Kamal has showcased her talent in every medium. Sunerah said, “I’m constantly working and keeping myself involved in different forms of work. This way, my schooling in acting has been ongoing. Acting is such a vast field that I can’t really say how mature I’ve become in it. I’m a workaholic. I feel frustrated when I’m not working. Now, I find joy only through my work.” In 2019, she received the National Film Award for Best Actress for her performance in the movie ‘No Dorai’. She was also praised for her acting in the short film ‘Moshari’. During Eid-ul-Fitr, her film ‘Daagi’ was released, followed by Tanim Noor’s film ‘Utsob’ on Eid-ul-Azha. Sunerah’s films are known for their character variations – she appears in a completely different role every time. When asked about this, she replied, “I love taking on challenges. Every time, I’ve enjoyed the challenging process of becoming the character. For an actor, that’s where the true peace and fulfillment lie.” Sunerah began her journey in television dramas in 2022 with ‘Shunnyo Theke Shuru’, acting alongside Tahsan. Since then, she has appeared in one after another drama, portraying diverse characters in different stories. Although she started as a film actress, Sunerah is now more active in TV dramas. Why is that? She explained, “There’s no particular reason. I’m always learning. I’ve done films and OTT projects. One of my seniors advised me to try acting in dramas to gain experience in that arena. I took that advice and gave it a try. In doing so, I somehow became a regular in TV dramas.” Recently, Sunerah joined a TV serial for the first time – ‘Eita Amader Golpo’, directed by Mohammad Mostafa Kamal Raz. The actress said, “This is my first time acting in a TV serial – a completely new experience. Honestly, I can’t sit idle anymore. Doing nothing makes me feel depressed. While working in films, there are often long gaps between projects. I’ve also taken acting courses regularly. I can’t afford to waste my free time – I have to keep practicing acting continuously. Acting in dramas helps me do that. Whether it’s drama, OTT, or cinema – it’s all acting. However, each medium has its own unique characteristics. Acting isn’t just about showing your face on screen – it’s a spiritual connection.” A few years ago, everyone knew Sunerah as a lively and outgoing girl who loved spending time with friends, chatting, and hanging out. But now, she has changed. When asked why, she said, “I’ve become more responsible now. I have my family – my parents and younger brother – we’re a happy family. So, I don’t spend much time outside work. Everyone says I’ve become much calmer. Honestly, people change over time – for different reasons, in different ways.”

title: I deserve more than you can imagine: Ankhi
body: Entertainment Report : National Film Award-winning singer Ankhi Alamgir recently shared a Facebook post revealing that she is deeply annoyed and angry. The post has sparked discussions among her fans. On October 31, Ankhi wrote, “I am very angry and irritated. Angry-because I’m tired of the drama and acting of some people around me. How beautifully they fool everyone, weaving stories with overconfidence, acting and pretending… I want freedom from hypocrisy. I want freedom from this smell. I want a quiet, independent, and peaceful life now.” Expressing frustration with herself as well, Ankhi also said, “I’m irritated with myself. I wish I didn’t have to understand so much. I used to sense and understand everything just by hearing and seeing. But now, with age and experience, I can smell and feel anger, jealousy, and lies.” She ended her post saying, “Believe me, I deserve more than you can imagine.” Ankhi didn’t specify whom she was referring to in the post. However, many believe her words reflect a sense of exhaustion and a yearning for peace within her. Ankhi Alamgir’s most recent release was the song ‘Prem Byapari’, a duet with singer Pulak Adhikari.

title: Mamo in presentation
body: Entertainment Report : National Film Award-winning actress Zakia Bari Mamo has joined as the presenter of the popular investigative and report-based programme Prekkhapot. Starting from November 1, Mamo has been seen hosting this awareness-oriented show. When asked why she took on the responsibility of presenting such a programme, the Lux superstar said, “I took up the responsibility out of social commitment. Prokkhopot highlights the problems surrounding our society and explores possible solutions.” The programme airs every Saturday at 8:00pm on the private television channel News24.

title: Priyanka surprises everyone with snake
body: Priyanka shocked everyone by wrapping a snake around her neck. Dressed in a white top and denim jeans, the actress stunned fans with the sight of a snake hanging from her neck. She shared several photos and videos featuring the snake. In one video, her husband Nick Jonas is heard saying, “I really like your new jewelry.” Priyanka replies with a smile, “Thank you, but this isn’t jewelry-it’s a real snake.” While Priyanka appeared comfortable posing with the snake, it was quite clear from the video that Nick was terrified, which amused Priyanka even more. Though she seemed eager to befriend the snake, Nick preferred to keep his distance. In addition, Priyanka shared several older photos of herself posing with snakes for her fans.

title: Golden Globe-winning actor becomes a father at seventy
body: Golden Globe-winning American actor Kelsey Grammer has become a father at the age of seventy. His fourth wife, Kate Walsh, has given birth to a son. The couple has named him Christopher. This is Kelsey’s eighth child. The news of the star actor becoming a father has created a buzz on social media. Many have commented that, just like his acting career, he has surprised people in his personal life as well. Kelsey’s fourth wife, Kate Walsh, is currently 46 years old. The couple got married in 2011.

title: How Sara Ali Khan avoids criticism
body: Sara Ali Khan is a star kid and an actress herself, so the inconveniences of fame are nothing new to her. Sara says, “I keep reminding myself that criticism of my work helps me learn, grow, and improve – I respect that. But if the criticism feels personal or seems like an attempt to belittle me, I don’t let it affect me. The most important thing is knowing who I am, what my values and purpose are, and staying connected with the people who know me beyond the screen.”

title: Puja not thinking about her marriage now
body: “I’m not thinking about marriage right now. Marriage, to me, means the end of a chapter in life. I’m currently focused on my career, and marriage can come later. For now, I want to stay busy with films. I feel like there’s still a lot more work to do and a long way to go. If I get married before going far enough, it would feel like getting stuck halfway,” actress Puja Cherry said.

title: Tania Bristy returning to film after long break
body: Entertainment Report : Tania Bristy started her film career with Akram Khan’s ‘Ghasful’ in 2015. After that, she acted in a few more films, but she did not get success on the silver screen. Later, she settled down on the small screen. The last film ‘Goyendagiri’ starring Tania Bristy was released in 2019. However, the film was shot two-three years ago. Tania is returning to the big screen after a long break. She will be seen in Raihan Khan’s movie ‘Tribunal’. When will she be seen in a movie again? Tania Bristy is often faced with such a question. The actress has always said that she is not thinking about movies right now due to her busy schedule in dramas. However, she has never ruled out the possibility of returning to movies. The actress said that she will return to movies if she gets a good story and character. Finally, the wait is over. Tania Bristy is shooting for a movie again after a break of almost a decade. The story of the movie ‘Tribunal’ is a mixture of courtroom drama and crime thriller. Apart from Tania Bristy, it also stars Tariq Anam Khan, Ador Azad, Mousumi Hamid, Rakib Hossain Evon, Saira Akhter Jahan, Milon Bhattacharya and others. The shooting of the movie Tribunal began in Chattogram earlier this month. It will continue for a few more days. Yesterday, director Raihan Khan shared a picture from the shooting and announced the news of this new movie. In the picture, Ador Azad is seen standing in a tunnel and talking about a deep topic with Milon Bhattacharya. A cigarette is on his lips, and a look of concern is on his face. Milon is trying to explain something by placing his hand on Adar’s shoulder. In the caption, Raihan Khan wrote, “This is not a poster, but something is happening. In the dim silence of a tunnel, two people are talking, a conversation that could change their fate. Where there is no court, no gavel, yet the truth is on trial.” It is learned that the film ‘Tribunal’ is being based on a true story, a story that raises questions about justice, morality, and the politics hidden behind every verdict. When contacted to discuss the new film, Tania Bristy did not respond. It is learned that she does not want to talk about the film until it is officially announced. The filmmaker wants to complete the work of ‘Tribunal’ within this year. The film is planned to be released in theatres early next year.

title: Sonu Nigam gets applause for stopping his song during call to prayer
body: Agencies : Sonu Nigam once objected to the sound of the Azan waking him up in the morning. There was a lot of criticism about that. Now, the same Sonu has set an example of harmony by stopping his song for the Azan. He has received praise. The video of that concert has gone viral on social media. In April 2017, Sonu Nigam got into a controversy by making negative comments about the call to prayer. At that time, there was a mosque in front of the house where he lived. Sonu’s comment added fuel to the fire. A controversy began. he effects of that controversial comment have been lingering in Sonu’s life for years. It has not completely faded yet. However, this time, the singer has set a new example by removing the past Azan and controversy. Sonu Nigam went to Srinagar, Jammu and Kashmir, to sing for the first time on October 26. His solo concert was at the SK International Conference Centre in Dal Lake. However, a few days before the concert, Sonu’s old comments about the Azan spread again among the people of the region. There were calls for a boycott of the concert. As a result, the attendance at the concert was not as expected. Many seats were empty. However, despite being labeled a ‘flop concert’, the singer won the hearts of the people there with his qualities. He said, “The call to prayer will start now, please give me two minutes.” After the call to prayer, he resumed the programme. The audience also applauded Sonu Nigam.

title: Katrina’s secret photo taken outside her home
body: Agencies : For a few days now, it has been rumoured that Bollywood actress Katrina Kaif is pregnant. After this news, the paparazzi have been paying more attention to the actress. Whenever they get a chance, they are taking pictures of the baby with the camera pointed at them, and even publishing them. At such a time, there has been an incident where Katrina Kaif’s private photos were secretly taken and shared on social media; which has drawn sharp criticism from her fans as well as Bollywood stars. According to Indian media reports, Katrina was enjoying a private moment on the balcony of her luxurious sea-facing apartment in Juhu, Mumbai, on Friday. At that time, a picture of her was taken from outside; and it was published on social media. After it went viral, questions have been raised about the invasion of the actress’s privacy; her fans and co-stars have erupted in anger. It is learnt that the pictures were published on a popular news portal in India. When the pictures quickly spread on the internet, questions were raised about the ‘audacity’ of the paparazzi. Bollywood actress Sonakshi Sinha strongly protested against the incident. She said, “What is your problem? You are secretly recording a woman in her own house without her permission and publishing those pictures on your portal, you are no less than criminals. Shit, shameful!” After this incident, Katrina’s fans demanded immediate police action. They raised the question, “Why can’t a star maintain privacy even in her own home?” This kind of paparazzi harassment is not new to Bollywood.

title: Hard preparation that Afran Nisho is undergoing for his new movie
body: Entertainment Report : Actor Afran Nisho is going to start shooting for his third movie ‘Domm’. The actor does not want to leave any stone unturned for that movie. He is preparing hard. He is working hard. On October 29 evening, the shooting of the movie ‘Domm’ was held at the Gulshan Shooting Club in Dhaka. Nisho was present at the event. There, Nisho said that he took on many challenges physically and mentally for this movie. Nisho is facing a huge challenge for the film ‘Domm’. As per the instructions of director Redoan Rony, he has to reduce his weight to 75kg. Nisho said that in his second film ‘Daagi’, his weight was 95kg to 97kg. Now he is at 83kg. He has already lost 12kg. He has to reduce it further to 75kg. While talking in this regard, Nisho said, “After the total draft was ready in a month or a month and a half, the pressure of losing 20kg in one month is not humanly possible.”

title: Chanchal doesn’t say anything for fear of trouble
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actor Chanchal Chowdhury has been very quiet recently. Once he was vocal on socio-political issues. But now he seems to be speaking calculatedly. Why? He himself gave the answer. He said, “Given the situation in the country, if you say something, you will get into trouble. So, I don’t say it.” Chanchal made this comment while attending the screening of the movie ‘Doom’ on October 29. The incident took place at an event organised at a club in the capital. Although it was meant as a joke, the actor’s words had a hint of reality. On the day of the mahurat, the film’s heroine Puja Cherry made a dramatic appearance. She was brought in a palanquin. After getting down from the palanquin, Puja said with a laugh, “When I was inside, everyone was very confused about letting me down. It seems no one loves me.” At that time, in response to Puja’s words, Chanchal smiled and said, “Given the situation in the country, if you say anything too much, you will get into trouble. That’s why I am keeping quiet.”

title: Alizeh deletes all photos, posts out of embarrassment
body: Alizeh Shah is one of the beautiful actresses of Pakistan. But there is a discussion about her – she often disappears from social media. Recently, the actress deleted all her Instagram photos; As a result, this actress is in the discussion again. Alizeh used to share difficult times in his life with his fans on social media. Later, she realised that it was an expression of emotionality and instability. That is why she has now deleted those old posts of her. When the actress’s decision was discussed, Alizeh clarified the matter herself in a video message. She said she felt ‘happy and ashamed’ at the same time. She also admitted that she didn’t understand herself as much as she used to.

title: I respond only when I feel limit has been crossed: Sonakshi
body: Bollywood actress Sonakshi Sinha often faces trolls, sometimes about her personal life, sometimes about her body. Netizens also had to hear a lot of things because she married a Muslim boy. But in a recent interview, she told how she handles these situations. Sonakshi said, “I rarely respond to them. But when I do, I have to understand that they have crossed the line. Usually I ignore them. But sometimes I think – who are you? How dare you say such things to me? A stranger sitting across the computer and you are going to insult me? Well, now I will show you.”

title: Shah Rukh’s joke about Aryan’s power
body: Bollywood star Shah Rukh Khan created a stir with his mere minute-long appearance in Aryan Khan’s first web series ‘Bads of Bollywood’. This was King Khan’s first work under his son’s direction. However, recently, Shah Rukh came into the discussion by joking about Aryan’s direction. For the first time, the audience has been filled with love for such a father-son equation through ‘Bads of Bollywood’. In the wake of this, the Bollywood King is facing the question of whether Shah Rukh will ever act in a film directed by Aryan Khan. Shah Rukh responded in a Q&A session with fans on social media. He jokingly said, “Does he have the power to cast me? How much of my nagging will he tolerate?”

title: Anonno Mamun’s post about Tamannaah
body: Dhallywood director Anonno Mamun has given a glimpse of a new thrill. The director recently posted a picture of popular Bollywood and South Indian film star Tamannaah Bhatia on social media, which has created a lot of excitement among movie lovers. Mamun made a special post on his verified Facebook profile. There, he uploaded a picture of Tamannaah looking stunning in a lack dress and highlighted some important points about the professionalism of the film industry. Mamun writes, “Despite being such a big artiste like Tamannaah, she has no arrogance.”

title: Arijit Singh coming to Dhaka
body: Entertainment Report : Arijit Singh is a popular Indian singer. He has won the hearts of both Hindi and Bengali audiences. He has numerous fans outside India as well. His concerts are filled with ecstasy and overflowing crowds. Arijit is coming to Bangladesh to sing after almost a decade. Arijit’s arrival in Bangladesh has been confirmed by the online ticketing platform ‘Tomorrow’. A video was shared on the Facebook page of Ticket Tomorrow platform on Tuesday night. The video, made by collage of scenes from various concerts, shows Arijit performing on stage. The song ‘Ilahi Mera’ from the movie ‘Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani’, sung by him, is playing in the background. The caption reads, “Arijit Singh Live in Dhaka.” Ever since the announcement of Arijit Singh’s concert in Dhaka, there has been a lot of interest among fans. There are numerous comments in the comments section of the post, almost everyone has one question – when will Arijit come, when will the concert tickets be available. However, despite announcing Arijit Singh’s arrival in Bangladesh, the Ticket Tomorrow platform has not revealed the venue, date, and organisers of the concert. When contacted to find out about this, the platform said that Ticket Tomorrow is the ticketing partner for this event. Advance tickets will be available on this platform, and the date will be announced in due course.

title: Puja to star in film ‘Domm’, dispelling all rumours
body: Entertainment Report : About two years ago, director Redoan Rony announced a new movie. He had said that Chanchal Chowdhury would star in a movie titled ‘Domm’. Last July, it was announced that Afran Nisho would be in it with Chanchal Chowdhury. Since then, speculations have started about the heroine of ‘Domm’. Many names including Jaya Ahsan and Swastika Mukherjee were being heard. Puja Cherry was the most discussed. However, news spread since yesterday morning that Mehazabien Chowdhury would be the heroine of ‘Domm’. Finally, all the rumours were dispelled and Puja Cherry’s name was announced as the heroine of ‘Domm’ at the movie’s mahurat on Tuesday evening. Puja Cherry was introduced dramatically at the mahurat ceremony. After the two actors Chanchal and Afran Nisho finished speaking at the ceremony, the heroine entered riding a palanquin. Nisho brought Puja down from the palanquin, which was surrounded by a curtain. Puja looked really nervous while talking about the movie ‘Domm’. The heroine said that she had prepared a lot of things to say, but she got confused on the stage. At this time, Puja said that she was finalised for the movie ‘Domm’ after auditioning. Puja Cherry said, “Thank you to everyone involved in the film ‘Domm’ for including me in this film. I had to audition for the character in this film. After that, I was finalised. Although I worked with Chanchal Dada in my childhood, this will be my first time working with Nisho Bhai. I hope that together we can give a good work.” The film is based on a true story of survival. The poster released two years ago showed a boy kneeling in front of a donkey in a desert surrounded by mountains. He is blindfolded. It is believed that the film will depict the struggle of expatriates who migrated to different countries in the Middle East in the hope of a better life. Although Saudi Arabia and Jordan have been mentioned as the shooting locations for the movie ‘Domm’, the makers have planned to shoot the film in Kazakhstan. The shooting will begin soon. The movie is being produced by SVF-Alpha Eye Entertainment Limited and Chorki. ‘Domm’ will be released on Eid next year.

title: Many people call me lady superstar: Subhashree
body: This time West Bengal actress Subhashree Ganguly will be seen in role of a journalist on screen. Her next series ‘Anusandhan’ awaiting to release. In this series, directed by Aditi Roy, Subhashree will be seen in role of a crime journalist Anumita. Subhashree is often referred to as ‘Lady Superstar’ by the media and fans. In this context, she said, “Many people call me a lady superstar. But have you ever heard the word superstar being used to refer to any actress anywhere? This is also our mindset. Maybe it will change slowly.”

title: Salman earns hundreds of crores just by hosting
body: The 19th season of popular reality show ‘Bigg Boss’ is going on now. Every year, Bollywood star Salman Khan is at the centre of the show’s discussion. Before the start of the new season, there were many rumours about his remuneration. Salman takes a fee of over 100 crores. Amidst these rumours, ‘Bigg Boss’ producer Rishi Negi has now opened his mouth. In an interview, he said, “I will not comment on Salman’s remuneration. It is a matter of agreement between Salman and Jio Hotstar. But I can say, ‘Salman deserves to get the remuneration he gets.’”

title: Sonakshi’s debut in South Indian movie
body: Actress Sonakshi Sinha has finally crossed the boundaries of Bollywood and is making her debut in South Indian movie. The shooting of her first Telugu film ‘Jatdhara’ has already been completed. Sonakshi says that her first experience was very different and challenging. Sonakshi will be seen in an unusual role named ‘Dhanpishachini’ in the film ‘Jatdhara’. The actress recently shared her experience at the trailer launch of the film. Sonakshi said, “This is the most different role I have played before. The success of an actor is to play different types of roles. To be able to express yourself in difficult roles. I’m really grateful to have this opportunity.”

title: Joy-Mahi ends 14 years of marriage
body: One of the ‘power couples’ of Hindi television, Joy Bhanushali and Mahi Vij, have broken up after nearly a decade and a half of marriage. After 14 years of marriage and parents of three children, the star couple has now called it quits. Joy and Mahi have not been living under the same roof for almost a month. Joy and Mahi Vij’s divorce was rumored since July this year. Although at that time the star couple kept the matter under wraps. A month ago, Mahi also said that she is not obliged to explain her personal life to anyone.

title: Netizens shocked by price of food at Gauri’s restaurant
body: Bollywood star Shah Rukh Khan’s wife and interior designer Gauri Khan’s luxurious restaurant ‘Tori’ is now in the news, but this time it’s about the price of the food. The menu and price list of this Mumbai restaurant have recently been made public, which is being discussed a lot among netizens. Many were shocked to see the prices of food at Gauri’s restaurant. Some even discussed the excessive prices on social media. From that menu, it is known that ‘Tori’ has a variety of international quality dishes – from dumplings, salads to seafood. A plate of dumplings called ‘Tori Veg Gyoza’ costs about 1,500 rupees (about Tk2,200 in Bangladeshi currency).

title: Boyfriend who made Sushmita win Miss Universe title
body: Sushmita Sen is a popular B-town actress and Miss Universe 1994. Although she is not married yet, Sushmita has had multiple relationships in her life. She always loves to discuss this openly. In a recent interview, Sushmita revealed the special person in her life, without whose support she might not have become Miss Universe. The actress’s first boyfriend was Rajat Tara. Sushmita said that Rajat was not only her boyfriend, but also her main supporter in fulfilling her dreams. Rajat even quit his job to help Sushmita become Miss Universe.

title: Liza’s new song composed by Hridoy Khan
body: Entertainment Report : Musician Sania Sultana Liza has sung a new song to the tune of composer and musician Hridoy Khan. The song is titled ‘Nei Odhikar’. Hridoy Khan has also arranged the music for the song, written by rapper Tawfiq Ahmed. The music video of the song was shot in Cox’s Bazar under the direction of Chandan Roy Chowdhury. Mohtaram Billah was the model with Liza in the video. Announcing the new song on Facebook, Liza wrote, “This is a song of loss, a story of silent pain, where there is love, but no demands. This is my first journey with this kind of song. I hope that ‘Nei Odhikar’ will touch your hearts. Stay tuned, our love song is coming soon.” About this new song, Liza said, “The song ‘Nei Odhikar’ is my personal favourite. Because, it has gone beyond the type of songs I sing and tried something different. The lyrics of the song written by rapper Tawfiq Ahmed will touch your heart. Hridoy Khan has put a great tune on those words. Director Chandan Roy Chowdhury has brought those words to life in the video shot in Cox’s Bazar. The director has tried to portray me in a different light in the video. I have also tried to work according to his instructions. Overall, I liked the song ‘Nei Odhikar’. I hope the audience will like it too.” Liza said that the music video for song ‘Nei Anurodh’ will be released on her official YouTube channel tomorrow. On the other hand, Liza is serving as a judge on the children’s music reality show ‘RTV Little Star’. She came to Europe on a musical tour a few months ago. Liza performed in France, Belgium, Switzerland, Italy and Spain during a 25-day Europe tour at the invitation of expatriate Bangladeshis.

title: The industry has a lot to offer, age is not an issue: Tamannaah
body: Agencies : South Indian actress Tamannaah Bhatia once believed that actresses are no longer cast in glamorous roles on screen after they reach a certain age, but now she feels that this idea is completely wrong. In a recent interview, Tamannaah said that even after crossing the 30s, actresses are working in many roles that were previously only done by younger people. The actress said, “I thought I would work for 10 years. When I turned 30, I would get married, have a family, and raise children because before, no one would cast a young actress except her. I thought so after seeing that trend. But I’ve been working in the industry for over 30 years. Now I feel like I have a lot more to give to my industry. Age doesn’t matter anymore.” After two decades in acting, Tamannaah Bhatia is now seeing that the nature of work has changed. In her words, “Nowadays, separate characters are being created for middle-aged actresses. Those characters also have considerable importance on screen.”

title: What Durefishan says jokingly
body: Agencies : Popular Pakistani actress Durefishan Saleem is facing a lot of criticism on social media for her recent comments on a television show. Durefishan was a guest on actress Nida Yasir’s Ramadan show ‘Shaan-e-Suhoor’. There, Durefisan revealed that he had once stolen a ‘Jaynamaz’ (prayer mat) from an elite five-star hotel. Durefisan’s confession shocked the show’s host Nida Yasir and co-host Mikael Zulfiqar. The video of that event has gone viral on social media. In it, Durefishan is seen laughingly recounting the incident. The actress said on that event, “I once stole a prayer mat from a big hotel because it was so soft and wonderful.” When the audience laughed at her words, actor Mikael Zulfikar asked in surprise, “Weren’t you ashamed of stealing the prayer mat?” In response, the actress said, “I thought that since I will use it for praying, maybe Allah won’t catch me doing this.” Actor Mikael couldn’t hold back his laughter after Durefisan’s comment. He immediately joked back, “Then those who steal shoes from outside the mosque should also be forgiven.”

title: We had a relationship once: Anirban
body: Agencies : Sohini Sarkar and Anirban Bhattacharya, the two stars of the much-discussed Tolipara, have been the pair that viewers have been wanting to see again and again from the big screen to the OTT platform. There have been rumours of love between the ‘Byomkesh’ Anirban of the screen and his ‘Satyavati’ Sohini for a long time. However, every time it has been buried under the label of ‘just good friends’. Sohini Sarkar has now spoken out about those rumors publicly. Finally, Sohini herself admitted that she once had a relationship with actor Anirban Bhattacharya. Recently, actor-director Anirban Bhattacharya lost his job due to rumors in Tollypara, conflicts between the federation and directors. An Indian news outlet asked actress Sohini Sarkar about this ‘living alone’. In response to that question, Sohini candidly said, “Actually, we are not close; we had a relationship at one time.” Regarding Anirban’s dismissal from work, he further said, “This shouldn’t have happened. Why would a working person be dismissed from work? This shouldn’t have happened. The technician grandparents are also very close to me. We all want the industry to improve, to put it simply.”

title: Ayushmann Khurrana says Thamma is ‘biggest film of career’
body: Actor Ayushmann Khurrana has said he is thrilled with the response to his latest release Thamma, calling it the “biggest film” of his career in terms of opening and audience reception so far. Speaking to ANI, Ayushmann said that public appreciation matters the most to him. “Validation by the public is the biggest validation. This is the biggest opening of my career and hopefully my biggest film as well,” he said. Directed by Aditya Sarpotdar and produced by Dinesh Vijan and Amar Kaushik, Thamma is the fifth instalment in the Maddock Horror Comedy Universe. The film stars Ayushmann opposite Rashmika Mandanna, alongside Nawazuddin Siddiqui and Paresh Rawal. The actor said what excited him most was the chance to move away from his familiar “boy-next-door” roles. “Here, the character slowly transforms — almost like a vampire with superhero traits. I did that for the first time and I have always been a fan of this universe,” he added. Ayushmann said the film’s success is an added bonus. “As an actor, I found the script very exciting. Whatever is happening now is like a cherry on top.” Looking ahead, he confirmed that before a sequel to Thamma, audiences will see Bhediya 2, as the horror comedy universe continues to expand. “I’m excited to see how different characters will merge and clash in upcoming films,” he said. Ayushmann also shared that he will begin shooting Sooraj Barjatya’s next film within days. “It’s a dream to play a character named Prem in Sooraj ji’s film. It’s a family entertainer with something fresh — a film like this hasn’t come out in years,” he said. The actor further confirmed a new project with Yash Raj Films, though the title is yet to be announced.

title: Farin opens up about favouritism in industry
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actress of the small screen Tasnia Farin didn’t act in the movie ‘Projapoti 2’ with Dev due to not getting a visa. The actress was a little disappointed after losing that opportunity. However, another opportunity has come. There has been talk of acting in Aniruddha Roy Chowdhury’s new movie for a long time. Chanchal Chowdhury is also expected to be in it. Farin went to Kolkata to talk to the director about that movie. This time there were no more visa complications. Farin also appeared with Chanchal and Aniruddha at the premiere of Koel Mallick’s ‘Swarthopor’ in Kolkata. She is roaming around Kolkata. She is also giving interviews to the media. Farin is not usually seen talking about the internal issues of the industry in the country. However, in an interview given to Anandabazar Patrika, she opened up about the discrimination between men and women in the entertainment industry. Tasnia Farin said, “My struggle or journey was very difficult. We had to go a long way to increase our salary by one taka. However, a new hero increased his salary after doing two films. His demand was also accepted. There is also the issue of working hours. So, where do we move forward? Even in women-centric films, the heroine is confined to certain boundaries, clichés – either women’s oppression, or women’s rights. No one wants to take us beyond that. There are no films about women’s work, their struggle. However, if that film does not do well, then the blame is placed on the fact that it was a women-centric film. You are not giving that budget to women-centric films. You are not giving a story that can be a hit. But in the case of men, there is no shortage of these.” Farin also talked about marriage.
