There was a time when it was believed that a heroine’s career ended once she got married. That situation has changed a lot now. The actress said, “Acting really has no conflict with marriage. Why should there be a specific age at which a heroine should get married? I will decide what the right time is for me. I see that my work has increased after marriage. Starting from Hollywood to our country, no one bothers about the marriage of heroines anymore.” Although she gained recognition through TV dramas, Farin has been largely absent from the small screen lately. She said that she has focused on the big screen because she is not getting the character she wants in dramas. Tasnia Farin said, “When I worked on the small screen, I didn’t get any film offers that were worth accepting. When I worked on Atanu Ghosh’s film ‘Aro Ek Prithibhi’, I still acted on the small screen. What has happened now, there is nothing new to discover on the small screen. The big screen can satisfy that hunger. That is why I want to see myself on the big screens of both countries. I am in touch with everyone. Opportunities are also coming my way. That does not mean that I will not act on the small screen anymore. That medium is what made me Tasnia Farin.”

title: Arnab’s new song album with poetry
body: Entertainment Report : Shayan Chowdhury Arnab has had a desire to work with poetry for a long time. He wanted to create songs with melodies in poetry. He started the work quite a while ago. It took some time to get everything organised. Finally, after almost 10 years, Arnab is releasing a full album of original songs. His new album titled ‘Bhallage Na’ will be released on October 30. It is being released by Adkhana Music. This album has been arranged with 8 songs. Some of its songs are made from the poems of popular poets, the rest are written by Arnab and his friends. He has created songs based on the poems of various poets of both Bengal including Jibanananda Das, Srijat, Nilanjan Bandyopadhyay. The tunes and music have been composed by Arnab himself.

title: Shabnur 1st time gives her statement on Salman Shah’s death
body: Entertainment Report : The accidental death case filed in the death of film actor Salman Shah has now been accepted as a murder case by the court. Salman Shah’s mother Neela Chowdhury’s brother, Mohammad Alamgir Kumkum filed a murder case as the plaintiff. Although actress Shabnur’s name is not in the initial list of 11 accused in the case, the actress has repeatedly been in the discussion as Salman Shah’s co-star. Shabnur has now settled in Australia. From there, Shabnur made a post on social media on Monday to clarify her position on the matter. She claimed that she does not know how Salman Shah died, and she expects a proper investigation and justice in the death of the hero. Requesting not to spread false propaganda and rumours about Shabnur in the incident of Salman Shah’s death, Shabnur wrote in a post, “Since the matter is currently pending in court, I didn’t want to talk about it at the beginning. But unfortunately, I have noticed that some people are spreading misleading information and false propaganda by linking my name with this case related to Salman Shah for malicious purposes. I strongly condemn these baseless rumors and propaganda about me and request everyone to refrain from spreading untrue and false information.” Shabnur said that she was personally and mentally affected by Salman Shah’s death. She wrote, “Salman Shah was my very favourite co-star. We worked together in about 14 films. Salman was a popular, incredibly powerful and talented actor. I can undoubtedly say that my film career has developed and become brighter by working with him. I was personally deeply affected by Salman Shah’s untimely death. The success of our pair was once a cause of envy for many. After his death, some may have intentionally spread various rumors and confusion about Salman’s relationship with me to save themselves. There has been a lot of turmoil about us, which has hurt me mentally a lot.” Shabnur has claimed that she does not know how Salman died or who killed him. In this regard, she said, “Even today, I want to make it clear that I really do not know how Salman Shah died. I only expect a proper investigation and justice in his death. Whoever is guilty, he should be brought to justice and given due punishment – this is my sole demand and expectation.” Expressing condolences to Salman Shah’s family members, Shabnur wrote, “I can feel the pain of losing a child just by seeing Salman’s mother Neela Aunty’s tears. I express my sincere condolences to the aunty and her family and above all, I pray for the forgiveness of Salman Shah’s soul.”

title: Raihan Rafi, Alimuzzaman receive Fazlul Haque Memorial Awards
body: Entertainment Desk : It was announced earlier that this year’s Fazlul Haque Memorial Award will be given to filmmaker Raihan Rafi and journalist Alimuzzaman. The award, initiated by novelist Rabeya Khatun, was presented to them at a ceremony on Sunday. Each of them received a crest and Tk50,000 as awards and was given an Uttariyo. The awards were presented to them by Shilpakala Academy Director General Poet Rezauddin Stalin, producer Matin Rahman, actor Afzal Hossain, chef Keka Ferdousi and Prokriti O Jibon Foundation Chairman Mukit Majumder Babu, said a press release. A special programme was organised on Channel i to mark the award giving ceremony. A documentary on Fazlul Haque was shown at the beginning of the program. Then the discussion began. Matin Rahman, Rezauddin Stalin, Mukit Majumder Babu, Keka Ferdousi, Afzal Hossain, actress and director Afsana Mimi, musician Khurshid Alam, director Chhatku Ahmed, actor Keramat Maula, Anyaprakash CEO Mazharul Islam, among others, took part in the discussion. The speakers expressed hope that Fazlul Haque would be evaluated at the national level. Director General of Shilpakala Academy said that arrangements will be made to screen the documentary made on Fazlul Haque in branches of the Shilpakala Academy across the country. After the discussion, the award was handed over to producer Raihan Rafi and journalist Alimuzzaman. Raihan Rafi was accompanied by his mother. She sought everyone’s blessings for her son’s award. It is worth noting that this award has been given for the past 22 years in memory of the late Fazlul Haque, the editor of the country’s first film magazine ‘Cinema’ and the director of Bangladesh’s first children’s film ‘Son of Pakistan (President)’.

title: Actor Hasan Masud admitted to hospital
body: Popular actor Hasan Masud is currently hospitalized due to serious illness. He was admitted to a private hospital on Monday night. According to hospital sources, he came to the hospital last night with a severe headache and seizures. After initial tests, doctors advised him to be admitted immediately. The actor is currently undergoing treatment at the stroke unit of Universal Medical College Hospital in Mohakhali. His physical condition is being closely monitored.

title: Kaushani faces ridicule as video goes viral
body: Netizens used to think that being a star in entertainment world meant travelling by air or in a luxury car. However, in last few years, there has been a big change in that perception. Recently, many Tollywood stars have been seen riding trains and buses during the promotions of movies or series. Viewers have become accustomed to seeing such scenes during the promotions of the film ‘Raghu Dakat’. In the viral video, Kaushani, dressed in a very plain outfit, is seen walking on the platform to board the Vande Bharat train. She said, “I boarded the train after almost 20 years. I boarded the train with my parents as a child, and now again. It’s a completely different feeling, which cannot be expressed in words.”

title: What Ahad says about coming to Bangladesh
body: Popular Pakistani actor Ahad Raza Mir is coming to Bangladesh very soon. He himself confirmed this information by sharing a note on his Instagram story recently. Meanwhile, the star also expressed his love for his Bangladeshi fans by sharing a video message on social media. In the video message, Ahad said, “Hi Bangladesh, I am Ahad. I can’t wait to meet you all.” His message has created a lot of excitement among fans in both countries. Basically, the popular South Asian actor is coming to Dhaka to attend a special opening ceremony.

title: Rejecting with respect is bravery: Misty Jannat
body: Dhallywood’s popular film actress Misty Jannat has once again come to the centre of discussion among netizens with a post. In which she mentioned that she considers it true courage to turn down an offer with respect rather than being disrespected by working in a small role in a film. Misty is often in the news due to rumours and various comments about her personal life as well as her acting career. In the caption of the picture, Misty Jannat wrote, “It is brave to reject with respect rather than being disrespected by playing a small role in a movie, no matter how big a star he is. Thank you, the picture was good.”

title: When Salman Khan, Aishwarya Rai, Abhishek Bachchan shared the screen in Dhaai Akshar Prem Ke
body: Salman Khan and Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s relationship was one of Bollywood’s most talked-about love stories in the early 2000s. The two reportedly fell in love while filming Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s Hum Dil De Chuke Sanam and dated for nearly three years before breaking up in 2002. While fans remember their on-screen chemistry from that film, few know that Salman and Aishwarya also appeared together in another movie — one that also featured Aishwarya’s future husband, Abhishek Bachchan. In the 2000 romantic drama Dhaai Akshar Prem Ke, directed by Raj Kanwar, Abhishek Bachchan and Aishwarya Rai played the lead roles, with Salman Khan making a brief cameo appearance. A viral clip from the film, shared on social media platform X, shows Salman as a truck driver, with Abhishek sitting beside him. During the scene, Aishwarya’s character is seen trying to hitch a ride, but Salman drives past without stopping. Later, he drops Abhishek off, telling him he has reached his destination. Following Dhaai Akshar Prem Ke, Aishwarya and Abhishek went on to co-star in several films together, including Kuch Naa Kaho, Umrao Jaan, Dhoom 2, Guru, Sarkar Raj, and Raavan*. The couple married in April 2007 and welcomed their daughter Aaradhya in November 2011. On the professional front, Salman Khan is currently hosting Bigg Boss Season 19 and will next appear in Battle of Galwan, a film inspired by the 2020 India-China border clash. Aishwarya Rai Bachchan was last seen in Mani Ratnam’s Ponniyin Selvan: II (2023), while Abhishek Bachchan recently starred in Kaalidhar Laapata, which premiered on ZEE5 in August.

title: Lalon Sondha’ held at JU
body: NN ONLINE: Jahangirnagar University Central Students’ Union (JUCSU) has hosted a cultural event titled ‘Lalon Sondha 2025’ under the theme “Manush Dhore Shonar Manush Hobi” (The human who holds human values). The event took place on Monday night at the university’s Selim Al Deen Muktamancha, reflecting Lalon’s vision for human connection and equality. The event, aimed at celebrating the life and legacy of Lalon Fakir, the renowned 18th-century Bengali mystic, poet, and folk singer, featured performances of his songs, philosophical teachings, and messages of love, equality, and humanity. The program included performances by various university groups and local artists, showcasing Lalon’s songs. It also featured speeches and discussions around the eternal message of humanity and love that Lalon advocated through his music. The program included performances by Fakir Saheb and his group, followed by cultural presentations by Beauty, Doli Mondal, Sukulal Roy, and the Bowl Songs group. Local artists and university performers also showcased Lalon’s music, offering a blend of spiritual and folk melodies. The programme was attended by Pro-VC (Academic) Prof Dr M Mahafuzur Rahman, JUCSU leaders, students, faculty members from different departments and institutes.

title: I am shocked
body: I am shocked, heartbroken, and deeply frustrated after hearing about the horrific accident on the Dhaka Metro Rail. We pay taxes so that the country’s infrastructure can make our lives easier and better. Yet, with that very tax money, a structure was built that collapsed and destroyed a family’s dreams, love, and future. It’s terrifying. In other countries, people die accidentally by falling onto railway tracks. But in our country, the railway track-or parts of it-falls from the sky onto us! Siam Ahmed

title: A new relationship means a new path with renewed love: Sabnam Faria
body: Entertainment Report : Popular television actress Sabnam Faria has recently remarried, marking her third time entering into wedlock. The actress views the ups and downs of her personal life as a source of strength. At the beginning of her new chapter, she faced various comments and criticisms. Responding to them, Faria wrote an emotional post on her verified Facebook page, expressing herself with great confidence. Faria wrote, “No one gets married thinking that one day the relationship will end. With love, patience, and hope, we all try to make it last. No matter how strong, educated, or successful we are, the heart always wants to hold on-unless there is betrayal.” Drawing from her own experience, she added, “Those who have married more than once do not take pride in their past. After a relationship ends, having the courage to love, trust, and believe again takes tremendous strength. Starting over requires strength, not shame.” Addressing her followers, Faria requested, “Please don’t judge anyone, don’t spread rumours, and don’t speak harshly. Because you never know how hard someone has fought to stand up again with a smile. ” Towards the end of her post, she also reminded everyone about life’s uncertainty, writing, “Be gentle with your words and kind in your actions. Life spares no one, and none of us knows what tomorrow holds.” Sabnam Faria sees her personal struggles as a form of empowerment. In her words, “A new relationship means walking a new path with renewed trust, love, and courage-something that should never be a matter of shame, but rather a renewed faith in life.” Faria’s message has already sparked widespread discussion on social media, with many praising her courage and positive outlook.

title: Sohini confesses her love affair with Anirban
body: Entertainment Desk : Be it OTT or the big screen, the pair of Sohini Sarkar and Anirban Bhattacharya has mesmerised audiences many times. Viewers still remember Sohini’s intelligent presence as Satyabati beside the serious Byomkesh played by Anirban. However, back in 2019, rumours about their romantic relationship made headlines, though neither of them spoke about it at the time. Anirban always said, “Sohini is a very good friend of mine,” and Sohini, too, chose to remain silent. But after marrying musician Shovon Ganguly, Sohini no longer hid her past relationship. In a recent interview, for the first time, Sohini broke her silence and clearly stated, “We were not just close friends – at one point, we were in a romantic relationship.” Her confession instantly reshaped the narrative of the long-standing speculation. Notably, Anirban married actress Madhurima Goswami in November 2020. Recently, rumours have surfaced about trouble in their marriage. Meanwhile, Sohini’s long-term relationship with actor Ranojoy Bishnu ended in 2023. Later, musician ShovonGanguly entered her life, and the two tied the knot on July 15, 2024.

title: Mila performs in South Korea
body: Entertainment Desk : After performing in Canada, this time pop star Mila Islam performed in South Korea. Recently she took the main stage at Yongji Cultural Park, located in the heart of Changwon, as part of South Korea’s 20th Migrant Arirang Multicultural Festival. Mila considered this event a proud moment for Bangladesh, as it presents an opportunity to showcase the country’s culture and Bangla music to the world. She was accompanied by her band members – Enayet (bass guitar), Malcolm (lead guitar), Kakon (keyboard), and Nayeem (drums). After being away from the spotlight for some time, Mila has made a comeback to music. Her song ‘Akashete Lokkho Tara 2.0’ from the film ‘Insaaf’ has become popular among listeners. Meanwhile, Mila is celebrating two decades in her musical journey. Reflecting on this milestone, she said, “Many people call it a long journey, but I don’t want to think of it that way. I still have so much more to give – many stages to perform on, many songs to sing, and many audiences waiting for me. Yes, sometimes when I sit quietly, I wonder, has it really been 20 years? Yet it feels like I just started a few days ago.”

title: Mosharraf hopeful about ‘Bonolota Express’
body: Entertainment Report : Director Tanim Noor is making a film titled ‘Bonolota Express’, based on Humayun Ahmed’s novel ‘Kichhukkhon’. Popular actor Mosharraf Karim will play an important role in the film. Mosharraf said, “I’ve talked to Tanim Noor about ‘Bonolota Express’. I’m hopeful it will be a wonderful project.” The actor mentioned that he joined the film because he liked the director’s vision. The actor added, “It’s based on a novel by Humayun Ahmed, which I’ve read before. It’s a great story. That’s one of the reasons I agreed to be part of it. However, even a good story can be ruined if the director fails to guide it properly. When I choose a film, I pay close attention to the director. After talking to Tanim Noor and understanding his vision, I decided to say yes.” Mosharraf did not want to reveal much about ‘Bonolota Express’ yet. He only said,”Filmmaking is not like factory work-you can’t guarantee how it will turn out. Cinema is a completely psychological game, involving the director, cinematographer, actors, and everyone else. Until the work is done, I prefer not to say much. But I’m very optimistic.”

title: An intimate evening for Katy and Trudeau on her b’day
body: Katy Perry’s birthday was on October 25. That Saturday evening turned out to be special for Justin Trudeau as well. He took his girlfriend out for a walk through the streets of Paris. This time, they made no attempt to hide their relationship-openly revealing their love to the world. On her birthday evening, Trudeau took Katy to a theatre called Crazy Horse Paris, where they enjoyed a cabaret show together. As they were leaving, the couple was captured by paparazzi cameras. Among the fans waiting outside, one handed Katy a rose and wished her a happy birthday.

title: Vidya to share screen with Rajinikanth for 1st time
body: Bollywood actress Vidya Balan is set to share the screen for the first time with veteran South Indian actor Rajinikanth. Directed by Nelson Dilip kumar, the Tamil film Jailer 2 will feature Vidya in an important role. In the movie, she will be seen portraying the eldest daughter of another veteran actor, Mithun Chakraborty. Mithun, known for his iconic Phatakeshto character, will play the antagonist in the film.

title: Anuv Jain coming to Dhaka again
body: After two years, Indian singer Anuv Jain is coming to Dhaka again. The concert has been confirmed by the event management company Triple Time Communications. Last Friday, Triple Time Communications posted a video on their Facebook page announcing the event. Using a video of Anuv’s song, they revealed that the singer will perform in Dhaka next November. Anuv Jain first performed in Dhaka in 2023. In the concert titled “Let’s Vibe Dhaka”, he shared the stage with Bangladesh’s Tahsan Khan, Pritom Hasan, and Jefer Rahman.

title: Twinkle reveals reason behind Karan’s deteriorating health
body: There has long been talk in Bollywood that popular filmmaker and producer Karan Johar lost weight by taking medication. However, Karan claims that his slim appearance is the result of eating less. Now, actress Twinkle Khanna has revealed the real reason. Twinkle said that Karan has reduced his food intake so much that he now eats only one meal a day. That single meal is vegetarian. He has completely given up dairy products and sugar. Some people are shocked after seeing Karan’s recent photos, and his fans are worried about the filmmaker’s health.

title: Baseer Ali and Nehal Chudasama exit Salman Khan’s show
body: NN ONLINE: The latest weekend episode of Bigg Boss 19 delivered a major surprise for fans after a double eviction sent Baseer Ali and Nehal Chudasama out of the house. The twist left viewers stunned, especially since Baseer had been regarded as one of the strongest contenders this season. What happened • The weekend episode hosted by Salman Khan turned emotional as both Baseer and Nehal were declared eliminated. • Fans were bracing for a single eviction, but the makers opted for a surprise double exit instead. • Four contestants — Gaurav, Baseer, Pranit and Nehal — were nominated this week, keeping viewers anxious during voting. • Baseer’s exit shocked many due to his consistent performances and competitive approach throughout the show. • Nehal, meanwhile, had a controversial run, often drawing criticism from housemates and Salman for attention-seeking behavior and unnecessary fights. • This was her second stint in the house after being previously evicted and kept in a Secret Room before re-entering the game. Her departure this time appears to be final. Background This marks the second double elimination of the season, which is being promoted under the theme Iss Baar Chalegi Gharwaloon Ki Sarkar. The show premiered on August 24, 2025, on JioHotstar and Colors TV, and has featured unpredictable turns and shifting alliances. There had been speculation that one of the evicted housemates might once again be sent to a Secret Room for a re-entry. However, reports suggest the makers scrapped the plan, confirming that both Baseer and Nehal’s departures are permanent.

title: Safa Kabir wants to work in films, but she is afraid
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : After gaining popularity in television dramas, everyone’s goal is to act in movies. Recently, some small screen actresses have entered movies. After proving themselves in dramas, Mehazabien Chowdhury, Sabila Nur and Tasnia Farin are proving their worth on the big screen. Actress Tanjin Tisha also started shooting for her first movie earlier this month. While many see this as a positive thing, some are making comments. They are belittling her as a drama artiste. Actress Safa Kabir said that many artistes are losing courage due to such negative comments. She herself is afraid to decide to act in movies due to negative comments. Recently, Safa Kabir said at an event that she also wants to act in films. However, she is afraid of negative comments. While talking in this regard, Safa said, “I have been hearing this question for a long time when I will be seen on the big screen. I also want to see myself in films. But now I am a little afraid. Recently, many good actresses from dramas are doing films. However, some people are mocking them by calling them drama heroines. Such comments are discouraging me. I have not come on the big screen yet, but I am getting scared because of such negative comments.” Last Eid, Sabila Nur became Shakib Khan’s heroine in movie ‘Taandob’. Many small screen artists acted in this movie. At that time, Shakib Khan said that artistes should not be discriminated between small and big screen. In that context, Safa said, “Stars like Shakib Khan should not make this distinction. But why are the others doing it? This is my question. When I hear about discrimination, I feel scared and bad. This should not be done. We artistes want to move from one stage to another. For that, we need everyone’s encouragement and love.” Safa Kabir has been seen less in dramas lately. The actress pointed out the reason, “I was on a break for a while. After an 11-year journey in my career, it seems like I am not getting any new stories and characters. Even if I do get them, they are very few. This is why the amount of work has decreased. However, I hope to be able to give everyone some good news next month.”

title: Purnima dispels breakup rumours, says they are happy
body: Entertainment Report : Suddenly, popular film actress Dilara Hanif Purnima is in the news, but not about acting, about her personal life. For a few days, it has been heard that her marriage with Ashfaqur Rahman Robin is in trouble. There are also reports that the two have separated. News has also been published about this. In such a situation, Purnima, without letting the water flow further, said on social media yesterday that the news of her family breaking up is not true. She is happy with her husband. The news of the separation surprised her. Rumours of Purnima’s breakup arose from a Facebook post she made. In it, she wrote, “Loneliness is much more peaceful, safe, and dignified than losing yourself in a crowd of fake relationships.” That’s when the rumours started. Upon realising the matter, Purnima shared a picture with her husband on October 22. But the rumours did not stop there. Finally, the actress clarified the matter yesterday. Purnima wrote on Facebook, “In good times, people do not lack friends. Most of them are opportunistic artificial friends. They are always busy protecting their own interests. Finding them in bad times is a burden! This is what was meant in the status I gave a few days ago. In fact, the status was written based on everything that happens around every person. At the end of the day, I am also a human being. Like everyone, I have more or less close and distant people. Because of this, I also have to face good-time friends and selfish people. But many people have confused some parts of the article with my family life without understanding it first and foremost!” The actress also wrote, “Some media outlets have published news in their online versions with flashy headlines without verifying the truth, which has surprised and shocked me and my family. The status I have given has nothing to do with family life. With your prayers and love, we are very well with our family and family life, Alhamdulillah.”

title: Tuhin sings ‘Cafe’ song at Coke Studio Bangla
body: Entertainment Report : India’s first Bengali rock band is ‘Moheener Ghoraguli’. In 1976, a group of young people decided to write, sing, compose, and play their own songs. Later, ‘Moheener Ghoraguli’ changed the definition of modern Bengali music. The band has given many timeless songs. One of the most popular songs of this band is ‘Aamar Priyo Caffe’. This song was in the band’s album ‘Jhora Somoyer Gaan’ released in 1996. Later, the song was also used in the movie ‘Kichhu Songlap Kichhu Prolap’. Now, Tanzir Tuhin has sung this popular song of the band ‘Moheener Ghoraguli’ in Coke Studio Bangla. The song titled ‘Cafe’ was released in Coke Studio Bangla yesterday. This song is about an ordinary cafe. A cafe is a place where even a person’s ordinary day becomes a story. Time seems to stand still, voices become low, and each table tells its own story, some people’s first meeting, some people’s last farewell. People come and go, but something always remains. This beloved cafe was born in this eternal silence. In addition to writing the lyrics and melody, Gautam Chatterjee, the founder of the band ‘Moheener Ghoraguli’, lent voice to the song. The new music of the song has been arranged by Shuvendu Das. The new music arrangement includes Afro-Cuban jazz, Latin salsa and Bengali lines. Tanzir Tuhin is accompanied by Brazilian artist Livia Matos and West Bengal’s Gaurav Chatterjee in the song.

title: Manoj returns from Busan, starts shooting
body: Entertainment Report : Television actor Manoj Pramanik went to South Korea last March to take a course in film production. He returned home on October 22, seven months after completing ‘Producing Track’ programme at the Busan Asian Film School. Yesterday, he participated in the shooting of an advertisement. After completing it, he will shoot for two short films and a few dramas. While talking in this regard, Manoj said, “I really missed acting for seven months in Busan. While I was there, we talked about this advertisement. I stood in front of the camera again after seven months. It feels great.” About talking this seven-month course, Manoj said, “This course mainly taught production. Apart from that, we were practically taught how to present a film in the market. We were made to pitch at the market of the Busan International Film Festival. It was very exciting. Apart from that, the style of study, teachers, subjects – everything was good.” Manoj said that the pre-production work of his movie ‘Seyana’ is almost complete. The actor wants to finalise the shoot soon and start shooting in the first half of next year. The movie will be directed by Iqbal Hasan Khan.

title: This is why I pretend to be stupid: Janhvi
body: Bollywood actress Janhvi Kapoor came into the world of acting from a filmy family. She has quickly made her place among the actresses of this generation. But Sridevi and Boney Kapoor’s eldest daughter Janhvi has now opened up about her survival in the industry. Janhvi said that to survive in Bollywood, one has to look ‘foolish’ at times. She said, “To survive in the industry, male actors have to understand the ‘male ego’. I understand that very well. I don’t go into the fight to prove myself most of the time to save myself from this problem, which is why I pretend to be stupid. I think this helps to avoid problems.”

title: Glamorous Mimi in a red saree
body: Apart from acting, popular actress and MP Mimi Chakraborty of West Bengal is always in news for her look and style. This time too, it was no exception, this heroine has already created a stir on social media with a glamorous look. On Saturday evening, Mimi shared a bunch of new photos on her Facebook page, where she is seen wearing a bright red silk saree. With gold jewelry around her neck and hands, the actress is captured in one pose after another with open hair, light makeup, and a confident attitude. The pictures seem to exude tradition and nobility at the same time.

title: Bon Jovi returning to stage after 4yrs
body: Popular American band ‘Bon Jovi’ is returning to the stage after a long time. The band will make a comeback through a European tour after a break of almost four years; it will feature several cities. The band’s lead singer Jon Bon Jovi recently told Sky News about this information. The ‘It’s My Life ‘ artiste is very excited and happy to be back on stage. Jon Bon Jovi expressed his gratitude to his band members and staff, saying that at that time the band’s income stopped. Even in such a situation, his band members did not abandon him, but rather gave him love and brotherhood. In Bon Jovi’s words, “They did not lose faith in me, which helped me continue the fight.”

title: Aparajita returning to small screen
body: After a long break, West Bengal actress Aparajita Adhya is going to return to small screen again. She has worked with great power on the big screen and web series. However, she will on the stage of a special reality show. Aparajita is going to pair up with popular actress Sudipta Chakraborty this time. However, this is not a serial, but a stage for a reality show ‘Lakh Takar Lakshmi Love’ aired on Sun Bangla. The second season of this show is currently going on. Aparajita is one of the special guests of the season.

title: Thamma box office Day 5: Ayushmann, Rashmika’s film nears Rs 100 crore mark
body: Ayushmann Khurrana, Rashmika Mandanna, and Nawazuddin Siddiqui starrer Thamma has crossed Rs 78 crore in just five days since its release, emerging as a strong contender at the box office. The horror-comedy continued its steady run on Saturday, earning an estimated Rs 13 crore on Day 5, taking its total collection to Rs 78 crore. The film recorded a 19.72% occupancy on Hindi screens that day. Thamma opened with Rs 24 crore on its first day, followed by Rs 18.6 crore and Rs 13 crore over the next two days. It has already surpassed the lifetime collections of Varun Dhawan’s Bhediya (Rs 68.99 crore) and the domestic earnings of Sunny Sanskari Ki Tulsi Kumari (Rs 60.35 crore). Ayushmann Khurrana thanked fans on social media, saying the love for Thamma is a blessing from his family, his late father, and the audience. Rashmika Mandanna revealed she faced challenges shooting the song Tum Mere Na Hue after a foot fracture, but continued promotions and shoots against medical advice. The film revolves around a man who transforms into a Betal, a vampiric creature, after a mysterious encounter, leading to a quirky battle between human instincts and ancient evil. The cast also includes Paresh Rawal, Faisal Malik, Geeta Agrawal Sharma, and Alexx O’Nell, with special appearances by Nora Fatehi, Malaika Arora, Sathyaraj, and Abhishek Banerjee.

title: Kona’s ‘Noyoner Alo’
body: Entertainment Report : National Film Award–winning singer Dilshad Nahar Kona is currently enjoying a delightful phase in her musical career. Following the massive success of her song ‘Dushtu Kokil’, the demand for her performances at stage shows both at home and abroad has increased significantly. In the meantime, Kona has completed work on several original songs. Recently, she lent her voice to a new track titled ‘Noyoner Alo’. The lyrics were written by Salma Sultana, with music composed by Shafiq Tuhin. Both Kona and Shafiq Tuhin performed vocals for the song, while Salman Zayem handled the music arrangement. Speaking about the song, Kona said, ‘I can’t recall exactly how many years it’s been since I last sang a song composed by Shafiq Tuhin. But after a long time, I got the opportunity to sing to his tune again. Recently, the respected Runa Laila madam also recorded a song composed by him, which I really liked. Likewise, I loved Noyoner Alo very much. The title itself is beautiful, and so are the lyrics. ’ It is worth mentioning that ‘Noyoner Alo’ is also the title of a popular and commercially successful Bangladeshi film directed by Belal Ahmed, starring Zafar Iqbal, Kajori, and Suborna Mustafa. Many of the songs from that film became memorable hits among audiences.

title: Safa interested in films, also feels fear
body: Entertainment Report : After gaining popularity in TV dramas, most actors aim to transition into films. In recent times, several small-screen actresses have made their debut in movies. After proving their talent on television, Mehazabien Chowdhury, Sabila Nur, and Tasnia Farin are now showcasing their abilities on the big screen. Earlier this month, Tanjin Tisha began shooting her first film. While many see this as a positive step, some have made sarcastic remarks about it. According to Safa Kabir, such negative comments discourage many artists from taking that leap. She herself feels hesitant to act in films because of these remarks. In a recent event, Safa Kabir expressed her desire to act in movies but admitted that negative comments have made her fearful. Safa said, ‘People have been asking me for a long time when I’ll be seen on the big screen. I also want to see myself there. But now, I feel a bit scared. Recently, many talented actresses from TV have started doing films, but some people mock them, calling them ‘TV heroines.’ Such comments discourage me. I haven’t appeared on the big screen yet, but these negative reactions are making me afraid.’ During last Eid-ul-Azha, Sabina Noor starred opposite Shakib Khan in the film Tandob. Many small-screen artists also acted in that movie. At that time, Shakib Khan said that there should be no distinction between small- and big-screen artists. Referring to that, Safa said, ‘A star like Shakib Khan has spoken against this division—so why are others still doing it? That’s my question. Hearing about such discrimination makes me feel scared and upset. It shouldn’t be done. As artists, we all want to grow from one stage to another. For that, we need everyone’s encouragement and love. ’

title: New wave of Asian  performing arts 2025  in South Korea
body: Entertainment Report : The South Korean city of Gwangju came alive from October 2 to 5 as it hosted the international festival “Beyond Borders: The New Wave of Asian Performing Arts 2025”, a vibrant celebration of Asia’s shared creativity and cultural diversity. Organised by the Asia Culture Center (ACC) under the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism of the Republic of Korea, the festival brought together artists from eleven nations, including Bangladesh , Japan, South Korea, China, Thailand, Malaysia, Mongolia, the Philippines, Vietnam, India and Sri Lanka, for four days of dance, music, and theatre that transcended borders and language. Syeda Saheda Begum, Cultural Officer at the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy served as a member of the festival committee overseeing coordination and creative programming. Hasan Zabed, Special Correspondent of NTV, attended as an observer upon the invitation of ACC, reflecting the growing media interest in Bangladesh’s cultural diplomacy. The dance troupe “Kathakia” stole the spotlight with a performance that fused folk rhythms with spiritual grace, earning praise from audiences and critics alike. One Korean spectator described the performance as “pure poetry in motion,” capturing the emotional depth of Bangladeshi artistic expression. The festival opened with “Rhythms of Asia,” a spectacular showcase featuring Korean traditional drums, Japanese dance, and the earthy charm of Bangladeshi folk movement, setting the tone for a celebration of art as a universal language. The second day focused on workshops and exchanges, where choreographers from Japan, Thailand, and the Philippines led interactive sessions exploring modern and contemporary dance. Artists from all participating countries collaborated closely, reaffirming the notion that creativity is humanity’s shared language. Performances on third day ranged from China’s Fan Dance and Thailand’s Khon Mask drama to Sri Lanka’s Kandyan ritual, each presenting distinctive cultural narratives. Bangladesh’s “Kathakia” captivated audiences with its harmonious blend of classical technique and folk spirituality, underscoring the nation’s growing footprint in regional arts. The festival concluded with “Symphony of Unity,” a mass ensemble featuring artists from all eleven countries, weaving together music and movement to symbolise peace and cultural solidarity.

title: Sadia Ayman confesses her love
body: Entertainment Desk : Popular small-screen actress Sadia Ayman and director Redoan Rony’s rumored relationship has been a topic of discussion on social media for the past two years. Until now, neither of them had spoken about it publicly. Recently, there were also rumors that the relationship had ended. To dismiss the breakup speculation, Sadia and Redoan shared a picture together on social media. Finally, Sadia herself addressed the matter in an interview — giving a clear hint about the truth behind the rumors. She appeared on a video streaming show of a local media outlet. The show’s format was fun — participants had to draw a question from a glass jar and answer it immediately. At one point, Sadia picked a note that read: ‘There are rumors that you are in a relationship with director Redoan Rony. So, who are you actually dating now? ’ Reading the question, Sadia smiled softly. Then, with a shy laugh, she replied, ‘There’s always some truth to what people say. ’ The host asked again, ‘So, how true is it? ’ Sadia, smiling bashfully, answered more openly, ‘I’m blushing — that should say enough. There’s nothing to declare outright, nor anything to deny. Since people already believe it, let them. That’s what makes me happy. ’ Becoming a bit serious, she added, ‘What will happen in the future, only Allah knows. Everything is in His hands. All we can do is try. Please keep us in your prayers so that I can stay well. ’

title: Bill Gates in Indian serial
body: The popular Indian television serial Kyuki Saas Bhi Kabhi Bahu Thi aired on Star Plus for eight and a half consecutive years starting from July 2000. In July this year, a second version of this 25-year-old serial began. In an episode aired last Thursday night, Microsoft founder and philanthropist Bill Gates was seen making an appearance. He was shown speaking via video call with the main character Tulsi, played by Smriti Irani. During the conversation, Bill Gates discussed maternal and child health. Notably, the Gates Foundation has been working for many years with the governments of Uttar Pradesh and Bihar in India to reduce infant and maternal mortality rates.

title: Kajol in new controversy
body: Actress Kajol has found herself embroiled in controversy after agreeing with a contentious remark made by Twinkle Khanna. Recently, on the Amazon Prime talk show “Too Much with Kajol and Twinkle,” actress Janhvi Kapoor appeared as a guest. During the conversation, Twinkle commented that a husband’s extramarital physical relationship could be overlooked as a minor mistake. Kajol agreed with her statement. Following the release of that moment’s video on social media, Kajol became the center of heated debate.

title: Kim Kardashian suffers from a dangerous disease
body: She has been experiencing constant headaches throughout the day, and even medication is not helping. Hollywood model and actress Kim Kardashian has shared distressing news about her health. Recently, on her TV show The Kardashians, she revealed that she is suffering from a rare and dangerous disease. It has been reported that Kim is battling a condition known as brain aneurysm. This is a problem that can silently develop inside the body and sometimes remain for a lifetime.

title: Prabhas’ movie to release in Bengali
body: On his birthday, Prabhas announced a new movie. The Telugu superstar turned 46 on October 23. On this special day, the prominent South Indian production house, Mythri Movie Makers, revealed that a new film titled Fauji is in the works. The movie will be directed by Hanu Raghavapudi, known for Sita Ramam, with Prabhas playing the lead role. Alongside Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Kannada, and Malayalam, Fauji will also be released in Bengali.

title: In my 25-year music career
body: In my 25-year music career, I have received immense love from countless listeners and audiences — a truly priceless gift. I have received far more than I deserve. This love is my greatest achievement. I have no unfulfilled desires. I just want to say one thing — thank you for considering me your friend in music. — Tahsan Khan

title: Beyond Borders: A New Dawn of Asian Performing Arts in Gwangju
body: Hasan Zabed: “When art crosses borders, language falls silent — only rhythm, melody, and the resonance of the heart remain.” This timeless sentiment came alive in the South Korean city of Gwangju during the international festival “Beyond Borders: The New Wave of Asian Performing Arts 2025”, held from October 2 to 5, 2025. The event was hosted by the Asia Culture Center (ACC) under the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism of the Republic of Korea — a landmark celebration of Asia’s shared creativity and diversity. A Celebration of Cross-Cultural Harmony Over four vibrant days, the festival united performers and creators from eleven Asian nations — Japan, South Korea, China, Thailand, Malaysia, Mongolia, the Philippines, Vietnam, India, Sri Lanka, and Bangladesh. Through dance, music, and theatre, artists expressed a collective rhythm of humanity that transcended geography and language. Representing Bangladesh, Ms Syeda Saheda Begum, Cultural Officer at the Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy, served as a member of the festival committee, contributing to coordination and creative programming. Mr Hasan Zabed , Special Correspondent of NTV, joined as an observer on the invitation of ACC. Adding a proud artistic chapter for Bangladesh, the dance troupe “Kathakia” delivered an electrifying performance that blended folk rhythms with spiritual grace, earning heartfelt praise from the international audience. “The Bangladeshi performance touched the soul — it was pure poetry in motion,” remarked one Korean spectator. Rhythms of Asia: The Festival Unfolds Day 1 — Rhythms of Asia: The opening night burst into life with the thunderous beats of Korean traditional drums, the delicate poise of Japanese dance, and the earthy charm of Bangladeshi folk movement. The message was clear: Art is not bound by geography; it breathes in every human soul. Day 2 — Workshops & Exchange: Interactive sessions led by choreographers from Japan, Thailand, and the Philippines explored modern and contemporary dance. Artists from all participating countries collaborated, reaffirming that “Art is humanity’s shared language.” Day 3 — Voices of Tradition: The third evening celebrated Asia’s living heritage. From China’s Fan Dance to Thailand’s Khon Mask drama and Sri Lanka’s Kandyan ritual, each performance shimmered with cultural distinctiveness. Bangladesh’s “Kathakia” captivated audiences with a rare harmony of classical technique and folk spirituality. Day 4 — Symphony of Unity: The festival concluded with a mass ensemble featuring artists from all nations, weaving a tapestry of sounds and movements that symbolized peace and unity. The Asia Culture Center: Where Asia Meets the World The Asia Culture Center (ACC) stands at the heart of Gwangju as a symbol of cultural rebirth. Established in 2015 under the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, the ACC embodies Korea’s vision of transforming Gwangju into the “Asian Cultural Hub City.” Built on a site deeply tied to the May 18 Democratic Uprising, the ACC’s architecture honors Gwangju’s human-rights legacy. Its mission extends beyond performance—it seeks to foster cross-cultural understanding, research, and creative collaboration across the continent. The center encompasses five major divisions: ACC Culture Exchange – promoting intercultural dialogue. ACC Children – nurturing creativity among young audiences. ACC Archive & Research – preserving Asia’s cultural heritage. ACC Creation – supporting artists and new works. ACC Theater – showcasing innovative performances and festivals. Through exhibitions, residencies, and festivals like Beyond Borders, ACC has evolved into one of Asia’s most dynamic platforms for creative diplomacy. Bangladesh’s Cultural Footprint Bangladesh’s participation in “Beyond Borders 2025” marks a growing commitment to cultural diplomacy and regional collaboration. The presence of Ms Sahida Begum and Mr Rafiqul Hasan highlighted Bangladesh’s contribution not only as a participant but as an active partner in shaping Asia’s artistic future. “Bangladesh’s art carries both heritage and innovation,” said Ms Begum. “To share that on an international stage is to let the world hear our cultural heartbeat.” An Eternal Resonance As the lights dimmed on the final night, the collective voice of eleven nations lingered in the air—echoing a timeless truth: “True art never recognizes borders; its wings reach beyond the sky.” In Gwangju’s festival halls, where rhythm met silence and tradition embraced innovation, art once again proved to be the universal language of humanity—bridging nations, cultures, and hearts. [The writer is a Special Correspondent, NTV. Reporting from Asia Culture Center, Gwangju, Republic of Korea]

title: Malaika Arora rings in her 50th Birthday
body: NN ONLINE: Malaika Arora marked her 50th birthday in grand fashion on Wednesday, with a glittering party attended by close friends and family. However, as pictures from the celebration surfaced online, many social media users jokingly remarked that “the math isn’t mathing.” The star’s sister, Amrita Arora, and close friend Kareena Kapoor Khan led the flood of heartfelt tributes on Instagram, calling Malaika their “golden girl.” Inside photos from the event showed Malaika posing beside a towering cake decorated with the number 50, surrounded by friends from the film industry. Amrita shared glimpses from the bash, including a photo of the cake, writing: “For all the years of being 50, you are finally 50, my beautiful sister.” In another post, she added, “Mallaaa, you are finally 50. Could there be a better 50-year-old? I love you deep. What a magical night!” Kareena Kapoor also penned a warm birthday message for her best friend, saying, “Happy Birthday, darling Malla. Golden girl, golden birthday! Have the best one ever. Love you.” Photos and clips from the star-studded evening quickly went viral, with fans showering Malaika with praise for her ageless looks — and some playfully questioning if she could really be turning 50.

title: What Nusrat says about Ishaan’s first sibling
body: Tidbits : Nusrat Jahan is a popular actress of West Bengal. From Durga Puja to playing sindoor on Bijoya Doshomi, she has made a name for herself in everything. Maintaining that continuity, she has now added the traditional festival ‘Bhaiphonta’ to her son Ishaan’s life. Her only son Ishaan is now almost five years old. In Nusrat’s words, “He is very small now. But he took a sip, ate sweets. But when it came to giving the gift, he ran away! In the end, I had to give it to him. But this is how we have to explain the importance of these days to the future generation.”

title: ‘Kantara Chapter 1’ creates history at the box office
body: Tidbits : Rishabh Shetty’s ‘Kantara Chapter 1’ has become the highest-grossing Indian film of 2025, surpassing Vicky Kaushal’s ‘Chhawa’, which has been a box office storm for several months. The film not only won the hearts of the audience with its eye-catching earnings worldwide, but also broke all past records. This blockbuster has grossed a total of Rs 809 crore worldwide. As a result, ‘Kantara Chapter 1’ is now the highest-grossing Indian film of 2025, surpassing ‘Chhawa’ (around Rs 807 crore).

title: Self-reliant wife can’t ask for maintenance allowance: Chahal
body: Tidbits : Even after their breakup, Indian cricketer Yuzvendra Chahal and Bollywood dancer Dhanashree Verma are back in the news on social media. Recently, Chahal’s Instagram post has made the internet buzz again. Many people believe that Chahal was actually referring to his ex-wife Dhanashree, citing a Delhi High Court verdict. Chahal shared a screenshot of a court ruling on his Instagram story, which said, “A financially independent wife cannot claim maintenance from her husband. I swear, mother, I will not budge from this decision.”

title: Arjun sends special b’day wishes to Malaika
body: Tidbits : Even though love between Bollywood’s famous couple Malaika Arora and Arjun Kapoor has broken up, Arjun seems unable to forget his old relationship. He is often heard talking about his ex-girlfriend Malaika, and Arjun has even been seen standing by the actress’s side whenever she needs him. Now, the actor has once again fueled that speculation when he sent a special message to Malaika on her 52nd birthday. Wishing Malaika’s ex-lover on her birthday, he wrote, “Happy birthday, always stay at such a high. Keep smiling and always keep looking.”

title: A beautiful day begins with a beautiful attitude: Bubly
body: Entertainment Report : Shobnom Bubly is one of the most talked about heroines of Dhallywood. She shares her favourite moments with her fans from time to time. In continuation of this, the heroine has shared some pictures with her fans, which have caught everyone’s attention. She also gave a message. Bubly is always active on social media, and any new post of hers is always a topic of discussion among her fans. Yesterday (Friday) morning, she posted a bunch of pictures on her official Facebook page; and wrote a positive message in the caption. In the picture, Bubly is seen in a very cheerful mood. She was wearing a black and white mixed flowing top, along with black pants; which brought a new dimension to her style. Along with the stylish sunglasses with large frames, holding her chin in her hand and confident look, she created a mysterious appeal. Not only that, her neat makeup and wavy hair further enhanced her soft beauty. Looking at these pictures of Bubly, it is clear that he is sitting in a sunny environment and enjoying the morning breeze. That is why he wrote in the caption, “A beautiful day begins with a beautiful mindset, good morning.” As soon as the heroine posted these charming pictures, it caught the attention of netizens. Seeing her beauty and positive message, fans poured love and admiration in the comment box. In just a few hours, her post was filled with thousands of likes and comments. It is worth noting that heroine Shobnom Bubly first started her career as a newsreader on television, but later gained wide recognition among the audience through acting in films. The star is regularly praised by her fans and admirers for her acting skills.

title: Aniston has no ‘regrets’ about her decision not to have children
body: Agencies : Hollywood actress Jennifer Aniston, 56, has opened up about her decision not to have children, saying she has now reached a place of ‘peace’ and ‘comfort’ after years of speculation, paparazzi scrutiny and the challenges of motherhood. The ‘Friends’ star recently explained his reasons for being childless on the ‘Armchair Expert’ podcast, insisting that it was now beyond his control. “It’s (not having children) very peaceful,” Aniston told the podcast hosts. “But I will say, there comes a time when it’s completely out of my control. Honestly, there’s nothing I can do about it.” Aniston also spoke about the idea of adoption, explaining why it didn’t feel right to her. “When people say, ‘You can adopt,’ I didn’t want to adopt. I wanted my own DNA to be in a little human being. Whether it was selfishness or whatever, that’s how I wanted it,” Aniston said. Aniston noted that while she has occasionally felt that they might have had better children with a particular partner, that feeling usually passes ‘within three seconds.’ According to her, when things get out of hand, a kind of ‘romanticism’ comes into play. The actress said she tried to get pregnant through IVF treatment after years of speculation about her personal life. In a 2022 interview with Allure magazine, she said she did not freeze her eggs. “I have no regrets,” Aniston says firmly on the podcast. “I feel a little relieved now, because now I don’t have that ‘Can I do it? Maybe, maybe, maybe’ feeling anymore. I don’t have to think about it anymore.” She simply says, “It may not have been in the plan.”

title: Controversial comment by Dev, Subhashree says ‘he said wrong’
body: Agencies : After a long wait, the film ‘Dhumketu’ starring Dev and Subhasree has been released. This blockbuster film is coming to the audience this year after almost a decade. Dev and Subhasree came on stage to promote the film before its release, out of respect for the love of the fans. A new controversy was created by a comment made by Dev. “The mother of two children, Subhashree, no longer has that innocence on her face.” Subhashree was upset by Dev’s words. After this comment, a lot of discussion and criticism started on social media. Meanwhile, Subhashree opened up about the whole matter in an interview given to the Indian media. Regarding coming on stage with Dev to promote the film ‘Dhumketu’, Subhashree said, “Whatever I have done in my life, I have done it honestly. When I said yes to the promotion of ‘Dhumketu’, I said it honestly. To be honest, none of us made any effort to keep our couple alive, no one in the industry did. Only the audience kept our couple alive in love. The fans kept our couple alive. The result of that was that night, and then the storm that broke out on the internet. I can never insult that.”

title: Mousumi Hamid angry about medical system after losing her uncle
body: Entertainment Report : Popular actress Moushumi Hamid is active on social media, sharing the good and bad feelings of her personal life with her fans. Now, the actress has expressed her disappointment and anger over the country’s medical system. She made this known in a post on social media on Thursday afternoon; she posted a picture to express her anger. In that picture, she was originally seen with her recently deceased uncle. In the post, Mousumi wrote, “I brought a healthy man to the ground. My rock star. Now he has become a star in the sky. Rest in peace, uncle.” The actress further wrote, “Your lifeless face was so full of smiles that I will remember that face for the rest of my life. Stay well. I’ll be back soon, maybe. We’ll chill together again soon, aunty.” Then, expressing her anger at the country’s medical system, Mousumi wrote, “My faith in this country’s medical system has been lost forever, forever.” However, the actress did not provide details about why this incident happened to her uncle.

title: Samira Khan Mahi explains the ‘controversial’ film
body: Entertainment Report : Popular small screen actress Samira Khan Mahi, who was the target of ridicule from netizens after sharing a picture on social media, recently opened up about the controversial picture and the controversy in an interview. Regarding the picture, which has faced severe criticism from netizens, Mahi said that the picture was taken on the set of a drama. She said, “Oh Allah! That picture. It is a very controversial picture, why? I will explain it.” She said the picture was taken on the set of a drama titled ‘Bhat Lover’, which was directed by Sokal Ahmed and co-starred Arosh Khan. Mahi said, “I and Arosh did a drama titled ‘Bhat Lover’ on the set of Sokal Ahmed. And the glasses I am wearing are also Sokal Ahmed’s glasses. There was an office scene in this scene, and I said, ‘Take a picture of me.’” In Mahi’s words, “I didn’t have any glasses with me. I told my director, ‘Brother, give me your glasses, I’ll take a picture.’ So when I was putting on the glasses, Arosh was telling me, ‘Mahi, you look like that!’ So I said, Brother, take some pictures of me. Then I took pictures in different poses like this.” Regarding the controversy, Samira Khan Mahi said, “Everyone knows what happened later, it became a very controversial topic. But I want to say that it was not my intention to deliberately cause such a thing.”

title: I have no relationship with anyone now: Bobby
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : Three years ago, producer Shakib Sonnet announced their relationship on social media by wishing film actress Eamin Haque Bobby on her birthday. At that time, the actress herself admitted to the love affair. She said that they are in a beautiful relationship, which started during the shooting of the movie ‘Nolok’. After that, they didn’t talk about their relationship anymore. For a long time, there have been rumours that Bobby and Sonnet’s love has broken. Finally, Bobby opened up about her relationship with Sonnet. She said that she has no relationship with anyone now. When asked about her relationship with Shakib Sonnet, Bobby initially tried to avoid it. Then she said, “This happened a long time ago. It was during the time of the movie ‘Nolok’. I don’t even remember whether I said anything then.” When asked if she is currently in a relationship with anyone, Bobby’s clear answer is ‘no’. Then Bobby said, “I’m busy with work now. Yes, there was definitely something, which is no longer there. But the friendship we had is still there. Apart from that, I have no comment on it.” There are also rumours that Bobby is in a relationship with a businessman named Mirza Abul Bashar Mamun after Shakib Sonnet. Even after Mamun was arrested by the police a few days ago following a complaint made by a businessman, he was introduced in the news as Bobby’s ‘alleged husband’. Does Bobby really have any relationship with Abul Bashar Mamun? When asked, Bobby replied, “I don’t want to worry about such news because, the news is completely false. If I talk about it, they will be highlighted which I don’t want. They have made news using my name in a problem just to increase TRP. I had a discussion with that person about my restaurant business, nothing else. But if you throw mud on this, I will resort to the law.” Bobby recently returned from Australia. Before leaving, she shot for the movies ‘Bou,’ directed by K A Niloy and ‘Shironam,’ directed by Anik Biswas. After returning from Australia, Bobby is now busy shooting for Badiul Alam Khokon’s film ‘Tochhnochh’. Her co-star in this movie is Munna Khan. Munna Khan is also the producer of this movie. Misha Sawdagor, Deepa Khandakar, Joyraj and others are also acting in this movie. Regarding talking about acting in this film, Bobby said, “I started shooting for the movie ‘Tochhnochh’ after returning from Australia. The shooting is going on in a grand manner. I hope I can present a good movie for the audience.”

title: No alternative for presentation to enliven a prog: Tahnia Yasmin
body: Maria Mahmud : Presenter Tahnia Yasmin, hailed from Satkhira, who was born in Nrityananda Kati, North 24 Parganas, India, in her aunt’s house. She was naturally grown up in a cultural environment. Her smile won everyone’s hearts before her time. Raised in a cultural environment, Tahnia expressed a deep interest in dance, singing, and poetry recitation in her childhood. Her pure pronunciation and style of speech attracted everyone’s attention. Her grandfather and grandfather were pioneers of stage drama. They inspired her. Tahnia does not want to come under the spotlight. She has always prioritised her education. After completing her honours and master’s degrees in Bengali Language and Literature, she is now celebrating the ‘joy of creation’. According to Tahnia, talks less, listens more. Regarding the presentation, Tahnia said, “This is an art. There is no alternative to presentation to enliven a programme. I am a vocal warrior.” Tahnia, who has been involved in journalism since 2020, has been regularly doing news presentation, reporting, and programme presentation. Currently, she is a regular presenter of the popular magazine show ‘Nibedon’ of Bangladesh Television (BTV) Chattogram Centre. The programme has received wide audience popularity. (Maria Mahmud is doing Bar-at-Law in London)

title: Camila Cabello joins Jonah Hill’s comedy
body: Agencies : Camila Cabello is returning to the big screen as Warner Bros announced that the ‘I Luv It’ singer and ‘Cinderella’ actress will join the cast of ‘Cut Off’, a new comedy directed by Jonah Hill, who will also star alongside Kristen Wiig. Langston Kerman, known for his role in ‘Abbott Elementary’, has also joined the ensemble. Written by Hill and Ezra Woods, ‘Cut Off’ follows two wealthy siblings, portrayed by Hill and Wiig, who are suddenly deprived of their parents’ fortune. Veteran actors Nathan Lane and Bette Midler will play the parents. While the roles of Cabello and Kerman remain undisclosed, the film is scheduled to premiere in theatres on July 17, 2026. According to Deadline, filming is currently underway in California, with Hill co-producing alongside Matt Dines and Ali Goodwin for Strong Bay. Cabello previously starred as the titular character in ‘Cinderella’, appeared in Chiwetel Ejiofor’s ‘Rob Peace’, and lent her voice to ‘Trolls Band Together’. The multi-talented artiste has also spoken about her love for performing, saying that she enjoys “almost acting when I’m singing.”

title: Why did Jim Carrey disappear?
body: Agencies : Once Hollywood’s most popular comedian, Jim Carrey, is now the symbol of a mysterious and lonely life. The star of ‘The Mask’ and ‘Dumb and Dumber’ once earned $20 million per film. And now he has almost disappeared from the screen. The Daily Mail reported that Jim Carrey will be presented with one of the highest honours in the French film industry at the prestigious Cesar Awards in France next February (2026). The French have called the world-famous actor ‘one of the original voices of modern cinema’ and said, “He reminds us that cinema is not just entertainment, it can also be a bold language of art.” However, after hearing this praise, many have raised the question – was Jim Carrey’s career really that courageous? The Canadian-born actor has sometimes claimed to be descended from French pirates. In 2010, he was made a Chevalier of the Order of Arts and Letters by France. But surprisingly, he has never been nominated for an Oscar. He hasn’t had any notable films in the past decade. In recent years, he’s only been seen in the Sonic the Hedgehog franchise, where his co-stars are mostly computer-generated characters. The fourth installment of the series is due out in 2027. It may be financially profitable, but it won’t add much to his career. His last two films, ‘Dark Crime’ and ‘The Bad Batch’, released in 2016, were abysmal failures. Both films were a disappointment to critics and audiences. The once highest-paid actor in Hollywood has been virtually unemployed since then, as if he had disappeared. But Carrey hasn’t completely retired. He’s working on a few new projects now.

title: Legal notice to Tanjin Tisha
body: Entertainment Report : Actress Tanjin Tisha has been accused of fraud by a female entrepreneur named Jhinuk. The allegation against Tisha is that she did not advertise as promised about a saree from an online fashion house called ‘Eponia’. However, Tisha said that she received the saree as a gift. On behalf of ‘Eponia’ Fashion Page, Executive Md Aminul Islam, Bangladesh Supreme Court lawyer Salimullah Sarkar has sent a legal notice to Tisha. The notice states, “After delivering the saree to Tisha’s house, she repeatedly promised her a promotion, but she didn’t do so even after 10 months; in fact, she didn’t even keep in touch for six months. The entrepreneur claimed that Tisha cheated by breaking her trust. When the matter was published in various online and other newspapers, she wrote from her verified Facebook ID, ‘I became a fraudster after receiving the gift’, which is not desirable from a well-known actress like you in the country and the statement is completely defamatory, ugly, fabricated and a mere trick to hide the truth.” The notice also states that Tanjin Tisha must pay the price of the saree worth Tk 28,800 and compensation of Tk 1 lakh within 7 days and publicly apologise. Otherwise, a case will be filed against her under the Bangladesh Penal Code.

title: Only people related by blood are not brothers: Rituparna
body: For popular actress Rituparna Sengupta of West Bengal, ‘Bhaiphonta’ has always been one of the favourite festivals of her life. She finds special joy in this event for her brothers. However, this year, her heart is filled with sadness around ‘Bhaiphonta’ because she lost her mother last year. Rituparna said, “Brothers are not just people related by blood. There are also some people who are like brothers. It feels great to spend this day with all of them. However, this year, why should all the lights go out just because my mother is not here?”

title: Karan reveals his secret, Janhvi is shocked
body: Bollywood director and producer Karan Johar recently appeared on Twinkle Khanna’s podcast show, where he revealed some unknown facts about his personal life. In a fun game on the show, Karan was asked to say two things, one true and the other false. Karan then revealed that he lost his virginity at the age of 26 and that he had an affair with a member of Janhvi Kapoor’s family. Janhvi, who was a co-guest on the show that day, was shocked to hear Karan’s comment.

title: Meher Afroz Shaon loses her mother
body: Actress and producer Meher Afroz Shaon’s mother Begum Tahura Ali is no more. Shaon confirmed the death news in a post on social media. In the post, she wrote, “It is with deep sorrow that we inform you that our beloved mother Begum Tahura Ali has passed away. May the Most Merciful Allah forgive her. May Allah grant us Jannatul Firdaus and grant us all the strength and patience to bear this grief.”

title: I felt like I could stand up: Bobby Deol
body: Actor Bobby Deol has completed almost three decades in the Bollywood industry. Entering the industry with the help of his father (Dharmendra), initial success followed by a long break, the life of an actor is like a roller-coaster journey. Recently, there has been a lot of discussion about Bobby’s character ‘Abra’ in ‘Animal’. In the words of the actor said, “I used to request directors and producers to give me work. I would go to their offices. If they don’t give me work, at least let them remember me! But I never gave up. I felt like I could stand up. It was as if someone gave me strength from within. So, I was able to stand up again.”

title: Upcoming South Indian Movies in November 2025: Top 12 Releases
body: The pulse of regional cinema has an endless powerful magnificence, as the storytelling of South Indian cinema shines through Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam releases. This November brings a fresh surge of premieres in exciting genres, including fantasy, adventure, comedy, action, drama, and sci-fi, with romance taking the spotlight. Teasers and trailers are igniting buzz, packed with fiery dialogues and moments that have audiences on edge. Let’s dive into the best 12 South Indian movies set to release in November 2025 with fresh emotions, bold ideas, and cinematic grandeur. Top 12 South Indian Films Premiering This November Jatadhara / Telugu Fantasy Horror / November 7, 2025 Sonakshi Sinha takes on a riveting role in Jatadhara, a mystery that delves into the secrets surrounding the Anantha Padmanabha Swamy Temple. The fantasy film blends myth, faith, and speculation to explore the temple’s long-whispered supernatural aura. Besides writing the project, Venkat Kalyan also takes on the directorial roles with Abhishek Jaiswal. The compelling ensemble includes Divya Khossla, Sudheer Babu Posani, Rajeev Kanakala, Shilpa Shirodkar, Ravi Prakash, Subhalekha Sudhakar, and Indira Krishnan. Credit for producing the horror film goes to Ess Kay Gee Entertainment, Sudheer Babu Productions, and Zee Studios. School Life / Telugu Romantic Drama / November 14, 2025 Produced under Jeniya Production and Naineesha Creation, ‘School Life’ is set in a quiet village in the 1990s. The drama captures the emotional turbulence of young love caught in the crossfire of caste and family expectations. Nani’s affection for Sweetie collides with his father’s rigid beliefs, leading to revelations that challenge his sense of loyalty and belonging. Pulivendula Mahesh directs and joins the cast alongside Savithri Krishna, Mude Varun Nayak, Shannu Shaik, Aamani, Suman, Muralidhar Goud, and Palle Vinayshankar. Andhra King Taluka / Telugu Drama / November 28, 2025 Written and directed by Mahesh Babu Pachigolla, ‘Andhra King Taluka’ unfolds as a heartfelt ode to fandom. It traces the life of Sagar, a devoted admirer whose world orbits around his cinematic hero, ‘Andhra King’ Surya Kumar. Naveen Yerneni and Ravi Shankar Yalamanchili helm the production, bringing together Mythri Movie Makers and T-Series. Upendra Rao, Ram Pothineni, Bhagyashri Borse, Murali Sharma, Rahul Ramakrishna, and Rao Ramesh portray the key characters. Aaromaley / Tamil Romantic Drama / November 7, 2025 Made under the direction of Sarang Thiagu, ‘Aaromaley’ thrives with Bipin R., Aashameera Aiyappan, and Kishen Das as its writers. The project brings together a lively cast: Kishen Das, Harshath Khan, VTV Ganesh, Megha Akash, Shivathmika Rajashekar, Namritha MV, Sibi Jayakumar, and Sandhya Winfred. The recently released teaser hints at a charming romantic drama that keeps its narrative under wraps for now. The Girlfriend / Tamil Romance / November 7, 2025 Featuring Rashmika Mandanna and Koushik Mahata in lead roles, ‘The Girlfriend’ boasts Rahul Ravindran as its director and writer. Rohini, Rao Ramesh, and Dheekshith Shetty round out the supporting cast. The romantic film narrative unfolds as a nuanced exploration of modern relationships, where love, doubt, and self-discovery intertwine. Dheeraj Mogilineni Entertainment, Geetha Arts, and Mass Movie Maker oversee the production. Kumki 2 / Tamil Musical Adventure / November 14, 2025 Prabhu Solomon returns to familiar emotional terrain with ‘Kumki 2’, a standalone sequel to his acclaimed 2012 film. Produced by Pen Studios, the adventure drama features Arjun Das, Shrita Rao, and newcomer Mathi. Set against lush natural backdrops, the story captures an unlikely yet tender bond between a young man and a timid elephant, revealing how empathy can transcend both fear and species. Writer and director Nanda Kishore crafts ‘Vrusshabha’ as a sweeping fantasy rooted in legacy, guilt, and redemption. Connekkt Media, Balaji Motion Pictures, and Abishek S. Vyas Studios join forces for the action film. It follows a powerful diamond tycoon forced to confront his buried past when his son’s return to their ancestral home reopens long-suppressed wounds. Mohanlal leads a formidable cast that includes Ragini Dwivedi, Samarjit Lankesh, Nayan Sarika, Neha Saxena, and Ajay. Cyber / Malayalam Sci-fi / November 7, 2025 Flourished by the directing prowess of Manu Krishna, ‘Cyber’ revolves around Dr. Vikram Aryan, a cyber-neuroscientist in Great Letzberg. He invents a mind-altering device after losing everything to an elite conspiracy. His creation sparks a dangerous pursuit that blurs the line between genius and ruin. Cereena, Chandhunadh, Jeeva, Jeeva Joseph, Prasant Murali, Mayooksha Murukesan, and Rinaz Yahiya assume the pivotal roles, with KGlobal Films and Root Productions producing. Athibheekara Kaamukan / Malayalam Romantic Comedy / November 14, 2025 Drishya Raghunath and Lukman Avaran headline ‘Athibheekara Kaamukan’, a film that teases a tender, emotionally layered romance wrapped in family warmth. Though plot details remain closely guarded, the tone suggests a heartfelt blend of humour and sentiment. The additional cast members are Manohari Joy, Karthik, and Ashwin. Backed by Pink Bison Studios and Etcetera Entertainments, the rom-com excels with Gautham Thaniyil and CC Nithin as its directors and Sujai Mohanraj as the writer. Bank of Bhagyalakshmi / Kannada Heist Comedy / November 7, 2025 Abhishek M’s ‘Bank of Bhagyalakshmi’ headlines Dheekshith Shetty, leading as a small-time thief whose crew sets out to rob a modest cooperative society. They discover that their grand plan has yielded a laughably small sum of Rs. 66,999. What follows is a wry, fast-paced scramble for survival as they try to outwit both luck and law. Bankrolled by Sri Devi Entertainers, the heist movie features an ensemble supporting cast that includes Srivatsa Shyam, Brinda Acharya, Sadhu Kokila, Ashwin Rao Pallaki, Bharath GB, Sruthi Hariharan, and Gopalkrishna Deshpande. Gatha Vaibhava / Kannada Period Drama / November 14, 2025 Dushyanth makes his debut alongside Ashika Ranganath in ‘Gatha Vaibhava’, a sweeping narrative that weaves together four interlinked tales across centuries. The drama features the mythical churn of Samudra Manthana and the arrival of Vasco da Gama. At the same time, the gripping story drifts along India’s coastal belt, reflecting on destiny and human endurance. Besides writing and directing the period drama, Simple Suni produces it under his banner, Suni Cinemas, along with producer Deepak Thimmappa. Full Meals / Kannada Romance / November 21, 2025 Produced under the banner of Likith Shetty Films, ‘Full Meals’ is brought to fruition by director N. Vinayaka, who also co-wrote it with Harish Gowda. The romantic film centred on a struggling wedding photographer chasing both artistic fulfilment and personal clarity. As ambition collides with emotion, his pursuit of passion entangles him in a web of love and self-doubt. Likith Shetty, Kushee Ravi, Thejaswini Sharma, Rangayana Raghu, and Suraj Lokre embody the protagonist roles. Wrapping Up South Indian movies arriving in November 2025 are expected to spellbind the audience with cinematic rhythm, echoing the creative spirit of storytelling. ‘Jatadhara’ and ‘Vrusshabha’ promise to transport viewers into realms of myth and imagination, while ‘Cyber’ stretches the boundaries of sci-fi with a haunting futuristic tone. On the softer side, ‘School Life’, ‘Aaromaley’, ‘The Girlfriend’, and ‘Full Meals’ celebrate the many shades of love. ‘Athibheekara Kaamukan’ and ‘Bank of Bhagyalakshmi’ lighten the lineup with doses of humour rooted in everyday chaos and wit. Meanwhile, ‘Andhra King Taluka’ delves into the depths of human devotion, ‘Kumki 2’ revives musical adventure through wilderness, and ‘Gatha Vaibhava’ reimagines history through timeless narratives. Together, these Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam films underscore the ever-growing appeal of Pan-Indian cinema, reaffirming South India’s dynamic influence on the nation’s cinematic pulse.

title: Jaya surprises everyone with her mother’s wedding saree
body: Entertainment Report : Recently, popular Bengali actress Jaya Ahsan has been showing off her traditional sarees one after another – sometimes in a colourful floral look, sometimes in bright yellow. But this time, she surprised her fans with a different emotion; she wore her mother’s wedding saree in a new look. In the pictures, Jaya is seen in a blue and orange saree with golden embroidery, which exudes a royal atmosphere. Heavy jewellery around the neck, bangles in the hands, and earrings in the ears; all in the perfect Bengali bridal attire. Also, her matching hair tie and soft makeup make Jaya even more unique. In the caption of the pictures posted on social media on Wednesday morning, Jaya revealed some of the stories behind this outfit and saree. Jaya wrote, “The two sarees seen in these pictures are 45 years old; in fact, these are my mother’s wedding sarees. One for the wedding, one for the bride. These two sarees are proof of various thoughts, discussions, and love. Over time, illusions, memories, and countless stories have accumulated in their folds.” The actress also wrote, “I used to take these two sarees out of my mother’s closet as a child, from the morning to the evening. I would stand in front of the mirror, quietly covering myself, avoiding my mother’s eyes… Then I would think, I too will become a mother one day, I too will have such a saree.” Jaya added words of love and gratitude for her mother with this post. She wrote, “My mother’s saree is a symbol of her hard work, sacrifice and love. Mother, your wedding saree, your bride’s saree, these two are priceless treasures to me.” Fans have praised Jaya’s sincere expression and her looks and taste in clothes. Someone wrote, “How can a daughter express so much love for her mother so beautifully!” Another commented, “Jaya is the new definition of elegance.” It is worth mentioning that she recently showed off her beauty in a dry blue saree crafted in the style of Krishnachura. A few days ago, she wowed her fans by wearing a colorful saree in a flower garden. However, be it western wear or casual look; the actress has maintained her individuality in all cases. Along with acting, Jaya’s presence in fashion is always in the spotlight. She is equally appreciated across the borders of Bangladesh and West Bengal. Not only on screen, Jaya has repeatedly raised herself to a different level in terms of aesthetics and taste.

title: Nusraat Faria in season’s favourite colour
body: Entertainment Report : Nusraat Faria is one of the most powerful heroines in Dhallywood. From acting to glamour, presenting or dancing in item songs; she has made a place in the hearts of the audience everywhere. Along with her busy schedule on screen, Faria is also active on social media; she often shares her new looks and moments with her fans.
