In continuation of this, Nusraat Faria appeared in a new outfit. On Wednesday afternoon, she shared a bunch of pictures on Facebook, where she was seen in a light pistachio green saree. A blouse that matches the saree, a heavy silver choker around the neck, and matching earrings in her ears; she captured an appealing look with a soft wavy hairstyle. Faria wrote in the caption of the post, “My favourite colour this season.” The comment section was flooded with love from fans on the post. Some wrote, “Amazing look!”, while others said, “You always shine”. Many also filled the comment box with heart and fire emojis. Nusraat Faria has been staying outside the country for a long time. In between, she appears in front of her fans in different outfits every day. Sometimes in a western look, sometimes in a fusion look, and sometimes in a completely casual style. Like every time, this time too, Faria’s new look has received a different response from her fans.

title: James announces marriage four months after becoming father
body: Entertainment Report : Mahfuz Anam James, ‘guru’ of the music world of Bangladesh, famous for his ‘Nagarbaul’, became a father four months ago. However, he has now announced the news! The rock star recently gave this information to a media outlet, along with his new marriage. James married Namia Amin, an American citizen of Bangladeshi origin, in 2024. After the wedding, she added ‘Anam’ to her name and is now Namia Anam. The couple’s first child, Jibran Anam, was born in a hospital in the USA in June of this year. Meanwhile, expressing his feelings about becoming a father, James said, “The feeling of becoming a father is extraordinary, beyond words. Thank Allah, he has given me a healthy child. Everyone will pray for the mother and the child.” Namia Anam is James’ third wife. She was born in USA; she graduated with a degree in criminal justice from John Jay College. James married Namia Amin a decade after his divorce from his second wife, Benazir, in 2014. In June 2023, the two met at a Los Angeles event, and from that meeting, their relationship blossomed into love and marriage. A year after they met, they got married in Dhaka on June 12, 2024, in the presence of family members. Gibran was born at 3:30am on June 8, 2025, at Huntington Hospital in New York. James and other family members were with him at the time. Meanwhile, James’ first wife was film actress Rothi. They got married in 1991 and divorced in 2003. Then, in 2000, James married Benazir Sajjad in USA. They divorced in 2014. James has a son and a daughter from his first marriage.

title: Lucky Ali slams Javed Akhtar for saying “don’t be like Muslims”
body: Agencies : An old video of Bollywood’s renowned lyricist and screenwriter Javed Akhtar has gone viral on social media. There is a huge debate about it. In that video, he can be heard saying to Hindus, “Don’t be like Muslims.” Renowned singer Lucky Ali has strongly criticised Javed Akhtar for this comment. However, Lucky Ali, commenting on an ‘X’ post that shared the video, wrote, “Don’t be like Javed Akhtar, he is never original (in the creative sense) and is disgustingly ugly…!” In the viral video clip, Javed Akhtar can be heard talking about freedom of speech and the state of democracy in India today. He made his comments while referencing a scene from the 1975 classic film ‘Sholay’. In the video, Javed Akhtar says, “There was a scene in ‘Sholay’ where Dharmendra talks behind a Shiva idol, and Hema Malini thinks Shivaji is talking to him. Is it possible to make such a scene today? No, I will not write such a scene (today). Were there no Hindus in 1975? Were there no religious people? There were. Raju Hirani and I said in front of a large audience in Pune, ‘You don’t become like Muslims. Make them like you. You are becoming like Muslims.’ This is a tragedy!” Lucky Ali made the scathing remark on social media in direct response to Javed’s comment. Singer Lucky Ali claims to be a devout Muslim. He has faced controversy in the past over his religious beliefs and personal ideas. However, he later deleted the post and expressed his regret to his ‘Hindu brothers and sisters’, saying that his intention was not to ‘hurt or offend’ anyone. Javed Akhtar has repeatedly criticised influential figures for their communal and hateful comments on social media, drawing criticism and protests. He said, “Some call me a ‘jihadi’ and tell me to go to Pakistan. Others say I’m an ‘infidel’ and I will definitely go to hell, so I have no right to the name Muslim.”

title: Dev-Rukmini’s ‘separation’ rumours
body: Tollywood superstar Dev and actress Rukmini’s closeness has been an ‘open secret’ in Tollywood for over a decade. They have repeatedly explained that their love story is different. But recent events have sparked fresh speculation about the nature of their relationship. There have been several disagreements between the two for the past few days. There were also questions about Dev’s closeness to another heroine. Even last year, Rukmini unfollowed Dev on Instagram! Although, later, she was seen with her lover on Dev’s birthday.

title: Bubly in whiteness of Kashful
body: Shobnom Bubly is a leading heroine of Dhallywood. She started her career as a newsreader on television, but later gained wide recognition among the audience through acting in films. This actress is constantly being praised by her fans and admirers for her acting skills. In the shared photos, Bubly is seen looking quite cheerful amidst Kashful’s beauty. With her open hair and sweet smile, she seems to have matched Kashful’s beauty. Bubly wrote in the caption, “Flowers are silent yet they show their beauty, grace and sweetness.”

title: Saline in hand, smile on face – Chitrangada’s message of hope
body: With a saline tube in her hand, obvious fatigue in her eyes, yet smiling! Bollywood actress Chitrangada Singh shared a picture of herself from her hospital bed, along with a message. The internet is abuzz with excitement, what has become of the actress! As the picture went viral on social media, concern spread among his fans. Recently, this popular actress posted a picture on Instagram and wrote, “Hopefully, I’ll be running like a rabbit soon.” However, the actress did not give any details about the exact reason for her hospitalisation.

title: Tanjin Tisha’s response to cheating allegations
body: Popular actress of small screen, Tanjin Tisha has been accused of not promoting a saree from an online fashion house. However, the actress claims that she received the saree as a gift. Jhinuk, the owner of the online fashion page called ‘Aponia’, said that last January, Tisha liked a yellow Jamdani saree, which cost Tk28,800. Considering Tisha’s popularity, Jhinuk offered to give the saree for free. After allegations of cheating surfaced, Tisha wrote, “I became a cheater with a gift! Haha! And if you want to do a photoshoot, where is the remuneration? Strange female entrepreneur! Salute to your gift.”

title: Deepika and Ranveer Celebrate Diwali as Daughter Dua Makes Her Public Debut
body: NN ONLINE: Bollywood stars Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh have finally shared a glimpse of their daughter, Dua, on Instagram, giving fans a peek into their Diwali celebrations. In the photos, the couple is seen in elegant traditional attire. Ranveer wore an off-white kurta with a matching coat and neck ornament, while Deepika dazzled in a red suit paired with statement jewellery. Dua looked adorable as she twinned with her mother, smiling for the cameras. The little one stole the show with her cute poses as Deepika held her in her arms and Ranveer embraced both. The final slide featured Deepika and Dua performing the Diwali puja together. Celebrities quickly reacted to the family pictures, with Hansika Motwani writing, “So cute,” Rajkummar Rao commenting, “So cute. God bless you guys,” and Ananya Panday exclaiming, “Oh my god.” Fans were also thrilled to see Dua Padukone’s first-ever appearance. Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh married on November 14, 2018, in a grand ceremony at Lake Como, Italy, reflecting Deepika’s Konkani heritage and Ranveer’s Sindhi background. The couple welcomed their first child, Dua Padukone, on September 8, 2024.

title: People say that my entire body has undergone plastic surgery
body: People say that my entire body has undergone plastic surgery. I’ve heard this myself. They say I’ve had head-to-toe plastic surgery. Botox, this, that—these are the things people talk about. People think I don’t see these comments. I do see them sometimes. If you look at our comment boxes, you can understand the state of mind of the men in our country. —Jaya Ahsan

title: Alauddin Ali, Alam Khan, and Ahmed Imtiaz Bulbul have left us.
body: If I talk about playback, I must admit that playback singers are gradually becoming orphaned. Legendary composers like Alauddin Ali, Alam Khan, and Ahmed Imtiaz Bulbul have left us. That void still exists, and along with it, the number of songs in films has also decreased. Only a handful of popular singers are getting regular playback opportunities. —Konal

title: Criticism should be focused on my work: Faria
body: Entertainment Report : Nusraat Faria now seems like a free bird—sometimes in Canada, sometimes in London, and from there traveling to other countries. However, this traveling is not just for leisure; she is also spending a busy time for work purposes. She is participating in various international events, performing on stage, and presenting herself anew to the audience through photoshoots. Faria is quite active on social media. Sometimes she appears in a saree in a pure Bengali look, and sometimes she stuns in a bikini with a bold and glamorous appearance. Each post sparks waves of discussion—some shower her with praise, while others criticize. Faria herself remains completely unbothered by such reactions. Rather, she believes that as long as there is discussion and criticism, people’s interest in an artist remains alive. Meanwhile, the latest news is that she has become busy with music once again, in addition to acting. A few months ago, she lent her voice to a song. Currently, the music video for that song is being filmed. Once everything is completed, she plans to release the song along with the video. Although she didn’t reveal much about it yet, she hinted that this upcoming song will be far more aesthetic and impressive than her previous ones. However, the beginning of this year was not very easy for Faria. It was a difficult time filled with controversies and personal incidents. Now, leaving everything behind, she has returned to work with renewed enthusiasm. In Faria’s words, ‘Since childhood, I have maintained one principle— whether it’s praise or criticism, it should be focused on my work. I am trying to do better projects in the coming days.’ Her film ‘Thikana Bangladesh’ is awaiting release. Based on the story of the Independent Bangladesh Football Team, the film stars Arifin Shuvoo opposite her and is directed by Anam Biswas. Faria shared that the story is highly inspirational and the production quality is excellent. However, the release date of the film has not been finalized yet.

title: Controversy over saree, Tanjin Tisha speaks out
body: Entertainment Desk : Popular small-screen actress Tanjin Tisha has recently faced a new allegation. A female entrepreneur has claimed that Tisha took a free saree from her but broke her promise. The allegation has sparked widespread discussion on social media. The incident dates back to last January. Tisha, from her verified Instagram account, contacted an online fashion page called ‘Aponia’. There, she asked for photos of some Jamdani sarees. According to the entrepreneur, Jhinuk, Tisha chose a yellow Jamdani saree priced at 28,800 taka. Considering Tisha’s popularity, Jhinuk offered to give her the saree for free on the condition that Tisha would wear it, take photos, and promote the brand on her social media. Tisha agreed to the proposal, and the saree was delivered to her home. Following the publication of the news, Tanjin Tisha officially responded on her Facebook page. She wrote, ‘I took a gift, and now I’m being called a fraud! Haha! And if you wanted a photoshoot, where’s the payment? Strange female entrepreneur! Salute to your so-called gift.’

title: Legendary comedian Asrani is no more
body: Legendary Bollywood comedy actor Govardhan Asrani has passed away. Due to age-related complications, he breathed his last on Monday afternoon (October 20) at a hospital in Mumbai. He was 84 years old at the time of his death. The renowned actor had been suffering from illness for a long time. The Indian film fraternity is mourning his demise. A post on his official Instagram account stated, ‘The news of the death of the King of Laughter, Asrani Ji, has plunged us into deep sorrow. His unique acting, simplicity, and sense of humor gave Indian cinema a new identity. His passing is an irreparable loss not only to the film industry but also to everyone who has ever laughed because of his performances.’

title: Salman Khan’s geography is weak!
body: At a star-studded event recently held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, Salman Khan found himself in a fix after referring to Balochistan and Pakistan as two separate countries. Since then, questions have arisen: is Bhaijaan really ‘geographically weak’ or was it all part of a plan? At the event, he was speaking about the global acceptance of Indian cinema. He said, ‘Today, if a Hindi film releases in Saudi Arabia, it becomes a superhit.’ The video has sparked criticism. One netizen wrote, ‘Salman Khan has finally admitted that Balochistan is not part of Pakistan.’

title: Dighi’s new film Biday
body: Entertainment Report : Prarthana Fardin Dighi has started shooting for her new film titled ‘Biday’. The shooting began on October 17 at various locations in Taherpur, Sunamganj. After the success of director Mehedi Hasan Hridoy’s film Barbad, released during last Eid-ul-Azha, there were rumors that the megastar Shakib Khan would be seen in the director’s next project. However, it has now been confirmed that ‘Biday’ will star Bapparaj and Prarthana Fardin Dighi instead of Shakib Khan. Bapparaj joined the shoot last Monday. The film’s producer, Shahreen Akter, told the media, ‘After Borbad, we had initially planned to start a new film with Siam. For now, that project is on hold. We are currently working on Biday with Bapparaj, Prarthana Fardin Dighi, and several other stars.’ Meanwhile, when asked about the film, Dighi said, ‘The production company has requested that I not discuss Biday publicly for now. But I’ll be able to talk about it after the shooting ends later this month. I can only say that the story of Biday revolves around a journey from a remote area to abroad.’

title: I want the audience’s love in films just like in dramas: Totini
body: Entertainment Report : Tanjim Saiara Totini is one of the most popular actresses on television today. Over the years, she has become a favorite among viewers. On social media as well, drama audiences show great interest in her. Recently, several television stars like Mehazabien, Sabila Noor, Farin, and Tanjin Tisha have transitioned to films. Following that trend, many fans also wish to see Totini on the big screen. Although she has already received several film offers, the actress has politely declined them. She says she wants to take more time to mature as an actress before making her film debut. Speaking about it, Totini said, ‘Right now, I’m focused on doing dramas wholeheartedly. I want to gain more experience. I’m receiving so much love from audiences through dramas—when I finally move to films, I want people to love me the same way.’ Totini further added, ‘From the beginning, I never focused on who the director or co-actor was. My attention was always on the story, the script, and the dialogue. Because if those are good, the project turns out well in the end.’ Apart from acting, Totini is also known to audiences as ‘Suhasini’. Despite being in demand, she acts in relatively fewer dramas compared to others. Totini believes that quality matters more than quantity. She said, ‘Even if I work less, I make sure to choose quality projects. I always try to ensure that the work I do is meaningful and well-made. After all, we work for the audience. Their support inspires us to do even better. So, I seek my audience’s support and prayers.’

title: The most painful chapter of Jolie’s life
body: Angelina Jolie’s life is not just a tale of Hollywood glamour and fame—it is a living history. Hidden within it is the story of how she transformed into a remarkable humanitarian icon, overcoming personal tragedy, physical suffering, and emotional turmoil. Through her recent film Couture, Jolie seems to have brought to life on screen the most heartbreaking chapter of her own journey. The story of cancer, which became a defining part of Jolie’s life, began in her childhood.

title: In a Diwali video, is it Rashmika or someone else?
body: On the occasion of Diwali, popular South Indian actor Vijay Deverakonda shared a video on his Instagram, which has sparked various speculations on the internet. The reason is that a feminine voice can be heard in the background of the video—leading curious netizens to wonder whether it is Rashmika or someone else. In the caption, Vijay writes, ‘Happy Diwali to you all—my people.

title: Shah Rukh Khan’s witty take on Salman’s ‘outsider’ remark goes viral
body: Bollywood’s iconic trio — Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, and Aamir Khan — reunited at the Joy Forum in Riyadh, sparking laughter and nostalgia among fans. During their conversation, Salman Khan mentioned that while he and Aamir come from film families, Shah Rukh “came from Delhi and struggled.” In his signature witty style, Shah Rukh interrupted, saying, “I also come from a film family — Salman’s family is my family, and Aamir’s family is my family. That’s why I’m a star.” His clever remark left both Salman and Aamir smiling as the audience erupted in applause. The three Khans, who began their film careers around the same time, continue to share mutual respect and camaraderie despite decades in the industry. Recently, they have been seen supporting each other’s projects and attending family events, reinforcing their enduring friendship.

title: Jaya criticises directors
body: Entertainment Report : Jaya Ahsan has been acting in Tollywood for a decade. She has won the Filmfare Award four times. Jaya believes that the biggest turning point in her career was the decision to act in Tollywood. She decided to work in West Bengal because she could not find suitable roles in Dhallywood. Recently, in a podcast, Jaya said, “At that time, I wasn’t getting the kind of work I could do in Bangladesh. I moved to Kolkata from that place of hardship and because of my passion for art. I have to work. I haven’t done anything or can’t do anything except acting.” Criticising the directors, Jaya said, “The directors for whom I was always present did not use me properly. One problem in Bangladesh is that directors have girlfriends or wives. This is not possible for me; I have not gone to these and will not go. Due to these reasons, I have been cornered, despite being so devoted, which did not happen in Kolkata. Even after being an outsider, they gave me good characters, thought about me, and made stories centred around me.” Jaya commented that Bangladeshi filmmakers are still afraid to make women-centric stories. The actress said, “Many directors in Bangladesh are still afraid to work with women. Even if they do, they will either hire their girlfriends or their wives. Or they will hire a megastar or superstar. They are not willing to bet on a pure artist….But there are many filmmakers working beyond that, with all due respect to them, there are many dynamic directors who could have gotten better work from me or from more talented actors. But they didn’t.” Regarding the recognition of the contribution of artistes and crew in cinema, Jaya said, “I find it stupid when a director writes, A film by so-and-so. I would say, it should be Directed by…. A film is the contribution of the entire team. There is one person who directs it. A film is as much a director’s as it is an actor’s, a cinematographer’s, a spot boy’s. Everyone together makes a film.” Jaya said that she has not yet been able to do her best work in Bangladesh. This pain torments her. She is waiting to portray the desired character on screen.

title: Ayub Bachchu Museum & Cultural Hub being built
body: Entertainment Desk : Ayub Bachchu Museum will be built in Moghbazar of the capital under the initiative of Ayub Bachchu Foundation. The museum named ‘Ayub Bachchu Museum and Cultural Hub’ will be spread over an area of 10 kathas. Various memories of the artiste’s personal and musical life will be preserved in this museum. Ferdous Akhter Chandana, wife of foundation president Ayub Bachchu, said that the implementation of this project is progressing, but it needs sponsorship. Abdullah Al Masud, the foundation’s secretary and a long-time companion of the late Bachchu, said that the museum will house various items associated with the artiste’s memories, including the guitar, T-shirt, hat, cap, ring, sunglasses used by Ayub Bachchu. There will be a recording studio modeled after AB Kitchen. Music lovers will have the opportunity to get directly acquainted with Bachchu’s life and music style in this museum. In addition, according to the plan, there will be a musical cafe, auditorium and open studio for musicians. The Ayub Bachchu Foundation said that each section of the museum will tell the story of Ayub Bachchu’s artistic journey. Bachchu’s arrival in Dhaka from Chattogram, the rise of the LRB band, and the opportunity to enjoy Ayub Bachchu’s various popular songs and concerts. Abdullah Al Masud said, “Initiatives are also being taken so that visitors can experience Ayub Bachchu’s concert here in virtual reality. However, government and private cooperation is needed to realise this grand dream. We want the people of the country to support this initiative. Our hope is that this museum will not only be a place to preserve memories, but also become a center of cultural inspiration.”

title: They are poisonous snakes hiding in guise of relationships: Purnima
body: Entertainment Report : Purnima is a popular actress of Dhallywood. From her acting career to her personal life, she is regularly in the news. Along with her work, she is also quite active on social media. Occasionally, she writes about her personal life or various aspects of society there. Recently, Purnima wrote something in one of her posts about the complexities of relationships, selfish people, and the importance of loneliness, which instantly caught the attention of netizens. Purnima wrote in the post, “There are some faces in the crowd of people, whom we consider our own and open the doors of our hearts to. But in the harsh test of time, we realise that they are actually poisonous snakes hiding under the guise of relationships. When necessary, they wear the mask of a friend and hang around, and whenever they get the chance, they pour poison into our dreams, into our lives.” “When people reach the pinnacle of success in life, they start buzzing around like bees. By showering praise and pretending to be close, they are actually collecting honey for their own interests,” she also said. In her words, “But when the wheel of time turns in reverse, when life is plunged into the darkness of struggle, they are the first to move away – just as a bee flies to another flower when the honey from a flower runs out, so too they move away due to the pull of self-interest.” Urging people to stay away from fake relationships, Purnima wrote, “That’s why it’s better to stay away from them because loneliness is much more peaceful, safe, and dignified than losing yourself in the crowd of fake relationships.”

title: Where has Jatrapala of Bengal been lost?
body: Entertainment Report : Once upon a time, when winter came, the announcement of Jatrapala could be heard on the streets and outskirts of rural Bengal. The sound of drums would fill the locality, and mythological and historical stories and stories of the land would come alive on the stage. But as the wheel of time turns, that scene is on the verge of extinction. Popular small screen actress Rukaiya Jahan Chamak has posted a video expressing regret over the loss of this vibrant form of contemporary Bengali folk culture. Posting a video, the actress expressed her deep feelings about the country’s traditional Jatrapala in the caption. Her question was, “Where has the Jatrapala of Bengal been lost?” Chamak wrote in her post, “The stage where the sound of drums once resonated, the stories of our land, the laughter and tears of our ancestors, our roots. All of it is being lost one by one under the guise of cheap entertainment.” According to the actress, Jatrapala is not just entertainment; it is closely linked to Bengali folk culture and folk beliefs. She said in this regard, “This Jatrapala was not just a play; it was Bengali folk culture, folk beliefs, folk spirit. Where there was no screen between the actor and the audience, there was only the smell of the earth and the connection of life.” Chamak entered the showbiz arena by becoming the second runner-up in the Miss World Bangladesh competition in 2017. She then started acting in 2020. Her notable dramas and series are: ‘Haider’, ‘House No. 96’, ‘Mohanogor’, ‘Sada Private’, ‘Ashomapato’, ‘Viral Husband Band’ etc.

title: Samantha opens up about her breakup
body: A long-standing love marriage, then a sudden separation; the divorce of popular South Indian film couple Samantha Ruth Prabhu and Naga Chaitanya was no less controversial. Just when her ex-husband was getting her life back on track, Samantha was away from acting due to personal problems and was diagnosed with a serious illness like myositis. She said, “I can say this with all my heart, I have always wanted to present the truth. Those who follow me are aware of my personal struggles. I have brought everything from separation to illness to the public.”

title: People trolled without even noticing: Ibrahim
body: This year, Bollywood actor Saif Ali Khan’s son Ibrahim Ali Khan made his acting debut with the film ‘Nadania’. But the newcomer faced heavy criticism in his first film. The film didn’t survive either, and now Ibrahim has opened up about the failure and criticism of that film. He said about his first film, “Even a few days ago, everyone was waiting for my debut in the acting world. But, after the release of ‘Nadania’, that excitement hit rock bottom. I was constantly trolled. It was very painful to hear this saying ‘It can’t be done by him’ over and over again. I want to admit in front of everyone that the film was really bad.”

title: Parineeti Chopra becomes a mother
body: Just before the festival of lights, Diwali, a new guest has arrived in the family of politician Raghav Chadha and Bollywood actress Parineeti Chopra. The star couple has become parents to a baby boy. Parineeti gave birth to the child at a private hospital in Delhi. Both mother and newborn are reportedly doing well. Expressing their joy through a joint statement on Instagram, Raghav wrote, “Finally he’s here. Our son! Honestly, I can’t remember what life was like before this moment. Our hearts are full now.”

title: Sunny Deol gives good news to fans on his b’day
body: Bollywood actor Sunny Deol gave good news to his fans on his birthday. On this special day, he announced his next film ‘Gabru’. In this film, Sunny Deol will also be seen with Simran Baga and Preet Kamani. Sunny shared the poster of ‘Gabru’ on social media, expressing his gratitude to his fans. He wrote in the caption, “A story of courage, conscience and compassion.” In his words, “It’s not about showing off your power, it’s about proving it by doing it. Thank you all for your love and blessings. I’m giving this to those who were waiting. ‘Gabru’ is releasing on March 13, 2026. A story of courage, conscience and compassion. From the bottom of my heart, for this world.”

title: Dilwale Dulhania at 30: Mandir’s timeless romance with SSK-Kajol classic
body: In the bustling heart of Mumbai, Maratha Mandir cinema stands as a relic of old-world charm, its faded posters and single-screen aura offering a glimpse into a bygone era. Yet inside, a cinematic phenomenon continues unabated: for 30 years, Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge (DDLJ) has played here every day at 11:30 a.m., drawing audiences as fervently as ever. Despite a city constantly chasing new releases, DDLJ has become more than just a film — it is a ritual, a shared memory, and a celebration of love. On its 30th anniversary this Diwali, early morning screenings transformed into a festival of nostalgia, with crowds queuing hours in advance, hand-painted placards in hand, and selfies in front of the iconic posters. Among the audience were families spanning generations: a father returning with his wife and three children, hoping to pass on the magic of his own first viewing, and a father who travelled over 2,000 kilometres from Shantiniketan to watch the film with his teenage daughter, an aspiring actress and Shah Rukh Khan fan. Enthusiasts even brought mementos from Switzerland — echoing the film’s memorable overseas locations — while international tourists lined up, captivated by the film’s global legacy. Inside, the theatre brimmed with shared excitement: cheers greeted Shah Rukh Khan’s grand entrances, dialogues were recited in unison, and songs like Tujhe Dekha Toh Yeh Jaana Sanam became collective karaoke. The smell of popcorn, the creak of wooden seats, and the aroma of samosas added to the nostalgic charm. Manoj Pandey, Maratha Mandir’s manager for over 20 years, highlighted the theatre’s commitment to accessibility, keeping ticket prices low and adapting from physical prints to digital projection. “There are days when DDLJ draws more viewers than new releases,” he said. As fans celebrated with a cake printed with Raj and Simran’s iconic embrace, it was clear that DDLJ at Maratha Mandir is more than a movie — it is a timeless testament to love, cinema, and enduring hope, uniting generations even after three decades.

title: Shithi to listen to stories of those who win battle of life
body: Entertainment Report : In 2022, singer Shithi Saha learned that cancer had taken root in her body. Shithi didn’t break down even though she was diagnosed with breast cancer. She continued her treatment. After surgery and chemotherapy, she is now completely healthy. In the meantime, she has become a mother to a child. No one knew about Shithi’s illness except a few close people. After becoming a mother, she announced the news of her victory over cancer. Now, on the podcast titled ‘The Healing Room’, Shithi will hear from some people who, like her, have struggled against adversity and achieved victory. Shithi announced the podcast last September. In a video message, the singer said, “Many of us give up hope of survival after losing a loved one, or a relationship that was built on a whim, or like me, after being diagnosed with cancer. From my own experience, when a person breaks down, they try to get back up again with courage. Then they come back with more strength. I am bringing you a new podcast, ‘The Healing Room’, to listen to the stories of those of you who are moving forward without giving up and overcoming all odds.” After almost two months, Shithi is ready to come in front of the audience with this new podcast. She said on social media that after the announcement of this podcast, many people have shared their stories of turning around with her. Her podcast will soon be available on the YouTube channel named ‘Vibe News’. Shithi Saha said, “For me, a new morning means new inspiration. About two months ago, we announced this podcast with the belief that your story can be an inspiration to others. In the meantime, many brave people have shared with us their stories of turning around, stories of not giving up. Soon we will be coming to inspire and encourage you with the stories of friends who have won the battle of life.”

title: Shapla to release new original song
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : This generation’s musician, Shapla Paul, is finally taking the initiative to release her new original song. Two years ago, work began on a song titled ‘Tumi Esho Shishir Bheja Paye’ written by Tarek Akhand, a talented lyricist of this generation, and composed by Khairul Wasi. Later, due to various reasons, the work on the song stopped. But at this time, Shapla has become more focused on releasing her original songs, so she wants to present the song to the audience quickly. So, Shapla said that she will now complete work on the music video for the song and release the song on her YouTube channel soon. While talking in this regard, she told this correspondent, “Many songs written by Tarek Anand Bhai have been sung by various artistes and have received great popularity. He is one of my favourite lyricists. I love every word of this song written by him. And Wasi Bhai who has composed a sweet melody for the song, I’m impressed. There couldn’t be a more beautiful melody in this lyric. Anyway, I’ve finally taken the initiative to release the song. I will make a video of the song in a few days and release it on my YouTube channel soon. I’m very confident that the audience will like the song.” Meanwhile, six years ago, a song titled ‘Jago Durga’ was released in ‘SaReGaMa Bengali’ about the arrival of Durga. The song was sung by Dwijen Mukherjee with lyrics by Bani Kumar and music by Pankaj Mallick. This ‘Durga Agamoni’ song sung by Dwijen Mukherjee has received a lot of response, especially in Kolkata. Shapla covered the song ‘Jago Durga’ and released it on the day of last Mahalaya. The music of the new song has been arranged by Monir Uddin. Several cover songs, including ‘Amar Ghore Srabon Jhore’, have been released on the ‘Shapla Paul’ YouTube channel. Shapla said she is receiving a lot of response for the songs released on her own channel. Shapla Paul, hailed from Chattogram, has already performed several stage shows. Her journey into the world of music was guided by her mother, Sanju Paul. She started practicing music in a pure way from a young age. She received training from Ustad Arun Banik, Rakhal Nandi and Surbondhu Ashok Chowdhury one by one. Her first original song was ‘Moner Shimana’.

title: Bollywood queen Parveen Babi thinks FBI wanted to kill her
body: Agencies : Bollywood actress Parveen Babi was a glamour, talent and fashion icon in the 1970s and early 1980s. Her performances opposite A-list stars including Amitabh Bachchan were loved by the audience. But behind this glittering career was a deep loneliness and the tragic consequences of a mental health struggle called ‘paranoid schizophrenia’. Even so many years after his death, discussions about his life and last days have not stopped. Recently, actress Pooja Bedi has revealed the turbulent times of Parveen Babi in a personal memoir. Parveen Babi once had a deep relationship with Pooja Bedi’s father Kabir Bedi. In a conversation with Siddharth Kannan, Pooja spoke about the time when Parveen Babi believed that the American intelligence agency FBI was conspiring against her. Pooja Bedi said that when Parveen Babi returned to India after many years, she almost became isolated from the film industry due to physical and mental changes. The scene she saw when she went to see her at her house was a complete contrast to the glamorous image of the past. Pooja recalls, “She opened the door, she looked very different. She had gained a lot of weight, and her hair was messy.” Although Parveen was very excited to see Pooja, she hugged her, but in the middle of the conversation, the panic inside her suddenly came out. When Pooja noticed that Parveen Babi was not serving her any food, she asked the reason. Parveen Babi told Pooja, “I’m sorry that I cannot give you anything to eat because I only eat eggs.” When asked why she was only eating eggs, Parveen Babi said, “This is something they (the Secret Service or FBI) cannot adulterate.” Hearing this, Pooja understood that Parveen Babi was going through deep mental anguish. Pooja Bedi further said that Parveen Babi was so deeply worried that she believed that everyone outside was out to harm her. Pooja recalls, “She told me not to buy makeup from the market because someone would adulterate or poison it. I asked her, ‘Who knows when you are going to buy what?’ She replied, ‘They know everything. This terrible distrust gradually pushed her life towards loneliness.’” Parveen Babi was known to suffer from paranoid schizophrenia towards the end of her life. Her personal life was also a subject of discussion. She had relationships with stars like Danny Denzongpa, Kabir Bedi and Mahesh Bhatt. However, she never married. Last year, Kabir Bedi had said in an interview that Parveen Babi had distanced herself from Kabir Bedi out of fear of mental health treatment. Because she thought that Kabir might pressure her to seek treatment. The life of this once-bright Bollywood star ended in extreme loneliness. She died on January 20, 2005 due to multiple organ failure. She was so lonely in the last three days of her life that when the secretary of the flat told the police that she had not done any shopping or taken any newspaper for three days, the police recovered her body exactly two days later, on January 22.

title: Sunerah in swimming pool
body: Entertainment Desk : Present generation’s actress Sunerah Binte Kamal is quite active on social media. She often shares moments from her daily life; she shows off herself. Recently, the actress posted several pictures on Instagram; and the internet is buzzing about them. Sunerah has been captured in a candid pose, and many have been amazed and amazed by those pictures. Appearing in bold looks is nothing new for Sunerah. This time too, she was no exception. She stepped into the swimming pool in a pink bikini; she set the hearts of her fans on fire with just a few poses in front of the camera. The actress also expressed her feelings in the caption of the pictures. She wrote, “Enjoying the warmth of the sun.”

title: Parineeti Chopra admitted to hospital
body: Bollywood actress Parineeti Chopra and politician husband Raghav Chadha are expecting a baby soon. The actress has been admitted to a hospital in Delhi as the time for the birth of her child approaches. This good news could come at any moment. However, no official statement has been released on this matter from either Parineeti or Raghav yet. In August this year, Parineeti and Raghav officially announced on social media that they were expecting their first child. The couple posted a picture of a cake on Instagram, with the caption, “One plus one equals three.”

title: Samantha’s item song was big challenge to test her limits
body: Samantha Ruth Prabhu, a South Indian film actress, one of the most talked about item songs of her career was ‘O Antava’ from the film ‘Pushpa: The Rise’. Her bold and glamorous appearance there took the box office by storm. But the actress said that performing in this song was a challenge to test her limits. She said, “I danced to the song to prove myself. I never considered myself ‘appealing’, nor did I think anyone would cast me in such a role. It was an opportunity to test my own limits.”

title: When Paoli Dam plays a serial killer
body: Actress Paoli Dam from West Bengal has appeared in front of the audience in a new look. She will be seen in role of ‘Trilokya Devi’ in Zee Five Bangla’s new web series ‘Ganashatru’, which is already a topic of discussion among the audience. The trailer and first look of the series were released last Saturday. In it, Pauly is seen in a different form in a creepy environment. She has created curiosity among the audience with her sharp gaze and mysterious expression. Directed by Shamik Roychowdhury, this crime thriller series is based on five true stories. One of its stories revolves around India’s first female serial killer, ‘Trilokya Devi’, who went from being a scorned Brahmin widow to a murderer.

title: Ayub Bachchu’s wife’s emotional message
body: Ayub Bachchu, legend of the country’s band music, guitar wizard and founder of LRB, left the silver guitar long ago. The legend passed away on October 18, 2018, at the age of 56, after suffering a heart attack. Seven years have passed since then. On seventh anniversary of his death last Saturday, family, friends, and fans remembered him with respect and love. On this day, Bachchu’s wife Chandana shared a picture on Facebook and gave an emotional message. She wrote, “Life is very strange, evenings do not pass, yet the year comes and goes. It seems like seven years…”

title: New Bollywood Movie List for November 2025: 10 Best Hindi Films
body: Bollywood’s enduring charm lies in its ability to reinvent emotions, genres, and storytelling for every generation. The upcoming Hindi films in November 2025 showcase that magic – spanning sci-fi, horror, drama, romance, and comedy. The month welcomes newcomers and rising stars alongside crowd-favourite performers. Let’s dive into the 10 Bollywood movies shaping the cinematic excitement of November 2025. 10 Most-hyped Hindi Movies Lighting Up Bollywood This November . Haq / Courtroom Drama / November 7, 2025 Penned by Reshu Nath, ‘Haq’ delves into a cross-section of individuals who wrestle with the quiet torment of debt and the fragile balance between dignity and survival. Their personal ties strain under the weight of financial uncertainty, sketching a portrait of contemporary life shaped by economic struggle. Produced by Baweja Studios, Insomnia Films, and Junglee Pictures, the legal drama is directed by Suparn Varma with music by Vishal Mishra. Emraan Hashmi, Yami Gautam, Sheeba Chaddha, Aseem Hattangady, Danish Husain, and Vartika Singh portray the major characters. Ikkis / Historical War / November 7, 2025 Directed and written by Sriram Raghavan, ‘Ikkis’ retraces the short yet heroic life of Second Lieutenant Arun Khetrapal, the young soldier who earned the Param Vir Chakra for his bravery in the 1971 war. Bankrolled by Maddock Films, the historical drama features Agastya Nanda as Khetrapal. The other pivotal performances come from Dharmendra, Shree Bishnoi, Jaideep Ahlawat, Sikandar Kher, and Ekavali Khanna. Mano Ya Na Mano – Anything Is Possible / Sci-fi / November 7, 2025 From SCI FI Indian Films and Falling Sky Entertainment comes ‘Mano Ya Na Mano – Anything Is Possible’. Besides directing the cerebral science-fiction drama, Yogesh Pagare also wrote it with Jerome Bixby. The story begins with a seemingly ordinary house party, a joint celebration of Vansh Mehta’s birthday and history professor Manav Kumar’s farewell, which turns extraordinary when Manav discloses his astonishing secret: he has not aged since forty and has lived on Earth for 14,000 years. The ensemble cast includes Hiten Tejwani, Shikha Malhotra, Rajiv Thakur, Nihar Thakkar, Pournima Navani, Hansi Shrivastava, and Sanjeev Srikar, with music composed by Siddharth Saha. De De Pyaar De 2 / Romantic Comedy / November 14, 2025 Helmed by Anshul Sharma, ‘De De Pyaar De 2’ is a follow-up to the 2019 hit. With writing by Tarun Jain and Luv Ranjan, the comedy film is brought to life by Luv Films and T-Series Films. The movie stars Ajay Devgn, Rakul Preet Singh, R. Madhavan, Jaaved Jaaferi, Meezaan Jafri, and Gautami Kapoor. The sequel revisits the world of Ashish Mehra, a 52-year-old London-based investor who sets out to win over the family of his 26-year-old girlfriend, Ayesha Khurana. What begins as a polite family visit turns into a battle of egos when Ashish finds himself out-aged by Ayesha’s father, Dev, sparking a string of awkwardly funny encounters. Taking charge of the musical score are Hitesh Sonik and Ariyan Mehedi, with songs by Yo Yo Honey Singh, Jaani, Payal Dev, Avvy Sra, and Sagar Bhatia. Agra / Psychological Drama / November 14, 2025 Saregama India Ltd, UFO Production, and O28 Films join forces to bring ‘Agra’ under the direction of Kanu Behl, who wrote it with Atika Chohan. The narrative centers on Guru, a lonely call center employee trapped between the claustrophobia of his family home and the false intimacy of digital life. His frustrations twist into delusion and self-destruction, capturing the raw ache of isolation in the urban middle class. The drama film features Priyanka Bose, Ruhani Sharma, Sonal Jha, Aanchal Goswami, Vibha Chibber, and debutant Mohit Agarwal in key roles. Karan Gour’s music heightens the unsettling tone. Kaal Trighori / Horror Thriller / November 14, 2025 Backed by Navin Productions, ‘Kaal Trighori’ flourishes with Nitin N. Vaidya as its director and writer. Arbaaz Khan, Rituparna Sengupta, Aditya Srivastav, Mahesh Manjrekar, Rajesh Sharma, and Mugdha Godse lead the ensemble. The horror film weaves a supernatural thriller around a rare cosmic phenomenon that reawakens Trighori – a mythical dark force tied to an ancient curse. As three fateful nights converge, the lives of three people unravel in a descent into fear and fate. Amar Mohile crafts the ominous background score. Mastiii 4 / Dark Comedy / November 21, 2025 The fourth entry in the Masti franchise marks Milap Zaveri’s takeover as both writer and director, following Indra Kumar’s stewardship of the earlier instalments. Six major banners, including Berkeley Media Group, Cine1 Studios, M Four Film, Maruti International, T-Series Films, and Waveband Productions, unite for the project. This chapter follows three disillusioned husbands who, weary of their monotonous marriages, hatch a daring plan for freedom, only to find that liberation comes with its own chaos. The ensemble features Riteish Deshmukh, Aftab Shivdasani, Vivek Oberoi, Genelia Deshmukh, Tusshar Kapoor, and Arshad Warsi. Meet Bros handle the soundtrack, while Sanjeev Darshan serves as music director. 120 Bahadur / History War / November 21, 2025 Scripted by Rajiv G. Menon and Sumit Arora, ‘120 Bahadur’ is set against the backdrop of the 1962 Sino-Indian War. It recounts the courage of Indian soldiers defending Rezang La to prevent a Chinese advance into Ladakh. Directed by Razneesh Ghai, the action drama places Ankit Siwach in the lead, joined by Farhan Akhtar, Raashi Khanna, and Vivan Bhatena, with Amitabh Bachchan lending his voice to the narration. The score is composed by Amit Trivedi, while Satish Raghunathan contributes the background music. Excel Entertainment, Ikigai Motion Pictures, and Trigger Happy drive the production. Gustaakh Ishq / Romantic Drama / November 21, 2025 Vibhu Puri takes the director’s seat for ‘Gustaakh Ishq’, a romantic drama he co-wrote with Prasshant Jha. Though the storyline remains under wraps, early hints suggest a tender exploration of love and longing. The film brings together an impressive cast featuring Avar Brar, Naseeruddin Shah, Fatima Sana Shaikh, Vijay Varma, Kamakshi Diwan, Sharib Hashmi, and Rohan Verma. Produced by Stage 5 Productions, it features music by Vishal Bhardwaj. Tere Ishk Mein / Action Romance / November 28, 2025 Starring Dhanush and Kriti Sanon, ‘Tere Ishk Mein’ traces the turbulent relationship between Shankar and Mukti, a love that consumes, transforms, and ultimately redeems. It explores the delicate tension between surrender and selfhood in the spiritual heart of Benaras. Neeraj Yadav and Himanshu Sharma shape the story, screenplay, and dialogue, with Aanand L. Rai directing. Sushil Dahiya and Maahir Mohiuddin round out the supporting cast. Colour Yellow Productions and T-Series oversee the production, with A.R. Rahman orchestrating the music and background score. Final Words The November 2025 slate of Bollywood releases brings together an arresting mix of genres. ‘Ikkis’ and ‘120 Bahadur’ revive India’s wartime valour through narratives that honour courage, sacrifice, and the indomitable spirit of soldiers. While ‘Mano Ya Na Mano – Anything Is Possible’ ventures into the philosophical depths of science fiction, ‘Kaal Trighori’ draws terror from ancient myth and cosmic dread. The unsettling ‘Agra’ peers into fractured minds, while ‘Haq’ dissects the moral complexities of financial injustice in a contemporary legal frame. ‘Gustaakh Ishq’ and ‘Tere Ishk Mein’ dive into love’s emotional intensity, and ‘Mastiii 4’ crafts humour with wild abandon. ‘De De Pyaar De 2’ balances romance and comedy with seasoned charm. Collectively, these titles mirror the evolving horizon of Indian cinema, bolder in form, deeper in storytelling.

title: Legendary actor, former president of the Bangladesh Film Artistes’
body: Legendary actor, former president of the Bangladesh Film Artistes’ Association, and founder of the ‘Nirapad Sarak Chai’ movement, respected Ilias Kanchan Bhai, has been diagnosed with a brain tumor. He is currently undergoing treatment in London. Kanchan Bhai, a socially responsible, skilled organizer and veteran actor, is a true asset to our nation. We sincerely hope he recovers soon and returns to us in good health. – Kanak Chapa

title: The film industry is in this state because he is gone
body: These days, it has become a trend – whenever someone asks about something, people say, It’s happening because he is no longer here. If he were alive, it wouldn’t have been possible. The film industry is in this state because he is gone. We, as humans, hardly appreciate or respect someone while they are alive. But once they are gone, we shower them with love and exaggerated praise.- Bapparaj

title: Moushumi hosts a travel vlog
body: Entertainment Report : Scrolling through social media, it’s common to see actress Moushumi Hamid surrounded by nature-sometimes in Cox’s Bazar, other times in Bandarban. Recently, she was at the Cox’s Bazar beach for the shoot of a 32-episode vlogging show, where she hosts 8 episodes. The show is titled ‘Have You Ever Seen Cox’s Bazar Like This?’ This marks Moushumi’s first experience as a travel vlog host. Laughing over the phone, she said, ‘Outdoor shooting feels like a picnic to me! This time it’s non-fiction vlogging-so it’s even more fun. I’m encountering all kinds of new experiences.’ Looking ahead, Moushumi plans to explore trekking, undiscovered natural spots, and less-visited regions. ‘Beauty isn’t confined to popular tourist destinations-there’s hidden charm in unseen places too,’ she said with confidence. Moushumi continues to act regularly on television. She recently completed shooting for the drama series Bishwas Banam Sarkar, directed by Sakal Ahmed. Her upcoming film Japita Jibon is awaiting release. Based on the novel by Selina Hossain, the screenplay was written by Animesh Aich and Imtiaz Hriday. The government-funded film is directed by Habibul Islam Habib. In the film, Moushumi shares the screen with renowned actor and filmmaker Afzal Hossain-fulfilling one of her long-cherished dreams.

title: Porshi Also amateur actress
body: Entertainment Desk : Porshi is not a regular actress-she acts purely out of passion. Alongside appearing in music videos, she occasionally stars in television dramas. After a brief break, she is now set to appear as a blogger who risks her life just to go viral. The drama, titled ‘Mon Priya’, stars Farhan Ahmed Jovan opposite her and is directed by Mahidul Mahim. Director Mahidul Mahim said, ‘Through this story, we wanted to deliver a strong social message. Nowadays, many people risk their lives just to make videos, which often leads to accidents and fatalities. Our goal is to remind people to take risks for life and for society, not just for the sake of a video.’ Filming for the drama was recently completed. During the shoot, Porshi posted a scene on TikTok, where she is seen filming a risky video at a railway station. At that moment, the drama’s hero, Farhan Ahmed Jovan, intervenes to stop her-and that’s where their story begins. Regarding her acting, Porshi said, ‘If I come across a good story, I have no objection to acting regularly. But if I don’t like the story, I simply say no. I act in dramas when the story feels right.’

title: A new story of love
body: Entertainment Report : Popular small-screen actress Sadia Ayman appears in a new romantic drama titled ‘Khuji Toke’, where she stars opposite actor YashRohan. The drama, centered on a fresh tale of love, is both written and directed by Imraul Rafat. Alongside Sadia Ayman and Yash Rohan, the cast also includes Shahiduzzaman Selim, Saberi Alam, and several others. Recently, the drama was released for viewers on Capital Drama’s YouTube channel. Sadia Ayman shared that she always chooses meaningful and unique stories for her performances. ‘Khuji Toke’ is one such project, with a storyline and character that differ from her previous works. She added that Imraul Rafat is a proven director whose projects always inspire confidence. The production went according to plan, and she believes the story, characters, performances, and direction together will meet audience expectations. Yash Rohan has also expressed optimism about the drama, while director Imraul Rafat feels that ‘Khuji Toke’ will leave a lasting impression on today’s viewers. Meanwhile, apart from ‘Khuji Toke’, Sadia Ayman has recently acted in several other dramas that are scheduled to be released at different times throughout the year.

title: Farin is not satisfied with her acting
body: Entertainment Desk : Farin Khan is currently a well-known name in the television industry. Her interest and dedication on the path to becoming an actress have made her increasingly popular among viewers. Despite having worked in a considerable number of quality projects on both small and big screens, Farin believes that her acting is still not complete, and she needs to push herself further. On this, Farin says, ‘I am the smallest person in the field of acting. I am still learning. I am not satisfied with my acting yet. I have a long way to go. I am trying to do something good.’

title: Focus  on yourself and spread love Sunehra
body: Entertainment Report : Actress Sunehra Binte Kamal, known for her work on both the small and big screens, has earned her place in the media industry in a short time through quality performances. Recently, she received much appreciation for her performance in Tanim Noor’s film ‘Utsab’. Even with her brief appearance in the film, Sunehra managed to capture the audience’s attention. Alongside acting, she remains quite active on social media. From glimpses of her daily life to her travels across the country and abroad-she shares everything with her fans and followers online. This time, however, she shared something more personal. On Thursday midnight, the actress posted a photo of herself with messy hair on Facebook, along with a long caption expressing her feelings. In that post, Sunehra wrote, ‘After finishing my shoot tonight (Thursday) and returning home, I looked in the mirror and was surprised. My hair had become so rough and curly. This new look caught my attention. I thought-sometimes my hair is smooth, straight, and silky; other times, it’s curly. In every hairstyle, I look completely different. Sometimes my sun-tanned skin glows in shades of bronze, and sometimes it’s evenly toned with a light brown hue. I’m amazed at how my face transforms with every new role I play on screen. Just like on screen, I love every version of myself in real life too. Truly, it feels like a kind of magic. These days, I’m trying to become a better version of myself-not to outshine anyone, but for my own growth. So I say, focus on yourself. Accept love, spread love, and stay humble.

title: Three Khans in one frame
body: It’s not a movie trailer or a song – just one photo that has set the internet abuzz. The world’s most popular YouTuber, MrBeast (Jimmy Donaldson), brought together Bollywood’s three legendary stars – Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan, and Aamir Khan – in a single frame. The historic photo was taken at the Joy Forum 2025, held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. On October 16, MrBeast shared the picture on his Instagram Story with the caption: ‘Hey India, shall we all do something together?’

title: Britney Spears furious over ex-husband’s book
body: Global pop star Britney Spears has expressed strong anger over the allegations made against her in her ex-husband Kevin Federline’s new autobiography. On social media platform Instagram, she wrote, ‘My ex-husband’s constant humiliation and emotional abuse are extremely painful and exhausting. I have always wanted to maintain a relationship with my sons – I have requested, even almost begged, for them to be a part of my life. That book’s false stories are being used to make money, and I’m the only one suffering from it. I love my children.’

title: Dangal girl Zaira got married
body: Five years ago, actress Zaira Wasim, who rose to fame with the film Dangal, left the acting industry for religious reasons. Two years ago, she also withdrew from social media. Now, after a long break, she has surprised everyone by returning to Instagram – announcing her marriage. On her Instagram account, she shared two photos – in the first one, Zaira is seen signing her marriage certificate, her hands adorned with mehndi designs and an emerald ring. The second photo captures a beautiful moment from behind the newlyweds – standing together under the moonlit sky.

title: Idhika Pal not interested in marriage
body: Recently, a Facebook page named Incoda TV shared a video of actress Idhika Pal. In the video, she was asked about her thoughts on marriage. In response, the actress said, ‘At the moment, I’m not thinking about getting married. Marriage comes with a lot of responsibilities, so I have no plans to get married right now. That thought is still far away. In the next 10 years, I want to do a lot of work. I want to become a very busy actress whose entire year is filled with work. My main focus now is on my career. Besides, this is not the time to think about my personal life.’

title: Shah Rukh Khan’s 60th Birthday: PVR INOX launches two-week film festival celebrating the superstar
body: NN ONLINE: As Shah Rukh Khan prepares to celebrate his 60th birthday on November 2, fans are being treated to a special cinematic celebration of his legacy — right where it all began: on the big screen. India’s top multiplex chain, PVR INOX, has announced a two-week Shah Rukh Khan Film Festival to honor the actor’s immense contribution to Indian cinema. The festival will begin on October 31 and run across 75 theatres in over 30 cities, giving audiences a chance to revisit some of his most iconic films. Whether as Raj waiting at a station, Rahul with open arms, Kabir Khan leading a women’s hockey team, or Raees challenging the system — Shah Rukh Khan doesn’t just portray characters; he makes them unforgettable. His films are more than just movies — they are emotional milestones that have shaped generations of viewers. The curated film line-up includes:Chennai Express – blending Shah Rukh’s comedic flair with Rohit Shetty’s high-octane action, Devdas – Sanjay Leela Bhansali’s epic tale of heartbreak and longing, Dil Se – a gripping story of love, obsession, and political turmoil, Kabhi Haan Kabhi Na – the endearing journey of a lovable underdog in love, Main Hoon Na – a patriotic action-drama filled with friendship and flair, Om Shanti Om – a reincarnation saga full of nostalgia and 70s-style grandeur, Jawan – SRK’s latest blockbuster that reaffirms his reign over hearts and the box office In a statement, Shah Rukh Khan reflected on the festival “Cinema has always been my home, and watching these films return to the big screen feels like a heartwarming reunion. These movies belong as much to the audience as they do to me. I hope people relive the joy, the music, and the shared magic of these cinematic journeys.” Niharika Bijli, Lead Strategist at PVR INOX Ltd, echoed the excitement: “Shah Rukh Khan is more than a star — he’s a feeling. This festival is our way of celebrating his incredible legacy and the joy he’s brought to audiences over the years.” For fans, this isn’t just about nostalgia — it’s about reconnecting with the moments that made them believe in love, resilience, and cinematic magic. Whether it’s Raj reaching out for Simran, Kabir’s unforgettable pep talk, or Om’s iconic line — “Picture abhi baaki hai mere dost” — the emotions are timeless. With Shah Rukh Khan, the magic of cinema never ends.

title: Dream of Sraboni Sayantony
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : Sraboni Sayantony, a popular singer of present generation known for her beautiful voice and famed for ‘Channel i-Shera Kontho’, has always focused on releasing her own original songs. In the meantime, several original songs sung by Sraboni have already been released. The singer said that she is going to release several more original songs in the future. She has already gone to Rangpur for Puja’s holydays. According to her, she will return to Dhaka in a few days and lend her voice to some new original songs. In the meantime, a song titled ‘Puja Elore’ was released in her voice during the recent Durga Puja. This song was released on YouTube. The song was written and composed by Punam Mitra. Along with Sraboni Sayantony, Champa Banik, Anyanna and Poonam have also lent their voices to this song. Sraboni said that the song has been receiving a lot of response since its release. However, the song for which she received the most response is ‘Tokei Shudhu Chai’ in her voice. This song was released on YouTube last year. The song was written by Al Amin Jomaddar and Ashik Mahmud. The song has already been enjoyed by millions of viewers. The melody of the song is as sweet as it is sung beautifully by Sraboni and Akash Mahmud. That is why the song has received a great response from the audience. Sraboni Sayantony told this correspondent, “My professional journey in the world of music is not very long. Even then, I received a lot of positive feedback for all the original songs that I have released. But the song I received the most response for is ‘Tokei Shudhu Chai’ song. The lyrics and melody of the song are really wonderful. To be honest, there are some songs I want to sing so that even if I’m never in the music world, the audience will remember me for my songs. My dream is that those who participate in future reality shows will sing the songs I sing. That day I felt like I was able to sing some really good songs.” Sraboni Sayantony is not only excellent in modern songs but also in folk songs. Some folk songs in her voice have been released on YouTube. Runa Laila is Sraboni’s favourite singer. According to her, the moment she met Runa Laila was one of the most memorable moments of her life.

title: Is this a place to earn dollars? – Niloy angry over video leak
body: Entertainment Report : “Are drama shooting sets now becoming a place to earn dollars?” – this is the question raised by actor Niloy Alamgir. The actor has expressed his anger on social media over the recent leak of behind-the-scenes videos of the shooting. In a post on his verified Facebook ID, Niloy wrote, “The producer or channel owner invests money in the drama. They try to withdraw that money from YouTube, TV or branding. The actors, director, production team, and everyone is paid. But even then, many people try to earn dollars by posting BTS (Behind the Scenes) videos on Facebook or YouTube during shooting on the set.” The actor questioned, “How ethical is this? Some say, we are promoting. But if we promote, it should be done with the producer’s permission. Because, the producer knows which promotion is profitable for his drama.” Niloy claims that sometimes some members of the shooting unit secretly open a YouTube channel and upload these BTS videos. Even some assistant directors or assistant cameramen may be involved in this work. Niloy said, “If they can’t collect BTS from the shooting set themselves, they collect BTS from the artistes’ IDs or pages and send them to their secret channels. Whatever they do, the producer is being harmed. Now if any producer takes legal action, who will be in danger?”

title: It will be their sin, nothing will happen to me: Jaya
body: Entertainment Report : According to acclaimed popular actress Jaya Ahsan, “Talent alone does not accomplish much; one must have an unyielding desire to achieve one’s goals. You have to test yourself and move forward. That’s the reason why success will come.” Jaya Ahsan would like to mention her hard work and infinite patience behind her reaching this stage. Jaya said, “For many years in my acting career, I didn’t know the camera angles. Thanks to the skillful guidance of talented directors, I may now have learned the A, B, C, and D of acting.” Jaya recently appeared as a special guest on the twelfth episode of the popular podcast show ‘Behind the Fame with RRK’, produced by Z I Faisal. This special show will be aired on Maasranga TV tonight (October 18) at 9:00pm and also will be broadcast on Radio Din Raat 93.6 FM. Scripted by Rumman Rashid Khan, Jaya said in this podcast, “I live in the past; everything that is old is not just the past. The past is more important to me than that. The past is always a bridge between the present and the future.” It is known in the context of the conversation at the show, Jaya Ahsan’s house has about 200-year-old cabinets. It is still kept in the same room. There is still also a bed where she was born. Regarding bullying on social media, Jaya said, “I don’t read the comment boxes on social media that way. But when I do, I feel bad for those people who are leaving an indecent comment in the world. Those who enjoy spreading bad words, they may leave this world one day, but the words will remain. It will be their sin, nothing will happen to me.”

title: MTV shutting down after 40 years
body: Agencies : The journey of the American-based television channel MTV (Music Television), which has been a symbol of music and youth culture, is coming to an end. However, all five of its channels that will be closed are from the UK branch. They include – ‘MTV Music’, ‘MTV 80s’, ‘MTV 90s’, ‘Club MTV’ and ‘MTV Live’. Paramount Global, the owner of MTV, has announced that these channels will be off the air from December 31 of this year. They said that they have planned to reduce the size of the television network and increase investment in digital platforms from now on. MTV’s journey began in the United States in 1981 with the slogan ‘I want my MTV’. Later, it spread all over the world. It began broadcasting in the UK in 1997 and in India in 1996. This channel was once a symbol of music, fashion and lifestyle for young people. But times have changed. In the age of YouTube, Spotify and social media, viewers have moved away from television. Former MTV video jockey Simone Angle said, “It’s a difficult time. MTV wasn’t just about music, it was about dance, fashion and the meeting place for young people.” However, ‘MTV India’ is still operating in India, where popular reality shows like ‘Roadies’ and ‘Splitsvilla’ are still favorites of young viewers, and the channel has maintained its popularity, at least to some extent.

title: Tom Cruise, Ana de Armas break up amid wedding rumours
body: Hollywood’s most talked about couple, Tom Cruise and Ana de Armas, have broken up after dating for less than nine months. According to a report by British newspaper ‘The Sun’, the two stars have mutually decided to remain ‘just friends’. The news comes at a time when there were rumours of them working together in a film. There were even rumours of their ‘space wedding’ or getting married in space. both Tom (61) and Anna (36) had realised that the ‘romantic attraction’ in their relationship had waned.

title: Meta AI will respond to Deepika’s voice
body: Bollywood actress Deepika Padukone is set to take on a new role as the voice of Meta AI, the artificial intelligence platform of Meta Platforms, the parent company of Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. Deepika is the first Indian star to be the voice of Meta AI. She recently announced her new journey on social media. In a video posted on Instagram, Deepika is seen recording her voice in a studio. There, Deepika says to her fans, “Hi, I’m Deepika Padukone, now I’m the new voice of Meta AI.”

title: EC investigating fake voter cards in names of 3 heroines
body: Three popular South Indian actresses, Tamannaah Bhatia, Samantha Ruth Prabhu and Rakulpreet Singh, have been embroiled in controversy over the upcoming by-elections in Telangana, India. The Election Commission (EC) of that country has launched an investigation after fake voter cards were circulated in their names in the Jubilee Hills assembly constituency. Voter cards with the names and pictures of three heroines went viral on social media. Addresses of all three are the same, which has further raised suspicions.

title: Shilpa will not testify against her hubby
body: Bollywood actress Shilpa Shetty and her businessman husband Raj Kundra are facing legal troubles again after being involved in a fraud case worth around Rs 60 crore. Recently, in a hearing in the Mumbai High Court, the court sternly told Raj and Shilpa, “First deposit Rs 60 crore, then you can go abroad.” After the court’s order, their foreign trip was postponed. In August this year, a Mumbai businessman filed a case against Raj and Shilpa for allegedly defrauding them of Rs 60 crore. In September, the Mumbai Police issued a ‘look out notice’ against them, preventing them from leaving the country without the permission of the court.

title: Tania Brishty’s new dramas one after another
body: Sheikh Arif Bulbon : Tania Brishty is one of the most popular TV drama actresses of this generation. She is one of those who are busy acting in solo dramas recently. Her solo dramas are constantly being released one after another. Brishty starred dramas ‘Jamai Bou Batpar’ and ‘Panu Hates Ranu’, directed by Masud Rana Anik; and ‘Dadir Dadagiri’, (director: Shahid Un Nabi). In the meantime, her acted more dramas – Mitul Khan directed ‘Sweet Premik’, Mohin Khan’s ‘Kabin er Bojha’ and Jakiul Islam Ripon’s ‘Rege Gelam To Here Gelam’ have also been released. Niloy Alamgir acted opposite Tania Brishty in this drama. Therefore, a few days ago, a drama titled ‘Joyeetar Dinratri,’ directed by Tuhin Hossain, was released in which Brishty played the title role. It was a female-led drama, which is why playing the role of Joyeeta was challenging for Tania Brishty. Still, she is receiving great response for her performance in it. Besides, under the direction of Sohel Rana Emon, Tania Brishty and Partho Sheikh acted in a drama titled ‘Ei Shohore Meghera Eka’. Brishty was also highly praised for her performance in this drama. Therefore, she is gradually getting positive response for her acted other released dramas. Tania Brishty told this correspondent, “The drama ‘Joyeetar Dinratri’ was a drama with a completely different story. I put in a lot of effort to play the role of Joyeeta. I am getting a very good response for the drama ‘Ei Shohore Meghera Eka’. To be honest, I am getting the opportunity to work in many good story based dramas at this time. I have the opportunity to work in challenging roles. This is a very good thing for me. After a lot of hardship and struggle, today, Alhamdulillah, I have been able to come to a good position as an actress. The audience enjoys every drama I act in with great interest, and after watching the dramas I act in, they express their loves for me — that’s what I really wanted. I actually try to work on good dramas for the audience. Now I can choose the story myself. I work if I like it, I don’t work if I don’t like it. This is the story of freedom in choosing artistes. All artistes want this. Some people get that opportunity in their lives, while others don’t. I’m sincerely grateful to those who are now working with me regularly because they are giving importance to my wishes. That gives me the opportunity to do good works.”

title: Occasionally weight increases and decreases: Srabanti
body: Entertainment Desk : Popular Bengali actress Srabanti Chatterjee recently spoke openly about her appearance or look. In a podcast, she clearly stated that she has not undergone any kind of surgery to maintain her beauty. In response to the presenter’s question, Srabanti said, “I am the way God made me. Sometimes I gain and lose weight. Besides, my face will remain the same. I haven’t had surgery until now, so I am the same.” The candid actress also said about her lack of change, “So how can I change?” When the presenter asked about taking help from Botox to enhance her beauty, Srabanti said that she is very afraid of injections. Although she didn’t completely rule out the possibility for the future. She said, “I am very afraid of injections, I will try it in the future, but I have not done it yet.” Srabanti is currently in the news for both her work and personal life. Her direct comments have quickly spread online, which is being discussed among her fans.

title: Runa Laila’s 60 on Maasranga TV
body: Entertainment Report : Legendary artiste Runa Laila is celebrating 60 years of her musical career. She started her musical journey by singing in the Urdu film ‘Jugnu’ in 1965. Since then, she has sung more than 10,000 songs. Runa has done playbacks singing in Bengali, Hindi and Urdu films. She has presented many popular songs. Her fame for her extraordinary singing has spread across the subcontinent. Runa Laila received the Swadhinata Padak, the country’s highest civilian honour. She has received the National Film Awards seven times. She has received numerous other awards at home and abroad. This legendary artiste recently appeared as a guest on Maasranga TV’s ‘Star Night’ programme to celebrate her 60 years in musical career. In the show, she talks about various events and experiences of her colourful career. Along with the local artistes, she has worked with many famous artistes and composers from India and Pakistan. Some of them spoke about Runa Laila, which will be shown in the programme. In addition, the programme will also feature talks from Runa’s friends and relatives, and will include information about her favourite songs and artistes. Many rare photos from Runa’s personal album will be on display at this show. The programme ‘Star Night’, scripted by Rumman Rashid Khan and presented by Mousumi Mou, is produced by Ajay Poddar. It will be aired tonight ( October 17) at 9:00pm.

title: Chanchal starts shooting for ‘Shekor’
body: Entertainment Report : Chanchal Chowdhury has started shooting for his latest Tollywood venture ‘Shekor’, directed by noted filmmaker Bratya Basu. The film went on floors recently, and Chanchal joined the shoot on Monday in Birbhum, Kolkata. Film ‘Shekor’ is inspired by Bibhutibhushan Bandopadhyay’s short stories ‘Drabmoyeer Kashibash’ and ‘Dadu’. The story centres on the lives of elderly men and women from two rural communities. Actor Loknath Dey portrays the elderly man, while Seema Biswas plays the elderly woman. Chanchal takes on the role of Loknath’s son, with Poulami Basu appearing as his wife. Speaking to the Indian media, Chanchal shared that the film beautifully captures a father-son relationship that deeply resonates with him. He said, “My character’s father reminds me a lot of my own father because he suffers from dementia – he forgets everything within moments. My father, too, struggled with this illness in the later years of his life. Another reason I wanted to do this film is Bratya Da (Bratya Basu). Working with him feels very comforting, and that deeply draws me in.” The cast of ‘Shekor’ also includes Ambarish Bhattacharya, Riddhi Sen, Angana Roy, Anasuya Majumdar, Anujay Chattopadhyay, and Narayan Goswami. The film is produced by Firdausul Hasan and is expected to hit theatres in March next year.

title: Amitabh joins the ‘Labubu’ trend
body: Bollywood legend Amitabh Bachchan has joined the internet’s latest trend, the ‘Labubu’ craze. Over the past few months, these strange, cute, yet slightly spooky-looking dolls have become very popular among celebrities. Big B joined the trend by sharing a short video from inside his car on his Instagram handle. In video, a Labubu doll is seen adorning the front of his car. In his familiar, serious voice, the actor introduces the doll to his fans and says, “Ladies and gentlemen, here is Labubu. Now in my car.”

title: What Sonakshi says about pregnancy rumours
body: Bollywood’s star couple Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal has now come to the centre of discussion to become parents. This is a buzz in Bollywood now. The discussion started recently around Sonakshi-Zahir’s appearance at a fashion show. Sonakshi was dressed in a red anarkali. But what caught everyone’s attention was her veil. The veil came down from her shoulders in such a way that many felt like she was trying to hide her stomach area. The actress clearly stated that she has found a way to distance herself from these wrong practices at the moment.

title: Mahi gives good news to fans amid rumours
body: For a long time, there have been rumours in entertainment world about the relationship between actress Mahiya Mahi and her husband Rakib Sarkar. The actress herself announced her separation a year and a half ago. Since that, Mahi has not been seen in public with her husband. She appeared with good news for her fans about a new movie. She is going to show a different side to the audience with her new movie ‘Antarayami’ directed by Saikat Nasir. Mahi clearly stated that although this movie is the sequel to her superhit movie ‘Agni-2’.

title: Apu celebrates birthday by cutting cake with son
body: Popular Dhallywood’s actress Apu Biswas’s birthday was today October 11. This actress has worked in more than a hundred films in her career. After passing 36 years of life, she is now 37. A special moment came for the heroine at the beginning of her birthday because at that time, her only son Abram Khan Joy wished her mother a happy birthday by cutting a cake.

title: Bonolota Express: Tanim Noor Takes Humayun Ahmed’s Classic to Cineplexes
body: Tanim Noor to Bring Humayun Ahmed’s Kichukkhon to Life on the Big Screen with Bonolota Express. After the acclaim of Utsab, Noor announced the project in a 52-minute Facebook motion video, revealing that Bonolota Express is an adaptation of Humayun Ahmed’s novel. The film stars Mosharraf Karim, Chanchal Chowdhury, Shariful Razz, and Sabila Nur, with one more major character kept under wraps. Principal photography is planned to begin in December across Dhaka and exterior locations, with a significant sequence on a train. Eid-ul-Fitr 2026 is the targeted release window. The collaboration marks a reunion for Karim and Chowdhury, who previously shared the screen in Television.

title: Stop it, focus on your work: Sonakshi
body: Bollywood actress Sonakshi Sinha and her husband Zaheer Iqbal have come under fire again over some pictures of Abu Dhabi’s Sheikh Zayed Mosque. Recently, they visited the mosque and posted some pictures of their visit on social media. The real controversy started after pictures were posted. In one of the many pictures, they were seen walking on the mosque premises in shoes. The netizens went into a frenzy after seeing this picture. Addressing the critics, Sonakshi wrote, “Please take a good look. We walked outside the mosque wearing shoes. We didn’t go inside main building of the mosque wearing shoes. We had taken off our shoes at a certain place before entering the mosque. That’s all we have. Now you guys stop.”
